title_en: Barrier gate alarm column
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a barrier gate alarm column which comprises a box body and a blocking body, wherein one side of the box body is provided with a height-adjustable installation column, the upper end of the installation column is hinged with a swinging rod through a locking rod, a monitoring part is arranged on the swinging rod, the front surface of the box body is provided with a display screen through a connecting bracket, the top of the box body is provided with an audible and visual alarm, and a photovoltaic panel is arranged on the swinging rod. The utility model can monitor the obstacles in the flat road blind area of the uphill exit of the underground parking garage in real time, synchronize the image information to the display screen, and simultaneously remind the driver in time through the audible and visual alarm to assist the driver in judging whether the vehicle passes safely, effectively reduce collision risk and improve passing safety.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning system for foreign matters on locomotive roof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent monitoring and early warning system for locomotive roof foreign matters, and belongs to the technical field of railway safety monitoring. The system comprises an image acquisition assembly, an embedded processor case, a spatial registration module, a heterogeneous calculation module, a chip acceleration card, an alarm execution terminal and a mobile communication module, wherein the image acquisition assembly comprises at least two high-definition cameras, each camera is internally provided with a protocol coding chip and outputs compressed video streams, the embedded processor case is connected with the cameras through an industrial Ethernet switch, a physical storage module is integrated in the case, the vehicle type standard image data are pre-stored, the spatial registration module is used for realizing a coordinate mapping circuit by the chip, inputting real-time video streams and outputting registration image signals, the heterogeneous calculation module is provided with the chip acceleration card, the registration image signals are input and foreign body position digital signals are output, and the alarm execution terminal comprises an audible and visual alarm and a field triggering alarm and a mobile communication module, and converts the foreign body position digital signals into wireless network data packets. The utility model constructs a scheme with high robustness, high efficiency and high expansibility, and replaces the manual inspection and the traditional low-efficiency mode of static detection.
assignees: BEIJING LINGHANG HUIZHI TECH CO LTD;FENGTAI LOCOMOTIVE DEPOT CHINA RAILWAY BEIJING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Audible and visual alarm device for invasion of foreign matters in distribution box
abstract_en: The audible and visual alarm device for intrusion of foreign matters in the distribution box comprises a control unit, a multi-sensor module, an audible and visual alarm module, a power management module and a wireless communication module, wherein the multi-sensor module is electrically connected with the control unit, the audible and visual alarm module is electrically connected with the control unit, the power management module is respectively electrically connected with the control unit, the multi-sensor module, the audible and visual alarm module and the wireless communication module, the wireless communication module is electrically connected with the control unit, and the multi-sensor module comprises an infrared correlation sensor array, a microwave radar sensor and a pressure sensing film. The utility model aims to solve the problems of untimely, inaccurate and high false alarm rate of the conventional distribution box foreign matter monitoring, and provides a device capable of accurately and reliably monitoring the invasion of the foreign matters in the distribution box in real time and timely giving out audible and visual alarms so as to ensure the safe and stable operation of the distribution box and reduce the power failure risk caused by the invasion of the foreign matters.

title_en: AI Camera based Warning and Alarm System to Prevent Accidents in Blind Spots
title_ko: Ai 카메라 기반 사각지대의 사고방지를 위한 경고 및 알람 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 카메라 기반 사각지대의 사고방지를 위한 경고 및 알람 시스템 에 대한 것으로서, 사각지대가 형성될 수 있는 교차로 일측에 설치되어, 감지 반경 내 차량 및 보행자를 360도 화각으로 실시간 탐지하는 AI 카메라에 적용된 AI 엔진 모듈, 탐지된 방향에 따라 시각적 경고를 제공하는 점멸부, 탐지된 대상 유형과 방향에 따라 청각적 경고를 제공하는 스피커부 및 탐지 결과를 기반으로 점멸부와 스피커부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: A device and method for guiding a visually impaired person who has stepped on a braille blocks at a bus stop to move to a safe area
title_ko: 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 시각 장애인에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 시각 장애인에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 탑승 대기자에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치는 적어도 하나의 압력 센서 및 상기 적어도 하나의 압력 센서에 의해 감지된 압력 값을 경보 장치로 전송하는 무선 송신부를 포함하며, 상기 버스 정류장과 차도 사이에 배치된 점자 블록; 및 상기 무선 송신부로부터 상기 압력 값이 수신되면, 탑승 대기자에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고등 및 경고음을 출력하는 경보 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Be used for not wet of urine is an intelligent gateway system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of diaper, in particular to an intelligent gateway system for diaper, which is used for acquiring diaper humidity data in real time through a humidity sensor, automatically triggering an alarm instruction by a control core module based on a preset threshold value or an algorithm, realizing that a guardian can accurately perceive the diaper saturation state without manual inspection, ensuring the accessibility of information under different environments by multi-mode reminding of the alarm module, simplifying the operation flow by one-key alarm elimination design of a key interaction module, preventing equipment damage risk by a voltage abnormality protection mechanism of a power supply module from a hardware level, integrating humidity monitoring, intelligent alarm, man-machine interaction and power supply protection, remarkably reducing the leakage rate of manual monitoring, reducing skin health hidden trouble caused by traditional diaper replacement delay, and solving the technical problems that a guardian is difficult to discover whether the diaper is saturated or leaked in time and replace in time in the use process of the conventional diaper.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGKE JIAHE SHUZHI MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety anti-collision early warning device for construction vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of construction safety protection, in particular to a safety anti-collision early warning device for a construction vehicle, which comprises four mounting pieces, wherein the front sides of the upper parts of the mounting pieces are respectively provided with a fixing piece, the fixing pieces are rotatably provided with back buckles, the back sides of the back buckles are provided with bumps, the back buckles are convenient for operators to toggle, torsion springs are connected between the back buckles and the fixing pieces, and a mounting frame is arranged between the fixing pieces and used for further fixing the mounting frame. The integrated high-precision millimeter wave radar can effectively detect obstacles in blind areas and link the acousto-optic alarm to perform multi-stage early warning, so that situation awareness is greatly improved, the spring damper and inclined plane anti-collision frame structure can actively absorb energy and buffer when collision occurs, impact force is obviously reduced, the safety of construction vehicle operation is improved in an omnibearing manner, and personnel and equipment assets are protected.
assignees: JIANGSU TRANSP ENGINEERING GROUP CO LTD;JIANGXI TRANSP INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Personnel positioning and overtemperature early warning bracelet for high-temperature area of metallurgical workshop
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metallurgical safety, and discloses a personnel positioning and overtemperature early warning bracelet for a high-temperature area of a metallurgical workshop. The personnel positioning and overtemperature early warning bracelet for the high-temperature area of the metallurgical workshop has the advantages of good warning effect, convenience in crisis management and the like, and solves the problems that once high-temperature dangerous situations or other emergency situations occur, the environment temperature of the personnel cannot be monitored in real time, all operation time periods are difficult to cover by regular inspection, monitoring blind areas exist, the personnel position is difficult to be mastered in time by management personnel, the rescue efficiency is low, and the optimal rescue opportunity is delayed.
assignees: Shiheng special steel group co ltd

title_en: Audible and visual alarm and emergency ventilation module for environment parameter abnormality of henhouse
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of audible and visual alarm and emergency ventilation modules, in particular to an audible and visual alarm and emergency ventilation module for abnormal environmental parameters of a henhouse, which comprises a henhouse body, wherein a power supply box, an audible and visual alarm and a sensor mounting groove are respectively arranged on one side of the henhouse body, an air inlet component is arranged on the right side of the henhouse body, an air outlet component is arranged on the left inner wall of the henhouse body, and an exhaust fan is arranged on the left outer wall of the henhouse body. This device accessible all sets up the filter screen that can dismantle at the air intake of chicken coop and air outlet and filters the gas of business turn over chicken coop, reduces external dust and gets into the chicken coop and produce the influence to the internal environment of chicken coop, and simultaneously when the unusual emergent ventilation of humiture starts, but the outside of inside filter screen sets up reciprocating sliding cleaning brush, thereby avoids the chicken feather to receive the influence of emergent ventilation to remove filter screen department along with the air current and jam filter screen or fan, improves the inside ventilation effect of chicken coop, and then better satisfies the demand of the emergent ventilation of chicken coop.
assignees: SICHUAN CHUNZHEN AGRICULTURAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent construction alarm equipment for construction site
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a construction site intelligence construction alarm device, including the control case and insert the ground pole, be equipped with the controller in the control case, the top fixed mounting of control case has loudspeaker, infrared range finder and LED alarm lamp, the lateral wall left and right sides of inserting the ground pole all is equipped with the slot, the bottom left and right sides of control case all fixed mounting has the fixed plate, be equipped with the slide opening on the fixed plate, the inside wall slidable mounting of slide opening has the inserted bar, integrated into one piece has the ring on the lateral wall of inserted bar, this patent is through all installing the fixed plate in the bottom left and right sides of control case, be equipped with the inserted bar through spring control on the fixed plate, the left and right sides of inserting the ground pole all is equipped with the slot, the elasticity of accessible spring makes the inserted bar peg graft in the slot, and then accomplish the control case and insert the ground pole and be connected, when whole transportation carries, only need make the inserted bar break away from the slot alright accomplish the dismantlement of control case and inserting the ground pole, the holistic dismantlement of being convenient for, holistic occupation space is reduced, do benefit to holistic carrying.

title_en: AI-based Customized Emergency Alert System for the Hearing Impaired
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 ai 기반 맞춤형 비상 알림 시스템
abstract_ko: 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 AI 기반 맞춤형 비상 알림 앱에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 AI 기반 맞춤형 경보, 긴급 구조 요청 자동화, 대피소 및 AED 위치 안내, 다국어 및 수어 지원의 기능을 제공한다. 특히, AI 알고리즘을 활용하여 사용자 개인의 위치, 행동 패턴, 선호도를 학습하고 이를 기반으로 불필요한 알림을 최소화하며, 중요한 경보만 선별적으로 제공한다. 긴급 상황 발생 시, 단일 버튼 조작만으로 구조대에 위치 정보와 상황이 자동으로 전달되어 신속한 구조 요청이 가능하다. 또한, 사용자에게 재난 상황에 맞는 색상, 진동, 플래시 패턴을 통해 직관적인 정보를 제공하여 재난 인지 속도를 높인다. 대피소와 AED 위치 정보는 실시간으로 업데이트되며, 다국어 번역과 수어 영상 지원으로 외국인 및 청각장애인의 접근성을 대폭 향상시킨다. 이러한 기능을 통해 재난 대응에서의 정보 접근성을 높이고, 보다 안전하고 신속한 대처를 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Storage fire alarm device based on multisensor fuses
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a storage fire alarm device based on multi-sensor fusion, which belongs to the technical field of multi-sensor fusion and comprises a mounting seat, wherein six mounting bolts are fixedly connected inside the mounting seat, an annular shell is fixedly connected to the top of the mounting seat, and a plurality of detection ports are formed in the annular shell; according to the utility model, the detection ports are arranged, the annular shell surface is provided with the plurality of detection ports distributed in multiple directions, so that multiple monitoring sensing channels can be formed, the problem of blind areas of traditional single-point detection of the device can be avoided as far as possible, the interception net sleeved outside the detection ports can prevent sundries such as dust particles from entering the device, meanwhile, the maintenance frequency is reduced, the threaded screw rod can be driven to rotate by the driving motor, the automatic lifting of the mounting table can be realized by matching with the guide rod, and the installation, replacement or maintenance of external sensors of different types by firefighters are facilitated.

title_en: Electrical cabinet monitoring and fire extinguishing equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to electrical cabinet monitoring and fire extinguishing equipment which comprises an infrared area temperature sensor, an ultraviolet light sensor, an infrared light sensor, a fire extinguishing device and a controller. The infrared area temperature sensor is used for scanning the temperature field of the inner area of the cabinet in real time, the area monitoring replaces a point type probe, the covering capacity and the early warning precision are improved, and the blind area and the missing detection probability are reduced. When the temperature of a certain area exceeds a preset temperature threshold, the controller judges that the temperature is abnormal, at the moment, the ultraviolet band spectrum and the infrared band spectrum in the gas holder are acquired through the ultraviolet light sensor and the infrared light sensor, the characteristic spectrum of the real flame can be identified, false alarm caused by non-fire factors is avoided, and accurate identification of fire is enhanced. When a fire source appears in the electrical cabinet, the controller can complete accurate decision under no intervention, and is linked with automatic fire extinguishing equipment, so that the intervention is completed at the initial stage of fire, and the accident loss and the diffusion risk are obviously reduced.

title_en: Intelligent zebra stripes early warning system for visual blind areas of construction channels based on video identification
abstract_en: The intelligent zebra stripes early warning system for the visual blind areas of the construction channels based on video identification comprises a video data acquisition module, a data analysis module and an on-site execution module, wherein the video data acquisition module comprises one or more high-definition cameras, the data analysis module comprises an AI edge calculation box, the on-site execution module comprises an integrated controller and an IP network horn, the integrated controller and the AI edge calculation box are installed in an office area, the IP network horn is fixed at the top of a gate of the office area, the AI edge calculation box is connected with the high-definition cameras through signal matching, the AI edge calculation box is connected with the integrated controller in a wired mode, and the integrated controller is provided with a wireless transmission module connected with the IP network horn. The system has intelligent sensing and early warning capability, can know the conditions of people and vehicles constructing the visual blind area of the channel in real time according to the video recognition technology, actively prevents collision between people and vehicles, and avoids collision accidents caused by the response delay of the visual blind area or a driver.

title_en: Dampproofing case of electronic component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic element moisture-proof box, belongs to the technical field of electronic element moisture-proof boxes, and solves the problems that in the use of the electronic element moisture-proof box, core elements such as a humidity sensor or an MCU are aged/damaged, so that the monitoring precision is misaligned, the display humidity is normal but the actual humidity deviates from a set value and is false, the reading of the sensor is abnormal, and a dehumidification system is stopped prematurely or runs continuously and excessively. Comprises a dampproof box body of an electronic element. According to the utility model, the reference humidity sensor sealed in the constant drying environment is introduced to provide the reference signal with high stability, the deviation between the output signal of the main sensor and the reference signal is compared in real time, and the audible and visual alarm is immediately driven to give out a warning when the deviation exceeds the preset tolerance, so that a user can timely detect the drift fault of the sensor, and the problems of out-of-control humidity in the box or abnormal operation of the dehumidification system caused by blind trust of the misalignment sensor are effectively avoided.

title_en: Track foreign matter monitoring device and unpacking system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tobacco processing equipment, in particular to a track foreign matter monitoring device and a unpacking system, comprising a control module, a visible light image acquisition module, an audible and visual alarm module, a ranging module and a driving module, wherein the control module is used for controlling the track foreign matter monitoring device to be unpacked; the control module is respectively connected with the ranging module, the visible light image acquisition module and the driving module, the audible and visual alarm module is connected with the driving module, the ranging module is used for detecting the distance between the track foreign matter monitoring device and the vehicle in real time and outputting a trigger signal when detecting that the distance is larger than a preset threshold value, the visible light image acquisition module is used for acquiring image data of the track after receiving the trigger signal, the control module is used for detecting the track foreign matter of the image data and sending out a driving signal when detecting the foreign matter, and the driving module is used for driving the audible and visual alarm module to work when receiving the driving signal of the control module.

title_en: Wheelchair with warning part
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wheelchair equipment and discloses a wheelchair with a warning component, which comprises a wheelchair frame, wherein a cushion is fixedly connected to the center of the upper part of the wheelchair frame, handrail frames are respectively welded to the left side and the right side of the wheelchair frame, arm supports are fixedly connected to the top ends of the handrail frames, small wheels are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the bottom of the front end of the wheelchair frame, a large wheel is rotatably connected to the bottom of the rear end of the wheelchair frame, a lighting lamp is arranged, a detachable lighting lamp at the front end of the right handrail frame without blind areas is driven at night, a front path can be illuminated, a user can be prevented from colliding due to unclear vision, the side and the rear of the wheelchair can be prompted to come into contact with a vehicle or a pedestrian, the lighting lamp can be detached through a clamping seat, the handrail frames are not required to be detached during battery replacement or maintenance, the lighting lamp is internally provided with a vibration sensor and a light sensor, and the lighting lamp is bright in daytime, and electricity is saved.

title_en: Method, system and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for providing multimodal services for the hearing impaired
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 멀티모달 서비스를 제공하기 위한 방법, 시스템 및 비일시성의 컴퓨터 판독 가능 기록 매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 태양에 따르면, 청각 장애인을 위한 멀티모달 알림 서비스를 제공하기 위한 방법으로서, MFCC(Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients) 기법에 기초하여 외부에서 입력되는 소리에 관한 특징(feature) 정보를 추출하고, 복수의 마이크에서 획득되는 상기 소리의 수신 시각(time)을 참조하여 상기 소리의 위치를 결정하는 단계, 상기 특징 정보를, CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) 기반의 공간적 특성 분석 모델과 LSTM(Long Short-Term Memory) 기반의 시간적 특성 분석 모델에 입력하여 출력되는 결과를 참조하여 위치별 상기 소리의 종류 및 경고 대상 이벤트 발생 여부를 분류하는 단계, 및 상기 경고 대상 이벤트 발생 여부에 관한 확률이 소정 수준인 것에 대응하여 경고 알림을 생성하는 단계를 포함하는 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Thermal power plant ash storehouse material level monitoring and superbit alarm safety device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a thermal power plant ash bin material level monitoring and oversubstance alarm safety device, which relates to the technical field of monitoring and alarm and comprises a device body, wherein an audible and visual alarm is arranged on the device body, assembly threaded blind holes are formed in four corners of the top end surface of the audible and visual alarm, a fixed support rod is arranged in the assembly threaded blind holes of the audible and visual alarm, a regular hexagon annular plate is arranged on the outer circumference of the lower end of the fixed support rod, threads are formed on the outer circumference of the lower part of the regular hexagon annular plate of the fixed support rod, a threaded column is arranged on the top end surface of the fixed support rod, the fixed support rod is conveniently arranged at the top of the audible and visual alarm to carry out shielding and protection on a shielding circular plate, the shielding and protection on an alarm lamp of the audible and visual alarm are conveniently realized through shielding the shielding circular plate, and the problem that the alarm lamp of the device is not provided with any shielding structure at the top of the alarm lamp is easy to be covered by snow and shielding measures are inconvenient to be additionally arranged at the top of the device is solved.

title_en: Rail-mounted area foreign matter intrusion monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a track area foreign matter intrusion monitoring and early warning system which comprises a plurality of monitoring points arranged along a track at intervals, wherein the monitoring points are provided with vibration sensing modules used for collecting vibration signals in a target track section, image collecting modules used for collecting image signals in the target track section, a data processing module, a track section with a slope, a landslide detection device arranged on the slope corresponding to the track area, a signal input end connected with the signal output end of the landslide detection device, and a dispatching center connected with the signal output end of the landslide detection device in a communication mode. The monitoring and early warning system for the invasion limit of the foreign matters in the track area can monitor whether the foreign matters fall or invade the track area, also monitor landslide conditions and early warn the invasion limit possibly faced by the track area in advance.

title_en: Optical fiber ring temperature monitoring device with warning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical fiber ring temperature monitoring and discloses an optical fiber ring temperature monitoring device with a warning function, which comprises a base, wherein a ceramic support used for bearing an optical fiber ring is fixedly arranged on the base, an inner ring, a middle ring and an outer ring are coaxially arranged on the ceramic support from top to bottom, an FBG temperature sensor I is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the inner ring, an FBG temperature sensor II is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the middle ring, an FBG temperature sensor III is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the outer ring, and the FBG temperature sensor I, the FBG temperature sensor II and the FBG temperature sensor III are connected with an optical coupler through transmission optical fibers in a signal mode. Through setting up FBG temperature sensor one, two, three respectively at ceramic support's inner ring, zhong, outer loop, realize the synchronous monitoring to the different regional temperatures of optic fibre ring, solved traditional single-point monitoring and can't catch the problem of local temperature difference, ensure no temperature monitoring blind area, accurately reflect the whole temperature distribution state of optic fibre ring.

title_en: Method and System for Providing Backup Messages to Wireless Devices During Outages
abstract_en: The method and system of the present invention provides an improved technique for providing email to a wireless device during an outage. Email messages are redirected from the primary email system to a secondary email system during an outage such as, for example, a natural disaster. Email messages are accessible from the secondary email system through a wireless device. A notification message is sent to the user's wireless device alerting them that their email messages are available on the secondary email system through their wireless device. After the termination of the outage, email messages received during the outage are synchronized into the users standard email application.

title_en: Method and system for real-time event journaling to provide enterprise data services
abstract_en: A data management system or “DMS” provides a wide range of data services to data sources associated with a set of application host servers. The data management system typically comprises one or more regions, with each region having one or more clusters. A given cluster has one or more nodes that share storage. To facilitate the data service, a host driver embedded in an application server connects an application and its data to a cluster. The host driver provides a method and apparatus for capturing real-time data modifications and application state notifications and, in response, generating data transactions in the form of an event journal that is provided to the data management system. The driver functions to translate traditional file/database/block I/O into a continuous, application-aware, output data stream. Using the streams generated in this manner, the DMS offers a wide range of data services that include, by way of example only: data protection (and recovery), and disaster recovery (data distribution and data replication).

title_en: Method and apparatus for waking person
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device that can provide ample protection for the hearing-impaired in case of a fire emergency.SOLUTION: A system and method for waking a person includes a system and method for the provision of tactile stimulation in a repeating interrupted pattern upon the detection of an alarm signal indicative of an event for which the person should be awakened. In one embodiment, a device for waking a person comprises: a circuit for generating a driver signal in response to an alarm signal, the driver signal having a repeating interrupted pattern; and an electrically controlled switch having a control input, a power input and a power output, the control input being connected to receive the driver signal from the circuit, the power input being connectable to a power source 400, and the power output being connectable to a tactile stimulation device 440 configured to produce a tactile stimulation.

title_en: Evacuation appliance
abstract_en: An evacuation appliance comprising a mounting plate configured to be connected to a wall, with the mounting plate having a terminal clip. The evacuation appliance further includes a notification device having at least one notification member, with the notification device being configured to be connected to the mounting plate to electronically connect the terminal clip to the at least one notification member to power the at least one notification member. The mounting plate and the notification device comprise an accessible testing system, such that when the mounting plate and the notification device are connected, the notification device can be measured using the accessible testing system to determine if the notification device is properly receiving power from the terminal clip without disconnecting the notification device from the mounting plate.

title_en: Method And Systems For Validating Accessibility And Currency Of Replicated Data
abstract_en: A validation manager comprises a policy engine that stores a data policy for a replica of a data set stored in a network device in a network, wherein the data policy includes a Disaster-Recovery, DR, path type requirement, and a validation engine. The validation engine is arranged to monitor at least one access path associated with the data set stored in the network device, wherein an access path represents a data flow path through a sequence of components including the network device storing the data set and a component storing the replica of the data set, determine a path type associated with each of the at least one access path, wherein the path type represents a sequence of component types corresponding to the sequence of components along the access path and compare the path type associated with each of the at least one access path with the DR path type requirement for the replica of the data set as defined in the data policy. The validation manager further comprises a notification engine that provides a violation notification if the DR path type requirement of the data policy is violated.

title_en: Event communication system for providing user alerts
abstract_en: An event communication system involves facilitating entry by a user of one or more device addresses via a network accessible user interface of the event communication system. The device addresses are associated with alerts provided by the event communication system. Test alert messages targeted for the device addresses are sent via the user interface. The system sends alerts user devices corresponding to the one or more tested device addresses in response to predetermined events. The system may provide user access to historical copies of data relating to the alerts. Registration on the system involves storing a personal identity data of a student on a database and comparing the personal identity data to registration data entered via the user interface. Authentication is automatically provided based on the comparison.

title_en: Testing apparatus for fire warning
abstract_en: A fire detector checking device is provided to check the performance and defect of a fire detector without using a ladder by installing a device for injecting smoke or setting operation temperature conditions of the fire detector, on the front end of a multiple-stage foldable pipe. A fire detector checking device(100) is composed of a support pipe(160) fixed and connected to the tip of an insulating cover(110) and inserted with a power line(122) supplying operating power to a heater(120); a foldable pipe(170) connected to the support pipe and extended or contracted; a power socket(180) disposed at the lower end of the foldable pipe and connected to an external commercial power source; an operating unit(190) installed at the lower side of the foldable pipe to control the operation of the heater; a burned material support plate(125) formed at the upper part of the heater adjacent to an opening of the insulating cover to prevent the inflow of foreign materials; a suction pipe(145) disposed at the outside of the insulating cover and connected to the inside of the insulating cover; a suction fan(140) sucking in the inner smoke of the insulating cover through the suction pipe; and a discharge pipe(150) discharging the sucked smoke to the outside. The fire detector checking device is engaged with the support pipe in an uneven form to adjust the inclination angle of the foldable pipe and rotated about a fixing bolt(165) to easily regulate the angle of the opening of the insulating cover.

본 발명은 화재감지기 점검장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 천장 등에 장착되어 있는 화재감지기의 성능 및 고장여부를 용이하게 점검할 수 있도록 하여 화재발생시 신뢰적으로 경보를 하여 인명피해를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 화재감지기 점검장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 화재감지기가 장착되는 장착면에 밀착되어 상기 화재감지기를 수용하기 위한 종형상의 절연커버와, 상기 절연커버 내부에 코일상으로 장착되는 히터와, 상기 히터의 온도를 감지하게 위한 온도센서를 포함하는 화재감지기 점검장치에 있어서,  상기 절연커버(110)의 첨두에 고정되어 연결되고 내부에 상기 히터(120)에 동작전원을 공급하기 위한 전원선(122)이 삽입되는 지지파이프(160)와, 상기 지지파이프(160)와 연결되어 신장 또는 수축이 가능한 접이식파이프(170)와, 상기 접이식파이프(170)의 하단부에 외부의 상용전원과 연결되기 위한 전원소켓(180)과, 상기 히터(120)의 동작을 제어하기 위해 상기 접이식파이프(170)의 하부에 장착되는 조작부(190)를 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 지지파이프(160)에 상기 접이식파이프(170)와의 기울기를 조절하기 위해 요철(凹凸)형상으로 맞물려 고정볼트(165)를 축으로 회전되어 상기 절연커버(110)의 개구부의 각도를 용이하게 조절하도록 구성되고, 상기 절연커버(110)의 개구부에 인접된 히터(120)의 상부에는 외부의 이물질이 투입을 방지하도록 연소물받침판(125)이 형성되며, 상기 절연커버(110)의 외측에 상기 절연커버(110)의 내부와 관통되게 연결되는 흡입관(145)과, 상기 흡입관(145)를 통해 절연커버(110)의 내측의 연기를 흡입하기 위한 흡입팬(140)과, 상기 흡입된 연기를 외부로 배출하기 위한 배출관(150)을 더 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Location tracking system with interfaces for setting group zones, events and alerts based on multiple levels of administrative privileges
abstract_en: An improved system and method for defining an event based upon an object location and a user-defined zone and managing the conveyance of object location event information among computing devices where object location events are defined in terms of a condition based upon a relationship between user-defined zone information and object location information. One or more location information sources are associated with an object to provide the object location information. One or more user-defined zones are defined on a map and one or more object location events are defined. The occurrence of an object location event produces object location event information that is conveyed to users based on user identification codes. Accessibility to object location information, zone information, and object location event information is based upon an object location information access code, a zone information access code, and an object location event information access code, respectively.

title_en: Crisis communication system and method utilizing group-based message distribution
abstract_en: A system and method of crisis communication includes a plurality of crisis communication points (CCPs) located in geographic dispersed areas unlikely to all be affected by a single disaster, and which are arranged to store messages left by individuals affected by a crisis for retrieval at any time by interested parties who call the CCP. Each individual associated with a subscriber, including family members, friends, and associates, has an individual box accessible through a telephone number coupled with a personal identifier and an optional individual or group password, and may (a) record a message, the message being distributed to all individual boxes in a group, and/or (b) play back messages from other box holders. Any messages recorded in one of the call boxes may be automatically distributed to all other voice mail boxes in the group of personal boxes associated with a contact list or, optionally, limited to selected personal boxes. Notification of next-of-kin may be facilitated by providing subscribers with a card instructing officials/medical personnel to contact a CCP and leave a message for automatic distribution to next-of-kin personal boxes.

title_en: The apparatus recognition to operate a every conditions
abstract_en: A recognition apparatus for a deaf driver and a driver who has difficulty in hearing is provided to avoid dangerous states by transmitting visual and tactual signals to eyes and a body of the driver. A plurality of sound sensor units(10) are installed at a front side, a rear side, a left side, and a right side of a vehicle in order to recognize alarm sound at a railroad crossing, siren sound of vehicles, sound of collision, and sound of panic brake. A micom(20) receives audio signals from the sound sensor units and controls a display unit(30) and a vibration unit(40) in order to transmit simultaneously a display signal and a vibration signal to a hearing-impaired driver and a driver who has difficulty in hearing. The display unit includes a plurality of LEDs which are installed at front, rear, left, and right sides of a hands-free and an angular panel. The LEDs of the display are operated in a period of 0.5 to 3 seconds according to a control signal of the micom. The vibration unit includes vibration elements installed at front, rear, left, and right sides of a driver seat in order to generate the vibration according to the control signal of the micom. The LEDs of the display unit are used as a first recognition unit for displaying a level 1 of red color, a level 2 of yellow color, and a level three of blue color according the audio signals of the sound sensor units. The vibration unit is used as a second recognition unit generates the vibration in a period of 0.2 to 0l.8 seconds according to the control signal of the micom.

abstract_en: An apparatus and a method for guiding visually impaired walkers in a mobile terminal are provided to enable a walking stick of the visually impaired to send a dangerous area and transmit a dangerous area sense signal to a mobile terminal so that the mobile terminal generates alarm or vibration to inform the visually impaired accordingly. A mobile terminal checks whether a signal informing that a dangerous area has been sensed is received from an external device(601). When the signal informing that a dangerous area has been sensed is received, the mobile terminal generates alarm or vibration to inform about the sensed dangerous area(603). The signal is received through short-range wireless communication which is one of Bluetooth, Wireless LAN, UWB(Ultra Wideband), IrDA(Infrared Data Association), ZigBee, and RFID(Radio Frequency Identification).
