본 발명은 휴대용 단말기에서 시각 장애우의 보행 안내 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 외부기기로부터 위험지역이 감지됨을 알리는 신호가 수신되는지 검사하는 과정과, 상기 위험지역이 감지됨을 알리는 신호가 수신될 시, 위험지역임을 알리는 알람 혹은 진동을 발생하는 과정을 포함하여, 시각 장애우가 실수로 위험지역을 감지하지 못하여 위험한 상황에 처하는 것을 방지할 수 있다. 
       
     시각장애, 지팡이, 홀소자, 보도블록, 단말기

title_en: Visual handicapped person for crosswalk of safety standby equipment
title_ko: 시각장애인 및 어린이 보호를 위한 횡단 보도의 안전대기장치
abstract_en: A device for guiding the safety zone in a crosswalk for protecting children and blind people is provided to improve reliability and a quality of products by outputting an alarm sound and a message in case that children or blind people are entered into a roadway. A device for guiding the safety zone in a crosswalk for protecting children and blind people includes a first standby zone unit(1) and a second standby zone unit(7). The first and second standby zone units are installed on both ends of a sidewalk respectively. The device for guiding the safety zone outputs an alarming sound and a message by transmitting a detected result of a light emitting unit and a light receiving unit as a detection sensor to a speaker in case that blind people, people who have bad sight, color-blind people or children are deviated from the safety zone and are entered into a roadway.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시각장애인 및 어린이 보호를 위한 횡단 보도의 안전 대기장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 이를 위해 횡단보도가 있는 인도쪽의 양단에 각각 제1대기구역수단(1)과 제2대기구역수단(7)을 설치하여 시각장애인, 저 시력자, 빛깔을 가려내지 못하는 색맹자 또는 어린이 등이 대기 안전 구역을 이탈하여 차도로 진입할 경우 감지센서인 발광부와 수광부의 감지된 결과를 스피커에 전달하여 경고음 및 메시지가 출력되도록 함을 특징으로 구성된다. 
     상기와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 시각장애인, 저 시력자, 빛깔을 가려내지 못하는 색맹자 또는 어린이 등이 대기 안전 구역을 이탈하여 차도로 진입할 경우 경고음 및 메시지로 대기 안전 구역으로 들어갈 수 있도록 하여 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 한 것이며, 이로 인해 제품의 품질과 신뢰성을 대폭 향상시켜 소비자로 하여금 좋은 이미지를 심어줄 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
       
     발광부, 수광부, 스피커, 신호등, 시각장애인, 횡단보도.
assignees: YOO JIN YOL;KIM JUNG HO;KIM DONG CHUN

title_en: Strobe light alarm detection and alert system
abstract_en: A system is disclosed that detects an optical alarm signal, such as a strobe light signal generated by a building alarm system. Upon detecting such a signal, the system generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting an individual who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as an individual who is asleep, hearing impaired, and/or sight impaired. The system may, for example, be implemented as a patient-worn device, a bedside unit, or a personal computer coupled to a light-sensing peripheral device.

title_en: Acousto-optic prompting system for blind and deaf persons
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an acousto-optic prompting system for the blind and deaf, in particular to an answering acousto-optic prompting system for the blind and deaf, which is composed of a voice button, an alarming switch, an alarm, a signal lamp, a voice memory, a box body of a power supply box and a loudspeaker; wherein, the voice button, the alarming switch, the alarm and the voice memory are placed in the box body of the power supply box; the voice button is connected with the alarm; the alarm is connected with the signal lamp; the alarm is connected with the loudspeaker through the voice memory; the alarm is connected with a remote control module through an alarming switch. The utility model aims at providing a safe answering acousto-optic prompting system for the blind and deaf which is conveniently mounted and used and makes the blind and deaf dispersed in time under the condition of emergency when in danger.

title_en: Adaption of emergency calls to the emergency services network based on caller location
abstract_en: The invention includes a technique for integrating emergency calling for VoIP users with legacy emergency services to facilitate adapting to the evolving emergency services network and the services that are available in a given location. Generic location information provided by (or determined for) VoIP emergency callers, typically in civic or geodetic formats, is translated into Emergency Response Locations (ERLs) defining an area, such as an area within an enterprise premises, in which the caller is located. The translated location information is conveyed to the Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) with the emergency call in for form of the ANI (Automatic Number Identification) or calling line identification number. An appropriate route/gateway is then selected to be used to reach the PSAP appropriate for the caller's location, and an emergency call notification to the appropriate local emergency response personnel is generated within the enterprise based on the caller's location.

title_en: Petroleum well drilling engineering accidents early-warning system based on layered fuzzy system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an oil drilling engineering accident early warning system based on a hierarchy fuzzy system. First, a stimulant database for oil drilling engineering accident early warning is created; second, an input variable for oil drilling engineering accident early warning; third, the characteristic information of input signals is analyzed; fourth, a structural model of the hierarchy fuzzy system is created; fifth, an interval mapping and a hierarchy fuzzy reasoning of a unified model are done for the input variable in the third step; sixth, the output quantity of the oil drilling engineering accident early warning system is confirmed; seventh, the self-adjustment of the early warning result is done. The present invention has the advantages that the hierarchy fuzzy system is used to translate the excessive physical variable in the oil drilling engineering accident early warning system into a hierarchy system formed by connecting hierarchically with a reduced dimensionality fuzzy unit, and make the regular number of the fuzzy system increase with the number of the input variable linearly, thereby putting an end to the phenomenal of dimension calamity, and realizing the purpose of early warning for the oil drilling engineering accident accurately, efficiently and conveniently.

title_en: Manufacturing method of inorganic insulating material using waste shells
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing an inorganic insulating material using waste shells is provided to produce the lightweight insulating material which has an improved heat-insulating effect and does not emit harmful materials upon firing. A method for manufacturing an inorganic insulating material using waste shells includes: a pre-treatment step(S110) of removing seawater and foreign substances from the waste shells; a grinding step(S120) of pulverizing the pre-treated waste shells into fine powder; a mixing step(S130) of adding a blowing agent which is an azo di-carbide amide and a dispersing agent to the fine powder, mixing the admixture to obtain an intermediate material, and adding a binder to the intermediate material to obtain a final material; and a molding step(S140) of putting the final material into a mold, and heating the mold to predetermined temperature to obtain a molded material.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 패각을 분쇄하여 분말로 만든 후 적절한 바인더 및 발포제를 혼합하여 일정 틀 속에서 열을 가하여 팽창시킨 뒤 충분히 굳게 만들어 흡음 및 차음효과까지 지닌 무기 보온단열재를 제조하는 폐패각을 이용한 무기보온단열재 제조방법에 관한 것으로써, 현재 우리나라 연안선을 따라 다량으로 발생되고 있지만 처리가 곤란하여 환경에 피해를 입히고 있는 패각을 이용함으로써 자연환경보호에도 일익을 담당할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 기존의 보온단열재를 대체함에 따라 유용한 자원의 절감을 기할 수 있으며, 특히 유기 보온단열재인 EPS나 폴리우레탄에 비하여 연소되지 않는 점은 물론 화재 시에도 각종 유해물질이 발생하지 않아 대형 인명피해의 방지에 도움이 될 수 있다. 
       
     폐패각, 조개껍질, 단열재

title_en: Timing vibration prompt system
abstract_en: The vibration reminding system of the utility model relates to a time control vibration reminding system, which is especially suitable for information exchange and communication of the special groups like deaf-mute and has the effect of reminding through vibration, voice, light and electricity. The structure includes a main control panel, a sub control panel, a voice and light alarm device, a bell, a smoke sensor and a vibrator. The signal input and output ends of the main control panel are connected with the signal input and output ends of the sub control panel. A plurality of sub control panels is provided and mainly controlled by the main control panel. A time program controller is installed on the main control panel and the voice and light alarm device and the bell are connected with the main control panel respectively through the wires. A transfer switch, a main reminding button, a main assembly button, a main calling button and an indicator lamp are installed on the main control panel. A red alarm flash lamp, an indicator lamp, a calling button, a power switch and a power plug are installed on the sub control panel. The bell is connected with the sub control panel through the wires. The smoke sensor is connected with the sub control panel through the wires. The vibrator is connected with the sub control panel through the wires.

title_en: Apparatus for guiding into emergency exit without man and control method therefor
abstract_en: An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit is provided to switch on and off a high-brightness lamp installed at an emergency guide lamp and concentrate the light to guide the emergency exit effectively. An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit connected to a fire alarm system(20) detecting a fire and outputting alarm sound is composed of an interface unit(30) receiving an emergency sensing signal transmitted from the fire alarm system; a memory(200) storing voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit; an auditory guiding unit(300), converting voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit stored in the memory, into a voice signal if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit and then outputting the voice signal; a visual guiding unit(400) turning on and off a lamp(410) if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit; a control unit(100) detecting data in the memory by receiving the emergency sensing signal transmitted through the interface unit, transmitting the data to the auditory guiding unit, transmitting a control signal for switching on and off the lamp to the visual guiding unit, and carrying out operations for driving each component; and a power supply unit(500) having an emergency power unit charged with power supplied from a power source to supply the charged power to the visual and auditory guiding units.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상구 무인유도 장치 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로서, 시각장애인이나 시력이 좋지 못한 대상에게 비상사태 및 비상구를 음성으로 안내하고, 비상구를 안내하는 유도등의 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     상기 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명은, 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 화재경보시스템으로부터 비상감지신호를 전송받아 그에 대응되는 신호를 출력하여 각 구성요소를 작동시키는 제어부와, 비상사태 및 비상구 음성안내 데이터가 사전 저장된 메모리와, 메모리에 사전 저장된 비상사태 및 비상구 안내 데이터를 음성신호로 변환출력하여 비상사태 발생시 시각장애인들의 대피를 돕는 청각유도수단과, 램프에서 발산되는 빛을 점멸 및 집광시킴으로써 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하기 위한 시각유도수단, 및 평상시에 상용전원으로부터 전원을 공급받아 비상용 전원으로 충전하였다가, 비상사태 발생시 전원을 공급하여 청각유도수단 및 시각유도수단을 포함한 각 구성요소를 정상작동시키기 위한 비상전원부를 포함하는 전원공급수단으로 이루어진다. 
       
     음성안내, 청각유도수단, 비상전원부, 무인유도

title_en: System and method of communicating emergency alerts
abstract_en: A set-top box device is disclosed. The set-top box device includes a processor and a memory device accessible to the processor. The memory device includes instructions to communicate with a multi-cast alert server to receive a multicast emergency alert message. The multicast emergency alert message includes data related to a location code and data related to a set-top box action. The memory device stores location information and includes instructions to execute the set-top box action when the location code matches the location information.

title_en: Electronic sound and light alarm bell for bicycle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bicycle electron reputation warning bell has the shell of translucent form on this warning bell, installs one on the lug of its one end and presses pronunciation switch, and this switch is except that easy user's touching is pressed to send out the sound that imitates traditional formula bell work by the pronunciation export of one end, also can be by the light of sending the warning on the shell simultaneously. Therefore, the blind spot on the vision of the rider can be removed, and a safer and more modern warning bell is provided.

title_en: The apparatus recognition to operate a every conditions
abstract_en: A situation recognition apparatus for the deaf and persons who are hard of hearing is provided to enable the deaf to recognize the sound by vibration, words, or sign language and to be compatible with the internal devices of a vehicle at low cost. In a situation recognition apparatus for the deaf and persons who are hard of hearing, plural sound sensor units(10) are installed at the front and rear sides and the left and right sides of a vehicle to let the driver recognize the warning sound of a crossing gate, siren sound of the ambulance, and collision and sudden brake sound. A microcomputer(20) receives a sound signal transmitted to the sound sensor unit and controls a light emitting unit(30), a word and sign language display unit(40), and a vibration unit(50) in order to transmit both a display signal and a vibration signal to the driver at the same time according to each position of the vehicle. The light emitting unit has a detachable light emitting acryl rim installed along the front rim and periphery of an audio system, a navigation, a GPS(Global Positioning System), and a liquid crystal monitor television of a vehicle, and emits the light at the intervals of 0.5~3 seconds by the controls of the microcomputer. The word and sign language display unit converts the warning sound of a crossing gate, siren sound of the ambulance, and collision and sudden brake sound into words or sign language and then displays the words or sign language on the navigation, the GPS, and the liquid crystal monitor television. The vibration unit generates vibration by the controls of the microcomputer by installing vibrating elements at the front and rear sides and the left and right sides of a driver's seat.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애 및 난청인용 상황별 인식장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 청각장애 및 난청이 있는 운전자가 운전중 철도건널목 차단기의 경보음이나, 응급차량(일예 : 응급차, 소방차, 경찰차, 렉카)의 사이렌 소리, 충돌 및 급브레이크 소리를 차량 내부 장치와 호환되면서 운전자의 눈(시각)과 몸(촉각)을 통해 동시에 인식할 수 있도록 음향센서부, 마이컴, 발광부, 문자·수화표시부, 진동부로 구성됨으로서, 저렴한 비용으로 기존의 차량 내부 장치와 호환이 잘 되고, 빠른 반응속도로 인해 운전자가 안전운전을 할 수 있는 청각장애 및 난청인용 상황별 인식장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.  
       
     청각장애, 난청, 마이크로폰, 표시부, 진동부

title_en: Sound type side-walk block
abstract_en: A sidewalk block capable of making a sound is provided to alert a blind person of a starting point, waiting point, transfer point and destination point, as well as to carry electric and communication cables within the sidewalk block by disposing a sounding room within the sidewalk block and conduit lines below the sounding room, thereby assisting blind persons as well as beautifying the city. In a sidewalk block(1) having Braille letters embossed, an empty sounding room(3) is provided inside the block. The sidewalk block can make distinguishing noises depending on the width of the block and thickness of upper surface of the block. Conduit lines are disposed below the sounding room. On each conduit lines, an electric cable and communication cable are separately accommodated. The sounds made from the sounding room are transfer point, waiting point, starting point, and destination point. Each sound is unique. The sidewalk block and the conduit lines are made from materials containing 80 to 85% of polycarbonate by weight, 10 to 15% of rubber by weight, 2 to 5% of Acrylic impact modifier, 1% of UV stabilizer, 0.5% of heat stabilizer, and 0.5% of lubricant by weight.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 발성(發聲)형 보도블록의 제조방법 및 이를 이용한 발성(發聲)형 보도블록에 관한 것으로, 이것은 보도블록 내부에 발성(發聲)공간 즉, 빈 공간을 형성하여 시각장애인이 보행시 지팡이로 두드릴 때 보도블록의 분기점, 대기점, 시발점, 목적지점 등으로 구분된 특유의 소리를 낼 수 있는 길안내기능과 보도블록 하단부분에는 도심 곳곳에 설치된 각종 저압 전기, 통신 케이블을 수용할 수 있는 관로가 구비됨으로써 기존 전주에 시설된 각종 케이블을 지중화하여 도심미관을 깨끗하게 개선할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     시각장애인 보도블록, 발성형 보도블록

title_en: ATM emergency database system for response to duress transactions
abstract_en: A computerized database system and associated process are disclosed for expediting an emergency response to an alarm signal indicative of a duress transaction imposed upon an ATM customer at a particular ATM terminal site. The system comprises an emergency response database stored at a secure location accessible by a bank or other financial service institution hosting the ATM either directly or through a data communications network. The emergency response database is compiled containing coded data indicative of the bank host, the ATM terminal location and respective serial number, customer identification information, and contact information for the designated emergency monitoring center and the appropriate public safety answering point (PSAP) for the given ATM terminal location. The present system enables the bank host through its conventional network processor to identify the victimized ATM customer and the terminal site of the duress transaction upon receipt of the alarm signal and then further access the emergency response database to retrieve the designated emergency monitoring center and appropriate PSAP to contact in relation to the ATM location. The retrieved database information is then forwarded to the designated monitoring center and relayed to the proper PSAP to expedite the dispatch of the authorities to the particular ATM terminal site.

title_en: Voice recognition auto alarm system
abstract_en: An automatic alarm system through voice recognition is provided to protect valuable life and fortune by reporting an emergency status to a safety enterprise or a police station by generating an alarm through an alarm generating device. An automatic alarm system through voice recognition includes a mike(10) and a noise removing unit(115), a tone comparing unit(105), and a warning lighting(50). The mike receives a voice. The noise removing unit removes a noise of the voice received from the mike. The tone comparing unit checks whether or not a voice tone is changed by comparing a received voice tone with a normal voice tone. A user's voice tone is normally stored in a general recording and storing unit. When a voice tone inputted through the mike is suddenly changed to a high voice tone, an emergency signal is transmitted to an emergency operating unit. The warning lighting receives an output signal of the alarm unit and visually recognizes the output signal.

title_en: Geological calamity rainfall monitoring prealarmer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster rainfall monitoring early-warning instrument which is applied to the weather early-warning of geological disaster and can prevent dust and blocking with simple operation. The invention is characterized in that the geological disaster rainfall monitoring and the early-warning are organically combined together, and the early-warning of geological disaster is carried through according to the actual measured rainfall monitoring value. The value of the rainfall is observed via the reading of the liquid surface, and the rainfall intension is monitored via a triangular weir. Foreign matters are prevented to enter a rain bearing mouth to block the pipeline via a steel mesh, and the dust remnant can be prevented via a water discharging device. The instrument has the advantages of simple structure and easy maintenance, the invention is flexible and cheap. The instrument can be used for cluster monitoring and cluster preventing of geological disasters, thereby is suitable for generalization in large scale.

title_en: Environment sensing system for the hearing-impaired
abstract_en: There is provided an environment sensing system for the deaf/hearing-impaired. A user wears a personal unit for notifying him/her of a sound event in its surrounding environment. The personal unit is also in communication with a central station, for the user to request immediate assistance. When receiving a sound event message from a sound detection unit in the environment, the personal unit vibrates and displays a notification on a screen. At any time, the user may request immediate assistance to the central station using push buttons located on the personal unit. The central station may contact the user by displaying inquiries or messages on the screen. The user may then confirm that immediate assistance is actually required or communicate more information to the central station using the push buttons.
assignees: HARMONYA TECHNOLOGIES INC;TAILLEFER ERIC;DURAND SYLVIE;GAGNON NORMAND;PELADEAU MICHEL;ROCHETTE LIONEL

title_en: Emergency warning method and system for warning a caretaker
abstract_en: Emergency warning method and system for warning a caretaker. A position of a subject is determined by receiving an emergency message from a locator (20) upon actuation of an emergency button (21), the emergency message comprising location data and identification data. The identification data and location data are translated in a verbal message, and the verbal message is sent to a personal communication device (16) in the possession of the caretaker after reception of the emergency message from the locator (20).

title_en: The apparatus of recognition a hadicapped person of heraing with sequence control
title_ko: 시퀀스 제어를 통한 청각장애인용 인식 장치
abstract_en: A sound recognition apparatus for a hearing-impaired person is provided to notify a message accurately by registering predetermined sounds and notifying the sounds according to the priority. A sound recognition apparatus for a hearing-impaired person includes a specific sound detector(100) and a notifying unit. The specific sound detector includes a micro sensor unit(110), an amplifier circuit unit(120), a first microcomputer unit(130), and an RF(Radio Frequency) transmitter(140), which are integrated in one module. The specific sound detector detects the specific sound and transmits the detected sound to the notifying unit by using an RF transmission scheme. The sound is converted to an electrical signal. A BLM(Boundary Layer Microphone) reproduces the electrical signal as a sound signal having a frequency within an audible frequency range.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 일상 생활에서 발생하는 중요한 가청음(일예 : 화재 통보기의 경보음，가스 누출 경보기의 경보음，휴대 전화기의 호출음, 팩시밀리 장치의 호출음, 전자레인지의 가열 종료 통보음，세탁기 그 밖의 전기 제품으로부터 발생한 통보음，방문자의 벨 소리)을 청각 장애인이 시퀀스 제어를 통해 시각적, 촉각적 또는 시각적 + 촉각적으로 동시에 인식할 수 있도록, 특정 생활음 검출 수단과, 청각장애인용 통보 수단으로 구성된 청각장애인용 인식장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
       
     가청음, 청각장애인, 마이컴부, 인식 장치

title_en: Security equipment, and security equipment arrangement method
abstract_en: Provided are a security equipment, which is enabled to exhibit high crime-preventing effects in the temporary scaffold of a jobsite or in the blind spot of a building, by threatening a trespasser in a manner to make the trespasser feel anxious or fear and by informing the presence of the trespasser to the circumference, and an arrangement structure for the security equipment.   The security equipment (10) activates a human sensor (18), in case the brightness of the circumference detected by a light sensor (16) is at or lower than a preset level, thereby to decide the presence/absence of the trespasser.  In case the presence of the trespasser is detected by the human sensor (18), a warning is issued by lighting or flashing an illumination light (12) and by generating an alarm sound.  Moreover, the security equipments (10) are so arranged in a predetermined region that at least one of them is activated in case the trespasser (40) trespasses on that predetermined region.

title_en: Emergency warning device for road
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency warning device for a road which is excellent in visibility from the remote place, and which is excellent in the maintenability in component exchange, packing, transport, and assembly or the like for warning the driver of a following car to enter a disaster region or the periphery when any disaster occurs on a blind road.  <P>SOLUTION: This warning device for road is provided with a smoke candle which burns and generates a coloring flame in order to improve visibility. The warning device for road is preferably provided with a warning part with the standing smoke candle in a box-shaped body whose inside is covered with a mirror. Also, this warning device for road is mounted with the plurality of warning devices on a strut, and the warning device for road is installed before a tunnel entrance or a curve entrance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Emergency exit guide and guidance broadcast speaker
abstract_en: A speaker with an emergency exit guidance function is provided to enable deaf people to follow an emergency flash by turning on an emergency lamp in an emergency situation. A speaker with an emergency exit guidance function includes a front case(10) and an emergency lamp(40). A speaker unit(20), a transformer(30), a circuit board, and plural voice holes are formed in the front case. The emergency lamp is mounted on an outer surface of the front case and turned on/off under the control of the circuit board. The emergency lamp uses a flash as an optical source. The flash is attached to a reflective mirror and inserted in a transparent cover(46). A coupling member(42) made of a rubber or silicon is coupled with an opening of the transparent cover. A through-hole(45) and a connecting hole(44) are formed in the coupling member. A cable(C) from the flash is extracted through the connecting hole and connected to the circuit board. A screw hole is formed on the transparent cover. An inner through-hole(15) is formed on an inner surface of the front case. A fixing screw is coupled with the inner surface of the front case through the through-holes and the screw hole.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 실내와 복도에서 측벽 또는 천정에 설치되어 방송실 또는 관리실로부터 안내 방송을 하는데 사용하는 것으로, 보다 상세히는 스피커의 전면케이스 외부면에 비상조명이 구비되어 화재와 같은 비상사태 발생시, 비상조명의 점멸 작동에 의해 시인성을 높혀주어 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 스피커를 통하여 안내 및 대피 방송을 함으로써 대피를 하는데 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 하는 비상시 유도를 안내하는 스피커에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 건물의 실내와 복도에서 측벽 또는 천정에 설치되는 비상시 유도를 안내하는 스피커에 있어서, 스피커 유닛과 변압기 및 회로기판이 내부에 장착되고, 다수의 소리방출공이 형성된 전면케이스; 상기 전면케이스의 외부면에 장착되어 비상사태 발생시 상기 회로기판의 제어에 의해 점멸 작동되는 비상조명을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기와 같은 구성으로 이루어진 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 등으로 인한 비상사태 발생시, 비상조명의 점멸 작동에 의해 시인성을 높혀주어 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 스피커를 통하여 안내 및 대피 방송을 함으로써 대피를 하는데 효과적으로 대처할 수 있다. 특히, 화재경보기의 경보음을 듣지 못하는 청각장애자들이 비상조명으로 사용한 섬광등의 섬광에 의해 비상상황을 인지할 수 있으므로 용이하게 대피할 수 있다. 
       
     건물, 안내방송, 스피커, 전면케이스, 비상조명, 섬광등.
assignees: DCN MEDIA CO LTD;JUNGANGI & TINDUSTRYCO LTD

title_en: Sound triggering early-warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice triggered warning system used by the deaf, which comprises: the audio frequency amplifier, which enlarges received voice signal; the signal processing circuit, which filtering plastics the amplified signal outputted by the audio frequency amplifier; the trigger circuit, which decides whether to change output electrical-level according to the filtering plastic signal whether to exceed threshold value; the alarm device, which sends out alarm signals according to signals outputted by trigger circuit; the power, which supplies power to system. The voice triggered warning system can start to vibrate automatically when vehicles whistling, thus reminding timely the deaf to have vehicles near, not only reducing effectively the risk of traffic accidents, but also providing a convenient travel for the deaf.

title_en: Improved structure of indicator light
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an indicator light structural improvement belongs to the electromechanical class. It includes a body, a control circuit and a signal discriminating panel, wherein, the body is provided with a space for accommodating; the control circuit is arranged in the body, a detection element is arranged in the control circuit in an extending way, and a voice device capable of broadcasting and a flash device capable of flashing strongly are connected in the control circuit in an extending way; the signal panel is installed on one side of the body and is provided with a light emitting set for warning indication. Has the advantages that: the alarm indication can be carried out according to the spreading condition of the fire so as to reduce unnecessary casualties; the device can respectively broadcast voice and generate intense flash and flash to inform sleeping people, deaf-mute people and blind people of fire, and escape before disaster is formed, so that casualties of unnecessary people are effectively reduced.

title_en: Vibration wake-up alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device which realizes the awaking of the normal person which sleeps deep and the deaf that has audition obstacle in time and at the same time can receive the alarming information through vibration. The device comprises a remote controller, a main control machine and a strong vibrator. The main control machine receivers the wireless instruction signal transmitted by the remote controller and at the same time actuates the vibration of the strong vibrator. The vibration of the strong vibrator awakes the person in sleep and at the same time the information after awaking is obtained.

title_en: Earthquake monitoring instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake monitoring meter, belonging to the technical field of earthquake monitoring devices, comprising a power supply circuit, an electronic acceleration transducer, a forth central processing unit (U4), a display processor (U7), a display, an external data interface circuit focused on a tenth processor (U10), a fifth comparison storage processor (U5), an alarm parameter input device, an alarm circuit, a first reset switch (S1) and a second reset switch (S2). The earthquake monitoring meter has the advantages of stable operation, high precision and simple technology; the price is only 1/2 of similar products of foreign countries; when matched with seismic station, oil field or precision machine tool, the earthquake monitoring meter can monitor weak vibration in surrounding environment with high precision; when matched with elevator control system, the earthquake monitoring meter can protect the safety of passenger in advance before the earthquake comes and reduce the disaster loss to the minimum.

title_en: Life safety device for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: The instant invention includes a central security and alarm system that operates to protect a home or business and includes a personal safety device to communicate with a hearing-challenged end-user at the protected home or business. The system includes at least one alarm event detection device, and a central panel in communication with the personal safety device and the at least one alarm event detection device, the central panel comprising a processor for carrying out a method of communicating to the hearing-challenged end-user at the detection of alarm events via the personal safety device. The method includes detecting an alarm event at the home or business and noting a designated, hearing-challenged end-user that the alarm event has occurred by causing a life safety device in the possession of the hearing challenged end-user to communicate the detected event by a mechanical communication signal.

title_en: Evacuation system which uses the strobe light and an alarm sound
abstract_en: An evacuation guiding system is provided to enable users to quickly evacuate a dangerous situation by guiding the users to escape using both visual and audio signals. An evacuation guiding system includes a driving body(15), which includes a controller and a power supply and is implemented on an implementation surface. The driving body includes a semi-transparent or transparent light emitting surface(151), on which a guiding lamp(22) is arranged. The light from the guiding lamp is emitted to outside. One side of the light emitting surface is coupled with the driving body. A visual alarm lamp(32) and an alarm speaker(42) are installed on the other side of the light emitting surface.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피난유도 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 피난을 유도하기 위한 유도램프(22)가 제어부(10)의 제어에 의하여 유도용 빛이 발광되도록 구비되어지되, 상기 제어부(10)에서 시각경보제어부(31) 및 음향경보제어부(41)가 작동하도록 구비함에, 상기 시각경보제어부(31)는 상기 제어부(10)로부터 시각경보램프(32)의 점등 제어신호를 수신받아 시각경보램프(32)를 점등되도록 하며, 상기 음향경보제어부(41)는 상기 제어부(10)로부터 음향경보 제어신호를 수신받아 음향경보용 음향신호가 경보스피커(42)에서 발신되도록 구비되어, 밝은 빛을 보고 안내음향을 들으면서 피난자들, 특히 청각장애인 및 시각장애인들이 용이하게 피난할 수 있도록 하는 시청각 복합형 피난유도 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
       
     피난유도, 램프, 스피커, 시각, 음향
assignees: KOREAN FIRE PROT ASS;CN EGS CO LTD

title_en: Emergency warning system
abstract_en: An emergency warning system for warning members of the public of an emergency situation comprises personal warning devices provided to members of the public and a cellular telecommunication system for transmitting coded cellular burst signals to the personal warning devices to elicit delivery of an emergency warning from the devices. The coded cellular burst warning signals contain emergency situation codes that the personal warning devices parse and translate into an emergency warning message displayed as text on a display screen of the personal warning device.

title_en: Disaster safety information management apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To much and quickly confirm whether many users including foreigners speaking different languages and affected by an earthquake, are safe, and to provide safe information in various languages in response to inquiries about safety.  <P>SOLUTION: When a safety confirmation processing section 22 receives an emergency earthquake news flash from a weather warning server apparatus 10, safety inquiry notices for inquiring the safety of the users having member terminal apparatuses 3 are edited, and transmitted to the member terminal apparatuses 3. When the user enters an input to the member terminal apparatus 3 in response to the notice and transmits a returned notice, a safety information providing/processing section 23 receives the returned notice, and stores information on the safety of user in the safety database 62 based on a content of the returned notice.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Guidance information management device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To quickly transmit information related with safety or life such as earthquake early warning while translating it into a language which is easily understood by various members including foreigners.  <P>SOLUTION: A delivery database 56 stores information showing a language which is understandable by a user, information for recognizing or estimating current location, and information showing a place to receive guidance information. An urgent earthquake information system reception device 30 receives an earthquake early warning based on detection by a seismometer arranged in each place. Complementary information required for a user to suppress any damage is added to the earthquake early warning by an editing processing part 34, and the edited information is translated into a language shown by the language information by a machine translation processing part 35, and delivered from a network 1 to a member by a delivery processing part 38.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Vibration triggering comprehensive alarm device
abstract_en: A vibration triggering comprehensive alarm device comprises an alarm and a transmitter, wherein the transmitter is connected with the alarm in a wired or wireless manner; one or more transmitters can be arranged, and different coded signals are adopted among the transmitters; the comprehensive alarm device of the utility model is realized by arranging a plurality of transmitters, and adopting different coding signals among the transmitters, so that the transmitter with a trigger switch can be used as a doorbell, and the transmitter of the vibration sensor is arranged on doors, windows and walls to be used as an anti-theft and earthquake alarm; the utility model discloses because the different pronunciation of accessible logic judgement control voice circuit selection makes the speaker broadcast corresponding warning sound, and the user just can come the difference condition from warning sound, has the advantage that a thing is multi-purpose, and this kind of alarm often is in the user state, when breaking down or work is unusual, can in time learn to maintain, ensures the normal work use of reporting to the police.

title_en: Alert broadcasting to a plurality of diverse communications devices
abstract_en: A system for the broadcast of alert messages to selected groups of recipients and their communications devices of a plurality of different types and communicating through a plurality of different communications means. Recipient profiles or characteristics are received variously from databases, directories, and communications nodes accessible by the system. These sources are queried for the identification of selectable groups which are then presented to a dispatcher for choosing the recipients. The alert message is then provided to delivery means which employ a plurality of included means each of which is particularly configured to communicate the alert message to a corresponding target device type. A response handler module then receives responses from the target devices for later reporting.

title_en: Embedded air defense alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides an embedded air defense alarm which is used for receiving and playing air defense warning and other alarms. An alarm receiving circuit and an alarm generating circuit of the air defense alarm use a large-scale integrated chip; a control circuit uses a monolithic microcomputer; the alarm receiving circuit and the alarm generating circuit are embedded in embedded machines such as a radio receiver, a television set, and the like and are electrically connected with the embedded machines; the alarm receiving circuit and the control circuit steer clear of the power source switch of the embedded machines and is connected with the power source of the embedded machines; when the alarm is not received, the embedded machines are connected according to the prior flow and work according to the prior functions; when the alarm is received, the alarm generating circuit outputs warning signals, and the control circuit ensures that a power amplifying circuit is connected with the power source and the warning signals to forcedly play the alarm. The utility model has the use functions of the embedded machine and solves the problems of the special aerial defense alarm system that the coverage is difficult, the blind spot is more, the warning type is uneasily differentiated, the dependency on commercial power is large, the maintenance workload is large, the special space is required, the availability is low, the invalidation is uneasily discovered, and the like.

title_en: Portable signal recognition equipment for hearing disorder
abstract_en: A potable alarming device for a hearing impaired person is provided to rapidly cope with a situation by immediately recognizing a situation generated regardless of places. A potable alarming device for a hearing impaired person includes a body(10), a display(20), two connection lines(33,34), and a reset pushing part(40). The body includes a signal receiving part, a control part, a vibration generating part, a character generating part, an illumination generating part, and a power supply part. The signal receiving part receives a sound signal generated according to a situation. The control part controls a signal received through the signal receiving part. The vibration generating part, the character generating part, and the illumination generating part display a signal sensed by the control part into vibration, character, and illumination. The power supply part supplies a power source to the control part. The display is formed on a surface of the body. The display displays the character and the illumination delivered by the character generating part and the illumination generating part into outside. The connection line is formed on both sides corresponding to the body. A female Velcro tape(31) and a male Velcro tape(32) are formed in an end of the connection line. The reset pushing part is exposed on one surface of the body. The reset pushing part is connected to the control part, and resets the control part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 종래 청각장애인용 알림장치가 지닌 문제점을 해결하기 위해 안출된 것으로서, 상황에 따라 이를 신속하게 진동이나 램프와 같은 조명 또는 문자로 알려주는 각각의 발생부가 내부에 구성된 몸체의 외측에 상기 몸체를 팔목에 차고 다닐 수 있도록 하는 줄을 더 구성하여 청각장애인이 자신의 팔목에 항상 차고 휴대할 수 있도록 함으로써 청각장애인이 어디에 있든지 관계없이 발생된 상황을 쉽게 인지할 수 있도록 하여 화재와 같은 긴급상황에 빠르게 대처하고, 일상생활에서 발생되는 상황을 쉽게 대처하여 일상생활에 불편함이 없도록 한 청각장애인용 휴대알림장치를 제공하고자 한다. 
     이를 위해 본 발명은, 발생되는 상황에 따라 발생되는 소리신호를 수신하는 시그널수신부(11)와, 상기 시그널수신부(11)를 통해 수신된 신호를 감지하여 제어하는 제어부(12)와, 상기 제어부(12)에 의해 감지된 신호를 진동과 문자 및 조명으로 표시하는 진동발생부(13), 문자발생부(14), 조명발생부(15)와, 상기 제어부(12)에 전원을 공급하는 전원공급부(16)가 내장된 몸체(10)와; 상기 몸체(10)의 표면에 구성되어 상기 문자발생부(14)와 조명발생부(15)에 의해 전달되는 문자와 조명을 외부로 표시하는 디스플레이(20)와; 상기 몸체(10)의 대응되는 양면에 연장형성되고 끝단에 암수벨크로테잎(31)(32)이 각각 구성되는 2개의 연결줄(33)(34)과; 상기 몸체(10)의 일면에 노출되고 상기 제어부(12)와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 제어부(12)를 리셋하는 리셋누름부(40)가 포함되어 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     청각장애인, 알림장치, 인식장치

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.
assignees: SCHUMAN RICHARD J;GLIDEWELL PATRICIA A;ROEHL ERIK E

title_en: Alarm system for a hearing-impaired person
abstract_en: An alarm system for a hearing-impaired person is provided to allow a user to detect a signal pattern at a place where a sensor is not installed by using a mobile terminal receiving a signal pattern. In an alarm system for a hearing-impaired person, a plurality of first sensors are installed at a plurality of spaces, and sense signal patterns generated in a plurality of spaces. A unified processing unit(200) stores a signal pattern for a user and a standard signal pattern which are generated in the plurality of spaces in advance. If the sensed signal detected by a plurality of sensors is concord with the stored signal pattern, the unified processing unit transmits the sensed signal. A mobile terminal converts signal pattern received from the unified processing unit to an alarm signal.
abstract_ko: 청각장애인 등을 위한 알림 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 알림 시스템은, 복수개의 공간들에 각각 설치되고, 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생하는 신호 패턴들을 센싱하는 복수개의 제1센서들; 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생할 가능성이 있는 사용자에게 특화된 신호 패턴들 또는 규격화된 신호 패턴들을 사전에 입력받아 저장하고, 상기 복수개의 제1센서들이 센싱한 신호 패턴들이 상기 저장된 신호 패턴들과 일치하는 경우 상기 복수개의 제1센서들이 센싱한 신호 패턴들을 송신하는 통합 처리기; 및 상기 통합 처리기로부터 수신된 신호 패턴들을 알림 신호로 변환하여 사용자에게 제공하거나, 또는 상기 복수개의 공간들에서 발생하는 신호 패턴들을 수신하여 알림 신호로 변환하여 사용자에게 제공하는 휴대용 단말기를 구비한다.

title_en: Intelligent calling and alarming system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent calling and alarming system. The inner module connection relation is characterized in that: a wireless control module is connected with a system control unit, the system control unit is respectively connected with a speech unit, an information suggestion unit, an alarm lamp unit and a vibrator unit, and a smog warning unit is respectively connected with the speech unit, the information suggestion unit, the alarm lamp unit and the vibrator unit. The intelligent calling and alarming unit can automatically assist schools for deaf mutes and schools for the blind with the daily life management and the rapid alarming of sudden events and avoid situations that deaf-mutes and blind men can not deal with work and rest and calling in daily life and sudden event alarming due to deafness and blindness.

title_en: Earthquake monitoring, analyzing and alarm equipment using tri-axial acceleration transducer, embedded hardware and software
abstract_en: Earthquake monitoring, analyzing and alarm equipment using a tri-axial acceleration transducer, an embedded hardware and software uses the tri-axial acceleration transducer, the embedded hardware and software, and mode identification technology to solve the universality, accessibility, effectiveness, accuracy, reliability difficult problems of the earthquake monitoring, analyzing and alarm, improves the situations of the high cost, strong specificity and the like of the existing similar instruments. A small-sized inexpensive instrument which is suitable for various occasions such as families, schools, earthquake monitoring stations and the like is provided. The earthquake monitoring, analyzing and alarm equipment can intelligently analyze and record seismic data, promptly discovers and sends out imminent earthquake exceptional warning and earthquake warning, can be connected with a computer, sends the monitoring data and analysis result into the computer for the further processing so as to realize mathematization and networking. The equipment is reliably design, can automatically correct and improve base-line shift phenomenon, has the capability of continuing work in the situation of insufficient power supply and fault, and uses a display screen, an indicator light and an acoustic generator to provide information such as power supply situation, functional mode, existence or nonexistent of earthquake, earthquake intensity, etc.

title_en: Fire alarm apparatus for blind individuals
abstract_en: A fire-warning device is provided, which enables a blind to easily approach the fire-warning device by equipping with a signal transmitter. A fire-warning device comprises: an alerter(30) for generating warning tone when a fire occurs; a signal transmitter(60) generating the tone to make the blind recognize clearly the location of the fire-warning device; a call button(70) for giving alarm to the fire station; a phone(90) for informing the fire station of occurrence of fire; and a Braille point display for recognizing a button and a call button.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시각장애인용 화재경보장치에 관한 것으로서, 화재 발생시 경보음을 발생시키기 위한 경보기와, 상기 경보기를 작동시키기 위한 버튼을 구비하여 실내에 설치되는 화재경보장치에 있어서, 시각장애인이 상기 화재경보장치의 위치를 인식할 수 있도록, 시각장애인이 들을 수 있는 신호음을 발생시키는 신호발신기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     본 발명에 따른 시각장애인용 화재경보장치는, 시각장애인이 들을 수 있는 신호음을 발생시키는 신호발신기를 포함하므로, 시각장애인이 화재경보장치의 위치를 용이하게 인식하여 화재경보장치 측으로 접근할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Isolating protector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an isolating protector. The isolating protector body is provided with a protecting pulling plate that can be pulled and inserted; the lower part of the isolating protector body is provided with a support member with the height adjustable so as to realize space isolation by adjusting the width of the protecting pulling plate and the height of the support member when in use. Besides, the isolating protector body is also provided with a pre-warning device which can give a prompt in such manners as sound, light and voice when persons are induced to be close to the working field and which can then inform the maintenance personnel, thereby overcoming the defect that the existing isolators are easy to move without ideal effect for special groups such as children and the blind. The utility model has reasonable structure, multiple functions and ideal using effect, and is suitable for being widely used in elevator maintenance.

title_en: Rapid alarm and emergency evacuation method for solving dormitory emergencies in school for blind
abstract_en: The invention provides a system with three interlocked devices of remote alarm, vibration alarm and electronic guide, and an additional circuit. The system has the functions of rapid alarm and safe evacuation for students in a school for the blind in emergence so that the blind students need not to relay the help of living teachers and other people, can be emergently evacuated and avoid dangerous situation by own abilities. The system takes the functions in daily life, such as morning waking, door alarm and walking guide in campus.

title_en: Intelligent calling and warming system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent calling and warming system. A computer center control unit is connected to an intelligent system control unit which is respectively connected to a voice unit, an information pointing unit, a warming light unit, a vibrator unit. The intelligent system control unit is constructed by sequentially connecting an RS485 bus receiving module, a microcomputer control module, a switch control module. The information pointing unit is constructed by sequentially connecting a singlechip processing module and a cache module and a display module. The information pointing unit receives a switch control command from the intelligent system control unit, chooses the to-be-displayed information segment which is processed by a singlechip and output by the display module. The invention can full-automatically help the normal life management in the school of deaf-mutes and the school for blind and achieve rapid alarm in emergency thereby avoiding the state that the people can not deal with work-and-rest, calling and emergency alarm in normal life due to deaf mute and blind.

title_en: Alarm apparatus for hearingdefect person
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 청각장애인용 알림 장치에 관한 것으로서, 특히, 초인종, 팩스, 화재경보 신호 및 보일러 이상유무를 감지하여 각각의 알림신호가 발생되는 신호발생유닛과, 신호발생유닛에서 인식된 알림신호를 송신하는 송신유닛과, 송신유닛에서 송신된 알림신호를 수신하는 수신유닛과, 실내의 청각장애인이 인식하도록 수신된 신호를 표시하는 디스플레이유닛 및, 신호발생유닛, 송신유닛, 수신유닛 및 디스플레이유닛을 제어하기 위한 제어유닛을 포함하고, 디스플레이유닛은 "초인종" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 초인종알림표시부와, "팩스" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 팩스표시부와, "보일러 이상" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 보일러고장표시부 및, "화재경보" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 화재경보표시부를 포함하는 구성으로, 실내에 거주하던 청각장애인들이 이들 신호를 신속하게 인지하여 상황에 맞는 대처를 효과적으로 할 수 있는 특징이 있다. 
       
     초인종, 전화, 화재경보, 램프

title_en: Fire Alarm System Using TTS
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 고안은, 화재감지 시스템으로부터 화재발생 위치정보를 포함하는 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 텍스트로 구성되고 편집 가능한 화재방송 시나리오를 적어도 하나 이상 포함하는 시나리오 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 화재발생 위치정보에 따른 대피경로를 획득하고, 상기 화재발생 위치정보와 상기 획득된 대피경로를 상기 화재발생 시나리오에 반영함으로써 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하는 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부; TTS 엔진을 이용하여 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하는 음성 변환부; 상기 음성 변환부에서 변환된 음성을 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 제1 전송부; 화재발생 정보를 소방서로 전송하는 제2 전송부; 및 상기 화재감지 시스템으로부터 상기 화재발생신호를 수신한 경우, 상기 시나리오 데이터베이스를 참조하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 부합하는 화재방송 시나리오를 검색하고, 상기 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부를 제어하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 따라 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하고, 상기 음성 변환부를 제어하여 상기 구성된 화재방송용 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하여 상기 제1 전송부를 통해 상기 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하고, 상기 제2 전송부를 통해 상기 화재발생 정보를 상기 소방서로 전송하는 제어부를 포함하는 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템을 제공한다. 
     
     화재 감지, 화재방송 시나리오, 화재방송용 텍스트, TTS, 구내 방송, 화재발생 정보, 다국어

title_en: Fire Alarm System Using TTS

      화재 감지, 화재방송 시나리오, 화재방송용 텍스트, TTS, 구내 방송

title_en: Providing notifications using text-to-speech conversion
abstract_en: Methods and systems for providing electronic notifications are described. A server is configured to serve an interface, such as a Web page, to a terminal that requests from a user a first set of user contacts to be used to provide notifications to the user by a telephonic notification system in response to a notification process initiated by an organization associated with the user. The interface further requests a first set of priorities corresponding to the first set of user contacts, wherein the notification system will attempt to provide notifications to the first set user contracts in an order based at least in part on the first set of priorities. A database is configured to store the first set of user contacts and the first set of priorities. A voice interface circuit is configured to transmit a voice notification to at least one of the first set of user contacts.

title_en: Braille block
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A raised block for subway sidewalk is provided to use the raised block for the person who is visually handicapped on usual days, and evacuate passengers to a safe place by switching off a light emitting diodes in case of a fire. CONSTITUTION: A raised block for subway sidewalk comprises a raised block(20), a fire alarm, and a control device. The raised block has a fire alarm, a control device, and a plurality of light emitting diodes(242) which display a guide direction. The fire alarm generates a loud bell and lighting in case of a fire. The control device connected with the fire alarm controls the light emitting diodes and characters shape installed in the raised block in case of a fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하철 보도에 설치되는 점자블록에 관한 것으로서, 지하철 보도에 설치되는 점자블록에 있어서 소정의 높이와 면적을 가지며 상부에는 장착공간이 구비된 점자가 일정간격으로 돌출형성되는 커버 판을 폴리카보네이트를 이용해서 투명하게 형성하고 상기 커버 판의 하부에는 상면이 노란색으로 형성되며 상기 장착공간과 대응되는 위치에 다수의 발광다이오드가 장착된 회로기판을 장착하여 점자블록을 구성하고, 상기 점자블록은 화재발생에 따른 화재경보기의 작동시 이를 인지하고 작동신호를 회로기판에 전달하는 컨트롤 장치와 연결되어, 평상시에는 시각장애인의 점자보도로 이용되고 화재 발생이나 비상시에는 컨트롤 장치에서 전달되는 신호에 따라 회로기판에 장착되는 발광다이오드를 화살표나 진행방향으로 점멸시켜 승객들을 안전한 곳으로 이동할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     점자블록, 커버 판, 점자, 회로기판, 발광다이오드, 화재경보기, 컨트롤 장치, 진동모터.

title_en: Emergency alert notification for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: An indication of an emergency alert message is provided to a user, potentially having a disability, via a networked enabled portable device. The emergency alert message is provided via sign language video images indicative of the emergency alert. A notification makes the user aware when broadcast emergency alerts are issued. In various embodiments, the portable device is enabled to receive information about an emergency alert broadcast of which the potentially disabled user should be aware, e.g., from the EAS, and to notify the user of the emergency alert. The user can be automatically taken to the emergency alert information by having the portable device automatically tune to the emergency broadcast information, the user can optionally retrieve the emergency information by tuning to the emergency broadcast channel, and/or the user can otherwise be presented with a reference to the emergency data, such as a link to the information.

title_en: Apparatus for guiding into emergency exit without man
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 비상구 무인유도 장치에 관한 것으로서, 시각장애인이나 시력이 좋지 못한 대상에게 비상사태 및 비상구를 음성으로 안내하고, 비상구를 안내하는 유도등의 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 고안은, 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 화재경보시스템으로부터 비상감지신호를 전송받아 그에 대응되는 신호를 출력하여 각 구성요소를 작동시키는 제어부와, 비상사태 및 비상구 음성안내 데이터가 사전 저장된 메모리와, 메모리에 사전 저장된 비상사태 및 비상구 안내 데이터를 음성신호로 변환출력하여 비상사태 발생시 시각장애인들의 대피를 돕는 청각유도수단과, 램프에서 발산되는 빛을 점멸 및 집광시킴으로써 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하기 위한 시각유도수단, 및 평상시에 상용전원으로부터 전원을 공급받아 비상용 전원으로 충전하였다가, 비상사태 발생시 전원을 공급하여 청각유도수단 및 시각유도수단을 포함한 각 구성요소를 정상작동시키기 위한 비상전원부를 포함하는 전원공급수단으로 이루어진다. 
       
     음성안내, 청각유도수단, 비상전원부, 무인유도

title_en: Remote control detecting and warning system for preventing closing on grounding-wire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote control detecting and warning system for preventing closing on grounding-wire, comprising a wireless remote-control launching device and at least one wireless receiving detector. The wireless remote-control launching device is arranged for sending a grounding-wire detecting command signal to the wireless receiving detector. The wireless receiving detector is arranged for detecting the grounding status of grounding-wire after receiving the grounding-wire detecting command signal from the wireless remote-control launching device. If the grounding-wire is notremoved, the system will warn. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of small volume, convenient use, wide coverage, strict detection, blind angle free, etc. The utility model can effectively avoid the serious failure caused by closing on grounding wire and can be applied to various power substations or converting stations without an integrated automatic monitor systemfor electrical operation.

title_en: Rainwate catch filter
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rainwater collecting filter is provided to remove and store foreign materials included in rainwater when the quantity of the rainwater is increased, and to prevent environmental contamination by clearly and conveniently managing and maintaining the filter. CONSTITUTION: A rainwater collecting filter comprises the following: a rainwater inflow pipe(23) receiving rainwater; a initial rainwater cut off bank(21) blocking inflow of the rainwater when the rainwater is flowed through the initial rainwater cut off bank; a first filtering net(18) filtering foreign materials included in the rainwater when a water level reaches the constant level; a second filtering net separating the foreign materials; a ceramic layer(25) rectifying the rainwater; and a storage tank storing the refined water.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빗물 저장시설에서 빗물을 차 집 할 때 사용하는 방법으로서 더욱 상세하게는 빗물을 차 집 할 때 비가 적게 오거나 초기 빗물 속에는 이물질이 많아 이 초기 빗물을 버리고 이물질이 빗물과 같이 씻겨 내려가고 빗물의 양이 많아지면 수위센서가 감지하여 초기빗물차단문을 열어 빗물유입관으로 들어오는 빗물을 1차 거름망에서 이물질을 제거하고 차 집을 한 후 속 거름망에서 한번 더 거른 다음 이물질을 침전 실에서 최종 침전을 하고 저장탱크로 보내어 빗물을 저장할 때 사용하는 빗물 차 집 필터의 방법으로서 
빗물을 저장하여 사용하면 홍수를 예방하고 상수원을 공급할 때 사용하는 에너지를 절약하여 경제적인 파급효과는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있는 줄 알면서도 시설비가 많이 소요되고 유지관리가 어려워 지금까지 시설을 외면하여 왔다. 
그러나 세계적으로 홍수가 자주 발생하고 또한 우리나라는 유엔에서 정하는 물부족국가 이여서 최근에는 정부차원으로 빗물을 저장하여 사용하는데 많은 지원이 있어 많은 지방자치단체에서 빗물저장을 의무화하는 조례를 만드는 준비를 하고 있는 것으로 조사되었다. 
빗물저장시설에서는 가장 시급한 것이 빗물저장탱크로 이물질이 유입되는 것이다  이물질이 유입되면 아무리 좋은 시설을 하여도 그 시설은 무용지물이 되어 버리고 또한 유지관리 면에서도 많은 비용이 소요되어 빗물저장으로 인한 경제적인 효과가 없어 시설을 하였다 하더라도 경제적인 효과가 없으면 가동을 하지 않을 것이다.  
이에 본 발명의 빗물 차 집 필터를 개발하여 빗물 차 집 시에 이물질을 제거하고 빗물을 저장하면 유지관리 면에서는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있을 것이다.

title_en: Control system of vehicle with a automatic breaking function based on observation result of blind spot
title_ko: 사각지대의 감시 결과에 기초한 자동 제동 기능을 가지는 차량 제어 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic braking function based on a monitoring result of a blind spot is provided to prevent collision by using warning announcement. CONSTITUTION: An automatic braking function based on a monitoring result of a blind spot comprises a memory(101), a camera, an acceleration pedal sensor(103), an ECU(Engine Control Unit)(105), and an ABS(Anti-lock Brake System)(106). The cameras output captured image data of a blind spot. The gear reduction unit senses the location of a shift gear and outputs a first sensing signal. The acceleration pedal sensor senses the operation of the acceleration pedal. The second sensing signal is outputted. The ECU recognizes the operation state of the vehicles based on the first and the second sensing signal, compares the captured image data and reference image data, and then outputs a braking control signal in an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사각지대의 감시 결과에 기초한 자동 제동 기능을 가지는 차량 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 차량 제어 시스템은 메모리, 복수의 촬영 장치들, 기어 감지부, 가속패달 감지부, ECU, 및 ABS부를 포함한다. 메모리는 기준 영상 데이터들을 저장한다. 복수의 촬영 장치들은 차량 외부의 전방, 후방, 및 양측에 각각 설치되어, 차량 주변의 사각지대들을 각각 촬영하고, 촬영 영상 데이터들을 각각 출력한다. 기어 감지부 변속 기어의 위치를 감지하고, 제1 감지 신호를 출력한다. 가속패달 감지부 가속 패달의 작동 상태를 감지하고, 제2 감지 신호를 출력한다. ECU는 차량의 점화 신호에 응답하여 동작하고, 제1 및 제2 감지 신호들에 기초하여 차량의 동작 상태를 인식하고, 촬영 영상 데이터들을 기준 영상 데이터들에 각각 비교하고, 그 비교 결과에 따라 위험 상황을 판단하고, 위험 상황일 때 차량의 동작 상태에 따라, 제동 제어 신호를 출력한다. ABS부는 제동 제어 신호에 응답하여, 복수의 휠 실린더가 차량의 복수의 차륜의 브레이크들을 각각 작동시키도록, 복수의 휠 실린더의 유압을 각각 증가시킨다. 본 발명에 따르면, 사각지대에서의 충돌 사고를 예방할 수 있다. 
       
     촬영 장치, ECU

title_en: A pedestrian crossing indicator
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A pedestrian crossing indicator is provided to safely guide a disabled person, especially a blind person, and to reduce unnecessary power consumption. CONSTITUTION: A pedestrian crossing indicator comprises advertising banners(12b), indicating lamps(10c), human body sensors(17a,17b), speakers(16), a signal lamp, and solar panels(13a,13b). Photo-luminescent print parts(19) are formed in the advertising banners. The indicating lamps are installed in the top ends of first posts, and are protected by acryl transparent panels(10d). The human body sensors and the speakers are installed on the side surface of the first posts. The signal lamp is installed in the side of one first post. The solar panels are installed in the top ends of second posts(16).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지방자치단체 또는 사업허가권자 등이 관할 교통로 상의 횡단 보도와 인접하는 인도의 양측 가장자리에 홍보용 또는 대민광고와 맹인을 위한 횡단신호 안내 및 야간에 신호등 알림 기능 등을 구비하여 설치하는 횡단 보도 표시기에 관한 것으로, 횡단 보도와 인접한 인도의 양측 가장자리에 각각 사각 기둥형상의 제 1장치 포스트가 지반에 지지고정되고 상기 두 개의 제 1장치 포스트와 일정거리를 유지하는 지점에 제 2장치 포스트가 또한 각각 지지고정되어 양측의 제 1장치 포스트와 제 2장치 포스트 사이에 축광 인쇄된 광고 현수막이 연결되고 두 개의 제 1장치 포스트의 상단 부에는 표시 전등이 설치되어 아크릴 소재의 사각 보호막이 안착 되며 중간 인도 방향 측면 부에는 인명 감지센서와 스피커가 내장되고 도로 방향 측면 부에는 신호등이 구비되며 다른 두 개의 제 2장치 포스트의 상단 부에는 태양열 전지판이 구비되어 하단 내부의 축전지에 전력을 축전시켜 자체 소용되는 등의 방법으로 설비함으로써 대민광고와 홍보 및 맹인 안내 및 신호등 표시 및 전력절감 등의 효과를 가져 올 수 있는 횡단 보도 표시기에 관한 것이다. 
       
     횡단 보도, 제 1장치 포스트, 제 2장치 포스트, 태양열 전지판, 현수막.

title_en: System and method for sos rescue and prevention of crime
title_ko: 응급신호 발신 및 범죄예방 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency signal sending method, a crime prevention system, and a method thereof are provided to prevent crimes in the blind spot of a discount store by using a light lamp and an alarm sound according to the emergency signal sending of a mobile terminal. CONSTITUTION: A key(106) of a mobile terminal(100) is used to send an emergency signal. A local communications part(104) of a mobile terminal transmits an emergency signal. A controller(102) of a mobile terminal decides the pressing of the emergency signal send key. The controller of the mobile terminal transfers the emergency signal sending command to the local communications part. A local area network receiver of a security company structure(200) receives the emergency signal transmitting from the local communications part of the personal mobile terminal. A controller(202) of the security company operates an alarm device according to an emergency signal. The alarm device executes an alarm operation according to the command of the controller of the security company structure.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급상황에 처한 사람들이 휴대 단말기의 응급신호 버튼을 누르면 응급구조를 신호를 주변의 경광등 내지 사이렌 등의 알람기기가 구비된 보안업체의 구조물들에게 전송하고 응급신호를 전송받은 보안업체의 구조물들은 아람기기를 가동하여 범죄를 방지함과 동시에 중앙센터로 응급신호를 전송하고 응급신호 발생위치에서 제일 가까운 직원에게 출동을 연결하여 범죄를 예방하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     휴대단말기, 응급구조, 보안업체

title_en: Blind with warning function and crime prevention window having the same
title_ko: 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드 및 이를 포함하는 방범창
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A blind with crime prevention and alarming functions, and a safety window including the same are provided to improve view efficiency, prevent outsiders from entering inside, and use in emergency situations for escape. CONSTITUTION: A safety window including a blind with crime prevention and alarming functions comprises a window frame(110), a window(120) and a blind(200). The window is coupled with the window frame to be opened and closed. The blind is installed on the window. The blind has crime prevention alarming functions. The blind comprises a pair of frames, a plurality of rotary shafts, a blind blade, a power supply unit, a controller, and an alarming unit. A pair of blinds are installed outside the window. The rotary shaft is positioned inside the frame. The blind blade is formed in the rotary shaft. The power supply unit applies electrical signals on the rotary shaft. The controller senses the signals applied on the rotary shaft. The alarming unit alarms the outside when the controller does not sense electrical signals.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 창의 외측에 여닫이 방식으로 설치되는 한 쌍의 프레임과, 상기 프레임의 내부에 수평 또는 수직방향으로 배치되는 다수의 회전축과, 상기 회전축에 마련되는 블라인드 날개와, 상기 회전축에 전기적인 신호를 인가하는 전원부와, 상기 회전축에 인가된 전기적인 신호를 감지하는 제어부와, 상기 제어부에서 전기적인 신호를 감지하지 못할 경우 이를 외부로 알리는 경보수단을 포함하는 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드와; 건축물의 벽면 개구부에 설치되는 창틀과, 상기 창틀에 개폐 가능하게 설치되는 창과, 상기 창의 외측에 설치되는 상술한 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드를 포함하는 방범창에 관한 것으로, 채광, 통풍, 환기, 단열, 방음, 조망 등의 기본적인 기능 이외에 외부인의 침입을 방지하고 비상시 탈출용으로 사용이 가능하며 조망 효율을 향상시킨 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드 및 이를 포함하는 방범창을 제공한다. 
       
     경보기능, 블라인드, 방범창, 방범시스템

title_en: Alarm apparatus for hearingdefect person
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An alarm apparatus for a hearing-impaired person is provided to respond the operational state of an electronic apparatus by converting the alarm signal of the electronic apparatus to vibration signal or visual signal and transmits the signal to a portable terminal. CONSTITUTION: A wireless receiving module(12) receives alarm signal from an electronic apparatus(10). A signal conversion module(22) converts the alarm signal to vibration signal and visual signal. The vibration module(23) generates vibration based on the vibration signal from the signal conversion module. A display module(24) displays the visual signal from the signal conversion module.
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 청각 장애인용 알림장치에 관한 것으로, 초인종, 팩스, 화재경보 및, 보일러 등 각종의 전자장치에서 생성된 알림신호를 감각 또는 시각으로 인지가 가능한 진동신호 또는 시각신호로 변환하여 청각 장애인이 착용하고 있는 휴대 단말기에 무선 제공하여, 청각 장애인들이 상기 휴대 단말기를 통해 최종 제공되는 진동신호 또는 시각신호를 통해 각종 전자장치의 작동상태를 인지하여 대처하도록 구성된 청각 장애인용 알림장치에 관한 것이다. 
       
     청각 장애인용, 알림장치, 진동, 시각, 휴대 단말기

title_en: Intelligent calling and alarming system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent calling and alarming system. The connection relations of the internal modules of the intelligent calling and alarming system are as follows: a wireless control module is connected with a system control unit; the system control unit is respectively connected with a voice unit, an information cue unit, a caution light unit and a vibrator unit; and a smog alarming unit is respectively connected with the voice unit, the information cue unit, a caution light unit and a vibrator unit. The utility model can full-automatically assist daily life management of schools for deaf-mutes and blind schools and rapid alarming of emergencies, thus avoiding the situation that work and rest, calling and emergency alarming in daily life can not be coped with as the deaf and mute persons can not hear and the blind persons can not see.

title_en: Blind-guiding stick
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind-guiding stick, which comprises a stick body (1) and a handle (2), wherein the stick body (1) is hollow and is made of light aluminum alloy; the lower end part of the stick body (1) is fixedly connected with an iron hemisphere base (3); an alarm device (4) is arranged on the stick body (1); a switch (5) is arranged on the handle (2); and a fluorescence layer (6) is coated at the outer surface of the stick body (1). As the overall blind-guiding stick adopts the tumbler-type design with the upper part being light and the lower part being heavy, when the blind-guiding stick is used, even though the blind-guiding stick slips out of the hand, the blind person can be convenient to find the blind-guiding stick again; in addition, the blind person can be convenient to open the alarm device to obtain help when in emergency situation; moreover, the fluorescence layer can be convenient to give an alarm for passersby and vehicles when the blind person walks in dark environment, so as to ensure the safety of the blind person; therefore, the blind-guiding stick has novel structure and is convenient and practical.

title_en: Fireman rescue device with wireless direction-finding positioning function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, and in particular relates to a fireman rescue device with wireless direction-finding positioning function. The rescue device consists of a multi-radial wireless receiving circuit, a wireless transmission circuit, a single-chip microprocessor, a motion sensor, a temperature sensor, an orientation indicator, a distance indicator, a sound alarm device and a power source, wherein the multi-radial wireless receiving circuit consists of a magnetic antenna group, a receiving control circuit, a filtering-amplifying circuit and an intermediate frequency receiving circuit; the wireless transmission circuit consists of the magnetic antenna group, a transmission drive circuit and a transmitting-frequency modulation circuit; the motion sensor, the temperature sensor, the orientation indicator, the distance indicator and the sound alarm device are connected with I/O ports of the single-chip microprocessor; and the power source is connected with the components to supply power. Due to the wireless direction-finding positioning function, the rescue device reduces rescue blindness in harsh environment and greatly improves rescue efficiency, thereby saving the lives of firemen to the utmost extent.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INST OF THE MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SECURITY;SHANGHAI BEIAN INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent calling and warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent calling and warning system. A computer center control unit is connected with an intelligent system control unit, the intelligent system control unit is respectively connected with a speech unit, an information prompting unit, a warning lamp unit and a vibrator unit, the intelligent system control unit is formed by sequentially connecting an RS485 communication module to a microcomputer control module and a switch control module, and the information prompting unit is formed by sequentially connecting a single chip processing module to a buffer memory module and a display module. The information prompting unit receives a switch control instruction from the intelligent system control unit, and selects information segments to be displayed, and the selected information segments are processed by a single chip and are output by the display module. The utility model can help the daily life management of school for deaf-mute people and schools for blind people in a full automatic way, can realize the fast warning of emergency events, and avoids the conditions that the work and rest, the calling and the emergency event warning in daily life can not be realized because of the hearing disturbance of deaf-mute people and the seeing disturbance of the blind people.

title_en: Liquefied gas and compressed gas filling apparatus and control method thereof
title_ko: 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치 및 이를 제어하는 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A device and a method for charging liquefied and compressed gas are provided to enable a charging facility to be controlled without depending on a foreign company. CONSTITUTION: A device for charging liquefied and compressed gas comprises a storage tank part(100), primary pumps(P101,P102), a primary heat exchanger(V101), secondary pumps(P201,P202), secondary heat exchangers(V201,V202), a feeding tank part(300), a detection sensor, an alarm unit, and an integral controller. The storage tank part stores liquefied gas. The primary pumps circulate the liquefied gas to the storage tank part. The primary heat exchanger heat-exchanges the liquefied gas provided by the primary pumps in a saturation state. The secondary pumps pressurize the low pressure liquefied gas provided from the storage tank part to the high pressure liquefied gas. The secondary heat exchanger vaporizes the liquefied gas provided from the secondary pumps. The feeding tank part stores the compressed gas provided from the secondary pumps. The detection sensor senses the pressure, the flow rate, the temperature and the density of liquefied and compressed gas, the water level of the storage tank part, and the driving states of the secondary pumps. The alarm unit informs the outside of the signal detected by the detection sensor. The integral controller controls the flow of the liquefied gas through the signal detected by the detection sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치와 상기 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치를 안전하게 운영할 수 있도록 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치의 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치는, 액화가스를 저장하는 저장탱크부; 상기 저장탱크부의 액화가스를 상기 저장탱크부로 순환 공급시키는 적어도 하나 이상의 1차펌프; 상기 1차펌프에서 공급되는 액화가스를 포화상태로 열교환시키는 1차열교환기; 상기 저장탱크부에서 공급되는 저압의 액화가스를 고압의 액화가스로 가압하는 적어도 하나 이상의 2차펌프; 상기 2차펌프에서 공급되는 액화가스를 기화시키는 적어도 하나 이상의 2차열교환기; 상기 2차펌프에서 공급되는 압축가스를 저장하고 이를 사용처에 공급하는 적어도 하나 이상의 저장공급탱크부; 상기 액화 및 압축가스의 압력, 유량, 온도와 밀도 및 상기 저장탱크부의 수위 그리고 2차펌프의 구동상태를 감지하는 감지센서; 상기 감지센서에서 감지된 신호를 외부에 알리는 알람부; 및 상기 감지센서에서 감지된 신호를 통해 상기 액화가스의 흐름을 제어하는 통합제어부; 로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명에 구동방법 액화가스의 열교환 제어방법은, 제어밸브를 제어하는 1차제어단계; 온도감지센서에서 1차펌프의 온도를 감지하는 온도감지단계; 1차펌프를 구동하는 1차펌프구동단계; 상기 제어밸브를 제어하는 2차제어단계; 압력감지센서에서 구동정지조건을 감지하는 제1구동조건감지단계; 상기 제어밸브를 제 어하는 3차제어단계; 상기 온도감지센서 및 수위감지센서에서 구동정지조건을 감지하는 제2구동조건감지단계; 및 상기 제1,2구동조건감지단계의 조건에 따라 포화상태의 열교환을 완료하는 완료단계; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명에 따른 구동방법 중 통합제어부에 의해 액화가스 충전을 제어방법은, 제어밸브를 제어하는 1차제어단계; 온도감지센서에서 온도를 감지하는 온도감지단계; 제어밸브를 제어하는 2차제어단계; 1차펌프를 구동하는 1차펌프구동단계; 제어밸브를 제어하는 3차제어단계; 상기 유량감지센서 및 밀도감지센서에서 액화가스 충전의 구동조건을 감지하는 구동조건감지단계; 상기 유량감지센서에서 충전되는 유량을 합산하는 유량합산단계; 및 상기 구동조건감지단계의 조건 및 유량합산단계에서 합산된 유량에 따라 액화가스 충전을 완료하는 완료단계; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     본 발명의 제어 방법 중 압축가스의 생산을 제어하는 방법은, 제어밸브를 제어하는 1차제어단계; 온도감지센서에서 온도를 감지하는 온도감지단계; 1차펌프를 구동하는 1차펌프구동단계; 제어밸브를 제어하는 2차제어단계; 상기 온도감지센서에서 2차펌프의 온도를 감지하는 2차온도감지단계; 2차펌프를 구동하는 2차펌프구동단계; 상기 유량감지센서에서 압축가스 생산모드의 구동조건을 감지하는 구동조건감지단계; 제어밸브를 제어하여 2차펌프에서 압축가스를 바이패스(Bypass) 시키는 3차제어단계; 제어밸브를 제어하여 2차펌프에서 압축가스의 바이패스(Bypass)를 종료시키는 4차제어단계; 상기 압력감지센서에서 감지된 압축가스의 압력에 따라 압축가스를 제1,2,3저장탱크로 저장하는 압축가스저장단계; 및 상기 제1,2,3저장탱 크의 압력의 이상 유무를 감지하여 이상 유무에 따라 제어밸브와 2차펌프를 제어하여 압축가스 생산공정을 종료하는 종료단계; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     마지막으로, 본 발명의 제어방법 중 구동대기 제어방법은, 제어밸브가 정상구동되는 구동단계; 1,2차펌프 및 제어밸브의 구동을 중단시키는 구동해제단계;  및 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치의 비상상황을 감지하는 비상감지모드를 선택하는 비상모드선택단계; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     
     제어, 제어방법, 충전장치

title_en: Stand alone fire alarm apparatus
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A stand-alone fire alarm device is provided to notify a fire to a visually handicapped person and hearing impaired person as well as general people. CONSTITUTION: A smoke sensing unit(10) comprises a smoke sensor and outputs a fire sensing signal. A power supply(20) changes commercial AC power into DC power and supplies the DC power. A sound or voice generator(40) outputs previously stored voice or sound when a fire is sensed. A flickering unit(50) discharges strobe at a fixed cycle when a fire is sensed.
abstract_ko:
연기감지센서를 구비하여 화재 감지신호를 출력하는 연기감지부; 상용 교류 전원을 직류전원으로 변환하여 충전함과 동시에 상기 직류전원을 공급하는 전원공급부; 화재감지시 기저장된 음성이나 음향을 출력하는 음 발생부; 화재감지시 기설정된 주기로 스트로보 방전하는 점멸부; 및 상기 각 부분을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하며, 상기 각 부분은 하나의 인쇄회로기판에 구현되어 단일 하우징에 수납되는 독립형 화재경보장치가 개시된다. 
     
     경보, 스트로보, 음성, 독립, 케이싱, 충전 배터리

title_en: System for monitoring intrusion of foreign bodies
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system for monitoring the intrusion of foreign bodies. The system comprises intrusion monitoring terminals, a monitoring and alarming processing system and a monitoring management system, at least one intrusion monitoring terminal is connected with the monitoring and alarming processing system through data transmission channels; and the monitoring and alarming processing system is connected with the monitoring management system through a data transmission network. The system of the utility model has the advantages of simple structure and convenient implementation; by adopting various alarming manners, the system can guarantee that the alarming message can be delivered accurately and carry out the analysis and pre-alarming treatment on various alarming messages, thus preventing disasters and secondary disasters.
assignees: SICHUAN GEZHI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing emergency and alarm communications
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for establishing emergency and alarm communications between devices via an interface device are provided. According to one aspect, an interface device comprises an input, an output, and logic. The input receives data in a first format from the first device. The logic detects whether the data is intended to request assistance from emergency services and if so, determining proper routing, retrieving location information and transmit the data and location information to the proper destination. If not intended to request assistance, a second device for receiving the data is identified as well as a second format, the data is translated to the second format and transmitted to the second device. A battery may selectively provide power to essential components of the interface device upon detection of a power failure. Notifications are made upon detection of a power failure, malfunction, or emergency request.
assignees: TISCHER STEVEN;ZELLNER SAMUEL N;STARR ROBERT J

title_en: Earthquake protection warning system of nuclear reactor
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake protection warning system of a nuclear reactor, which comprises a plurality of intelligent sensor modules and a main control unit that are connected into a data communication network through a twisted-pair cable. Each intelligent sensor module comprises a triaxial acceleration sensor, an A/D converter, a single chip microcomputer, a communication chip and a communication interface that are connected sequentially; and the main control unit comprises a main-control module, and a display, an audible-visual annunciator, a keyboard, a nuclear reactor emergency shutdown switching circuit and a communication interface circuit that are connected with the main-control module. The intelligent sensor modules are mounted on building supporting structure on the periphery of the nuclear reactor, so as to obtain the maximal monitoring area, and no detection blind zone or repeat detection zone appears; and after the information collected by each intelligent sensor module is calculated and compared by the main control unit, working personnel can judge whether an earthquake wave emerges and obtain the strength of the earthquake; in the case of a strong earthquake, the nuclear reactor is closed automatically and quickly, and the warning system gives an alarm to inform the working personnel to escape.

title_en: Nowcast of Natural Resource and Calamity Warning
abstract_en: A method of forecasting naturally-occurring phenomena, such as seismic activity, includes taking localized measurements of the Earth's gravitational force change using MEM inertial motion units. Trends in the measurements are interpreted and related to a phenomenon of interest, a likelihood of occurrence is predicted based on the relationship, and the likelihood is reported to interested parties, preferably automatically to emergency bulletin sources. Measurements can be taken from above the Earth's atmosphere. The trends can be interpreted by determining blind source separation information directed to the region underneath the Earth's mantle crust to determine composition and/or movement.

title_en: Matter removing device and base station with matter removing function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the wireless communication technology, in particular to a matter removing device and a base station with the matter removing function. The matter removing device comprises a monitoring unit, a control unit and a processing unit, wherein the monitoring unit is connected with the control unit and is used for sending an alarm signal to the control unit when monitoring foreign matters; the control unit is connected with the processing unit and is used for triggering the processing unit to activate the matter removing function after judging the signal sent by the monitoring unit as the alarm signal; and the processing unit is used for activating the matter removing function to remove the foreign matters. As the foreign matters entering the base station can be monitored by the device and removed through the processing unit, the safety of equipment in the base station is ensured.
