The Ad Hoc Network wireless intelligent public emergency broadcasting terminal has the advantages that the terminal can replace the current centralized control type wired/wireless public emergency broadcasting systems to cope with different emergent natural/artificial disaster events; multiple terminals can compose a wireless emergency broadcasting network, wherein it is not required to arrange a central control node in the network, instead, multi-hop relays are used between the nodes to finish distributed control and information communication; by using the terminal, there is no blind area, thereby expanding covering range of the public emergency broadcasting system; and the terminal has intelligent automatic control capability, which improves the early warning efficiency and reduces loss caused by disasters.
assignees: HUNAN DEHAI COMM EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Radar device used for monitoring landslide
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radar device used for monitoring a landslide. The radar device comprises an on-site controller, a monitoring radar, a power supply, a rotary support and a signal cable/optical fiber. The monitoring radar is fixed on the rotary support. The power supply is used for providing power for the monitoring radar. The monitoring radar and the on-site controller are connected through the signal cable/optical fiber, so that the radar device is controlled. The monitoring radar is used for monitoring foreign matter invasion and restriction caused by the landslide on a site, and transmitting data including speed and distance information to the on-site controller. The on-site controller is used for setting emission and reception functions of antennas of the monitoring radar, controlling grouping forms of the antennas, comprehensively analyzing information sent by the monitoring radar, providing alarming of invasion and restriction, and uploading the alarming to a base station monitoring center near a monitored point. The advantages of the radar device are that: the device is high in reliability in terms of landslide monitoring and can meet the requirement about high reliability for a railway industry; objects can be monitored in a dynamic manner; the remote monitoring precision is improved and more flexible monitoring is exhibited; the speed of alarming response is faster and alarming is uploaded in a more timely manner; and the radar device has a function of querying and setting an on-site apparatus.
assignees: NANJING TICOM SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Vibration-type smoke alarm with illumination function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vibration-type smoke alarm with an illumination function, which is especially suitable for hearing-impaired people. The vibration-type smoke alarm comprises a smoke sensor, a main shell, and a vibration block. A control panel is arranged inside the main shell. A standby battery is arranged inside the control panel. The main shell is provided with a liquid crystal display screen, indicating lamps, a switch, and adjusting buttons. The vibration-type smoke alarm is characterized in that a lifting handle is arranged on the main shell and located above the adjusting buttons, and one side of the main shell is provided with an illumination bulb. The vibration-type smoke alarm is convenient to use and humanized in design.

title_en: Centralized control type fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicator system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicator systems of modern intelligent buildings, particularly relates to a centralized control type fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicator system, which comprises an emergency lighting controller, an emergency lighting centralized power supply, an emergency lighting distribution box and a centralized power supply type emergency light. The centralized control type fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicator system uses a centralized monitoring mode, and monitors fire safety channels in buildings in real time through information technology, computer technology and automatic control technology, thereby achieving the purpose of intelligence of product maintenance and safety evacuation, solving the problems of routine maintenance of products, automatically analyzing route of escape after obtaining fire alarm fire linkage information, and adjusting evacuation planning. The centralized control type fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicator system eliminates escape evacuation indicator blind zones in the buildings when fire happens, and increases safety factors of the buildings.
assignees: HEFEI LIANXIN POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Fire voice-alert controller for the blind and control method
title_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 화재 음성경보 제어장치와 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm control device for the invisible and a control method thereof are provided to evacuate the invisible to far away from a fire occurring position through an alarm. CONSTITUTION: A fire alarm control device(100) is composed of a signal receiver(110), controller(120), and an alarm controller(130). The signal receiver receives signals from a smoke sensor or a thermal sensor installed adjacent to an exit sign. The controller receives a fire signal from a fire fighting system, a signal from the signal receiver, and generates a control signal after combining the signals. The alarm controller receives the control signal from the controller and blocks the output of an alarm from the exit sign.
abstract_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 화재 음성경보 제어장치가 개시된다. 상기 제어장치는, 유도등 장치에 인접하여 설치된 열 감지기 또는 연기 감지기로부터 출력되는 감지신호를 수신하는 감지신호 수신부; 소방시스템으로부터 화재신호를 수신하고 상기 감지신호 수신부로부터 상기 감지신호를 수신하여 이들을 조합하여 제어신호를 생성하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 제어신호를 수신하여 상기 유도등 장치의 유도안내 음성경보의 출력을 차단하는 음성경보 조절부를 포함한다.

title_en: Device for security monitoring of frontier defense and coastline by communication optical cables
abstract_en: Disclosed is a device for security monitoring of frontier defense and coastlines by communication optical cables. Three optical cable sets are mounted at an import section and respectively are main optical cable, an auxiliary optical cable and an emergency armored cable, wherein the main cable which is linear is mounted on border guardrails, the auxiliary optical cable is arranged blow the guardrails and is curved or zigzag, the emergency armored cable is spaced from the main optical cable by a certain distance and is embedded on a set line. Besides, the emergency armored optical cable, the auxiliary optical cable and the main optical cable are connected with a main monitoring unit of a terminal; the main optical cable is used for acquiring and positioning signals after interruption, the emergent armored optical cable is used for realizing daily communication, video, audio and data transmission task, and cameras and alarms are mounted each section or at important places of the main optical cable, the auxiliary optical cable and the emergency armored optical cable. The device has a precise positioning alarm function, and is safe and reliable. Foreign matters invade or escape when in interruption, conditions can be viewed through video of an emergency circuit, and thus, illegal intruders inside and outside frontier junctions can be prevented to the utmost extent with fewest posts.

title_en: Urgency notification delivery channel
abstract_en: A method including, by one or more computing systems, receiving an indication of a communication from a first user to a second user, calculating an implicit urgency score of the communication, calculating a composite urgency score, determining an urgency of the communication and providing an indication of the urgency as determined for presentation to the second user. The implicit urgency score may be based at least in part on information accessible by the computing systems. The composite urgency score may be based at least in part on the implicit urgency score. The urgency of the communication may be based at least in part on the composite urgency score.

title_en: A notification equipment for the blind
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A notification device for a road reflector for the blind is provided to enable the blind to recognize the approach of a vehicle by an auditory signal and to notify a driver of the walk of the blind by a warning light. CONSTITUTION: A notification device for a road reflector for the blind comprises a sensing unit(11), a control unit(12), an acoustic unit(13), and a light emitting unit(14). The sensing unit recognizes an RFID(Radio Frequency Identification) tag for the blind(20) for sensing the walk of the blind and produces a sensing signal by sensing the approach of a vehicle(30). The acoustic unit produces an auditory warning signal. The light emitting unit operates a warning lamp. [Reference numerals] (11) Sensing unit; (12) Control unit; (13) Acoustic unit; (14) Light emitting unit; (20) Disabled person(Wireless identification tag); (30) Vehicle;
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각이 큰 커브길이나 'T'자형 좁은 골목길에 설치된 도로반사경에 장착되어 진입하고자 하는 방향으로 시각장애인이 보행하고 있음을 차량 운전자가 경고등을 통해 경고할 수 있는 동시에 차량의 진입상태를 시각장애인이 신호음을 통해 인지할 수 있어 교통사고의 위험성에 노출된 시각장애인을 보호할 수 있는 상술한 바와 같이 본 발명의 시각장애인을 위한 도로반사경용 알림장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire alarm system for hearing-impaired person
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired is provided to immediately find fire occurrence and location, regardless of where people with hearing impairment are present indoors. CONSTITUTION: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired includes a plurality of wireless alarm devices(100). The wireless alarm device is installed in the vicinity of a fire detector(50) installed in the ceiling of each room. The wireless alarm device includes a fire detection reception unit(110), a control unit(130), and a wireless transception unit(140). The control unit lights a light-emitting unit if a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit or the wireless transception unit. The control unit transmits the fire detection signal and a unique ID to the other wireless alarm devices when a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit. The other wireless alarm devices display a location corresponding to the unique ID based on the unique ID received from the wireless transception unit on a display unit. [Reference numerals] (50) Smoke detector;
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재감지신호를 무선으로 여러 장소로 송수신하여 청각장애인이 실내 어느 장소에 있더라도 신속하게 화재가 발생하였음을 알려줄 수 있는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위하여, 본 발명은 화재시 청각장애인에게 화재경보를 줄 수 있는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템에 있어서, 상기 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템은 복수 개의 무선경보장치를 포함하며, 상기 무선경보장치는, 화재감지기로부터 감지된 신호를 전송받는 화재감지수신부; 상기 화재감지수신부의 신호를 증폭시키는 증폭부; 상기 무선경보장치에 설치된 각종 부품을 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부에 의하여 다른 무선경보장치와 무선으로 신호를 송수신하기 위한 무선송수신부; 상기 제어부에 의하여 발광하는 발광부를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 제어부는 상기 화재감지수신부 또는 무선송수신부로부터 화재감지신호가 수신되면 상기 발광부를 발광시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템을 제공한다. 
따라서, 본 발명에 의하면 실내에 기존 설치된 화재감지기의 변경 없이 용이하게 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템을 설치할 수 있으며, 청각장애인이 실내 어디에 있든 신속하게 화재발생 여부 및 화재발생 장소를 파악할 수 있어 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 해 준다.

title_en: Fire-fighting access monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting access monitoring device. The fire-fighting access monitoring device comprises a base fixedly connected with fixtures; a rotary mechanism arranged on the base; a range finding sensor arranged on the rotary mechanism; and a control circuit electrically connected with the range finding sensor. The fire-fighting access monitoring device which can periodically monitor fire-fighting accesses in a timing way and a scanning way makes occupied fire-fighting accesses monitored in a timely manner and sends alarm signals through a communication network to a remote fire-fighting management center. By networking a plurality of fire-fighting access monitoring devices, remote monitoring on all the fire-fighting accesses in any building or place can be achieved. The management labor cost of fire-fighting management departments can be significantly lowered. Management on fire-fighting accesses can be enhanced due to the real-time monitoring of the fire-fighting accesses. Therefore, accessibility of the fire-fighting accesses can be realized anytime.

title_en: Double-sound reminding blind-guiding traffic signal lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a traffic equipment field especially relates to a traffic signal lamp. The utility model provides a double-voice warning blind-guiding traffic signal lamp, includes stand, vehicle pilot lamp, pedestrian's pilot lamp and PLC controller, the fixed vertical installation of stand is subaerial, vehicle pilot lamp fixed mounting is on the upper portion of stand, pedestrian's pilot lamp fixed mounting is at the middle part of stand, and the PLC controller sets up in the stand, and PLC controller control connects vehicle pilot lamp and pedestrian's pilot lamp, still be equipped with two vocal wares on the stand, the axis of two vocal wares intersects into 90 degrees. The double-sound reminding blind-guiding traffic signal lamp of the utility model is provided with two sounders with 90-degree orientation on the upright post, so that the sounders correspond to two crossroads of a crossroad one by one, thereby facilitating the identification of the blind; the signal lamp can also realize remote management and monitoring of the signal lamp through the wireless signal transmitting unit and the wireless signal receiving unit, and effectively guarantees the traffic order of the intersection.

title_en: Laser cutting machine alarming device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser cutting machine alarming device. The laser cutting machine alarming device comprises a laser cutting machine and an alarming device. The alarming device comprises inductors, a power source and a lamp body. The inductors are arranged in the inner portion of the laser cutting machine in a dispersing mode. The power source is arranged in the inner portion of the laser cutting machine. The lamp body is arranged on the outer shell of the laser cutting machine. The problem that the existing carbon dioxide type laser cutting machine can not alarm in time when the fire disaster occurs is solved. The inductors are installed below a movable machine frame and are installed in a dispersing mode, thus the whole covering is achieved. A blind area is avoided with the maximum limit.
assignees: HANGZHOU LANTAI MECHNICAL & ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Personal audio cable alarm device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personal audio cable device comprising a personal alarm being easily accessible to a user. The personal audio device is configured to relay electric audio signals to a personal hearing device, said personal audio cable device comprising an electric signal receiving unit, a jack socket configured to receive a jack plug of the personal hearing device. The personal audio cable device comprises an audio alarm unit, and an audio alarm actuating circuit, wherein the audio alarm unit is configured to generate an audio frequency alarm when actuated and triggered by disengaging the jack plug of the hearing device from the jack socket of the personal audio cable device. The audio alarm unit may in also dial up an emergency rescue number, upon actuation. The invention provides how to easily actuate an audio alarm when being attacked by an intruder.

title_en: Wireless Relay Module For Remote Monitoring Systems Having Alarm And Display Functionality
abstract_en: Wireless relay modules for enabling alarm recognition and alerts in networked communications between a series of medical devices and a remote monitoring device via wireless relay networks and/or internet-accessible wireless communications networks. The wireless relay module including a receiver, a first transmitter coupled to the wireless relay network, a second transmitter coupled to the internet-accessible wireless communication network, a controller and a display. The controller identifying if received medical device data from the medical device includes an alarm condition and causing the display to display an alert accordingly. The wireless relay module may additionally include a speaker alone or in combination with a microphone for providing an audible alert of the alarm condition and verbal communication between a local healthcare provider and a clinician at the remote monitoring device.
assignees: WIESNER JOEL D;BREITWEISER KENNETH M;GAINES ROBERT B;TYCO HEALTHCARE

title_en: Earthquake acousto-optic alarming device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the teaching equipment field and the detection field, especially relates to an earthquake acousto-optic alarming device. The earthquake acousto-optic alarming device is characterized in that a bottom plate is provided; the bottom plate is provided with a support, and the support is provided with a conductive cycloid, which is hung vertically on the support; a lower part of the cycloid is provided with a counter weight, and a periphery of the cycloid is provided with a surrounding wire; a closed circuit can be formed by contacting the cycloid with the surrounding wire; an alarming device connected with the circuit is also provided; and the bottom plate is provided with a protruding bottom part. The earthquake acousto-optic alarming device is advantageous in that the structure is simple, the costs are low; no electric energy is consumed, when no alarm is given, therefore the device is environmental friendly and energy saving; by introducing the optic alarming function, the deaf-mutes can be aware of the earthquake; the device is suitable for the use and the production in households; compared to the professional earthquake precursor, the device is convenient and practical.

title_en: Speech synthesis module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a speech synthesis module. The speech synthesis module comprises a casing and a main board arranged in the casing; a digital baseband signal processor, a text-to-speech convertor, an audio coding and decoding device and an analog baseband signal processor are arranged on the main board; the digital baseband signal processor comprises an MCU (microprogrammed control unit) unit and an ASIC (application specific integrated circuit) unit; and a data communication interface and a speech output interface are connected on the main board. The speech synthesis module can covert text into speech, has a simple structure, is easy to connect, and ensures that a disaster early-warning system supports a short message early-warning function.

title_en: Module of alert for disasters and accidents
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic voice notification module for disaster forecasts and alerts is provided to convert disaster data, delivered as a phone call, a text message, or a packet by using a CDMA(Code Division Multiple Access) module, into a voice and outputted by voice. CONSTITUTION: A TTS(Text To Speech) control part(2100) extracts text data from a disaster data and converts the text data into a voice data. A driving information storage part(2200) stores operating system data driving the TTS control part. A memory part(2300) temporarily stores the text data extracted from the TTS control part and the voice data converted from the TTS control part. A voice database part(2400) stores the corresponding data to the voice conversion of the text data and voice data by a phoneme unit or syllable. [Reference numerals] (2100) TTS(Text To Speech) control part; (2200) Driving information storage part; (2300) Memory part; (2400) Voice database part; (2500) Data communication part; (2600) Power management part
abstract_ko: 재난정보에서 문자데이터를 추출하여 문자데이터를 음성데이터로 전환하는 TTS(Text  To Speech)제어부; 상기 TTS제어부를 구동하는 운영체제 데이터를 저장하는 구동정보저장부; 상기 TTS제어부에서 추출된 문자데이터 및 전환되는 음성데이터를 임시로 저장하는 메모리부; 및 문자데이터와 음성데이터의 음성전환 대응정보를 음소 또는 음절 단위로 저장하는 음성데이터베이스부; 를 포함하는 재난재해예경보 자동음성 통보 모듈은 재난, 재해 등이 발생하거나 , 예측이 되는 지역에 경보를 제공하여 인명 피해와 재산피해를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 존재한다.

title_en: Audio guiding device for the blind
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A sound induction device for the blind is provided to wirelessly transmit a guidance requesting signal according to the standard of the sound induction device for the blind in a fire, and to guide an evacuating method in the corresponding position. CONSTITUTION: A sound induction device for the blind is comprised of the followings: an operation table(112) which contains a control code for the blind guidance, a control code for a fire evacuation guidance, a control code for advertisement, and all kinds of predetermined values for the operation under the control code; a memory(110) which stores blind guidance sound source data, fire evacuation guidance sound source data, and advertisement guidance sound source data; a sound output unit; and a control unit which confirms whether the control code in the received wireless signal is the control code for the blind guidance, the control code for the fire evacuation guidance, or the control code for the advertisement in the operation table, plays the blind guidance sound source data, the fire evacuation guidance sound source data, or the advertisement sound source data according to the confirmation result, and outputs the data to a sound output unit. [Reference numerals] (110) Operation table; (120) LED driving unit; (130) Voice processing unit; (132) Voice amplifying unit; (140) Power supplying unit; (142) External power; (144) Emergency power; (152) RF receiving unit; (160) Infrared ray receiving unit; (220,320) Command coding unit; (230,330) RF transmitting unit; (250,350,360) Battery; (410,105) Micom; (420) Key input unit; (430) Display device driving unit; (440) Display device; (450) Infrared ray transmitting unit; (AA) Fire sensing signal; (BB) Basic guide voice source data; (CC) Additional guide voice source data; (DD) Fire evacuation guide voice source data; (EE) Public relation guide voice source data
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 발생 시에 시각장애인용 음성유도기의 규격에 따라 시각장애인용 음성유도기에 안내 요청 신호를 무선으로 송출하고, 이에 응하여 시각장애인용 음성유도기가 해당 위치에서의 대피 방법 등을 음성으로 안내할 수 있도록 함으로써 시각장애인 음성유도기의 활용도를 극대화시킬 수 있도록 한 시각장애인 음성유도기용 무선 송신 장치 및 이에 사용되는 시각장애인 음성유도기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 시각장애인 음성유도기용 무선 송신 장치는 시설물에 고정 설치되어 당해 시설물에 설치된 시각장애인용 음성유도기와 통신하되, 화재감지신호가 입력된 경우에 화재알림용 제어 코드를 발생시키는 명령 코딩부 및 상기 명령 코딩부에 의해 발생된 상기 화재알림용 제어 코드를 시각장애인용 음성유도기의 캐리어 주파수에 실어서 출력하는 RF 송신부를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
전술한 구성에서, 상기 화재감지신호는 시설물에 설치된 소화전의 경종에 공급되는 직류전원이거나 시설물에 설치된 화재 감지기로부터의 화재 감지 신호인 것을 특징으로 한다. 
화재를 감지하는 연 감지기 또는 열 감지기를 더 구비하고, 상기 화재감지신호는 상기 연 감지기 또는 상기 열 감지기로부터 입력될 수도 있다.

title_en: Intelligent blind walking stick
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent blind walking stick. An existing blind walking stick can only detect whether a barrier exists at a short distance by the tip and cannot detect barriers out of the distance of the walking stick, and often when the danger is near, the blind cannot sense the danger and the avoidless disaster usually can be generated. The intelligent blind walking stick comprises a walking stick (1); the walking stick is provided with an intelligent control box (2); an ultrasonic distance measurement singlechip microcomputer system (3) is arranged in the intelligent control box; the ultrasonic distance measurement singlechip microcomputer system is connected with an ultrasonic transmitting and receiving circuit (4); the ultrasonic transmitting and receiving circuit is connected with an alarm output circuit (5); and the alarm output circuit is connected with a buzzer (6). The intelligent blind walking stick is used for a blind walking stick.

title_en: Automatic alarm pill case
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 질병의 치료 또는 건강증진 등의 목적으로 여러 가지 약을 장기간 복용할 때에 약수납을 간편하게 하고 정해진 일시에 정해진 약을 빠뜨리지 않고 꾸준히 복용할 수 있게 도와주는 지능형 약상자에 관한 것으로서, 복용할 봉지약이나 알약을 각각의 수납공간에 수납하고 전자화 된 컨트롤부를 활용해 복용 시작일자, 복용 마지막 일자, 하루중 복용횟수, 복용시간을 미리 셋팅하고 시각장애인도 쉽게 인지할 수 있는 양각된 글자를 약상자 뚜껑에 새겨 넣고 약복용 확인센서 및 LED를 활용해 약물 오남용을 방지하고 보다 높은 약복용율로 약복용자의 건강 증진에 도움이 되는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     종래에는 약을 조제 할 때에 약 먹을 시간과 날짜에 따른 구분을 미리 설정하여 각각의 약봉지에 봉합함으로 장기간 보관 할 경우 그 내용물인 약이 파손되거나 물과 습기에 약하고 흡수된 수분이 약재를 손상시키거나 성분의 변질을 일으키는 단점과 기억력 감퇴로 인해 약복용을 빠뜨리는 경우가 왕왕 발생되고 있었다. 
     또한 봉투에 그 복용 방법을 인쇄 또는 필기할 경우 기재가 쉽게 지워져 정확한 복용을 어렵게 하며 맹인의 경우에는 기재를 읽을 수 없는 폐단이 있어왔다. 
     본 고안은 전술한 문제점을 개선하기 위하여 안출된 것으로서 최대 한달 정도의 약을 수납하게 될 복용 시간대별 약수납부(아침,점심,저녁,취침전,기타)와 각각의 뚜껑으로 이루어지는 약상자와 상기 뚜껑표면에 양각의 문자를 새겨 넣어 시각장애인들도 구분 할 수 있도록 하고 각각의 약복용에 관한 시간을 셋팅하고 약복 용을 음성으로 알려주는 컨트롤부로 나누어 종래의 단점을 간단히 개선함을 목적으로 한 고안이다 
       
     약복용 확인 센서 --- 약 복용 여부를 확인하기 위해 설치하는 센서. 봉지약 정리기 --- 분리된 봉지약을 가지런히 정리하기 위한 구성품

title_en: Abrasive material recycling system
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An abrasive material recycling system is provided to protect workers from an industrial accident by maintaining a clean work site and to improve the durability of the abrasive material recycling system by minimizing impact and overload which occurs in the separation process. CONSTITUTION: An abrasive material recycling system comprises a collection part (100), a separation part (200), and a storage part. The collection part removes dust and moisture included in the transferred waste abrasive material. The separation part separates iron and foreign substances included in the waste abrasive transferred from the collection part step-by-step. The storage part stores the recycled abrasive material. The collection part comprises a supply hopper (110), a waster abrasive material supply pipe (120), and a dust suction pipe (130). The waster abrasive material supply pipe transfers the waster abrasive material to the supply hopper with the vacuum of a vacuum generator (400). The dust suction pipe is connected between the vacuum generator and the supply hopper to suck the dust included in the transferred waste abrasive material.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 사용된 연마재를 수거해서 재생하기 위해, 진공발생장치의 진공에 의해 폐연마재를 이송하는 연마재 재생장치에 있어서, 수거부, 분리부, 저장부로 구성되며, 상기 수거부는 진공발생장치의 진공에 의해 이송된 폐연마재의 분진과 습기를 제거하여 분리부로 이송하고, 상기 분리부는 폐연마재에 포함된 이물질을 단계적으로 분리하여 저장부에 저장하여, 폐연마재의 재생효율을 높여 연마재의 신규 구매 비용을 절약하고, 산업폐기물을 감소시켜 환경보호에 일조하고, 청결한 작업현장을 유지하여 산업재해로부터 작업자를 보호하고, 분리과정에서 발생하는 충격과 과부하를 최소화하여 연마재 재생장치의 내구성을 높이는 연마재 재생장치에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은, 사용된 연마재를 수거해서 재생하기 위해, 진공발생장치의 진공에 의해 폐연마재를 이송하는 연마재 재생장치에 있어서, 상기 진공발생장치의 진공에 의해 폐연마재가 이송되고, 상기 이송된 폐연마재에 포함된 분진과 습기를 제거하는 수거부; 상기 수거부로부터 이송된 폐연마재에 포함된 철분과 이물질을 단계적으로 분리하는 분리부; 상기 분리부에서 이물질이 분리되어 재사용이 가능한 상태로 재생된 연마재가 저장되는 저장부;로 구성된다.

title_en: System and method for delivering mobile wireless broadcast messages in designated languages
abstract_en: A mobile wireless system and method are described for distributing emergency alert messages to mobile wireless devices in multiple languages. The emergency alert system receives an alert message including a geographic area identification, and a text alert. The emergency alert system renders one or more translations of the text alert from the text alert. The one or more translated versions of the text alert are provided in particular foreign languages based upon designated foreign languages corresponding to the geographic area identification. The emergency alert system transmits the text alert and one or more translated text alerts commercial mobile wireless service provider networks for broadcasting the text alert and the translated text alert(s) via mobile wireless transmitters having a coverage area falling within a region corresponding to the geographic area identification.
assignees: LEMBERG VYACHESLAV;THALANANY SEBASTIAN;SAXENA NAROTHUM;US CELLULAR CORP

title_en: Air-defense alarm raising system based on Beidou short-message communication technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air-defense alarm raising system which comprises a control center and an alarm terminal. The control center is composed of a control-center host and a Beidou short-message communication module which is connected with the control-center host, the alarm terminal is composed of an alarm-terminal host and a Beidou short-message communication module which is connected with the alarm-terminal host, and the control center communicates short messages with the alarm terminal via the Beidou short-message communication modules to raise the alarm. The air-defense alarm raising system is characterized by simple principle, low cost, high reliability, strong emergency response capability and coverage free of blind areas.
assignees: NANJING JUNLI INTELLIGENT & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Voice light alarm lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an alarm device field, concretely relates to pronunciation light alarm lamp, including main control board, chargeable and discharge power supply unit, the automatic power automatic switch who communicates with power supply unit behind the commercial power disconnection, the luminous body that twinkles after circular telegram, speaker, recording device, recording switch and broadcast switch, power supply unit passes through power automatic switch and connects the main control board, and the main control board is connected to the luminous body, and recording device is all connected to recording switch and broadcast switch, and the speaker is connected to the recording device, and the main control board is connected to the speaker. Under the normal power supply condition of commercial power, the utility model discloses a power supply unit is in charged state. After the commercial power is disconnected, the power automatic transfer switch is connected with the power supply device, the power supply device supplies power to the outside, and the loudspeaker plays audio information in the recording device. The audio information of the recording device can be recorded by the recording switch and the broadcasting switch. The luminous body can flash after being electrified, and has stronger prompting effect for deaf people.
assignees: DONGGUAN JIANXI BARRIER FREE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Portable instrument for warning deaf people of objects moving at back sides
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable instrument for warning deaf people of objects moving at back sides, and is characterized in that the portable instrument comprises a detector and a hand ring, wherein a detector power supply, an ultrasonic detector module, a detector master controller and a wireless transmitting module are disposed in the detector, and a hand ring power supply, a wireless receiving module, a hand ring master controller and a lighting vibration module are disposed in the hand ring; the detector power supply is individually connected with the ultrasonic detector module, the detector master controller and the wireless transmitting module, the ultrasonic detector module is connected with the detector master controller, the detector master controller is connected with the wireless transmitting module, and the wireless transmitting module is in wireless connection with the wireless receiving module; and the wireless receiving module is connected with the hand ring master controller, the hand ring master controller is connected with the lighting vibration module, and the hand ring power supply is individually connected with the wireless receiving module, the hand ring master controller and the lighting vibration module. The portable instrument is simple in structure, convenient in usage and small in size.

title_en: Environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system based on forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the environment monitoring field, and provides an environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system based on forest fire prevention. The environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system comprises a wireless communication module, a satellite communication module, a satellite positioning module, a video monitoring module, a sensor module, a power supply module and a central processor, wherein the output ends of the satellite positioning module, the video monitoring module and the sensor module are respectively connected with the input terminal of the central processor, the central processor is respectively connected with the wireless communication module and the satellite communication module, and the wireless communication module, the satellite communication module, the satellite positioning module, the video monitoring module, the sensor module and thee central processor are electrically connected with the power supply module respectively. Through satellite positioning and satellite communication, the environment monitoring GPS and communication pre-warning system realizes complementation of communication blind areas of 2G and 3G networks and covers a wider scope. Solar power supply, resource conservation and environment protection are achieved. The pre-warning system is simple in structure, convenient for use, easy for operation and low in cost.

title_en: Cable tunnel multi-state comprehensive monitoring system based on integration of optical, mechanical and electrical technologies
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cable tunnel multi-state comprehensive monitoring system based on integration of optical, mechanical and electrical technologies. The monitoring system comprises a data processing system, a video monitoring subsystem, an alarm subsystem, a distributed fiber temperature-measurement subsystem and a tunnel state on-line monitoring subsystem. The monitoring system which can monitor the body temperature of cables inside tunnels, cable protective layer currents, poisonous and harmful gas, accumulated water and well lids further performs video monitoring, foreign matter invasion alarming, etc. The monitoring system can further perform expanded monitoring and controlling on cable partial discharge, communication systems, draining systems, blower fan systems, entrance guard systems, fire-fighting linkage alarm systems, illumination control systems inside the tunnels, etc. The monitoring system provides a comprehensive safety guarantee for cable tunnels and significantly enhances the intelligentization construction of tunnels.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Interactive calling and alarming control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an interactive calling and alarming control system. Connection relation of internal modules of the interactive calling and alarming control system is that: an interactive control module, a wireless control module, and a doorbell control unit are connected with a system control unit, and the system control unit is connected with a voice unit, an information display unit, and a vibration prompting unit. The interactive calling and alarming control system can be used to facilitate daily life, study and management of a school for deaf-mutes, a school for blinds, a kindergarten and a primary school automatically, and to achieve quick alarm and processing for emergencies, so as to avoid the situation that a deaf-mute person who cannot hear, a blind person who cannot see, and a child who is lack of safety protection capability, cannot handle work and rest in daily life or in study, and call and alarm in emergencies.

title_en: A wearable type head mounted display device for hearing impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a head-wearable display device for a hearing-impaired person, which enables a person to prepare for emergency by separately displaying voice signals or sound signals using text subtitles or symbols. For this, the present invention provides a head-wearable display device for a hearing-impaired person comprising: a subtitle processing and control unit for processing and analyzing a sound signal received from the outside and outputting a display symbol according to the direction and sort of the sound signal, or recognizing the sound signal, converting the sound signal into a subtitle, and transmitting the subtitle to a head-wearable display unit through cables; and the head wearing display unit for transmitting a voice signal inputted by a microphone to the subtitle processing and control unit, receiving a display control signal from the subtitle processing and control unit, and outputting a display symbol or a text subtitle corresponding to the display control signal, thereby enabling users having hearing impairment to recognize a dangerous situation in case of emergency. [Reference numerals] (10) Subtitle processing and control unit;(11) Sound signal processing unit;(12) Voice signal processing unit;(13) Subtitle display unit;(14) Battery;(23a) Fire alarm
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 머리 착용형 디스플레이 장치에 관한 것으로, 음성신호나 소리신호를 문자 자막이나 기호 등으로 구분 표시하여 유사시 대응할 수 있게 하는 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 외부에서 수신되는 음원 신호를 신호처리 및 분석하여 소리신호의 방향과 종류에 따라 표시기호를 구동하거나 음성신호를 인식 및 자막으로 변환하여 유선을 통해 머리 착용형 표시기로 전송하는 자막처리 및 제어기, 마이크에서 입력되는 음원 신호를 자막처리 및 제어기로 전송하고 자막처리 및 제어기로부터 표시 제어신호를 입력받아 그에 대응하는 표시기호 또는 문자 자막을 출력하는 머리 착용형 표시기를 포함하는 청각장애인을 위한 머리 착용형 디스플레이 장치를 제공하여, 청각장애 또는 난청이 있는 사용자들이 유사시 위험상황을 인식할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Instrument for detecting and alerting during an emergency situation
abstract_en: An alarm system with an integral high-intensity illumination means comprising reflective beads for increased visibility is intended to provide alarm notification for the hard-of-hearing or deaf individuals. The illumination means on the bottom provides visual notification to deaf or hard of hearing building occupants and those who may outside of the building. To aid in the visual observation of the illumination means, a series of reflective beads are hung from the bottom of the detector.

title_en: Blindfold
abstract_en: The present invention provides a blindfold for sleeping, capable of more securely waking up a user by notifying the user of alarm time with visual, aural, or tactical methods if it is preset alarm time. The blindfold for sleeping according to the present invention includes a blindfold part (100) and an alarm device (200) which is mounted on the blindfold part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자가 사전에 정한 알람시각이 되면 이를 시각(발광), 청각(음향), 촉각(진동)적 방식 중 하나 또는 둘 이상의 방식으로 알려 줌으로써 사용자를 잠에서 보다 확실하게 깨울 수 있는 수면 안대를 제공한다.

title_en: Alert system
abstract_en: An alert system includes centrally-located alarm device and a plurality of handheld remote devices, each remote device storing a unique identification code. Upon a primary depression of an externally-accessible actuation button, a mobile device in direct communication with each remote device transmits a predefined distress message to a predefined emergency responder which can be used to provide immediate assistance. Upon a secondary depression of the actuation button, each remote device transmits a wireless distress signal encoded with its unique identification code that in turn causes the alarm to emit an auditory and visual alarm. An alarm monitoring center is in communication with the alarm device and automatically receives historical data relating to activation of the alarm device, the historical data including, for instance, the identification code of the remote unit responsible for activation of the alarm device as well as the time and date of the transmitted distress signal.

title_en: Solar warning lamp for power overhead line passing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric overhead line passing solar warning lamp, which comprises an upper lamp shell and a lower lamp shell, wherein the upper lamp shell and the lower lamp shell are connected with each other, a hook is arranged at the top end of the upper lamp shell, a solar panel is installed in the upper lamp shell, a antimagnetic cover is arranged in the solar panel, a antimagnetic cover cap is arranged at the lower end of the antimagnetic cover, a main control circuit board and a storage battery are arranged in the antimagnetic cover, the solar panel is connected with the main control circuit board through a connecting wire and a wire passing hole in the antimagnetic cover, an ultrasonic sensor and a loudspeaker are arranged on the lower lamp shell, a sensor circuit board is arranged in the lower lamp shell, and an LED, an infrared sensor and; the upper lamp shell and the lower lamp shell are both made of light-transmitting materials. According to the invention, the two sensors are used for respectively carrying out living body approach detection and foreign body approach detection, alarm information is sent out in time, the overhead line is prevented from being collided by mistake, a power supply is provided by adopting solar energy, and the existing energy is saved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ZHENGZHOU HUALI INF TECH CO LTD;HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;ZHENGZHOU XIANGYU TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;HENAN RUIPU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Manhole cover missing caution and intelligent radio alarm system
abstract_en: A manhole cover missing caution and intelligent radio alarm system comprises a computer monitoring terminal, a plurality of wireless repeaters and a plurality of manhole cover missing alarm devices. The computer monitoring terminal carries out data transmission with the wireless repeaters through a wireless interface mode, receives information of each manhole cover missing alarm device and displays a manhole cover state on a computer screen. The wireless repeaters are responsible for receiving and sending the information of the nearby manhole cover missing alarm devices to the computer monitoring terminal so that a blind area which can not be monitored by the manhole cover missing alarm devices is avoided. Each manhole cover missing alarm device comprises a cell, a voltage control switch, a central processor plate, a wireless alarm conveyer, a caution system and a sound and light alarm device. By using the system, when the manhole cover is missing, warning marks can be popped around the manhole cover and sound-light alarm can be emitted so that pedestrians and vehicles are timely warned and an accident of falling into a well is avoided as far as possible. Simultaneously, through an electronic detection technology and radio communication, manhole cover missing information is sent to a municipal administrative center.

title_en: Microwave dryer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dryers and provides a microwave dryer. The microwave dryer comprises a case, a microwave generator, a microwave suppressor, an exhaust port, an inlet and an outlet. The microwave dryer is characterized by further comprising a conveying belt, an adjusting device, a foreign matter detection device, a radiation detection device and an automatic flame detection device, wherein the conveying belt is arranged between the inlet and the outlet, and two ends of the conveying belt penetrate through the microwave suppressor connected with outsides of the inlet and the outlet respectively; the adjusting device is connected with the conveying belt and the microwave generator; the foreign matter detection device is located at the inlet and connected with an alarm device; the radiation detection device is located on the outer surface of the case and connected with the alarm device; and the automatic flame detection device is connected with the alarm device and a spray firefighting device. According to the microwave dryer, the problem that the drying rate, the strength of emitted microwaves and residual moisture in dried things cannot be adjusted is solved. The microwave dryer has the characteristics of fire protection, microwave leakage prevention and more safety.

title_en: Fire alarm device for the blind in factory
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alarm device, and particularly relates to a fire alarm device for the blind in a factory. The fire alarm device comprises a body. The lower end surface of the body is provided with an installation supporting base. The body is provided with a signal receiving device which is connected with a control circuit. The upper end surface of the body is provided with a protruding indication arrowhead which indicates an escape direction. The head end of the indication arrowhead is provided with a high-volume loudspeaker. The tail end of the indication arrowhead is provided with a low-volume loudspeaker. The high-volume loudspeaker and the low-volume loudspeaker are connected with the control circuit. The side surface of the body is provided with a protruding second indication arrowhead. The objective of the invention is to provide the alarm device by which people can be guided to escape from a scene of fire without using eyes.

title_en: Compact local operation pannel
abstract_en: Although a conventional industrial site operating panel is intermittently operated, installation costs are too high and installation spaces are too big, thereby a space usability and safety are compromised and the conventional site operating panel is limited in terms of a kind of operator information, availabilities, and distances. To solve the above-mentioned problems, circuits are miniaturized, the size of the site operating panel is reduced, and operator information is diversified. A main frame (41) is added in a motor control panel (20) and information for the site operating panel and an alarm lamp (60) is transmitted to and received from the site operating panel (10) in a digital format via a dedicated cable. Therefore, the motor control panel (20), site operating panel (10), and alarm lamp (60) are integrated in one system. A specialized system, which is 100% compatible with specific sites without modifying conventional circuits and configured to be 1:1 matched with loads, is thus provided according to the present invention, such that construction and maintenance costs are reduced. A machinery room is provided to improve accessibility of operators. The site operating panel is installed in various ways such as on walls or ceilings as well as on grounds, such that installation convenience is improved and negligent accidents are prevented. A voice alarm and the alarm lamp are installed, such that a remote status monitoring is enabled. title_en: Solar warning lamp for power overhead line passing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric power overhead line solar energy warning light that passes through way, it contains upper lamp body and lower lamp body, and the two are interconnected together, the top of upper lamp body is provided with the couple, install solar panel in the upper lamp body, be provided with the antimagnetic cover in the solar panel, the lower extreme of antimagnetic cover is provided with the antimagnetic shroud, be provided with main control circuit board and battery in the antimagnetic cover, solar panel through the connecting wire with the line passing hole on the antimagnetic cover is connected with main control circuit board, be provided with ultrasonic sensor and loudspeaker on the lower lamp body, be provided with the sensor circuit board in the lower lamp body, be provided with LED, infrared sensor and bee calling organ on the sensor circuit board; the upper lamp shell and the lower lamp shell are both made of light-transmitting materials. The utility model discloses a two kinds of sensors carry out the life body respectively and are close to the detection and the foreign matter is close to the detection, in time send alarm information, prevent that the mistake from hitting overhead line, adopt solar energy to provide the power, practice thrift the current energy.

title_en: Surveillance and Security Communications Platform
abstract_en: A surveillance and security communications platform for detecting and responding to potential emergencies is provided. The platform may be utilized to automatically open communications channels via multiple media streams based on predefined settings for detecting a potential emergency situation. The platform may further be utilized to automatically send video and audio streams to an emergency responder upon detecting the potential emergency situation. The platform may further be utilized to detect the potential emergency situation while it is occurring and automatically initiate escalated emergency notifications to multiple parties. The platform may further be utilized to receive computing device sensor data for detecting the potential emergency for a potential victim in a business or home setting and immediately send an emergency notification, which may include a predefined text-to-speech announcement, to emergency responders in order to mitigate the potential emergency.

title_en: Detecting and early warning device for A-pillar vision blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detecting and early warning device for an A-pillar vision blind area. The device comprises an information acquisition unit, a sensor unit, a master control unit, an alarm module and a power supply, wherein the sensor unit is in coupling connection with the information acquisition unit, the sound and light alarm module is in coupling connection with the master control unit, the power supply is in coupling connection with the master control unit, and the information acquisition unit communicates with the master control unit through a CAN-BUS. According to the detecting and early warning device for the A-pillar vision blind area, when the device detects that the distance between a vehicle and a barrier is smaller than an early warming value, the sound and light alarm is started to remind a driver of braking/avoiding, if the device detects that the vehicle has no braking/avoiding behavior, a safety procedure is started, and braking control is started, so that vehicle damage and casualties caused after the vehicle collides with pedestrians and other barriers are prevented.

title_en: Medical informational kit for emergency responders
abstract_en: The need for medical information to explain a potential patient's medical condition is greatly desired by emergency medical responders. Often the patient is unconscious or confused and therefore unable to communicate clearly with the emergency responder. Thus there is a need for this information in a location most likely accessible to an emergency responder. The medical information kit has the patient's medical information and comprises at least a triplicate form, two sealed containers, one magnet sign, one adhesive label sign and optionally one key-chain fob sign. One copy of the form is placed in a container and placed in the refrigerator/medicine cabinet, to alert an emergency responder. Another copy of the form is placed is the second sealed container and placed in the glove compartment of the auto of the patient. Lastly, the last sheet of the triplicate form is placed in the patient's wallet, next to the driver's license.

title_en: Safe timing fuel gas stove
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safe timing fuel gas stove including a fuel gas stove body. The fuel gas stove body is provided with a flame adjusting device connected with a timing device; the fuel gas stove body is also provided with a flame induction device connected to a fuel gas tube; the side edges of the fuel gas stove body are provided with limit inductors and an alarm device, and four side edges of the fuel gas stove body are each provided with the inductor. The structure is simple, and the arrangement of the timing device and the flame adjusting device enables people to finish cooking in a case of outgoing. The arrangement of the limit inductors and the alarm device allow an alarm to be emitted when a child closely contacts the fuel gas stove or a foreign matter touches the fuel gas stove, so as to avoid the child from being scalded or burnt due to close contact with the fuel gas stove under an unattended condition, and also avoid fire disasters from generating to some extent.

title_en: Warning system comprising wristband embodiment
abstract_en: The present invention is related to warning systems(S) that enable the people to detect various electrical warning signals around by means of vibration and light, to inform the third persons in the emergencies and to provide the electricity and gas where they are present, to be cut automatically in case of emergencies. The present invention is especially related to a warning device that enables the hearing impaired people, the elderly, children and patients to transform the various electrical signals into vibration and/or light, the people to detect said sound warnings, the two users that are using wristband (41) to contact with each other, all the users to be warned, and only one user to be called/warned; and to the warning method of said device.

title_en: Emergency notification system for hearing-impaired persons and the like
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency notification system for hearing-impaired persons and the like in which, wherever a hearing-impaired person or the like who is disable to utter, can make an emergency notification at ease and surely and can receive the result thereof, and a notification method.SOLUTION: The emergency notification system comprises: a notification application for transmitting positional information and emergency information to a notification server; the notification server in which a present position is transferred to the positional information server together with member information and artificially converted into voices by a voice synthesis section and a telephone set at the side of a call center is called; and the call center in which an operator receives the emergency information via a display of the positional information server and the telephone set and then requires a dispatch to an emergency agency. Dial buttons of the telephone set corresponding to several kinds of message patterns encoded beforehand are pressed, one response message selected from among a plurality of encoded response messages is transmitted and the message is displayed in the notification application, thereby contacting a person who made the notification.

title_en: Intelligent calling device for train
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a calling device for communication between train passengers and trainmen, and specifically relates to an intelligent calling device for a train. The intelligent calling device is mainly formed by a housing body, a microcontroller, a calling input circuit, a buzzing calling circuit, a calling flickering circuit, a liquid crystal display circuit, a response circuit, a vibration drive circuit, a vibration device and a power supply device. Each call button provided in the calling input circuit is provided with protruded braille indications which help the blind to carry out identification in a touching manner. The buzzing calling circuit and the calling flickering circuit output sound-light alarm signals after receiving service signals to remind the trainmen to arrange correlation services; after receiving the service signals, the trainmen feed response signals back to the passengers through a response circuit; and the vibration drive circuit drives the vibration device to generate vibration signals, thereby greatly improving communication efficiency between disadvantaged groups, such as the blind and the deaf-mute and the like, and the trainmen.

abstract_ko: 본 고안에 따른 터널 막장 안전관리 시스템은 터널 막장 내부에 설치되어 막정면의 변위를 측정하는 레이저 거리계, 상기 레이저 거리계의 측정 데이터를 수신하여 변화를 분석하는 계측수단, 상기 계측수단의 정보를 수신하여 막장을 모니터링하는 관리수단, 상기 계측수단에서 계측한 데이터의 변화가 설정치를 초과하는 경우 경보음과 경고 조명을 발생하는 경보수단 및 상기 레이저 거리계의 전원을 공급하고 상기 복수의 레이저 거리계와 결합하며, 레이저 거리계를 소정 위치에 고정시키는 고정수단을 포함한다.

title_en: Alarm system and alarm device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an alarm system and an alarm device that uses flash light, whereby even a visually impaired person is made aware of fire breakout and urged to evacuate, without causing optically-stimulated epileptic seizure.SOLUTION: In an alarm system having a plurality of alarm devices that emit flash light on the basis of a fire signal from a piece of automatic fire alarm equipment, the fire alarms are grouped for each evacuation route, each alarm device is provided with synchronization means, and also provided with synchronization correction means for preventing the synchronization means of the alarm device from losing synchronism. Thereby, the alarm devices are simultaneously activated by a fire signal, and emit flash light with a common light emission period. At least the alarm devices of the same group repeat flash light emission stably and synchronously.

title_en: Add-on device for a mobile communication device and system and method for receiving an alarming signal
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to an add-on device (11) for a mobile communication device (12, 62) being adapted to transmit a communication signal to another communication device (12, 62) via a distinct signal line (18, 73, 74), and to a system (1, 61) and a method for receiving an alarming signal. 
     In order to allow a better accessibility for the transmission of an alarming signal transmission, the invention suggests that the add-on device (11) comprises a FM radio antenna (22) having a bandwidth including the frequency range of an alarming signal broadcast by a FM radio sender (5), and a FM radio receiver (27) adapted to receive the alarming signal from the FM radio antenna (22). The FM radio receiver (27) is adapted to forward the alarming signal to a user interface (14, 64) of the mobile communication device (12, 62) through a signal connection (15) with the mobile communication device (12,62).

title_en: Domestic ladder with escape function
abstract_en: Disclosed is a domestic ladder with the escape function. A domestic aluminum alloy herringbone ladder (1) which is qualified as a main body structure; a folding type external hanging device (2) is added to the ladder to enable the ladder to be hung outside a windowsill or a balcony so as to enable the indoor personnel to escape or avoid fires or other disasters through the ladder; the ladder is provided with a descent rescue device hanging ring (3) and accordingly a descent rescue device is convenient to use; an escape toolkit (5) is assembled on the ladder; the lower end of the ladder is connected with a chain type extension rope ladder (6); a wireless smoke synchronous alarm device, a sound and light alarm device and an LED (Light Emitting Diode) emergency lamp (4) which are applied to the early fire alarm, the help-seeking foreign aid alarm and the emergency lighting at night respectively are integrated on the ladder; the ladder is provided with a magnetic suction type charging rod (8) and a 12 V uninterruptible power supply (9). The domestic ladder with the escape function, the double functions of the daily use and the self-escape are achieved and accordingly the domestic ladder is suitable for household use.

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for emergency notifications to the hearing impaired
abstract_en: Systems and methods for communicating emergency alerts to a hearing-impaired user are disclosed. Queries are performed to one or more emergency alert databases to develop emergency alert notifications. At least some of the emergency alert notifications are filtered responsive to user selected criteria to select one or more filtered emergency alerts. An attention desired indicator is transmitted to a hearing-impaired user device that subscribes to a hearing-impaired relay service supported by the server if the one or more filtered emergency alerts are present. The filtered emergency alerts are transmitted to the hearing-impaired user device in response to a emergency information query from that user device.

title_en: Transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system which comprises a storage battery, an infrared monitoring module, a logic judging module, a warning loudspeaker and a warning lamp. Whether a foreign object invading the line safety distance exists in the transmission line protection area or not is monitored and judged by transmitting and receiving infrared rays at the high frequency. The installation position and height of the transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system are set according to the line safety distance, and warning is conducted before the foreign object enters the transmission line protection area. By means of the transmission line anti-contact and anti-external-force warning system, voice and light warning can be given before a large machine such as a crane or a controllable foreign object enters or gets close to the transmission line protection area, the problem that the safety distance of the transmission line is invaded is fundamentally solved, the phenomenon that vehicles and other machines flow frequently or the phenomenon that the contact accident occurs in the constructed transmission line protection area is avoided, the effect of protecting the transmission line against external force is improved, personal safety of personnel and safe and reliable running of the transmission line are better guaranteed.

title_en: Alarm system and alarm device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an alarm system and alarm device using flash light which are capable of notifying even a hearing-impaired person of the occurrence of a fire to prompt evacuation without causing photosensitive epilepsy.SOLUTION: In an alarm system having a plurality of alarm devices that emit flash light on the basis of a fire signal from an automatic fire alarm system, the alarm devices are grouped for each evacuation route. In each of the groups, the alarm devices repeat the operation of emitting flash light in order from an alarm device farthest from an emergency exit or an alarm device associated with a fire sensor that has detected a fire along the evacuation route toward an alarm device that is located at the end of the route, so as to perform evacuation guidance toward the emergency exit that is located at the end of the evacuation route.

title_en: Alarm system and alarm device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an alarm system using flash light configured to notify a person, including the hearing impaired, about fire breakout to urge evacuation without causing photosensitive epilepsy, and to provide an alarm device.SOLUTION: An alarm system includes a plurality of alarm devices which emit flash light on the basis of a fire signal from an automatic fire alarm system. The alarm devices are grouped by evacuation route. In each group, flash light-emitting operation is repeated along the evacuation route from an alarm device located closest to a fire sensor which has transmitted a fire sensing signal toward an alarm device located at the terminal in sequence with a predetermined phase difference, to evacuate a person toward an emergency exit located at the terminal of the evacuation route.
