title_en: Photoelectric alarm device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photoelectric alarm device, which comprises a photoelectric sensor, a controller, a strong light, an althorn and a camera device, wherein the photoelectric sensor, the strong light, the althorn and the camera device are respectively in linear connection with the controller; the photoelectric sensor is a bijection-type photoelectric sensor or a diffuse reflection-type photoelectric sensor; and the controller comprises a time delay switch; and the photoelectric sensor is connected with the trigger end of the time delay switch. In the above mode, the invention discloses a photoelectric alarm device. When invasion of a foreign object is sensed by the photoelectric sensor, the time delay switch is triggered, high pitch and strong light alarm is carried out for a certain period of time, video recording work is carried out at the same time, certain privacy is provided, common energy consumption is low, and durability of the device is good.

title_en: Tactile and Visual Smoke Detector System
abstract_en: A multi-feedback fire alarm system incorporating a wearable signal notification article is provided. The system detects fire threats and notifies users of specific threat types, even when the user is not in proximity to a detection unit. The system includes one or more detection units and one or more wearable signal notification articles. When the detection unit perceives danger, it sends an activation signal and an alarm signal to the signal notification article to alert the user that a threat is present. The wearable signal notification article comprises a flexible bracelet-style housing, and an integrated alert circuit module with a sensor chip, an antenna, multiple light sources, a vibrator, and a battery. Different illumination and vibration patterns occur depending upon the type of threat present and the associated alarm signal received. In this way, the device provides specific threat type information to hearing impaired users.

title_en: Performance with the discharge of the high-pressure and high-speed axial flow pump
title_ko: 고압 및 고속의 토출 성능을 갖는 축류펌프
abstract_en: An axial flow pump with high pressure and high speed discharge performance of the present invention comprises: a pipe-shaped casing, which has a pipe shape and has a curved section in the orthogonal direction from an inlet to be formed long in the axial direction from the inlet, and which has a high pressure generating unit, a spiral vortex generating unit, and a high pressure generating unit in order from the inlet by being formed as steps getting smaller in the inner diameter toward an outlet formed to have a small diameter in a neck unit; a rotation axis, which is installed in the axial direction in order to be located in the center inside the casing, and which is connected to an operating device by penetrating toward the outside in the curved section in one end; a first impeller, which is located in the high pressure generating unit and is installed in the rotation axis; multiple spiral guide flags, which are formed to protrude in the inner wall of the pipe of the spiral vortex generating unit; and a second impeller, which is installed in the rotation axis by being located in the high pressure generating unit, and which has a smaller outer diameter than the outer diameter of the first impeller. Accordingly, the axial flow pump with high pressure and high speed discharge performance minimizes the change in the amount of discharge by absorbing the large amount of fluids and can be used as an alternative to a traditional expensive fire pump by spraying fluids at high pressure and high speed from the outlet. Also, the axial flow pump can remove impurities or foreign substances contained in fluids, using a filtering member, so the axial flow pump can be prevented from being damaged. In addition, the rotation direction and speed of the first impeller and the second impeller can be controlled as required, so the discharge pressure and amount are easily variable according to a target fluid or a pumping environment.
abstract_ko:
본 발명 고압 및 고속의 토출 성능을 갖는 축류펌프는 관 형상으로 이루어져 흡입구로부터 직각방향으로 곡선구간이 형성되고, 이로부터 축 방향으로 길게 이루어지되, 목 부분 내경이 작게 형성된 토출구쪽으로 갈수록 내경이 점차적으로 작아지는 계단형으로 이루어져서 흡입구로부터 고압발생부, 나선형와류발생부 및 고압발생부가 순차적으로 형성되어 이루어진 관 형상의 케이싱; 상기 케이싱 내부 정중앙에 위치되게 축 방향으로 설치되고, 일단부는 곡선구간에서 외측으로 관통되어 구동장치와 연결되어 있는 회전축; 상기 고압발생부에 위치되어 상기 회전축에 설치되는 제1임펠러; 상기 나선형와류발생부의 관 내벽에 돌출 형성되는 다수의 나선형안내깃; 상기 고압발생부에 위치되어 상기 회전축에 설치되고 상기 제1임펠러의 외경보다 작은 외경을 가지는 제2임펠러;로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라 유체를 대량으로 흡입하여 토출 유량의 변화를 최소화시키면서도 토출구에서는 고압 및 고속으로 유체가 분사되므로서 기존의 고가의 소방펌프를 대체하여 사용할 수 있게 된다. 그리고, 유체에 함유된 불순물이나 이물질을 필터부재에 의해 제거할 수 있기 때문에 고압 및 고속의 성능을 발휘하는 본 발명의 축류펌프의 파손을 방지할 수 있게 되며, 필요에 따라 제1임펠러와 제2임펠러의 회전방향 및 회전 속도를 제어할 수 있으므로 토출압력과 토출량을 대상 유체에 따라 또는 펌핑 환경에 따라 용이하게 가변시킬 수 있는 고압 및 고속의 토출 성능을 갖는 축류펌프.를 제공할 수 있는 탁월한 효과를 발휘하게 되는 것이다.

title_en: Water proof fire transmitter equipped with cover
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transmitter to sound an alarm when a user presses the transmitter if a fire occurs and, more specifically, to a waterproof transmitter equipped with a cover which includes: a pressing means for activating the alarm if a fire occurs; and a housing where the pressing means is coupled to expose the pressing means and where an openable cover is arranged for ease of use. The present invention provides a waterproof means to the cover or the housing or both of them to prevent foreign matter, water, and moisture which may hamper the alarm from going off. The waterproof transmitter for fire alarm equipped with a cover can further improve the waterproof effect by further arranging a locking means.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재가 발생하였을 경우 상용자가 눌러서 경보를 울리는 발신기에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 화재가 발생하였을 경우 경보를 작동시키기 위한 누름수단와, 누름수단이 노출되도록 결합되는 하우징을 구비하되, 하우징에 개폐가능한 커버를 구비하여 사용의 편의성을 향상시키되, 커버 또는 하우징 또는 이들모두에 방수수단을 구비함으로서 이물질, 물기, 습기등이 투입되는 것을 방지하여 합선등으로 경보가 울리지 않는 것을 방지할 수 있으며, 록킹수단을 더 구비하여 방수효과를 더욱 향상시킬 수 있는 커버가 부착된 방수형 발신기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Alarm system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an alarm system and an alarm device using flash light, capable of notifying also a hearing-impaired person of fire occurrence to prompt evacuation without causing light sensitive fluctuation.SOLUTION: An alarm system comprises: fire sensing means; fire reception means for determining fire, specifying a fire area, and transmitting a fire signal to an evacuation target area; relay means having radio communication means for transmitting an alarm command signal in a period which is a multiplication by a natural number of a prescribed period on the basis of the fire signal; and a plurality of alarm means organized into groups and disposed for each evacuation route, and each including timing means for repeating timing for each prescribed period, delay time setting means for setting a delay time from reception of the alarm command signal to flash light emission by own machine, and light emission means for emitting flash light in the prescribed period. When a fire occurs, the timing means of the alarm means are initialized and the timing means of all alarm means belonging to the group are synchronized.

title_en: A kind of instable slope autoalarm
abstract_en: A kind of instable slope autoalarm, comprises steel pipe, one end sealing of steel pipe, and the other end arranges wire rope chute, and side has slide block chute; Steel duct is provided with tension spring, and one end of tension spring is connected to the blind end of steel pipe, and the other end is connected to the bottom of slide block; The top of slide block is connected to wire rope; Wire rope is drawn through the wire rope chute of steel pipe, is connected with joint bar; Steel pipe arranged outside has upper stroke switch and lower stroke switch, and upper stroke switch and lower stroke switch are connected respectively to the auxiliary contact of contactor; On slide block, be provided with teat, teat stretches out from slide block chute, between upper stroke switch and lower stroke switch; The main contacts of contactor and power supply, warning horn connect and compose alarm circuit successively.The quick warning of very first time when the utility model can meet instable slope and deforms, simple in structure, easy processing, safe and reliable, highly sensitive, has alleviated safety and patrol personnel's pressure.

title_en: A kind of aspirating smoke detection device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire-fighting equipment technical field, a kind of aspirating smoke detection device that the present invention is provided, it is provided with the sampling pipe of several thieff hatch, the end cap that sampling pipe is provided with is provided with passage, sampling pipe is connected with zonal device air inlet in smoke alarm, zonal device gas outlet and blower fan inlet end are connected, blower fan exhaust end is connected with muffler, muffler is provided with air inlet and exhaust outlet, zonal device is additionally provided with detection gas return air inlet, detection gas return air inlet is connected with laser detector air outlet, laser detector air intake vent is connected with filter air outlet, filter air intake vent and muffler air outlet are connected.The present invention has the advantages that small blower fan volume, power saving, low noise；Subregion sets the long-term accessible work of reliable, energy, is adapted to pollution environment；External zonal device is reduced significantly the alarm of detector protection zone；The service life of the thieff hatch patch effective elongated pore of film and the absolute precision and uniformity in guarantee hole, prevent hole to be blocked.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional emergency situation warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multi-functional emergency situation warning device, comprise the main equipment arranged from equipment and disengaging wrist strap be arranged in wrist strap; Main equipment comprises main micro control unit, sensor assembly, wireless transmitter module, voice module, loudspeaker, sound and light alarm module and main power source module; Described sensor assembly comprises the smoke transducer module, Temperature Humidity Sensor module and the shock sensor module that connect described main micro control unit respectively; Comprise from micro control unit, wireless receiving module, shock module, LED flashing module and from power module from equipment; When there is the situations such as earthquake, fire, gas leakage, corresponding sensor detects signal, and control module control LED flashing module starts, and shock module starts, and sound and light alarm module starts.This device can solve when there is the situations such as earthquake, fire, gas leakage, can not wake up in time and the problem of reporting to the police of cannot sounding when deaf-mute and non-sensitive crowd are in sleep.

title_en: A kind of sun power forest fire protection alarm
abstract_en: The utility model relates to fire plant technical field, especially a kind of sun power forest fire protection alarm.Alarm, smoke-detectors and temperature detector that it comprises MCU primary controller and is connected with MCU primary controller, it also comprises DC/DC translation circuit, power is 10W solar panels, 12V accumulator and step-down power supply circuit, described MCU primary controller controls solar panels to 12V charge in batteries by DC/DC translation circuit, and the output voltage of described 12V accumulator is depressurized to after 5V through step-down power supply circuit is powered to alarm, smoke-detectors and temperature detector by MCU primary controller.The utility model realizes solar panels by the DC/DC translation circuit arranged and controls the charging of 12V accumulator, be convenient to MCU primary controller and MPPT maximum power point tracking is carried out to solar panels, with the maximized efficiency utilizing solar panels, thus whole device is enable to be applicable to the demand of forest fire protection; Its structure is simple, with low cost, energy-conserving and environment-protective and easy for installation, has very strong practicality.

title_en: Vehicle intelligent fire-fighting control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the fire-fighting technique field of vehicle, particularly a kind of vehicle intelligent fire-fighting control device.The utility model proposes a kind of vehicle intelligent fire-fighting control device; comprise: the housing be made up of front panel and back casing, be arranged on circuit board in housing and in purchase electric battery pack, the circuit of this circuit board comprises: the testing circuit of single-chip microcomputer governor circuit, dispatch from foreign news agency input protection circuit, the switch between alternating current and standby battery circuit, standby power detection circuit, fire extinguisher start-up circuit, fire extinguisher testing circuit, fire extinguisher feedback sense circuit, temperature sensing cable.The utility model is connected with vehicle-mounted fire extinguisher, for patrolling and examining the state of fire extinguisher, temperature sensing cable, having during fault and sending sound and light alarm, when breaking out of fire, effectively can start fire fighting with fire extinguisher.
assignees: CHINA AUTOMOBILE CUSTOMER AUTO PARTS XIAMEN CO LTD

title_en: Sound adding device for visually impaired person
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology which properly perform alarm output and evacuation guidance, even when commercial power cannot be obtained.SOLUTION: A control unit 12 of a sound adding device 10 controls each structure element in an integrated manner, and carries out sound output to speakers 1-4. The control unit 12 carries out the output processing of voice guidance for emergency such as the occurrence of power failure. For example, the control unit 12 obtains an operation state (a power obtaining state and the like) from another sound adding device 10 through a communicating portion 16, related to the output processing, and carries out predetermined processing according to the residual capacity of an emergency power source 20. The control unit 12 holds evacuation guiding route data having a plurality of route patterns, and carries out voice guiding processing by selecting a proper route pattern from the evacuation guiding route data in an emergency voice guidance.

title_en: A kind of high ferro wireless video transmission system
abstract_en: A kind of high ferro wireless video transmission system, comprises the video monitoring apparatus in high ferro train, by the wireless high-speed transmitting device of image information real-time Transmission, and the relay base station of downline distribution and station Surveillance center device.Video monitoring apparatus on high ferro train, realizes the collection to car epigraph, and wireless high-speed transmitting device realizes the real-time Transmission to image information and data message, by amplification and the forwarding of relay base station, is transferred to station Surveillance center.High ferro wireless video monitoring system together form the integral framework of perfect all standing non-blind area with the train scheduling communication system coordinated with it and high ferro video monitoring system along the line and surrounding area, can early warning and prevent the generation of cruelly probably case effectively, can early warning avoid the train operation safety because natural calamity causes.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINGSHENG COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Protected surface accurate monitoring alarm system
abstract_en: The invention provides a protected surface accurate monitoring alarm system. The protected surface accurate monitoring alarm system comprises a landslide deposit bearing sensor, a light grating type double grid sensor, a protected surface mounting flexible double grid sensor and a protected surface touch convex sensor. The protected surface accurate monitoring alarm system is arranged on a hazardous position of a protected surface, performs real time monitoring on impact pressure generated when the protected surface slides down, obtains real time pressure data, and transmits the real time pressure data to a monitoring center through a middle piece. The monitoring center translates point judgment of pressure threshold value into face judgment of neighboring relations through a set pressure threshold value and neighboring relation discrimination algorithm, judges whether a slope endangers a protected target, and achieves an accurate forecasting purpose. The protected surface accurate monitoring alarm system can be used in combination with a tendency forecasting system and a criticality forecasting system so as to achieve a comprehensive alarm purpose.
assignees: JIANGXI XILING TRACK TRAFFIC TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Wireless fire sensing system of apartment house for the deaf
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 소리를 듣지 못하는 청각 장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 아파트 등 공동주택에서는 화재가 발생하였을 때 현관 밖의 소화전에서 소리로 화재에 대한 위험 경고를 큰 경종 소리로 알려 주게 된다. 그러나 소리를 듣지 못하는 청각 장애인의 경우 밖에서 들리는 경고 소리를 듣지 못해 집안에서 화재 경보 대응을 하지 못하게 되어 위험에 처할 수 있는 가능성이 있다. 소방법에 의거, 이미 설비인증 받은 소화 시설은 어떠한 형태로든 변경, 변형이 안되기 때문에 기존의 화재 경보기에는 일체 손을 댈 수가 없다. 하여 기존의 화재 경보기 부근에 근접 부착할 수 있는 무선 경보 소리 감지 발신기를 통해 빛이나 진동으로 경보를 집안의 청각 장애인에게 확실하게 알려 주어 화재경보시 안전하게 대응할 수 있게 한 청각장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템으로 매우 유용한 고안인 것이다.

title_en: Automatic switching from primary to secondary audio during emergency broadcast
title_ko: 비상 방송중 주 오디오로부터 보조 오디오로의 자동 전환
abstract_en: An audio video display device (AVDD) includes a display, a processor controlling the display and a computer readable storage medium that is accessible to the processor. The computer readable storage medium bears instructions which when executed by the processor cause the processor to present, on the AVDD, AV content that is not associated with information pertaining to an emergency. The instructions cause the processor to receive, at the AVDD, data associated with an emergency alert and, responsive to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert, change audio presented on the AVDD from first audio presented on the AVDD and associated with the AV content to second audio associated the data to present the second audio. The second audio is presented on the AVDD automatically without receiving user input to change from the first audio to the second audio subsequent to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert.
abstract_ko: 오디오 비디오 디스플레이 디바이스(audio video display device: AVDD)는 디스플레이, 디스플레이를 제어하는 프로세서, 및 프로세서에 액세스될 수 있는 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체를 포함한다.  컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체는 프로세서에 의해 실행될 때, 프로세서가, AVDD 상에 비상 사태에 관련된 정보와 연관되지 않은 AV 콘텐츠를 제시하도록 하는 명령어들을 포함한다.  명령어들은 프로세서가, AVDD에서 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하도록 하고, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 응답하여, AVDD 상에 제시되는 오디오를, AVDD 상에 제시되고 AV 콘텐츠와 연관된 제1 오디오로부터 그 데이터와 연관된 제2 오디오로 변경하여 제2 오디오를 제시하도록 한다.  제2 오디오는, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 후속하여 제1 오디오로부터 제2 오디오로 변경하기 위한 유저 입력을 수신하지 않고 자동으로 AVDD 상에 제시된다.

title_en: Self-rescue swimming cap for deaf-mutes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-rescue swimming cap for deaf-mutes and belongs to life saving tools. The self-rescue swimming cap is capable of calling for help and comprises a swimming cap body. The self-rescue swimming cap is characterized in that a water-proof membrane layer is fixed on the outer surface of the top of the swimming cap body and provided with a high-density waterproof alarming box, and a battery, a sound alarm and a power switch button are arranged in the alarming box and are electrically connected through a wire. The self-rescue swimming cap has the advantages that in use, the user wears the swimming cap and presses the power switch button in the emergency, and the sound alarm and a flash alarm light send emergency signals; in this way, once see and/or hear the emergency signals, rescuers can make a rescue timely to avoid unnecessary risks. The self-rescue swimming cap is easy and convenient to operate and adaptable to other swimmers.

title_en: Mechanical arm with warning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical arm. The mechanical arm comprises a processor and a driving unit; the mechanical arm further comprises a plurality of infrared distance sensors and a warning unit, the processor judges that the distance induced by any infrared distance sensor is less than or equal to the preset value and the warning unit outputs the warning information and controls the driving unit for stopping driving the mechanical arm. According to mechanical arm with warning function, the mechanical arm sends the warning information while a person or foreign matter gets close to the mechanical arm and stops rotating. Thus, the harm to the persons from the mechanical arm is avoided, and the harm to the mechanical arm from the persons or foreign matter is also avoided.
assignees: FUTAIHUA IND SHENZHEN CO LTD;HON HAI PREC IND CO LTD

title_en: Method for accurately early warning forest fire of power transmission line
abstract_en: A method for accurately early warning the forest fire of the power transmission line comprises 4 steps of collecting fire point information, decomposing a wind speed signal, denoising the signal and early warning the forest fire of the power transmission line. The method changes the backward and old manual monitoring and early warning modes, has the characteristics of convenient calculation, obvious effect and the like, and is suitable for the forest fire prediction and warning of the power transmission lines at different altitudes and different areas; the method provides help for scientifically and accurately early warning the mountain fire information of the power transmission line, can be purposefully used when the mountain fire information is in the initial stage, and avoids line loss caused by blind prediction and warning.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST YUNNAN POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Single-chip microcomputer based crutch for blind people
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-chip-microcomputer based crutch for blind people. The single-chip-microcomputer based crutch for blind people comprises a button switch, a single-chip microcomputer, an ultrasonic ranging instrument, a vibrator and an alarm; the button switch controls the whole circuit to be closed; the ultrasonic ranging instrument is used for measuring the range from a barrier in front of a user to the user; when the tested range is less than the safety range, the vibrator and the alarm synchronously work to remind the user. The single-chip microcomputer based crutch for the blind people is simple in creation principle, effectively ensures the safety of the blind people during walking, and is relatively high in practicability.

title_en: Emergency mobile notification handling
abstract_en: Systems and methods for handling emergency notification messages such as Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS) alerts. In an example scenario, a call center maintains personal profiles of a number of clients, including contact information for persons or other entities designated by the clients to receive information about the clients. The call center receives from a device associated with a particular client of the call center that the client's device has received a text-based emergency notification message. The call center notifies one or more of the designated entities. The notification may include the content of the emergency notification message, and may include an audio version of the notification message. An indication or the notification message may also be placed in a database accessible to one or more of the designated persons or entities.

title_en: Wearable/Portable Device and Application Software for Alerting People When the Human Sound Reaches the Preset Threshold
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to a portable/wearable device as well as application or a software program to be downloaded onto a mobile device or computer. The present invention is intended to measure sound intensity/level and provide an alert signal to remind user(s) or crowds (i.e groups of people) that they are speaking too loud or making too much noise. Furthermore, optionally, the device may play a pre-selected music or pre-recorded message when the sound level threshold is exceeded, which can encourage all of the users to use the bio-feedback of the present invention to relax when they see the visual que such as the light color changes, hear the music, message or produced from the device. Another object of the present invention is to help people to know whether his/her voice is loud enough to be heard by people who have hearing impairment.

title_en: A kind of Hearing Impaired's special intelligent fire-alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Hearing Impaired's special intelligent fire-alarm.Comprise acoustic-optic alarm, base, power bin and smell alarm.Acoustic-optic alarm is arranged on base by screw, and power bin is arranged on base by plastics clip, and smell alarm and base integrated make shaping.Alarm receives automatic fire alarm signal or visitor's intercommunication signal, start micro motor by the interlock of parallel connection power supply line simultaneously, micro motor controls the airtight cover plate of smell alarm by motor shaft and rotates, be provided with barrier plate and control airtight cover plate maintenance 90 degree of maximum unlatchings, smell warning solution can volatilize fast, reminds Hearing Impaired or old man to withdraw in time.The utility model is with low cost, and install simple, alarm security is effective, is easy to promote.After the utility model is installed, effectively can promote the alarm rate to Hearing Impaired.Meet every national regulation requirement, make up the defect of domestic existing conventional fire warning device.
assignees: CHINA LIGHT INDUSTRY WUHAN DESIGN ENG CO LTD

title_en: Air conditioning outdoor unit clean notification device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cleaning notification device for an air conditioner outdoor unit, which is installed with a nozzle installation duct (30) having a plurality of injection nozzles (32) in a cooling pin seating plane of the air conditioner outdoor unit (20), wherein the nozzle installation duct (30) is connected to an air compressor (10) by a connection pipe (40) as an intermediation. Therefore, it is possible to prevent a foreign substance from being attached by ejecting compressed air generated in the air compressor (10) on the cooling pin of the outdoor unit (20). Therefore, the cooling performance degradation of the air-conditioner due to the adhesion of the foreign substance of the condenser cooling pin of the outdoor unit (20) can be prevented. The energy efficiency of the air-conditioner is improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 에어컨과 관련된 화재는 주로 외부에 설치된 실외기에서 발생하고 있다. 주요 원인은 장시간 사용에 따른 실외기 내부 모터나 전자부품의 과부하, 실외기의 소음을 차단하기 위해 밀폐된 구조의 장소에 설치해 실외기 작동 시 발생한 열을 외부로 방출하지 못해 열이 축적된 경우, 에어컨 설치 시 연결배선의 접촉 또는 절연 불량에 의해서 발생하는 것으로 나타났다. 본 발명의 이러한 목적은 특히 영업집처럼 에어컨을 장시간 사용하는 업소는 점검을 해야 하다. 첫 번째 증상으로 에어컨 찬바람이 안 나오는 경우도 번째 에어컨이 다운되는 경우 세번재 실외기 가 과열이 되는 경우 등으로 에어컨실외기가 햇빛에 노출이 되어있다던가 1층 도로 번에 있는 경우 밀폐된 창고 나 여러 대 에어컨실외기가 함께 있는 경우는 점검하여 에에컨 실외기청소를 해주는 것이 좋다. 미리 점검하여 화재로부터 중용한 재산을 보호하자 
본 발명은 에어컨 실외기 청소 알림 장치에 관한 것으로, 에어컨 실외기(20)의 냉각핀 설치 면에 다수의 분사노즐(32)을 구비한 노즐설치 관(30)이 설치되고, 상기 노즐설치 관(30)은 연결관(40)을 매개로 공기압축기(10)에 연결된다. 
따라서, 상기 공기압축기(10)에서 생성된 압축공기를 실외기(20)의 냉각핀에 분사하여 이물질의 부착을 방지하고, 이미 부착된 이물질을 제거할 수 있다. 
따라서, 실외기(20)의 응축기 냉각핀의 이물질 부착으로 인한 에어컨의 냉방성능 저하를 방지할 수 있고, 에어컨의 에너지 효율이 향상된다. 
선풍기 화재는 모터가 가열돼 먼지에 불이 붙는 경우나 날개에 의류가 끼어 모터가 과부하 돼 발생하는 것이 대부분이다. 
냉방기 화재를 예방하기 위해선 청소와 점검이 필수다. 냉방기기를 사용하지 않을 때는 작동을 정지하고, 선풍기 모터 먼지 제거와 선풍기 날개가 헛도는 것을 확인해야 한다. 에어컨은 피복손상 여부를 확인하고 실외기 주변에 물건을 놓지 말아야 한다.  
소방안전본부 우재봉 본부장은 “에어컨의 장시간 사용 시 잠시 작동을 중단해 실외기에서 발생한 열을 식혀줄 수 있도록 해야 한다.”라며 “특히 전력 소비를 줄이는 것은 에어컨 화재예방과 함께 전력수급 비상사태에 대처하는 한 방법이 될 것”이라고 말했다.

본 발명은 종래 청각장애인용 알림장치가 지닌 문제점을 해결하기 위해 안출된 것으로서, 상황에 따라 이를 신속하게 진동이나 램프와 같은 조명 또는 문자로 알려주는 각각의 발생부가 내부에 구성된 몸체의 외측에 상기 몸체를 팔목에 차고 다닐 수 있도록 하는 줄을 더 구성하여 청각장애인이 자신의 팔목에 항상 차고 휴대할 수 있도록 함으로써 청각장애인이 어디에 있든지 관계없이 발생된 상황을 쉽게 인지할 수 있도록 하여 화재와 같은 긴급상황에 빠르게 대처하고, 일상생활에서 발생되는 상황을 쉽게 대처하여 일상생활에 불편함이 없도록 한 청각장애인용 손목시계를 제공하고자 한다.

title_en: Guidance lighting system equipped with emergency exit direction guiding function
title_ko: 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit, which is normally used as an emotional lighting lamp and which detects emergency to provide a visual and audio guidance for the direction of emergency exit for safe evacuation in case of emergency such as a fire and a blackout, conducts tactile guidance through a heat generation of a luminescent device for visually and hearing-impaired users and performs an emotional guidance by changing the brightness and color of a luminescent device. For the above purpose, the guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit detecting an emergency and generating an emergency detection signal; a power supply unit normally supplying utility power and supplying charging power in case of emergency; a display unit normally used as a usual lighting and displaying the guidance of the predetermined direction of the closest emergency exit when the emergency detection signal is received; and a control unit controlling the luminescence, voice and alert of the display unit according to a normal state or an emergency state.

title_en: Railway network system for monitoring natural disasters and foreign invasion

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection and warning system for visually and hearing impaired persons. The fire detection and warning system for visually and hearing impaired persons of the present invention comprises: an audio-visual output unit for broadcasting an auditory emergency guide in accordance with a sound warning which guides an evacuation guide path from a sound input unit and for displaying a visual evacuation direction by using a data signal and power; a data signal generating unit for generating the data signal for controlling a guide direction display displayed through the audio-visual output unit; an oxygen supply equipment unit for supplying oxygen when oxygen is insufficient in a space due to smoke or gas leakage as a result of a fire occurrence; a PLC communications unit for synthesizing a sound signal, a data signal, and power to an evacuation guide signal and thereby transmitting to the audio-visual output unit and for transmitting an operation control signal to the oxygen supply equipment unit; and a control unit for monitoring a state of each component and for controlling an operation thereof. According to the present invention, when a fire occurs, a voice guide broadcast is performed to guide the visually and hearing impaired persons to an exit far away from the fire occurrence point, a letter, a sign and a specific pattern having an improved visibility are displayed through a blinking light having a variety of patterns, and oxygen is provided as needed. Therefore, it is possible to safely evacuate visually and hearing impaired persons.

title_en: Transmission tower ground wire bracket angle steel buckling monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower ground wire bracket angle steel buckling monitoring method and system. The system comprises a strain gage, a stress tester, wireless transmission equipment and a remote server, wherein the strain gage is connected to the stress tester by virtue of a wire; and the stress tester is connected to the remote server by virtue of the wireless transmission equipment. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the result of a to-be-monitored transmission tower ground wire bracket according to transmission tower design software and steel structure calculation software, finding angle steel with the highest pressure, mounting an optical strain gage on the angle steel according to a specified method, and combining the strain gage, the stress tester, the wireless transmission equipment and the remote server into a transmission tower ground wire bracket angle steel buckling monitoring system. In addition to a creative angle steel tensile strength calculation method and an angle steel stress early warning value calculation method, the operating state of the monitored tower ground wire bracket can be safely and reliably monitored and early warned in real time, blindness of transmission line de-icing and emergency rescue is reduced, and the scientificity and reliability of the decision are improved.

title_en: System and method for crisis and business resiliency management
abstract_en: Methods and systems for providing a crisis management platform are described. A method includes receiving a first notification of an event, such as a crisis event. A second notification of the event is transmitted to user equipment devices of a plurality of individuals. A user selection of a crisis-related option from a plurality of crisis-related options is received after transmitting the second notification is transmitted, and an action is taken in response to receiving the user selection of the crisis-related option. An electronic document is designed and distributed as a portable tool with easily accessible information for a crisis team to use as a straightforward reference to manage the decisioning and workflow coordination related to crisis management. Interactive user interfaces with hyperlinks to various electronic resources and tools may be provided to automatically and methodologically inform various users of their roles and guide them through a crisis response procedure.

title_en: Aviation emergency locator beacon device based on Beidou
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aviation emergency locator beacon device based on Beidou. title_en: Intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system and monitoring center database
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system and a monitoring center database. The intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system comprises a data acquisition system, a monitoring center, an integrated management platform and an intelligent alarming device. The data acquisition system is used for acquiring state monitoring data in a monitoring region. The monitoring center is in communication connection with the data acquisition system and is used for analyzing the state of a monitoring objective in the monitoring region and determining an alarming objective and the danger level of the alarming objective in real time according to the state monitoring data and triggering corresponding guard signals according to the danger level. The integrated management platform is connected with the data acquisition system and the monitoring center and used for monitoring and managing on-site monitoring equipment of the monitoring region in a centralized manner. The intelligent alarming device is in communication connection with the monitoring center to achieve linkage and is used for giving out an early warning or an alarm according to the guard signals. Thus, by means of the intelligent limit intrusion monitoring system and the monitoring center database, natural disasters, unexpected accidents, unlawful entry and other foreign body limit intrusion events endangering safety operation of a railway can be accurately monitored, pre-warned and alarmed in time.

title_en: Smart natural disaster alert system
abstract_en: A smart natural disaster alert system comprising a central controller and alert machine units. The central controller is placed either at a Bureau of Agriculture, a meteorological observatory or other places and collects early warning information such as weather and geological disasters via a dedicated data channel or a network. The alert machine units carry out data communication via a GPRS channel at places where GPRS signals are widespread and communicate via a satellite datalink at blind spots of GPRS coverage. The central controller collects, collates, organizes, and distributes the early warning information and, after processing, transmits by means of short messages to any alert machine unit in need of such. When the early warning information is received by the alert machine unit, same alerts the public in the corresponding area by means of GPRS short message forwarding or loudspeaker broadcast. The smart natural disaster alert system fully utilizes complementary characteristics between GPRS and satellite communication technologies, provides comprehensive communication coverage, ensures that the alert information has no blind spot, and allows the smart alert machine units to be flexibly distributed and free from effects of terrain.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable haptic device and a method for providing walking guidance information using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the wearable haptic device includes: a movement detection unit which detects the position and movement information of a user; a communication unit which transmits the position and movement information of the user to a user terminal and receives a haptic signal from the user terminal; and a guidance information notification unit which provides the user with walking guidance information by outputting the received haptic signal as vibration, light, or sound. A walking guidance providing server detects the position, speed, and moving direction of neighboring vehicles using at least one among recorded video on the road, fixed sensor(s) on the road, and loop(s), generates neighboring information, and transmits the neighboring information to the user terminal. The user terminal determines if there is any danger using the received neighboring information and the position and movement information of the user, and in case of a danger, generates the haptic signal showing a danger situation and transmits the signal to the wearable haptic device. According to the present invention described above, the wearable haptic device and the method for providing walking guidance information using the same enable effective provision of the walking guidance information to the senior citizens or the hearing-impaired and helps users walk safely by notifying the users of unexpected danger(s).

title_en: Real time monitoring system for prevention of crime and violence
title_ko: 폭력 및 범죄예방 위한 실시간 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: It is difficult to install, in terms of privacy protection, CCTVs or the like which can obtain spot information in order to cope with violence or crime which occurs or is expected to occur at a blind spot (an enclosed space, a secluded space, a restroom, a vacant lot, and a playground) or the like, thereby resulting in the violence or crime being left as it is. The present invention relates to a system which recognizes, determines, and processes the occurrence of violence or crime, and which is capable of obtaining spot information that occurs or is expected to occur at the blind spot while protecting the privacy. The system for recognizing, determining, and processing the occurrence of violence or crime, according to the present invention, determines, while processing voice or other information generated at the spot of the violence or the crime such that identity with respect to the information is hidden, an emergency situation by comparing information received in real time, on the basis of a value for a violence or crime-related contour-extracted video and a similar behavior video, and a violence or crime-related voice information determining reference value. The violence or crime-related video and voice is obtained, such that violence or crime situation can be determined, through much repeated trial and error for video, acquired by a contour extraction method, about movement in a spot, and is stored in a database; induces, when the emergency situation is confirmed, stopping an act of violence or crime by performing a warning broadcasting using content which is extracted from the database and has spot situation-matched content and voice tone; stores the emergency situation content (the violence or crime-related contour-extracted video and the violence or crime-related voice information) in the database; and enables a manager and a jurisdiction department to be dispatched to the spot and cope with a crisis in addition to transmitting the content to the manager and the jurisdiction department so as to determine the emergency situation.

사각지대(밀폐된 공간, 인적이 드문 공간, 화장실, 공터, 놀이터) 등에서 발생되거나, 발생이 예상되는 폭력이나 범죄에 대처하기 위해 현장정보 입수가 가능한 CCTV등을 사생활 보호 측면에서 설치하지 못해 폭력 및 범죄를 방치하고 있는 것이 현실이다. 
 본 발명은 사각지대에서 발생되거나, 발생이 예상되는 현장정보를 사생활을 보호 하면서 입수가 가능한 특징을 지닌 폭력 및 범죄발생 인지, 판별, 처리관련 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
 본 발명에서는 폭력 및 범죄현장에서 발생되는 음성정보 및 누군지를 알 수 없게 처리하되, 폭력 및 범죄 상황을 판별할 수 있도록 현장의 움직임을 윤곽선 추출방법으로 동영상을 확보하여 수많은 시행착오를 통해 확보되어 데이터베이스에 저장되어 있는 폭력 및 범죄행위관련 윤곽선 추출 동영상 및 유사행위 동영상 값과 음성정보 판별 기준값을 기준으로 실시간으로 입수되는 정보를 비교하여 위급상황을 판별하고, 위급상황으로 판별되면 현장상황에 맞는 내용 및 목소리 톤으로 저장된 내용을 저장장치로부터 추출하여 경고방송을 하게 하여 폭력 및 범죄행위 중지를 유도하고, 위급상황 내용(폭력 및 범죄관련 윤곽선 추출 동영상 및 음성정보)을 저장장치에 저장하며, 상기 내용을 관리자 및 관할부서로 전송하여 위급상황을 판단하게 함은 물론, 발생 현장에 출동하여 위급상황에 대처하도록 하는 것을 특징으로 하는 폭력 및 범죄발생 인지, 판별, 처리관련 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire alarm for blind person
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a fire alarm for a blind person. The fire alarm for the blind person comprises an alarm body, a shell and a base; the alarm body is arranged in the shell; the lower end surface of the shell is provided with the base; the alarm body includes a signal detector, a controller, a sounding device and a power source; the signal detector, a signal processor, the sounding sound device and the power source are connected with one another sequentially; the outer end surface of the shell is provided with an indication arrow; the indication arrow is provided with a plurality of protruding points; the fire alarm also comprises a voice recording and playing device; and the voice recording and playing device is arranged in the shell and is connected with the controller. The fire alarm provided by the present invention has the advantages of simple structure and high practicability, and can make the blind person quickly escape from a fire scene.

title_en: Battery interconnected alert device system with vibrational alert
abstract_en: Disclosed is a battery interconnected detection and alert device system with building structure vibrational alert. The system includes of one or more alert devices wired into a dedicated circuit with a single location housing a DC power backup source, such as a rechargeable DC battery. The DC power backup source may be replaceable or rechargeable with DC current from an AC-DC transformer-rectifier, a photovoltaic cell, or other means. An electrical relay within the system provides a current to the dedicated circuit by selecting between the line-voltage alternating current source and the DC power backup. When activated, the detection and alert device generates a distinctive pulsed vibrational alert transmitted through the building structure to beds and other furniture resting on the floor, and additionally transmitted through the air as pressure waves which are perceived by hearing-impaired and other persons alerting them to a possible emergency situation.

title_en: System and method for alerting a user
abstract_en: The alarm monitoring system provides various alerts of events that are not readily discernable to those individuals that are deaf or hard of hearing. The system generates visual, vibratory, and high decibel alerts separately or in combination to alert the user to a wide variety of events in combination with a vibratory illuminating puck shaped device and allows a user to filter out alerts based upon a variety of modifiers.

title_en: Indoor and outdoor integrated planning method used for emergency rescue optimal path calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor and outdoor integrated planning method used for emergency rescue optimal path calculation. The indoor and outdoor integrated planning method comprises the following steps that a mutually connected three-dimensional navigation network is constructed so that a three-dimensional navigation data model INDM in high-rise and super high-rise buildings is constructed, and the three-dimensional navigation network in the buildings is connected with an urban traffic network; and vehicle speed is acquired through an intelligent traffic system, the traffic accessibility coefficient of the urban traffic network is determined based on vehicle speed, escape speed in the high-rise and super high-rise buildings is acquired through an intelligent building system, the traffic accessibility coefficient of the three-dimensional navigation network of the high-rise and super high-rise buildings is calculated, accident point confirmation is performed according to alarm information, optimal path analysis is performed by utilizing a dynamic Dijkstra algorithm and an optimal rescue path is acquired. High-rise building rescue is converted from extensive rescue to intensive rescue so that the indoor and outdoor integrated planning method used for emergency rescue optimal path calculation has important theoretical meaning and practical application value.

title_en: Evacuation Routes notification system for visually impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route notification system for a visually impaired person and, more specifically, to an evacuation route notification system which provides an evacuation direction for a visually impaired person by a plurality of vibrator units installed in a handrail or a guide foothold which guides the movement direction of the visually impaired person by being installed along the wall surface of a building. The vibrator units are driven by a phase difference vibrator circuit comprising: a control box which provides a direction signal by a fire signal received from a fire sensor; a forward/reverse shift register which generates a time difference vibration signal by the direction signal received from the control box; and a plurality of vibrators which vibrates by receiving the time difference vibration signal received from the forward/reverse shift register.

title_en: System and computer program product for coordinating and monitoring service providers
abstract_en: A system and computer program product for coordinating and monitoring service providers is disclosed which provides an electronic portal accessible by service requesters and service providers. Service requesters may request and hire service providers that are assigned to an event and location to provide services. The progress of services may be monitored remotely. In addition, a safety feature is included which transmits a polling signal to the computing device of the service provider requiring acknowledgment of the polling signal to ensure that an emergency situation has not occurred needing attention. Some embodiments will alert a third party if the service provider has not responded.

title_en: Positioning and navigation cap for blind based on single-chip computer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positioning and navigation cap for the blind based on a single-chip computer. The positioning and navigation cap comprises a positioning and navigation cap body for the blind and an electronic circuit board arranged in the positioning and navigation cap body for the blind and provided with the interior used for helping the blind to overcome obstacles or listen to music. The electronic circuit board comprises a single-chip computer controller, a battery power, a reset circuit, a data storage circuit module, a communication interface circuit and a crystal oscillation circuit. An input end of the single-chip computer is connected with a clock circuit, a button input circuit, an FM frequency modulation circuit module, a GPS positioning sensor and an ultrasonic receiver. An output end of the single-chip computer controller is connected with the ultrasonic receiver, an SOS alarm, a voice output circuit, a voice driving circuit and a control indicating lamp. An input end of the voice driving circuit is connected with an output end of the single-chip computer controller. The positioning and navigation cap for the blind based on the single-chip computer has following beneficial effects: the positioning and navigation cap is novel in design, simple in structure and high in practicability and has functions of guiding the blind to go forward and listening the music in a real-time manner.

The control box is provided with a power line, a transmitting antenna, and an emergency arm switch. The interior of the control box is provided with a data processor, a signal transmitter, a smoke sensor, and a control circuit board. The alarm watch comprises an upper watchband, a dial, and a lower watchband. The upper watchband is provided with a clamping hole and a sleeve ring. The dial is provided with an alarm flash lamp, a time adjustment rotary knob, and a power charging interface. The interior of the dial is provided with a dial control box, a vibrating motor, and a rechargeable power supply. The device provided by the invention is provided with a smoke sensor. Students can accurately and timely receive the alarm information, and quickly leave a fire scene, thereby protecting the personal safety of students.

title_en: In-hospital first aid alarm system based on hybrid positioning technologies

The in-hospital first aid alarm system adopts the technical scheme that the system comprises alarm terminals, a wireless local area network, a unified access platform, an integrated server, and on-duty mobile phones, wherein after dialing a specific alarm number through different alarm modes, the alarm terminals upload alarm information to a monitoring center through the unified access platform; after obtaining alarm occurrence location information through different methods according to the different alarm modes, the monitoring center activates rings of the on-duty mobile phones and pushes the location information to the on-duty mobile phones. The system provided by the invention has the advantages that the GPS technology and the Wi-Fi positioning technology are combined, the various alarm modes are provided, and the monitoring center obtains the relevant location information through the various methods, so that first-aid personnel can provide patients with the most effective in-hospital first aid through professional first aid skills in the first time.

title_en: Railway natural disaster and foreign matter beyond limit monitoring system interior and exterior interconnection method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a railway natural disaster and foreign matter beyond limit monitoring system interior and exterior interconnection method. The method comprises the steps of using a railways bureau central system of a railway natural disaster and foreign matter beyond limit monitoring system to package the disaster monitoring data within a preset time quantum into a mail with a text format, and sending the mail to an adjacent railways bureau central system, a flood prevention management system, an operation scheduling management system or a transportation scheduling management system via a mail server. According to the present invention, the disaster monitoring data within the preset time quantum is packaged into the mail with the text format to send out, so that during a real-time transmission process, only the disaster monitoring data greater than an alarm threshold value, namely the alarm data needs to be sent by a TCP/IP protocol, the real-time transmitted data size can be reduced, and a real-time transmission mistake caused by the connection timeout is avoided. Moreover, the to-be-transmitted data is packaged into the mail with the text format and is sent by the mail server, so that relative to a message transmission mode, the responsibility is convenient to determine when problems occur during a data transmission process.

title_en: Apparatus for detecting foreign substance of programmable logic controller system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a foreign substance sensing device of a programmable logic controller (PLC) system. The PLC system having a base with a plurality of slots comprises: a foreign substance sensing module which has a space portion where foreign substances from outside are collected, senses a state of the foreign substance collected in the space portion, and outputs a specific alarm signal according to the sensed state of the foreign substance; and a microprocessing unit (MPU) module which is mounted on one slot among the slots of the base, receives the specific alarm signal outputted from the foreign substance sensing module, and controls such that an external user is notified of a foreign substance alarm. Since the foreign substance sensing module and the MPU module are configured to be attached to and removed from the PLC system, it is possible to suppress malfunction, corrosion, etc. of the PLC system or a board in advance.

title_en: Multiple filter-type two-stage rainwater filter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-layer filter type two-stage rainwater filter which rapidly removes foreign materials included in rainwater while the rainwater passes through a multi-layer filter, thereby allowing rainwater to be used in a wastewater reclamation and reusing system. The filter of the present invention, which filters rainwater using the filter, includes a filter box introduces and discharges rainwater; allows rainwater to be introduced to an upper portion of the filter box toward a tangent line direction; has a bottom plate installed on the inner lower portion of the filter box; has a ring-shaped coupling frame installed in the center of the bottom plate; and inserts the multi-layer filter, with which a plurality of filters are overlapped, into the coupling frame. The multi-layer filter: forms the diameter of a lower filter wider than that of an upper filter while forming pores, which gradually become smaller from the outside to the inside thereof; discharges rainwater, in which foreign materials are not filtered, at the upper portion of the bottom plate; and discharges rainwater, in which foreign materials are filtered, from a lower surface of the bottom plate to a side surface of the filter box.

title_en: Alert device, system and method

The device includes a wearable unit having a plurality of differently colored LEDs and a plurality of differently colored sound-detecting units, with each of the differently colored sound-detecting units corresponding to the same colored LED's on the wearable unit thereby to color code the wearable unit to the sound-detecting units. title_en: System and method to communicate an emergency alert message
abstract_en: Various aspects of a system related to communication of emergency alert messages are disclosed herein. The system comprises one or more circuits in an electronic device communicatively coupled to a broadcast server. The one or more circuits are configured to register one or more output preferences based on one or more input parameters provided by a user. An emergency alert message and associated metadata of an emergency event is received from the broadcast server. The associated metadata includes time-sensitive information of the emergency event. title_en: Centralized management and control system and method for railway natural disasters and foreign matter invasion
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized management and control system and method for railway natural disasters and foreign matter invasion. Monitoring, management and control are conducted on the high-speed railway natural disasters and foreign matter invasion. The core part of the centralized management and control system is a railway bureau central system. The railway bureau central system is arranged in a railway bureau and used for collecting, analyzing and processing disaster monitoring data in the jurisdiction scope, has an alarming function, an early warning function and other functions, and achieves information interaction between the railway bureau central system and related system inside and outside of a railway. The monitoring objects of the centralized management and control system is wind, rain, snow, earthquake and overcrossing railway road and bridge foreign matter invasion, and distributing and acquiring, centralized management, centralized alarming determining disposal and comprehensive application of monitored information on all lines within the domain of the railway bureau are achieved. The centralized management and control system provides alarming and early warning information for dispatching, commanding and maintenance management, automatically gives corresponding disposal measures according to the severity of the disasters and effectively prevents or reduces the effect of the disasters on the high-speed railway train operation safety.

title_en: VANET Warning Message Propagation Method for Electric Wave Blind Area
title_ko: 전파 음영지역에서의 vanet 경고 메시지 전달 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicular ad-hoc network (VANET) warning message transmission method which can be used in a radio wave shadow area. More specifically, the present invention relates to a VANET warning message transmission technology using routing information and dividing the state of a node into a direct mode and a redirect mode to execute an operation. According to the present invention, the VANET warning message transmission method, which can be used in a radio wave shadow area, includes the steps of: receiving an initial warning message from an emergency occurrence node; checking whether a node is in an intersection area by checking whether the weight of the intersection is one or not; operating in redirect- mode when the weight of the intersection is not one; checking whether there is only a single node when the weight of the intersection is one; transmitting a warning message when there is only one node; checking which node has higher transmission priority when there is more than one node; and executing a warning message transmission process upon checking the node with the higher transmission priority and making other nodes with lower transmission priority wait.

본 발명은 전파 음영지역에서의 VANET 경고 메시지 전달 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 라우팅 정보를 이용하면서 노드의 상태를 다이렉트 모드와 리다이렉트 모드로 이원화하여 동작하게 하는 VANET 경고 메세지 전달 기술에 관한 것이다.

abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of alarm device, more particularly to a kind of joint defence linkage alarm device.Alert, the integrated of Defence areas alarm subsystem, standardization and digital management are realized, accomplishes the quick, accurate, timely of alert management and control.Body side sets network interface and ship type power switch；Box house is provided with equipment immobilization carrier plate, for centrally connected power supply power supply, hub, alarm card, LED control cards to be fixedly mounted, holds audible-visual annunciator；Box house both sides set venetian blind type thermovent, loudspeaker.LED display is provided with, for showing alert type, anti-zone position, can quickly know that position occurs for alert.Audible-visual annunciator, including fire-fighting sound, police whistle sound, alarm song, rescue sound, the class of bugle call five are provided with, for quickly recognizing alert by alarm tone.LED controls are provided with by red button is released for ann reset；Blue button receives alert information for confirmation.

title_en: Battery interconnected alert device system with vibrational alert
abstract_en: Disclosed is a battery interconnected detection and alert device system with building structure vibrational alert. The system includes of one or more alert devices wired into a dedicated circuit with a single location housing a DC power backup source, such as a rechargeable DC battery. The DC power backup source may be replaceable or rechargeable with DC current from an AC-DC transformer-rectifier, a photovoltaic cell, or other means. An electrical relay within the system provides a current to the dedicated circuit by selecting between the line-voltage alternating current source and the DC power backup. When activated, the detection and alert device generates a distinctive pulsed vibrational alert transmitted through the building structure to beds and other furniture resting on the floor, and additionally transmitted through the air as pressure waves which are perceived by hearing-impaired and other persons alerting them to a possible emergency situation.

title_en: Power-off protector for high speed rail earthquake emergency action
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of power-off protector for high speed rail earthquake emergency action, effective control of the earthquake pre-warning monitoring system to train can be solved, while ensure that does not influence the normal operation of train under non-earthquake conditions as far as possible；The logic core of device uses CPLD, with good autgmentability, real-time, and also more other implementations are higher for its reliability and security.Meanwhile, integrated independent UPS in device can keep equipment to work more than 168 hours after dispatch from foreign news agency is lost；Also, by setting power-off monitoring relay, it will not also cause after battery exhausts and lead change system cut-off, the influence to leading change system is reduced as far as possible.In addition, by setting long-range isolation signals, remote control it can isolate in the warning algorithm of Commissioning field detection device, reduce the workload of people, what is set is manually isolated the control for switching and can then shielding relay completely to leading change system, will not be impacted when repairing or changing part to leading change system.

title_en: System and method for universal emergency notification and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for triggering emergency mass notifications include an EMNS activation service, a plurality of activation premises devices, a plurality of EMNS provider services, and a plurality of event personnel devices. The EMNS activation service includes a universal translator module that receives an event trigger signal relating to an emergency event from one of the activation premises devices. The universal translator module translates the event trigger signal to event-specific EMNS protocols of the EMNS providers. The EMNS activation service communicates the event-specific EMNS protocols to the EMNS providers, and communicates event data to event personnel devices based on a list of event personnel devices to be notified of an emergency event. An activation premises device includes a housing event with trigger controls for creating the event trigger signal, wherein these event trigger controls are inaccessible to users in the absence of an authorized access or an emergency access.

title_en: Sensitivity analysis method of the network load to meteorologic factor under a kind of typhoon weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses network load under a kind of typhoon weather to the sensitivity analysis method of meteorologic factor, it is related to weather warning technical field.Sensitivity analysis method of the network load to meteorologic factor under described typhoon weather, assay matrix is set up by historical load characteristic index and influence factor, data normalization processing is carried out according to positive correlation type and negatively correlated type to each index in assay matrix；The extreme value uniformity of data is taken into full account during data normalization processing, the data representation after standardization has direction uniformity；Major influence factors are selected according to the size of degree of association index variation rate, avoid because of the calculation error that blindness selection influence factor is brought, the analysis precision of part throttle characteristics and meteorologic factor dependency relation is improved, can more definitely reflect fluctuation of the Load characteristics index before and after typhoon is mainly influenceed by which factor.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CORP ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method for requesting rescue for a hearing impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to request a rescue for a hearing-impaired person. The rescue inducing method for a hearing-impaired person uses: an emergency situation sensing module which is installed in a predetermined building and generates and outputs a preset emergency signal by sensing an emergency situation when an emergency occurs due to a power outage or an earthquake in a building; and at least one emergency exit display which receives an emergency signal by being installed to be separated mutually at a predetermined distance in a building. The present invention comprises: a step of transmitting an emergency signal to at least one emergency exit display in the emergency situation sensing module; a step of broadcasting an alarm signal having preset frequency respectively in the emergency exit display receiving the emergency signal within a predetermined radius; a step in which a user terminal positioned within the radius receives the alarm signal; a step of transmitting a preset rescue signal to the emergency exit display transmitting the alarm signal received in the user terminal; and a step of outputting alarm sound or sound message which notifies the existence of a rescuer within the radius based on the emergency exit display in the emergency exit display receiving the rescue signal. Thus, the present invention has an effect of quickly requesting a rescue by automatically notifying the existence of a hearing-impaired person, who is difficult to properly respond, in the event of a disaster to people around or to a police officer or fire station.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 구조 요청 방법에 관한 것으로, 소정의 건물 내부에 설치되어 건물에 정전 또는 지진으로 인한 비상 상황 발생 시 이를 감지하여 기설정된 비상신호를 생성 및 출력하는 비상상황 감지모듈과, 건물 내부에서 상호 일정 거리 이격되도록 설치되어 비상신호를 수신하는 적어도 하나 이상의 비상구 표시 장치를 이용한 청각장애인을 위한 피난 유도 방법에 있어서, 비상상황 감지모듈에서 비상신호를 적어도 하나 이상의 비상구 표시 장치로 전송하는 단계와, 비상신호를 수신한 비상구 표시 장치에서 각각에 기설정된 주파수를 갖는 경보 신호를 일정 반경 내에서 브로드캐스트하는 단계와, 반경 내에 위치하는 사용자 단말기가 경보 신호를 수신하는 단계와, 사용자 단말기가 수신한 경보 신호를 전송한 비상구 표시 장치로 기설정된 조난 신호를 전송하는 단계와, 조난 신호를 수신한 비상구 표시 장치에서 비상구 표시 장치를 기준으로 반경 내에 조난자가 있음을 알리는 경보음이나 음성 메시지를 출력하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라, 재난 상황 발생 시 적절한 대응이 어려운 청각장애인의 존재를 자동으로 주변 사람들에게 알리거나 경찰서나 소방서로 긴급 발신하여 신속하게 구조를 요청할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of forest fire protection smog identifying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of forest fire protection smog identifying device, belong to fireproof alarming field, including support base, control unit is provided with wherein in the support base, provided with monitoring probe above the support base, camera and Smoke Sensor are respectively equipped with the monitoring probe, the camera and Smoke Sensor are connected with described control unit, restraining is equipped with the two ends of the support base, the end of the restraining is by snapping connection, the Smoke Sensor set first can carry out good early warning to fire, the collection of image/video can also be carried out to scene by camera simultaneously, accurate judgement is made to the serious conditions of fire, the monitoring probe of rotation then can be to carrying out comprehensive monitoring around monitoring point, avoid the occurrence of the situation of monitoring blind area.

title_en: A kind of regulator cubicle for energy-saving control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of regulator cubicle for energy-saving control system of regulator cubicle technical field,Including cabinet and side plate,The side plate is arranged on the rear side side of cabinet,The left and right sidewall of the cabinet is provided with heat emission fan,The left and right madial wall of the cabinet offers chute,The inner chamber of the cabinet is horizontally arranged with pull plate,The left and right ends of the pull plate are plugged on the inner chamber of chute,Temperature alarm and smoke alarm are respectively arranged with left and right sides of the inner cavity top of the cabinet,Water tank is provided with the top of the cabinet,The inner chamber of the water tank is provided with circulating pump,The utility model is easy to that the caused heat inside regulator cubicle is absorbed and distributed,Alarm is monitored to the temperature inside regulator cubicle and fire by temperature alarm and smoke alarm,Related personnel is notified by ring in time,Prevent disaster,Pass through the setting of Air Filter and dust-proof blinds,External dust is reduced to enter in regulator cubicle.

title_en: Landslide, avalanche method for early warning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disaster alarm field, discloses a kind of landslide, avalanche method for early warning.This method comprises the following steps：A, massif is observed, the position for selecting that landslip easily occurs is punched into massif；B, after the completion of punching, by the patchhole of monitoring unit, the shotcrete into hole, blind；C, capstan head in signal is set up, monitoring unit is established with warning center and communicates to connect；D, communication connection is established between warning center and local household.Early warning effectively can be realized to landslide, avalanche by this method.

title_en: A message circulation system for contingencyaccident/disaster
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for automatic text-to-speech/image conversion and transmission of a disaster notification message. According to the present invention, the system includes: a text-to-speech conversion module for converting a disaster notification message also called as a cell broadcasting service (CBS) transmitted from a state administration agency in a wired or wireless manner to a speech; and a speaker module which outputs the converted speech from the text-to-speech conversion module. The speaker module can output the converted speech sounds selectively in a low-frequency band region, a middle frequency band region, a high-frequency band region, or a combination thereof. In the event of a disaster such as a typhoon, flood, heavy rain, tsunami, flooding, snowfall, and earthquake, the system of the present invention can output the CBS transmitted from the state administration agency in the low-frequency band region, the middle frequency band region, the high-frequency band region, or the combination thereof as speech or images to each household, thereby enabling the public, hearing-impaired patients, and elderly people to actively cope with a disaster.
abstract_ko:
재난문자 음성화/시각화 자동 전송 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 재난문자 음성화/시각화 자동 전송 시스템은, 재난문자 음성화/시각화 자동 전송 시스템으로서, 국가행정기관으로부터 유선 또는 무선으로 전달받은 재난전달문자(CBS)를 음성으로 변환하는 문자음성변환모듈과, 상기 문자음성변환모듈로부터의 변환된 음성을 출력하는 스피커 모듈을 포함하여 이루어지되, 상기 스피커 모듈은 변환된 음성 신호를 선택적으로 또는 함께 저음대 영역, 중음대 영역 및 고음대 영역 또는 이의 조합 영역으로 출력되게 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire-warning band for hearing-impaired
abstract_en: Fire, one of the most common emergencies in a typical building, often makes a fire alarm bell ring to evacuate people in the entire building if it is not in a fire zone. In the case of a building that employs a hearing-impaired person, it is inevitable that the evacuation will be delayed because the hearing-impaired person cannot hear the sound of the fire alarm bell. When a fire signal is detected or a central control room activates a fire alarm, the signal is sent to a wirelessly connected band with the fire alarm to vibrate a band. Therefore, the present invention provides technology to announce an emergency situation through vibration of a band. A fire-warning band includes a wireless communication module, a smoke detection sensor, a vibration module, a flashing lamp and a band part.
abstract_ko: 일반적인 건물에서 가장 많이 발생하는 긴급상황 중에 하나인 화재는 화재가 발생한 구역에 있지 않는 경우 건물 전체에 대피 명령을 하기 위해 화재경보벨을 울리는 일이 많은데, 청각장애인을 고용하고 있는 건물의 경우, 청각장애인은 화재경보벨의 소리를 들을 수 없기 때문에 필연적으로 화재에 대한 대피가 늦어질 수 밖에 없다. 화재 신호를 감지하거나 중앙통제실에 의해 화재경보기가 울리게 되면, 화재경보기와 무선으로 연결되어 있는 밴드에 해당 신호를 송부하여, 밴드가 진동하는 것으로 긴급상황임을 전달할 수 있는 기술을 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of lamp panel of accessible fire alarm control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of lamp panel of accessible fire alarm control system, it includes：Lamp panel main body, the front of the lamp panel main body have a lamp panel panel；Light fixture, the light fixture are installed in the positive both sides of the lamp panel main body；Spray head, a mounting hole is offered on the positive lamp panel panel of lamp panel main body, the spray head is located at the back side of the lamp panel main body, and is installed in the mounting hole of the lamp panel panel；Tear-away cover plate, the tear-away cover plate is located at the positive position of mounting hole of lamp panel main body, and is connected to the spray head；Sensor is sprayed, the spray sensor is connected to the spray head by the first wire, the tear-away cover plate is connected to by the second wire；Fire-fighting controls exchange.And then whether connection of the spray sensor for monitoring tear-away cover plate and spray head disconnects, and fire-fighting control exchange is sent a signal to, by the power supply of fire-fighting control exchange control light fixture.

title_en: A kind of electrical fire monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of electrical fire monitoring system, including at least one detection module, substation processing module and Central Control Module；Each detection module is provided with unique network address；Detection module is used for the electrical safety parameter in acquisition terminal loop, is additionally operable to be sent to substation processing module by network address and more than the electrical safety parameter of predetermined threshold value；Substation processing module and detection module wireless connection, for network address translation to be transmitted into Central Control Module into physical location, and by security parameter and physical location；Central Control Module is used to receive electrical safety parameter and physical location, and the information that gives a warning.Electrical fire monitoring system disclosed in the utility model, it is possible to increase the accuracy of the Monitoring Data of electrical fire monitoring system, realize fast positioning electric disaster hidden-trouble position, be easy to exclude electric disaster hidden-trouble rapidly.
