14단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 테스트하여 이상여부를 확인하는 제 15단계, 상기 제 15단계에서 상기 골프시계에 이상이 발생하는 경우 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크를 통해 고장반납을 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하는 제 16단계, 상기 보관함이 열리고, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크를 통해 오염, 분실, 도난, 파손, 침수 중에 하나를 선택하여 상기 골프시계를 상기 보관함에 반납하는 제 17단계, 다른 상기 보관함이 열리고 상기 소비자가 대체기기를 대여하는 제 18단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 사용하는 제 19단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 사용하는 중에 상기 골프시계에서 이상이 발생하는 경우 상기 제 16단계로 돌아가는 제 20단계, 대여시간 종료 전에 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 대여시간 종료 알림을 전달하는 제 21단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 테스트하여 이상여부를 확인하는 제 22단계, 상기 제 22단계에서 상기 골프시계가 이상이 없는 경우, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크로 반납을 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하여 상기 보관함을 열고 상기 골프시계를 충전연결하여 상기 골프시계를 반납하는 제 23단계, 상기 제 22단계에서 상기 골프시계에 이상이 발생하는 경우 상기 제 16단계로 돌아가는 제 24단계, 상기 제 23단계에서 상기 골프시계가 미반납되는 경우 상기 서버에서 확인된 불출 시간 이후에 주기적으로 상기 소비자단말기로 미반납 알림을 전달하며, 이용권 횟수를 차감하는 제 25단계, 상기 제 25단계에서 보유 이용권 횟수가 부족한 경우 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 비용을 청구하거나 이용권 구매를 요청하고 반납예정 및 분실 중 미반납 사유를 선택하도록 하는 제 26단계, 상기 제 26단계에서 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 반납예정을 선택하는 경우, 반납될 때까지 이용권 횟수를 차감하고 상기 제 22단계로 돌아가는 제 27단계, 상기 제 26단계에서 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 분실을 선택하는 경우 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 분실 비용에 대한 알림을 전달하는 제 28단계, 상기 제 26단계에서 상기 소비자가 미반납 사유를 선택하지 않고 상기 골프시계가 미반납되는 경우, 상기 서버에서 회원가입된 정보를 바탕으로 도난처리 및 신고하는 제 29단계로 구성되며, 상기 제 23단계에서 상기 골프시계의 (대여횟수/제품수명사이클)*100의 값이 90 이상인 경우 상기 서버에서 상기 본사단말기로 배터리 교환의 알림을 전달하는 제 30단계로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: JEONG MIN WOO;JUNG IL GUON;SON HYEOK JIN

title_en: Optimized urgent scenario and emergency scenario mass/group messaging/notifications/communications service exposed/delivered via web user interface and mobile device application
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and devices for simultaneously distributing mass notifications to multiple users. A mass notification system receives input data and, based on this input data, creates notifications for mass distribution for urgent scenarios and emergency scenarios via Short Message Service (SMS) and/or Voice communication (audio recording or text to speech) The notifications are then transmitted to devices used by the users who are to be notified. The communication network control system confirms the indication of the emergency situation to the mobile device and notifies emergency personnel of the indication of the emergency situation. The communication network control system transmits an indication of the emergency situation to one or more additional mobile devices in the area. The message text and or voice recording is pre-configured/pre-set by the valid user. Target recipient groups for message/notification are also pre-configured/pre-set by the valid user.

title_en: Experimental device for testing impact damage and electromagnetic radiation effect of gas-containing coal rock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing experimental device for impact damage and electromagnetic radiation effect of coal rock containing gas, which comprises an electromagnet, a heavy hammer, a hammer barrel, a glass fiber heating belt, an impact generation sealed cabin, a nylon rod (PA-66), organic glass, a coal rock sample, an impact force sensor, a metal shielding net, a vacuum pump, a computer, a data acquisition system, a temperature probe, a temperature sensor, a strain gauge, an electromagnetic radiation receiving antenna, a gas tank, a fixing bolt, a harness cord bolt, an air inlet valve, an air outlet valve, an air inlet hole, an air outlet hole, a lead threading hole, a flange and a flange blind plate. The electromagnetic radiation signal is suitable for measuring the coal rock impact damage electromagnetic radiation signal in the gas-rich environment, is helpful for really researching the impact load and the influence rule between the structural characteristics of the coal body and the characteristics of the electromagnetic radiation signal such as amplitude, energy and frequency in the coal rock impact damage process in the gas-containing environment, provides theoretical basis for the prevention and early warning of the dynamic disaster of the coal rock of the gas-containing coal mine, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Blind area monitoring and alarming system of agricultural harvester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blind area monitoring and alarming system of an agricultural harvester, which comprises a main body, wherein the lower side of the main body is connected with a moving device, the main body is connected with a control room, one side of the main body is provided with a harvesting device, and the harvesting device is arranged at one end of the main body, which is close to the harvesting device; the agricultural harvester blind area monitoring and alarming system has a multiple blind area visual field reminding function, and can detect the surrounding environmental information of the harvester through the arrangement of the early warning system, so that a user can take preventive measures in advance, and the damage to personnel caused by the visual field blind area of the harvester is reduced; through the arrangement of the display system, a user can observe the blind area in an all-around and visual manner, and through the arrangement of the vibration system, the user can feel visually, the environment of the blind area in the visual field can be treated in time, and casualties are reduced; through voice system's setting, can carry out voice broadcast to the blind area environment, further warning user.
assignees: PIZHOU BINYA MACHINERY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: All-round intelligent security early warning system of car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile omnibearing intelligent safety early warning system, which comprises a foreign matter sensing system, a speed sensing module, a weather inducing system, a distance detection device, an omnibearing camera system and an alarm display module, wherein the foreign matter sensing system is used for sensing foreign matters around a vehicle, the speed sensing module is used for monitoring the speed of the vehicle, and the weather inducing system is used for sensing the weather during the running of the vehicle; the omnibearing intelligent safety early warning system for the automobile has various early warning types, is intelligent, and can reduce accidents caused by reaction and consideration of a driver, the foreign matter sensing module can sense foreign matters around the automobile under normal conditions and can also sense foreign matters such as falling rocks in natural disasters, the automobile speed control system is matched to avoid damage to the safety of the automobile and the driver caused by the falling rocks and the like, the weather induction system can also automatically turn on and off the light and the automobile window in time and automatically control the automobile speed, and the accidents caused by sudden weather are reduced.
assignees: PIZHOU LUYA AUTO PARTS CO LTD

title_en: Touch feedback floor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an  sense of touch feedback floor lays in VR experience place, including flat region, blind way region, luminous indicating device, the blind way region has buried the pressure sensing device underground, and the pressure sensing device is connected with control center communicational for detect the pressure information that applies on the pressure sensing device, and transmit the pressure information who detects to control center, control center still communicational coupling has detection device and feedback device, and detection device is used for detecting whether the user correctly wears VR equipment, control center receives the user correctly and wears the testing result of VR equipment, receives simultaneously behind the pressure information, control feedback device opens, otherwise, feedback device closes the utility model discloses a level land and blind way the most direct sense of touch of foot and warning sound's warning, divide safe experience district and dangerous warning district, and the user keeps operating at safe region all the time, has also guaranteed the safety in user, experience equipment and experience place simultaneously.

title_en: Intelligent clothes with threat judgment and alarm functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent clothes with threat judgment and alarm functions, which comprise a clothes body and an alarm device, wherein a wired transmission plane pinhole camera is respectively arranged at the back and cuffs at two sides of the clothes; the camera covers the vision blind area of the wearer; the chest of clothes sets up controlling means, include microprocessor in the controlling means, wireless signal transceiver, alarm device, power module, microprocessor and three pinhole camera, wireless signal transceiver, alarm device link to each other, the camera sends the picture of shooing to microprocessor through the wire transmission mode, be connected with mobile base station through wireless transceiver, send video information to mobile base station by wireless transceiver, mobile base station gives the terminal of local setting with data transmission again, the terminal obtains user's surrounding information, utilize artificial intelligence algorithm to judge whether there is the person or the thing that has the threat to the user that abnormal approach.

title_en: Emergency air supply life-saving device for fire danger
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergent air feed life saving equipment device of fire disaster, including small-size air-blower, the battery, main guide duct, the siren, small-size gas pitcher, the lifesaving helmet, the air guide hose, the hanging flower basket, the lifting rope, control circuit constitutes, provide the required clean air that lasts for the stranded personnel of fire disaster provide breathe, simultaneously, play the warning and make things convenient for the rescue personnel to confirm stranded person's position effect, can make stranded personnel avoid the harm that the blind flee and bring in smog poisoning and the fire disaster, extension rescue time promotes stranded personnel's survival probability greatly, moreover, the steam generator is simple in structure, convenient and practical.

title_en: Fire-fighting information receiving, processing and alarming device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control information receiving processing alarm device, concretely relates to fire-fighting equipment field, including mounting box and movable shell, the mounting box side is located in the movable shell activity, the top and the equal fixed connection card shell in bottom and the cushion of movable shell, and cushion fixed connection in card shell side, the inside installation cavity that is equipped with of mounting box, installation cavity bottom fixed mounting has the mounting panel, mounting panel top fixed connection spacer, and the spacer horizontal direction is equipped with two sets ofly, the fixed receiving arrangement, processing apparatus and the alarm device that is equipped with in installation cavity middle part, the processing apparatus level is located between receiving arrangement and the alarm device. The utility model discloses wholly set up the function comprehensively and the volume is less more frivolous, has low in manufacturing cost and not occupation space's characteristics, is applicable to small-size regional interior use, will show and the operating portion sets up in the side, and the outward appearance is neat simple and convenient, can avoid the extrusion to damage, and the installation is accessible when placing.
assignees: JIANGXI LIANYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a monitoring method, a monitoring device and a monitoring system, relates to the technical field of communication, and can avoid the situation that express mail loading and unloading processes become logistics monitoring blind areas. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a target video stream sent by a terminal device, wherein the target video stream comprises a first video stream and/or a second video stream, the first video stream is a loading video stream of a transport object acquired by the terminal device, and the second video stream is an unloading video stream of the transport object acquired by the terminal device; and if the target video stream meets the preset logistics monitoring condition, sending alarm indication information to the terminal equipment, wherein the alarm indication information is used for indicating the terminal equipment to output alarm information.

title_en: Walking assistance device for the blind and walking system having it
title_ko: 시각장애인 보행 보조기구 및 이를 구비한 보행시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a walking aid device for a blind person, which comprises: a glass body including a frame formed to cover a face to be worn on the face of a blind person in a glass shape, a lens installed at the frame to protect an eye, and a leg installed to be folded on both sides of the frame to be hung on both ears of the blind person so as to support the frame; an obstacle detection amplifying unit installed in front of the frame to recognize a position of an obstacle disposed in front of the blind person and a distance from the obstacle; a GPS receiving unit installed at one side of the glass body to receive position information on the blind person; an output unit for outputting voice and vibration when the obstacle is detected; and a voice recognition unit for recognizing voice of the blind person to receive information on a destination. Therefore, safe walking can be performed by receiving a voice message to the destination while receiving a current position from the GPS receiving unit. Also, an emergency button is set for an emergency situation to issue a notification to a remote management server so as to allow a guardian and a consignment organization to take an emergency measure. In addition, a disabled person can live and show ability like normal people, thereby minimizing loss of a social opportunity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 시각장애인 보행 보조기구는 시각 장애인의 안면에 안경 형태로 착용할 수 있도록 상기 안면을 감싸는 형태로 형성된 프레임과, 상기 프레임에 설치되는 눈을 보호하는 렌즈와, 상기 프레임의 양측에 절첩 가능하게 설치되어 시각 장애인의 양측 귀에 걸림되도록 하여 상기 프레임을 지지하는 다리로 이루어지는 안경 몸체와; 상기 프레임 전방에 설치되어 시각 장애인의 전방에 배치된 장애물의 위치와 장애물까지의 거리를 인식할 수 있도록 하는 장애물 검지 증폭부와; 상기 시각 장애인의 위치 정보를 수신하도록 상기 몸체의 일측에 설치된 GPS 수신부와; 상기 장애물이 검지될 경우에 음성 및 진동을 출력하는 출력부와; 상기 시각 장애인의 음성을 인식하여 목적지에 대한 정보를 수신하는 음성인식부를; 포함함으로써, GPS 수신부로부터 현재 위치를 수신 받으면서 목적지까지 음성 메세지를 전달받아 안전하게 보행을 할 수 있도록 하고, 비상시 응급버튼을 설정함으로써 원격지의 관리 서버로 통보하여, 보호자, 위탁기관으로 응급조치를 취할 수 있고 장애자가 정상인과 같은 생활과 능력을 발휘할 수 있도록 함으로써 사회적 기회 손실을 최소화 할 수 있도록 하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION DAEGU UNIV

title_en: Elevator safe operation security protection monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elevator safe operation security protection monitoring device, which comprises a fixing plate and i, the top inner wall of fixed plate is provided with the recess, and the inner wall of recess has a fixed box through bolted connection, there is super miniature camera machine top inner wall of fixed box through bolted connection, one side inner wall of fixed plate is provided with the horizontal pole, and the outer wall of horizontal pole has the camera model through bolted connection, one side inner wall of fixed box is provided with the spacing groove. The utility model provides a camera model can play the effect of blinding the people's ear for lawless persons only can destroy and block the camera model, and super miniature camera can carry out real time monitoring through the shooting hole on the hidden plate, security protection monitoring effect when effectively having improved the elevator operation, and the staff conveniently overhauls super miniature camera in the fixed box, and simultaneously, the warning light can use with the bee calling organ cooperation, reach certain warning effect, the security protection effect of device has further been improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU WENCHUANG EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Functional fire safety management reminder signs
abstract_en: The present invention relates to firefighting management notification sign board which comprises: a main body unit formed to be attached and fixed to a building, provided in the form of a plate, and configured to transmit information such specifications, locations, etc. of firefighting equipment in the form of letters, numbers, symbols, etc. displayed on a front surface thereof; an information checking means formed on a front side of the main body and capable of communicating with a fire station server management center (C) while double-checking accurate information such as firefighting-related equipment, located the inside and outside of the building, and operation states thereof through a terminal (B) such as a tablet PC during management performed by a firefighting equipment inspector (A) so as to allow for improvement of operational failure and operational malfunction in real-time; and a coating unit which protects the main body unit while preventing external foreign substances from entering the main body unit and the information checking means. According to the present invention, the firefighting management notification sign board enables a firefighting equipment inspector to recognize all kinds of information such as firefighting-related equipment of a building and a status of firefighting equipment (building drawing, emergency escape information, previously-conducted firefighting inspection items, etc.) at once and to identify whether initially-stored firefighting equipment details match information of a present view point which inspects modification information, thereby increasing convenience of firefighting management. In addition, the firefighting management notification sign board enables the firefighting equipment inspector to exchange various kinds of firefighting equipment information of a modified view point in real-time with the firefighting server management center through a terminal so that the firefighting equipment inspector may take precautions to cause the corresponding firefighting equipment to be properly functioning, and may also set up an emergency call available. Therefore, when an emergency situation occurs at night, it is possible to make an emergency call to a police station of a fire station.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방관리 알림표지판을 형성함에 있어서: 건물 등에 부착 고정이 가능하도록 구성되고, 플레이트 판 형태로 형성되어 전면에 글자 · 숫자 · 기호 등의 형태로 소방 설비 제원 · 위치 등의 정보를 전달하는 본체부; 본체 전면부에 형성되어 소방시설점검자(A)의 관리 시 태블렛 PC 등의 단말기(B)를 통해 건물 내·외부의 소방관련 장비와 작동상태 등의 정확한 정보를 재차 확인하면서 소방서버관리처(C)와의 교류가 가능하여 실시간 형태로 기기의 작동불능 및 오류의 개선 등이 가능하게끔 구비하는 정보확인수단; 및 본체부와 정보확인수단에 외부의 이물질 유입 등을 방지하면서 본체부의 보호가 가능하게끔 코팅부를 구비함을 특징으로 한다. 
이러한 본 발명에 따르면, 건물의 소방관련 장비와 소방 기기상황(건물도면 · 비상탈출정보 · 종전의 소방점검사항 등) 등의 모든 정보를 소방시설점검자가 일거에 인지하도록 하는 한편, 최초 저장된 소방설비내역과 변경정보 등을 점검하는 현재시점의 정보가 일치하는지를 단번에 알 수 있도록 함으로써 소방 관리의 편의성이 증진되도록 하면서도 변경된 시점의 각종 소방 설비정보를 소방시설점검자가 단말기를 통해 소방서버관리처와 실시간으로 교류하여 해당 소방 설비가 제대로 작동될 수 있도록 사전 조치하고 비상호출 또한 가능하도록 함으로써 야간에 긴박한 일이 발생할 시 경찰서 또는 소방서로 비상호출이 가능하게 한 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Intelligent control type fire-fighting emergency lighting evacuation system with centralized power supply and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centralized power supply intelligent control type fire-fighting emergency lighting evacuation system and a construction method thereof. The system is linked with the original fire alarm device to clarify the fire point, evacuation simulation analysis is carried out through personnel evacuation simulation software, and an optimal dynamic evacuation route is generated in time, so that trapped personnel can actively avoid smoke and fire, judgment is accurately made, and the occurrence of group death and group injury accidents such as blind escape, treading and the like is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG NO 1 CONSTR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Tire breaking device for vehicle deceleration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tire-breaking device for vehicle deceleration, which comprises a panel and a main body, wherein the panel is fixedly arranged on the ground of a road through screws and is positioned on the same horizontal plane with the ground, and the main body is arranged in a blind groove arranged below the ground; the main body is of a hollow box body structure, a driving mechanism is arranged at the bottom in the main body and connected with a fixed plate, a plurality of tire breaking nails are mounted at the upper end of the fixed plate, and a plastic waterproof layer is further mounted at the uppermost end in the main body; the panel is externally electrically connected with an alarm, the panel is provided with nail holes corresponding to the broken tire nails one to one, and when the broken tire nails penetrate through the nail holes, the alarm can respond to triggering. The utility model discloses can conveniently arrange under the ground in public place, not only do not influence public transport, can also force illegal vehicle to slow down or stop in time, reduce emergency's casualties and loss of property.

title_en: Glass breakage alarm circuit and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a glass breakage alarm circuit and system, wherein an alarm induction lead is arranged on glass, no electric cross point exists on the whole layout of the alarm induction lead, and two ports of the alarm induction lead are respectively connected with corresponding devices in the glass breakage alarm circuit. When the glass is not broken, the circuit switching device is electrified, so that a loop formed by the external power supply, the alarm induction lead, the circuit switching device and the first protection device is conducted. When the glass is broken to cause the breakage of the alarm induction lead, the circuit switching device loses power, so that a loop formed by the external power supply, the circuit switching device and the alarm device is conducted. Through the scheme, the glass breakage alarm circuit is distributed on the glass at the positions of doors, windows and the like, when the glass breaks due to severe weather or impact of foreign objects, the alarm device can send an alarm signal to remind a user in time, and the use reliability of the doors, windows and the windows is effectively improved.

title_en: Railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identification system based on distributed optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway foreign matter invasion safety perception and identification system based on distributed optical fiber sensing is based on two kinds of distributed optical fiber sensing technologies and video linkage technology: monitoring a vibration invasion signal generated when illegal personnel, vehicles and construction invade a high-speed railway by utilizing a phase optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position, the event and the like of the invasion signal; monitoring a fence deformation signal of the high-speed railway generated when large-scale rockfall and debris flow invade the high-speed railway by utilizing a Brillouin optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position of the invasion signal; when any one or two of the two optical fiber sensing systems gives an alarm, the optical fiber sensing systems can be linked with cameras arranged on a high-speed railway tower pole to call monitoring pictures of the intrusion event. The three subsystems work synchronously, study mutually, monitor invasion layer by layer, and realize early warning and identification of foreign matter invasion of the high-speed railway together.
assignees: NINGBO ZHENGYE AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted intensity meter with earthquake early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted spirit meter with earthquake early warning function, which comprises a microprocessor, a power circuit, a network module, an earthquake analysis module, an acceleration sensor, a light alarm and a sound alarm, wherein the spirit meter with the earthquake early warning function is carried by the vehicle, has small volume and can be easily installed in a cab and can be used as early warning equipment of a driver, the equipment has the functions of local earthquake detection and foreign earthquake early warning, when the acceleration sensor arranged in the spirit meter monitors the local earthquake condition in real time and calculates the acceleration value to automatically analyze the vibration signal, when the signal is generated by natural disaster earthquake and the spirit value reaches the preset spirit threshold value, the sound and light alarm is automatically carried out, the light flickers, the alarm bell sounds, and the spirit meter transmits the signal to a server to provide data support for emergency rescue command, meanwhile, the earthquake early warning platform can obtain the information of the earthquake at different places, so that the early warning is given in advance, and the time is won for the driver to avoid danger in advance.
assignees: YIN HAITAO;LI YANZHAO;YANG LE;WANG JIEMIN;LIU HAN;ZHANG TIAN

title_en: Emergency evacuation method for dense crowd
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation method for dense crowds, which comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time people flow information at each escape passage in a building; according to the people flow information at each escape passage, respectively analyzing the people flow density in each escape passage of the building; determining evacuation routes according to pre-stored building structure information and structure distribution information of each escape channel and by combining people flow density in each escape channel; and transmitting and announcing the evacuation route to each output terminal respectively. When an accident occurs in a dense crowd gathering place, the invention can intervene and help large-scale crowds to evacuate and escape orderly, perform the functions of risk alarm, detect trapped people and conveniently implement rescue and the like, and avoid the singleness and blindness of the dense crowd during escape so as to reduce casualties of the sudden accident.

title_en: Fire hydrant monitoring terminal, device and system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire hydrant monitoring terminal, device and system, wherein fire hydrant monitoring system includes fire hydrant monitoring terminal, local monitoring host computer and remote server. The fire hydrant monitoring terminal comprises a pressure detection module, a flow switch, an angular displacement sensor, a main control module, an LED module, a GPS module, a power supply module and a LoRa radio frequency module; the local monitoring host comprises a main control module, a LoRa radio frequency module, a Wi-Fi module and a liquid crystal display screen. The fire hydrant monitoring terminal is connected with the local monitoring host through a LoRa radio frequency signal; the local monitoring host computer and the remote server are connected through the Internet. The utility model discloses can monitor the water pressure and the flow variation in the fire hydrant, when detecting that water pressure does not satisfy fire-fighting water requirement or flow switch action, both accessible detector itself, local monitoring host realize local alarming function, can send alarm information to remote server again, realize remote alarming function.

title_en: Intelligent walking stick system integrating machine learning and Internet of things technology for blind people
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent walking stick system for blind people, which integrates machine learning and Internet of things technology, and comprises an obstacle avoidance module, a help seeking module, a remote GPS positioning module, a GPRS communication module, a cloud server database, a core module and a WeChat small program unit; the system calculates the attitude angle by adopting a Kalman filtering algorithm according to attitude data acquired by a nine-axis accelerometer gyroscope sensor, the working principle of an alarm unit is that the sensing data acquired by the sensor is input into a classifier, then the sensing data is compared and classified with real-time nine-axis accelerometer gyroscope sensor data according to normal classification, the attitude data is judged and classified, if the classification is not in the normal classification, an alarm signal is output if the abnormal attitude is judged, the alarm information is transmitted to a WeChat small program unit to be popped up and displayed for reminding a guardian, and the safety of the blind person when going out and the guardian of family members can be fundamentally solved.

title_en: Monitoring method and monitoring device for foreign matter invasion of line corridor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring foreign body invasion of a line corridor, which comprises the following steps: shooting towards a preset direction to obtain an SAR image, and resolving two adjacent towers and a transmission line between the two towers from the SAR image; judging whether foreign matter shielding exists in the tower or the transmission line; and if so, generating an alarm, acquiring the longitude and latitude of the tower, and sending the longitude and latitude to a background server. The invention also discloses a device for monitoring the foreign body invasion of the line corridor. By implementing the monitoring method and the monitoring device for the foreign matter invasion of the line corridor, the condition of the foreign matter nearby the tower can be monitored in real time, the tower or the power transmission line is prevented from being damaged by the surrounding foreign matter under the weather condition of typhoon or thunder and lightning, and the potential safety hazard is eliminated.

title_en: Positioning blind-guiding glasses
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pair of positioning blind-guiding glasses, which comprises a glasses frame, wherein a main control module, a positioning module, a distance sensing module, a receiving module and an emergency module are arranged in the glasses frame, the positioning module comprises a GPS module and an SIM card module, the distance sensing module is connected with the main control module and is used for inputting the distance information of an obstacle into the main control module after the obstacle is detected and sending the distance information to the receiving module through the main control module, so that a blind person can obtain the distance information of the obstacle; the positioning module and the emergency module are respectively connected with the main control module, and the GPS module is used for acquiring the current position information of the blind person and sending the current position information to the associated mobile phone through the emergency module; the SIM card module provides required wireless signals and flow for the GPS module and the emergency module. The invention can send out alarm when the blind person is lost and other emergency situations occur, and can obtain rescue in time.

title_en: Weak current engineering safety alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light current engineering safety alarm device, including smoke transducer and (window) curtain, the (window) curtain includes stay cord, (window) curtain footstock, bottom plate and the curtain body, be equipped with the spooler in the (window) curtain footstock, the stay cord twines in the spooler, the one end of stay cord is connected with the lower extreme of the curtain body, the other end of stay cord passes (window) curtain base to the external world, the stay cord twines the coiling by a plurality of hot melt lines and becomes, constitute by the flameproof fabric on the curtain body, extinguishing device is located the top of (window) curtain, smoke transducer, extinguishing device and (window) curtain are all installed on the wall body. The utility model discloses when the conflagration appears, not only can play the effect of early warning through smoke transducer, also can prevent stretching of the intensity of a fire with the intensity of a fire separation through the (window) curtain to accessible extinguishing device puts out the fire, reduces casualties and loss of property.

title_en: Solar blind ultraviolet lens with large relative aperture and long focal length and optical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-relative-aperture long-focal-length solar blind ultraviolet lens and an optical system, wherein the large-relative-aperture long-focal-length solar blind ultraviolet lens comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a sixth lens, a seventh lens and an eighth lens which are sequentially arranged from an object space to an image space, the optical system further comprises an aperture diaphragm positioned between the fourth lens and the fifth lens and an ultraviolet detection image surface positioned at the rear side of the eighth lens, wherein the first lens and the seventh lens are negative focal power convex-concave lenses, the second lens, the fourth lens and the sixth lens are positive focal power biconvex lenses, the third lens is a negative focal power plano-concave lens, the fifth lens is a negative focal power biconcave lens, and the eighth lens is a positive focal power convex-concave lens. The large-relative-aperture long-focus solar blind ultraviolet optical system has the advantages of fast focal ratio, long focal length, high resolution, high-precision detection and the like, and is suitable for photoelectric detection system application in the aspects of ultraviolet alarm, corona detection, forest fire prevention and the like in a solar blind ultraviolet spectral region.

title_en: Standard text-based sign language translation system, disaster/emergency broadcasting system, sign language translation transmission method and system, and disaster text message sending system utilizing the translation system
title_ko: 표준문안 기반 수어번역시스템과 이를 이용한 재난/응급방송시스템, 수어번역 전송방법과 시스템 및 재난문자 발송시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a standard draft based sign language translation system that can be suitably used in a disaster/emergency broadcasting system of high-speed trains such as SRT and KTX, subways, and light rails, and can be useful for other disaster text message transmission systems. The standard draft based sign language translation system comprises: an original text analysis module that automatically analyzes approved text information and extracts information on a standard draft identifier and characters in a variable text part; and an animation data generation module that retrieves the information output from the original text analysis module in a database, extracts fixed text part animation data and finger language animation data, and generates animation data corresponding to combined and approved standard draft.
abstract_ko: SRT, KTX 등의 고속열차, 지하철, 경전철 등 열차의 재난/응급방송시스템에 적합하게 활용할 수 있고, 여타 재난문자 발송시스템 등에도 유용하게 활용될 수 있는 표준문안기반 수어번역시스템이 개시된다. 상기 표준문안 기반 수어번역시스템은 인가되는 문자정보를 자동으로 분석하여 표준문안에 대한 식별자와 가변문자부의 문자에 대한 정보를 추출하는 원문분석모듈, 원문분석모듈에서 출력되는 정보를 데이터베이스에 조회하여 고정문자부 애니메이션 데이터와 지화 애니메이션 데이터를 추출하고 조합하여 인가되는 표준문안에 대응하는 애니메이션 데이터를 생성하는 애니메이션 데이터 생성모듈을 포함하는 구성을 한다.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system for intelligent building
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a fire fighting system facing an intelligent building, which comprises an escape module and a central control module, wherein the escape module comprises an information storage module, a position indication module, an escape route planning module, a voice broadcast module and an automatic notification module, the escape route planning module is connected with the position indication module and the central control module, the escape route planning module receives ignition point position information and area division information output by the position indication module and outputs the ignition point position information and the area division information to the central control module, the central control module plans an escape route by taking each room as a starting point according to the ignition point position information and the layout of the building, guides disaster-stricken personnel to escape from a fire scene, plans a safer escape point position after determining an unsafe escape route, avoids the personnel from blindness and self-rescue, thereby improving the survival probability, and as the disaster-stricken personnel are concentrated in the escape route or difficulty avoidance, the disaster relief personnel can relieve the disaster according to the escape route and the position of the refuge point, thereby reducing the difficulty of disaster relief.

title_en: Light source assembly for alarm device and fire alarm device including the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a light source assembly applied to an alarm device, which comprises a base; a light source arranged on the base and configured to emit visible light; and a lens arranged on an emission path of the light source and configured to modulate the visible light emitted by the light source into a light distribution curve conforming to the presetting. title_en: Method for monitoring blind spot of cycle using smart helmet for cycle rider and blind spot monitoring device using them
title_ko: 바이크 라이더용 스마트 헬멧을 이용하여 바이크의 블라인드 스팟을 모니터링 하는 방법 및 이를 이용한 블라인드 스팟 모니터링 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for monitoring a blind spot of a bike using a smart helmet for a bike rider to enable the bike rider to recognize a situation around the bike during riding. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of a blind spot monitoring device: (a) when a video image of a first blind spot corresponding to the smart helmet is detected, allowing an object to detect an object from the video image and checking a first object located at the first blind spot; and (b) referring to sensor information acquired from a part of a GPS sensor, an acceleration sensor, a geomagnetic sensor installed in the smart helmet, determining the direction of the smart helmet and a bike driving direction, referring to the direction of the smart helmet and the bike driving direction to check a second object located at a second blind spot corresponding to the bike among the first objects, and displaying the second object through a head-up display (HUD) installed in the smart helmet or warning the rider of that the second object is located at the second blind spot in sound through a speaker.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이크 라이더용 스마트 헬멧을 이용하여 블라인드 스팟(Blind Spot)을 모니터링하는 방법에 있어서, 블라인드 스팟 모니터링 장치는, (a) 스마트 헬멧에 대응되는 제1 블라인드 스팟의 영상 이미지(Video Image)가 획득되면, 객체 검출기로 하여금 영상 이미지 상의 객체를 검출하도록 하고, 제1 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제1 객체를 확인하는 단계; 및 (b) 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 GPS 센서, 가속력 센서, 및 지자기 센서(Geomagnetic Sensor) 중 일부로부터 획득되는 센서 정보를 참조하여 스마트 헬멧 방향 및 바이크 주행 방향을 판단하고, 스마트 헬멧 방향과 바이크 주행 방향을 참조하여 제1 객체 중 바이크에 대응되는 제2 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제2 객체를 확인하고, 제2 객체를 상기 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 헤드업 디스플레이(Head Up Display; HUD)를 통해 표시하거나, 제2 블라인드 스팟에 제2 객체가 위치하고 있음을 스피커를 통해 소리로 경보(Alarm)하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Combustible gas early warning device based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combustible gas early-warning device based on the Internet of things, which is connected with a thing networking for data transmission, can feed back gas leakage information to personnel, can give an alarm for prompting, timely controls the on-off of gas and can form back pumping to the leaked gas, and is characterized by comprising a gas sensor, a detection box, an electromagnetic valve, an emergency control unit, a gas suction pipe and a gas collecting tank, wherein the gas sensors are in signal connection with the detection box through data transmission lines, the emergency control unit is in signal connection with the detection box through the data transmission lines, the emergency control unit is communicated with the gas collecting tank through the gas suction pipe, the electromagnetic valve is in signal connection with the detection box through wireless transmission, the gas leakage information can be directly sent to a middle moving end, a householder can conveniently master the gas leakage condition in time and take measures to perform multi-point high concentration detection, avoiding detection blind areas.

title_en: Mining excavation transportation equipment anti-intrusion and dangerous proximity alarm device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of mine safety equipment, and particularly relates to an anti-invasion and dangerous proximity alarm device and a detection method for underground mining and transportation equipment. When the portable signal terminal enters the alarm range of the core controller or two core controllers enter the alarm range between the portable signal terminal and the core controller, the sound-light alarm module emits corresponding sound and light alarm signals, the portable signal terminal vibrates for alarm, and the core controller outputs corresponding switch contact signals through the output isolation module according to the danger level of the alarm signals to control equipment to execute braking and emergency shutdown actions; the invention fully considers the particularity of active safety protection of mining transportation equipment, effectively solves the problems of equipment injury and equipment-equipment collision accidents caused by poor sight line and equipment blind areas in the underground dark environment, avoids the underground collision accidents and improves the production safety.

title_en: Disabled person's fire emergency light
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency indicator lamp for disabled people, which comprises a lamp body, a lamp shell, a pressure sensing ground mat, a power supply, an alarm, a sound generator and a control device. According to the floor mat with the pressure sensing function, when a fire disaster occurs, the emergency indicating lamp is provided with the power supply for supplying power, the lamp body flickers, the pressure sensing device senses whether a person is positioned on the pressure sensing device, when the person is positioned on the pressure sensing device, the control device reasonably plans the escape route and carries out voice broadcasting, the visually impaired and deaf-mute people are effectively guided to escape, and the alarm can be used for sending distress signals and position signals when the person cannot escape by means of self force, so that the firefighters can rescue, and casualties can be reduced.

title_en: Systems, apparatuses and methods for enhanced notifications to users of wearable medical devices
abstract_en: A wearable medical device (e.g., wearable drug delivery pump) sends a request to another device for generation of an audible or vibratory notification at the other device, which is helpful when the wearable medical device is obscured by a user's clothing or the user is vision or hearing impaired. The other device receiving the request to generate a notification can be a remote controller or smartphone paired with the wearable medical device, or a smart watch or a Bluetooth (BT)-enabled headset or other device paired with the remote controller. The wearable medical device is configured with a BT stack that allows the device to pair with its controller in a secure bonded relationship, but to send signals requiring less security (e.g., requests for generation of notifications) to other devices (e.g., a BT-enabled headset or smart watch) using a more ubiquitous wireless protocol such as a standard BT protocol with broadcast mode.

title_en: Alarm apparatus for preventing blind accident
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for preventing an accident caused by a working line (13) of a roller blind (10). The apparatus comprises: a main body (20) including a space part (21) and a hanging part (23) therein and serving as a weight to the working line (13); a sensing means (30) installed on the main body (20) to detect the shaking of the main body (20); a covering means (40) installed on the main body (20) to reduce the exposed length of the working line (13); and a controller (50) issuing an alarm or operating the covering means (40) in response to a signal of the sensing means (30). Accordingly, the apparatus senses a state, in which a child accesses the roller blind installed on the window or the like to shade the light and plays with the roller blind, and issues an alarm. In addition, the apparatus temporally reduces an exposed portion of the working line, thereby increasing the accident prevention rate.

title_en: Wirelessly Activated Monitored Safety Temperature Sensing Alarm
abstract_en: This Wireless Safety Temperature Sensing Alarm is a thermally actuated alarm designed to send a wireless signal to a remote base which will turn on a buzzer, a visual light signal or an emergency alert system to alert anyone around that a child/person/pet/plant has been left in a confined environment that is experiencing extreme temperatures, whether hot or cold. It can also simply alert someone that a certain device or environment has reached the user defined set point temperature. It consists of 2 units: a base and a remote. The base is easily installed on any kind of carrier or as a standalone fixture, and it is designed to sense the temperature of the environment that the child/person/pet/plant is in and it can trigger a wireless signal on the remote to turn on the buzzer/alarm, and a flashing light for people who are hearing impaired or send an RF signal emergency alert. It's designed with a 10 minute turn-on delay to prevent false alarms upon startup. It also has a low-battery alert as an add-on safety precaution. The remote can be easily carried on or as a standalone device, or is easily installed on the exterior of the confined environment which the child/person/pet/plant is in. This makes it possible for anyone who is nearby to hear/see the alarm and take action. Many lives of children, beloved people, pets, and plants could be saved (and financial loss or wasted time could be prevented) using this easy to install invention. A future development of the product will be able to alert an emergency system in case that human lives are in danger of extreme temperatures.

title_en: Hazard-sensitive headset
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hazard-sensitive headset for predicting and alerting the possibility of collision with a surrounding object, which comprises: an object recognition unit for recognizing one or more surrounding objects approaching a headset wearer; a parameter calculating unit for calculating a distance and an approach speed with respect to the one or more recognized objects; an alarm control unit for controlling an alarm by determining a collision risk in a manner of real-time tracking the accessibility of the object with the highest probability of collision based on the calculated distance to and approach speed of each object; and an alarm unit for outputting an alarm under the control of the alarm control unit.

title_en: Storm avoiding buildings and structures
abstract_en: A building sheltering structure is configured to facilitate the shielding of at least one domicile or building into an underground foundation before an emergency environmental condition arises. The foundation includes a cover plate that translates horizontally to occlude the at least one domicile upon retraction into a secure cavity of the foundation by a lift assembly positioned at the bottom of the foundation cavity. Mounted atop the lift assembly, the at least one domicile can be fully retracted into the foundation cavity and completely shielded by the cover plate. The operation of the lift assembly is commanded and powered by a supply system. A processor of the supply system facilitates emergency warnings and panic transmissions to signal for help. Further, the supply system accommodates a plurality of solar panels mounted atop the at least one domicile to keep the system charged for the use in emergency.

title_en: Switch gear with apparatus for judging earthquake-proof integrity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchgear having an apparatus for determining earthquake-proof integrity, comprising: an enclosure having a device for a switchgear installed therein; an arc sensor installed inside the enclosure and sensing generation of arc; a temperature sensor installed inside the enclosure and measuring temperature; a tilt sensor installed inside the enclosure and measuring tilt; a sensor elevator installed inside the enclosure such that the arc sensor and the temperature sensor are installed therein, and elevating the arc sensor and the temperature sensor to vary a sensing area; an integrity determination unit for determining integrity of a switchgear depending on whether sensing results of the arc sensor, the temperature sensor and the tilt sensor satisfy integrity determination conditions; a communications unit for performing communications with an external device; and a control unit for controlling a determination result by the integrity determination unit to be provided to a predetermined terminal or system through the communications unit. According to the present invention, it is possible to determine warping, structural deformation and internal abnormal temperature and always diagnose an internal arc generation state in a switchgear and an internal device. If an abnormal state occurs, a warning signal can be transmitted to nearby workers or the like through a terminal such as a smartphone or the like. Thus, failure prevention of a switchgear and reduction of maintenance therethrough are possible, and temperature measurement at all times and inspection for a deterioration state are possible while simultaneously removing a blinding spot of sensors according to various components of a switchgear to sense occurrence of an abnormal state.

title_en: System for notifying of disaster such as fire
abstract_en: To provide a solution to achieve flexible emergency broadcasting such as evacuation guidance by a foreign language while utilizing an existing automatic fire warning facility and an emergency broadcasting facility.SOLUTION: A system includes sensors for monitoring information transmission means to be operated when an automatic fire warning facility and an emergency broadcasting facility arranged in an installation are in an issuing state, and detects an issuing state of the automatic fire warning facility and the emergency broadcasting facility by detection of the sensors. Detection information of the sensors is transmitted to an external server via a network in response to detection of an issuing state. The server receives detection information from the sensors so as to transmit notification information for notifying of occurrence of a disaster to a predetermined network terminal inside the installation. The network terminal receives notification information from the server so as to notify of occurrence of a disaster by visually or acoustically outputting notification information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Frontier defense equipment and system for construction site safety supervision
abstract_en: The invention relates to a frontier defense device and a frontier defense system for construction site safety supervision, which comprise an intelligent sensor array arranged in a frontier defense guardrail or a visual blind area of mechanical equipment, a chip label attached to a worker and a background management system in signal connection with the intelligent sensor array and the chip label. title_en: Resource allocation method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, and can be applied to intelligent medical scenes. The resource allocation method comprises the following steps: receiving emergency information of a patient, and extracting position information of the patient from the emergency information; judging space grid information of a patient according to the position information of the patient, and acquiring space accessibility information between the patient and each medical institution according to the space grid information; matching emergency institutions and police emergency ambulances for patients according to the space accessibility information between the patients and the medical institutions; and planning an alarm-outputting route for the alarm-outputting emergency ambulance through a preset path planning algorithm according to the geographical position information of the alarm-outputting emergency ambulance, so that the alarm-outputting emergency ambulance executes a patient receiving task. The method considers the matching condition of the emergency resource and the patient information to the greatest extent, can effectively improve the efficiency and reliability of the emergency resource allocation, saves the time cost of emergency work, and improves the efficiency of the rescue work.

title_en: Intelligent Camera System capable of Video Translation
abstract_en: A camera system capable of video translation includes: an image information input unit for detecting visible light images, thermal images, and motion information in a preset photographing area; a sound recognition unit which collects sounds in each preset direction; an air component detection unit which detects air components; an alarm module unit which transmits an alarm using visual and auditory methods; and a control unit which displays the type of objects detected based on the information transmitted from the image information input unit on the image and detects a dangerous situation of each object based on the sound information transmitted from the sound recognition unit and the air component transmitted from the air component detection unit, and then controls the alarm module unit to perform warning.

title_en: Distribution board with built-in battery having audio-visual guidance means
title_ko: 시청각 안내 수단을 구비한 배터리 내장형 분전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a battery-embedded panel board having an audio-visual guide means. According to the present invention, the battery-embedded panel board having an audio-visual guide means comprises: a charging circuit unit for generating battery charging power; a battery to be charged by the battery charging power; an emergency lamp; a fire alarm unit; and a controller. According to the present invention, a hearing-impaired person can be guided to evacuate rapidly and safely.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재와 정전 상황을 구분하여 비상등을 동작시킬 수 있으며, 특히 화재 발생 시에는 시청각 장애인이 화재 상황을 구분하여 인지할 수 있도록 하며, 비상 부하 연결 라인의 단선이나 단락 등의 사고에도 배터리를 안전하게 보호하여 비상 동작 회로부의 과열에 의한 2차 사고를 방지할 수 있도록 한 시청각 안내 수단을 구비한 배터리 내장형 분전반에 관한 것으로서, 분전반에서 분기되는 상시전원을 정류하여 배터리 충전전원을 발생시키는 충전회로부; 상기 배터리 충전전원에 의해 충전되는 배터리; 상기 배터리의 전원에 의해 동작되며 정전 시 또는 화재 발생 시에 점등되는 비상등; 상기 배터리의 전원에 의해 동작되며 화재 발생 시에 시각적 또는 청각적 경보 신호를 출력하는 화재 경보 알람부; 및 정전 시에는 상기 비상등을 점등시키며 건물 내에 설치된 화재 감지기로부터 화재 감지 신호가 발생될 때에는 상기 비상등과 상기 화재 경보 알람부를 동시에 동작시키도록 제어하는 컨트롤러를 포함하며, 상기 화재 경보 알람부는, 상기 비상등 내에 내재되며 일 방향을 따라 배치되는 제1 경보 조명용 고휘도 LED(L3, L4)와, 상기 제1 경보 조명용 고휘도 LED(L3, L4)에 교차하는 방향을 따라 배치되는 제2 경보 조명용 고휘도 LED(L1, L2)와, 상기 제1 경보 조명용 고휘도 LED(L3, L4) 및 상기 제2 경보 조명용 고휘도 LED(L1, L2)를 교호로 점멸 구동하는 경보 조명 회로부를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 화재 발생 시에는 화재 감지 스위칭소자와 비상 동작 스위칭소자의 2단 스위칭에 의해 화재 경보 알람부와 비상등을 동작시키고, 정전 시(화재가 동반되지 않는)에는 제1 포토 커플러와 비상 동작 스위칭소자의 동작에 의해 비상등만을 동작시킴으로써, 정전 상황과 화재 발생 상황을 정확하게 구분하여 경보할 수 있으며, 특히 화재 발생 시에는 비상등에 내재된 고휘도 LED를 십자형으로 점멸시켜 표시함으로써 청각 장애인이 화재 발생과 정전을 구분하여 인지할 수 있도록 하고 신속하고 안전하게 대피하도록 유도할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed gas alarm of sensor components of a whole that can function independently installation relates to gaseous response alarm equipment field. The sensor is mounted on the fixed gas alarm in a split mode, the lower surface of the fixing head is in threaded connection with the sensing assembly, one side of the fixing head is connected with the alarm through the extension cable circuit, and the back face of the fixing head is fixedly connected with the first mounting plate. title_en: System for providing location alerts relating to emergencies
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for generating alerts communicated to emergency responders and/or contacts indicating a location of an incident. The system comprises a housing, one or more light sources, and a computing processor. A switch is located in the housing and configured to be accessible to a user. When the switch is actuated by a user indicating an incident, the processor provides power to the at least one light source to output light from the housing thereby indicating the location of the system. The system may also control a speaker to output an audible signal and a transmitter to transmit an emergency signal with location information to a device of an emergency responder and/or an emergency contact. The present invention may also be embodied in a software application that is implemented on a mobile device to thereby leverage the components of the mobile device to send alerts.

title_en: Guard bar patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inspection devices, and provides a guardrail patrol machine which is used for solving the problem that a large amount of manpower and material resources are needed to patrol and detect on a current road; the driving unit is used for receiving a preset driving signal and driving the guardrail patrol machine to move relatively along the guardrail; the illegal snapshot unit is used for snapshot of illegal vehicle information preset on a road; the foreign matter monitoring unit is used for detecting whether preset foreign matter information exists on a road; the sound and light warning unit is used for warning the road according to a preset sound and light warning mode; and the real-time monitoring unit is used for acquiring the current image information of the road. The guardrail patrol machine can monitor foreign matters on the road and give an alarm correspondingly, and improves the driving safety of the road.

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system which comprises a guardrail patrol machine, a tunnel patrol machine, a gateway robot, an acousto-optic early warning system and a background server, wherein the guardrail patrol machine is connected with the tunnel patrol machine through a network; the guardrail patrol machine is arranged on a road guardrail and used for sending preset early warning information to the background server; the tunnel patrol machine is arranged at a preset position of the tunnel and used for acquiring the illegal information of preset vehicles, the information of preset tunnel foreign matters, the air quality concentration and the preset traffic image information in the current tunnel and uploading the information to the background server; the gateway crossing robot is arranged at a preset position of a gateway crossing and used for acquiring preset vehicle information of the current gateway crossing and uploading the acquired preset vehicle information to the background server, and the sound and light early warning system is used for receiving preset alarm signals and carrying out corresponding sound and light early warning according to the received preset alarm signals. The system has the advantages of intelligent monitoring on high-speed traffic, high safety and strong convenience.

title_en: Traffic early warning system based on tunnel patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides a traffic early warning system based on a tunnel patrol machine, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that a driver does not react in time due to road foreign matters in the current tunnel traffic, and comprises the following components: the system comprises a tunnel patrol machine, an acousto-optic early warning system, a fan control module, a light control module and a background server; the acousto-optic early warning system is used for receiving a preset acousto-optic early warning signal and carrying out corresponding preset sound early warning and preset light early warning; the fan control module is used for controlling the opening and closing of the fan according to the air quality concentration in the tunnel, and the light control module is used for receiving a preset light early warning signal and generating a preset light signal at a tunnel entrance to stop entering the tunnel. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system and method based on acousto-optic early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system based on an acousto-optic early warning device, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that road foreign matters are not timely reacted by a driver in current road traffic; the acousto-optic early warning system is used for receiving a preset alarm signal and uploading the preset one-key alarm signal to the background server; and the background server is used for calculating the guardrail patrol machine which is closest to the acousto-optic early warning device uploading the preset warning signal according to the received preset one-key warning signal, scheduling the guardrail patrol machine to move to the acousto-optic early warning device and carrying out early warning and rechecking. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system based on guardrail patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system based on a guardrail patrol machine, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that a driver cannot react timely when road foreign matters come in current road traffic; the guardrail patrol machine is used for sending preset early warning information to the background server; the background server is used for issuing a corresponding preset early warning instruction to the acousto-optic early warning system according to the received preset early warning information; and the sound and light early warning system is used for carrying out corresponding sound broadcast early warning and light starting early warning according to the received preset early warning instruction. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Tunnel patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides a tunnel patrol machine, which comprises: the system comprises a control unit, and a driving unit, a networking transmission unit, an illegal snapshot unit, a foreign matter monitoring unit, a gas monitoring unit, an acousto-optic warning unit, a real-time monitoring unit and a position positioning unit which are respectively and electrically connected with the control unit; the illegal snapshot unit is used for snapshot of preset vehicle illegal information in the tunnel and snapshot of the preset vehicle illegal information; the foreign matter detection unit is used for detecting whether preset foreign matter information exists in the tunnel or not; the gas monitoring unit is used for monitoring the air mass concentration in the tunnel; the acousto-optic warning unit is used for carrying out tunnel warning according to a preset acousto-optic warning mode; the real-time monitoring unit is used for acquiring preset traffic image information within a preset distance range; the position locating unit is used for obtaining current position information. The tunnel patrol machine can actively identify the foreign matters and abnormal parking events of the current tunnel in time and perform early warning.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device which comprises a box body, wherein through holes are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the box body, the bottom of a torsion spring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of a bent plate, a belt is fixedly connected to the outer side of the bent plate, the outer wall of the belt is in clearance fit with the inner wall of the through holes, the outer wall of the belt is rotatably connected with a grooved wheel, the grooved wheel is rotatably connected with the rear end face of the inner wall of the through hole through a connecting shaft, rod bodies are fixedly connected to the outer side of the belt, and the two rod bodies are respectively rotatably connected. This forest fire prevention control early warning device for smoke alarm accessible box and box cover's protection carries out stable work, and convenient to use person takes out smoke alarm, makes box cover and box can carry out stable laminating, and then makes box cover and box can carry out stable protection to smoke alarm, makes smoke alarm can carry out stable protection.

title_en: Automatic recognition early warning method and system for road foreign matters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically identifying and early warning road foreign matters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the data acquisition unit acquires image information by installing cameras at various disaster hidden danger points; processing the acquired image information, and extracting various features in the acquired image information by the image after enhancing the source image; identifying the difference of image information obtained in adjacent time periods through the structural similarity; simplifying the extracted characteristic information by adopting a mathematical morphology method; and detecting whether the foreign matters in the acquired image information are motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles and pedestrians by adopting a YOLOv2 multi-target detection and identification model. According to the invention, through comparing the difference in the space structure between the images and adopting the YOLOv2 multi-target detection recognition model, the rockfall and other geological disasters of the road surface are recognized and detected, the problems of automatic recognition, prediction and early warning of the geological disasters of the road surface and the side slope are solved, and the image recognition and target detection precision is improved.

title_en: Self-rescue method based on 5G D2D straight-through technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-rescue method based on a 5G D2D straight-through technology, which comprises the following steps: s1, the master D2D terminal located in the cellular network blind area initiates a detection request containing emergency rescue information to the nearby slave D2D terminal; s2, detecting the networking capability of the nearby slave D2D terminal after receiving the probe request; s3, extracting the emergency rescue information of the probe request from the D2D terminal and sending response information to the main D2D terminal; s4, the slave D2D terminal continuously initiates a probe request containing the emergency rescue information of the master D2D terminal to other slave D2D terminals near the slave D2D terminal; s5, detecting the networking capability of other nearby slave D2D terminals after receiving the detection request, if the detection is that the network exists, extracting the emergency rescue information of the detection request and sending response information to the slave D2D terminal at the upper stage, and if the detection is that the network does not exist, returning to S4; and S6, after receiving the response information, the main D2D terminal selects a path and sends the emergency rescue information to an alarm center. Thereby ensuring the personal safety of the user.

title_en: Personal emergency alert system, method and device
abstract_en: A system, method and device for notifying designated recipients about a personal emergency. An individual maintains a personal emergency alert device (PEAD) in accessible proximity. The PEAD is activated by onboard or remote sensor(s) in proximity to the PEAD. The sensor(s) monitor the occurrence of an emergency activation event. PEAD includes a controller. The controller, triggered by detection of an emergency event by a sensor, activates a geolocation module to obtain geolocation information, formulates an alert message, establishes a network connection, and transmits the message with geolocation information to a personal emergency alert notification service (PEANS). PEANS responds by sending a text, email or other emergency notification to designated notification recipient(s). Once activated, PEAD periodically tracks and transmits its geolocation until it runs out of power. Alternatively, PEAD can be deactivated by sending a deactivation code to the PEANS, which in turn instructs such PEAD to deactivate.

title_en: Wireless Power System With Foreign Object Detection
abstract_en: A wireless power system has a wireless power transmitting device and a wireless power receiving device. The wireless power transmitting device may be a wireless charging mat or other device with a charging surface. The wireless power receiving device may be a portable electronic device receiving transmitted wireless power signals from the wireless power transmitting device while resting on the charging surface. During digital ping operations, low-power wireless power signals may be transmitted from the wireless power transmitting device. Information gathered during the digital ping such as wireless power transmission efficiency information, coupling coefficient information, Q-factor information, and coil inductance information may be used in determining whether a foreign object is present. Control circuitry in the transmitting device can cause the receiving device to present an alert for a user indicating that wireless power transfer operations are commencing in response to determining that no foreign object is present.

The parking space fire early warning and controlling system can timely acquire relevant information at the initial stage of fire occurrence, takes active measures to carry out fire extinguishing operation through the fire control device, and simultaneously informs a fire department and a main monitoring platform to quickly find out foreign aid so as to avoid further expansion of the fire; measures can be taken at the first time, and personal and property losses caused by untimely discovery are avoided.

title_en: Monitoring system for monitoring foreign matter between metro platform screen door and train door
abstract_en: A monitoring system and device for monitoring a foreign matter between a metro platform screen door and a train door. The system comprises a power supply module (10), an MCU controller (20) connected to the power supply module (10), an image collection apparatus (30) connected to the MCU controller (20), a sensor (40), an alarm apparatus (50), a storage module (60), a signal transmission module (70), a background server (80), and a receiving terminal (90) connected to the MCU controller (20) by means of the background server (80). The image collection apparatus (30) comprises a camera (31), a light compensation module (32), a positioning module (33), and an image processing module (34); the image collection apparatus (30) is provided on two sides of the platform screen door, and the light compensation module (32) is provided on one side of the platform screen door close to the train door. The sensor (40) comprises a pressure sensitive module (41) and a signal processing module (42), and the pressure sensitive module (41) is provided on the periphery of the light compensation module (32) in a surrounding mode and is used for transmitting obtained pressure information to the MCU controller (20) after the pressure information is processed by the signal processing module (42). The invention carries out 24-hour uninterrupted intelligent monitoring and early warning management on the high-voltage line region through the front-end monitoring device, and realizes the conversion from ' people ' defense ' to ' technical defense ' of the high-voltage line through the intelligent analysis and accurate judgment of the background server.

title_en: Apparatus for judging earthquake-proof integrity for switch gear
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining earthquake resistance integrity for an incoming and distributing board, including: an arc sensor installed inside an enclosure of the incoming and distributing board, and configured to detect arc generation; a temperature sensor installed inside the enclosure, and configured to measure a temperature; a slope sensor installed inside the enclosure, and configured to measure a slope; a sensor elevator installed inside the enclosure, on which the arc sensor and the temperature sensor are installed, and configured to elevate the arc sensor and the temperature sensor to vary a sensing area; an integrity determination unit for determining the integrity of the incoming and distributing board according to whether detection results of the arc sensor, the temperature sensor, and the slope sensor satisfy integrity determination conditions; a communication unit for communicating with an external device; and a control unit for performing a control to provide a determination result obtained by the integrity determination unit to a predetermined terminal or system through the communication unit. According to the present invention, distortion, structural deformation, internal abnormal temperature determination, and an internal arc generation state are always diagnosed in the incoming and distributing board and internal devices, and a warning signal is transmitted to a nearby worker through a terminal such as a smartphone when an abnormal condition occurs, so that a failure of the incoming and distributing board is prevented so as to reduce maintenance and repair, and constant temperature measurement and deterioration state inspection are possible while removing a blind range of the sensors according to various components of the incoming and distributing board to detect the occurrence of the abnormal condition.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster warning system using text-to-speech conversion. The disaster warning system of the present invention is the disaster warning system which notifies disaster information by sending a text message from a disaster management center to a user terminal. The system includes: a disaster information receiving unit for receiving disaster information by text message from the disaster management center; a user language analysis unit for analyzing the language used by the user in the user terminal from which disaster information is received; a text-to-speech conversion unit for converting the text of the disaster information received in the user terminal into a speech including the language analyzed by the user terminal; and a disaster information transmission unit for transmitting the disaster information voice converted by the text-to-speech conversion unit to the outside. The system is configured to notify the disaster information with a voice signal including a user language using the user terminal.

The utility model provides a pair of audible and visual alarm induction system for vigilance does benefit to and provides the warning at the sight blind area, and the sentry of being convenient for is timely makes corresponding processing.

title_en: Fire control unit in intelligence building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire fighting device in an intelligent building, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a manual button is movably arranged at the bottom end of the right side surface of the outer shell, an air inlet is arranged above the manual button, and a baffle is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the front surface of the outer shell; set up the upper cover and be glossy spherical curved surface, install miniature air pump and carry out the dust removal of regularly blowing to inductive probe, can avoid the dust to adhere to and pile up on inductive probe, make fire alarm device's response more sensitive, the early warning reaction is faster, strive for the quality time for relief and emergency rescue, set up three connecting rods of group and inductive probe simultaneously, reciprocating motion about connecting rod itself can make a round trip automatically, inductive probe can rotate around the connecting rod, very big promotion fire alarm device's response interval, inductive probe's field of vision blind area has been reduced, thereby reach the effect that utilizes fire alarm device still less to cover bigger monitoring range.
