title_en: Emergency vehicle access notification device and method for the deaf
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 긴급차량 알림 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology for a notification device for notifying an approaching emergency vehicle for a hearing-impaired person or a driver who has not heard an external sound. The notification device includes: an emergency vehicle notification signal generating unit which generates a signal to know the type of emergency vehicle; a transmission unit which transmits a signal from the emergency vehicle to a general vehicle; a reception unit which receives a signal of the emergency vehicle from the general vehicle; an emergency vehicle signal analysis unit which analyzes the received signal of the emergency vehicle; and a display unit which visually expresses the analyzed signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인 또는 외부의 소리를 듣지 못한 운전자를 위하여 접근해오는 긴급차량을 알려주는 알림 장치에 관한 기술로서, 긴급차량의 종류를 알 수 있는 신호를 발생하는 긴급차량 알림신호발생부, 긴급차량에서 일반차량으로 신호를 송신하는 송신부, 일반차량에서 긴급차량의 신호를 받는 수신부, 수신한 긴급차량의 신호를 분석하는 긴급차량 신호분석부, 분석한 신호를 시각적으로 표현해주는 디스플레이부를 포함한다.

title_en: Zebra crossing system and wearable equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a zebra crossing system and wearable equipment, zebra crossing system includes: a zebra crossing body; the camera module is used for shooting to obtain the vehicle information of the intersection where the zebra crossing body is located, the delay condition of the green light and the walking condition of pedestrians on the zebra crossing body; the control pile is used for delaying the green light under the operation of the disabled; the warning information module is used for sending warning information under the condition that a person falls down on the zebra crossing body; blind bricks arranged on two sides of the zebra crossing body; and the radio frequency identification tags are arranged on the blind bricks, and each blind brick is provided with one radio frequency identification tag.

title_en: Intelligent gas leakage monitoring device based on optical fiber sensing technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gas leakage intelligent monitoring device based on optical fiber sensing technique. The device consists of five parts, namely an optical fiber sensor module, a signal conditioning module, a main control module, an audible and visual alarm module and a human-computer interaction display module. The device can detect the gas concentration in the kitchen in time when a household user uses gas, the gas concentration in the kitchen is displayed in real time through the human-computer interaction display module, and acousto-optic alarm reminding for the dangerous condition that the gas concentration in the kitchen and the gas leakage concentration exceed the standard is provided for the user in real time through the acousto-optic alarm module. When a user uses gas, the sound-light alarm module gives an alarm to remind, meanwhile, the man-machine interaction display module displays the gas concentration and gives a dangerous condition prompt, and the user can turn off the sound-light alarm prompt through the man-machine interaction display module when receiving the alarm prompt. The device adopts an alarm mode combining sound and light, and can be suitable for deaf-mute families. Therefore, the risk of using fuel gas by the user is greatly reduced, and the personal and property safety of the user is also greatly guaranteed.

title_en: Pattern recognition method based on point data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pattern recognition method based on point data, which comprises the following steps: periodically acquiring detection data of the laser radar, and performing pulse conversion processing on the detection data of the laser radar to obtain a pulse feature matrix; performing feature decomposition on the pulse feature matrix, performing dynamic visualization processing on the obtained feature value, and extracting a dynamic change value; judging whether the extracted dynamic change values have biological characteristic values, if so, continuing to judge the dynamic change values after eliminating the biological characteristic values until all the dynamic change values have no biological characteristic values, and giving an alarm; if not, alarming is carried out. The scheme can accurately distinguish whether the scanned foreign object is a target object or not, such as falling rocks, debris flows, landslide, slumps and the like, and solves the problem that whether the foreign object is a living organism or a target object can not be distinguished when the radar detection is used conventionally, so that false alarm is caused.

title_en: Stand-Alone Type Fire Alarm Having Light Part
abstract_en: Disclosed is a single alarm type fire alarm. The single alarm type fire alarm according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a main body part attached to a ceiling or a side wall of a room, and having a gas detection sensor, a control unit, and a power supply unit mounted therein; a lighting unit mounted on a lower surface of the main body part and emitting the light downward or sideways according to a control signal from the control unit; an alarm unit mounted inside or on one side of the main body part and outputting an audible signal according to a control signal of the control unit; and the control unit mounted inside the main body part and determining whether a fire has occurred based on data detected by the gas detection sensor, and then controlling operations of the lighting unit and the alarm unit. According to the present invention, the single alarm type fire alarm including a lighting unit has effects of: preventing casualties that may occur by difficulties in securing visibility for evacuation in the event of a fire; enabling a user to secure visibility for evacuation in the event of a fire; and performing visual alarm for a hearing-impaired person.

title_en: Fire alarm apparatus having transparent stick
abstract_en: A fire alarm having a transparent stick according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a body part detachably attached to a bracket installed on a ceiling; a fire detection part formed on one side of the body part to detect fire; a lighting part outputting predetermined light through a transparent stick having a predetermined length, which is detachably attached to the outside of the body part; a sound part formed on one side of the body part to output a preset sound; and a control part for outputting the predetermined light and sound when the fire is detected and providing a fire alarm. The hearing-impaired or general public can easily check the fire alarm.

title_en: A system for emergency safety warning and risk mitigation
abstract_en: Various embodiments relate to a system for activities of daily living (“ADL”) and instrumental activities of daily living (“IADL”) monitoring through electric current profile sensing, the system including an electric current profile sensing module configured to sense electricity usage and capture a current profile of a plurality of devices in a home using a plurality of current clamps, a device usage detection module configured to match the current profile for each of the plurality of devices to a referenced profile for each of the plurality of devices to determine a detected usage for each of the plurality of devices and an ADL and IADL module configured to translate the detected usage for each of the plurality of devices into ADLs and IADLs; wherein the ADL and IADL detection module determines whether a detected usage is a hazardous situation based on ADLs and IADLs.

title_en: Tramcar level crossing safety detection device and method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tramcar level crossing safety detection device and method based on image recognition, wherein the device comprises sound-light alarm equipment, an image acquisition and processing device and a barrier gate system; the barrier gate system rises and falls the barrier rod according to the analysis result of the image acquisition and processing device, and sends out an alarm prompt through the sound-light alarm device, so that vehicles and pedestrians passing through the level crossing can pass through safely. The invention can send out warning information before the tramcar reaches the level crossing by adding the image acquisition and processing device and combining the improvement of the barrier gate mechanism, thereby preventing the tramcar from invading into the crossing protection area and simultaneously accurately identifying the foreign matters which are still positioned in the crossing protection area, and then controlling the rising and falling of the road bar according to the result, ensuring the driving safety when the tramcar passes through the crossing protection area, and greatly improving the safety when the tramcar passes through the crossing protection area.

title_en: Multilingual safety management broadcasting device

abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전관리 방송장치에 관한 것으로서, 특히 마이크를 이용한 유선 또는 무전기 및 휴대폰을 이용한 무선에 의해 선택적으로 안전관리장치의 방송을 제어하고, 비상상황시 선택된 다국어로 안내방송을 출력함으로써, 보다 효율적인 현장관리를 구현하는 다국어 안전관리 방송장치에 관한 것이다.  이를 위해 본 발명은 외부의 무전기와 무선신호를 송·수신할 수 있도록 RF모듈이 구비된 알에프 보드(RF Board)와; 제어동작을 수행할 수 있도록 음성IC와, 오디오 콘트롤러와, 내·외부스피커 앰프와, 제어동작을 수행하는 CPU와, 이동통신모듈과, 음성신호를 외부로 출력하는 내·외부스피커가 구비된 메인 보드와; 경광등을 작동시키며 비상상황을 경보하는 비상버튼을 포함하여 구성되어, 스피커로 통해 안전관리 방송을 출력하고 경광등을 작동시키는 안전관리 방송장치에 있어서, 안전관리 방송장치에 구비된 비상버튼이 작동되는 경우 국가별 선택스위치에 의해 선택제어된 특정한 국가에 대한 국가별 안내방송을 순차적으로 내부스피커 및 외부스피커와 지정된 무전기로 출력하고, 지정된 휴대폰으로 긴급 안전문자를 발송하며, 무전기 또는 마이크 또는 휴대폰 중 어느 하나 이상에서 전달되는 음성신호에 의해 내부스피커 및 외부스피커와 지정된 무전기로 실시간 안전방송을 출력하되, 상기 안전관리방송장치에는 외부의 무전기를 안전관리 방송장치와 통신 가능한 상태로 등록하기 위한 주파수복사버튼이 구비되며, 외부의 무전기를 안전관리 방송장치(100)에 인접한 상태에서 송신을 하고, 안전관리 방송장치의 주파수복사버튼(108)을 작동하면, 상기 RF모듈이 주파수 스캔을 하여 무전기의 송신주파수를 검색하고, 그 주파수를 분석하여 안전관리 방송장치에 지정된 무전기로 저장하는 것을 특징으로 하는 다국어 안전관리 방송장치를 제안한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 유선 또는 무선에 의해 안전관리장치의 방송을 제어함에 있어서, 현재 발생된 비상상황에 따라 유선 또는 무선에 의해 효율적인 안전방송을 실현할 수 있고, 공사장이나 다중 이용 시설 등에 모여있는 다양한 국적의 사람들에게 모국어로 현재 상황을 인지할 수 있도록 방송함으로써, 안전사고의 피해를 최소화 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Forward and Rear Safety Apparatus For Vehicle
abstract_en: Provided is a safety device for forward and backward collision warning for a vehicle. The safety device for forward and backward collision warning for a vehicle is a safety device mounted on a vehicle where a front wheel and a rear wheel are disposed respectively at the front side and the rear side, which comprises: an obstacle detection unit mounted on the front side or the rear side of the vehicle to detect an obstacle which comes closer or goes farther within a predetermined distance and transmit the detected data to a control unit; an image output unit mounted on one side of the vehicle to output the data received from the control unit as an image signal to a driver; a sound output unit mounted on one side of the vehicle to output the data received from the control unit as a sound signal to a driver; and a control unit for calculating a distance from the obstacle in real time, based on the data received from the obstacle detection unit, estimating chance of collision with the obstacle, based on the calculated data, and transmitting a warning signal to the image output unit and the sound output unit when the chance of collision exceeds a predetermined reference value. title_en: Emergency channel monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an emergency channel monitoring method and device, wherein the monitoring method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of monitoring images including an emergency channel within a first time period; judging whether the emergency channel in the monitoring image is occupied or not; judging whether the proportion of the monitoring image occupied by the emergency channel exceeds a first threshold value or not; if yes, alarming. In the method for monitoring the emergency channel provided by the embodiment, the monitoring of the emergency channel can be realized only by adopting the camera, a data basis is provided for judging whether the emergency channel is occupied, other sensors and detection devices are not required to be relied on, and the monitoring cost of the emergency channel can be effectively reduced. In addition, whether the alarm condition is met or not is judged according to the occupied monitoring image proportion of the emergency channel in the first time period, false alarm caused by temporary stop of foreign matters or approach of the emergency channel can be avoided, the probability of false alarm can be effectively reduced, and the accuracy of alarm is guaranteed.

title_en: Method and device for obtaining forest fire monitoring blind area based on stationary meteorological satellite
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for obtaining a forest fire monitoring blind area by a stationary meteorological satellite, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining DEM data, observation point longitude and latitude, stationary meteorological satellite orbit height and stationary meteorological satellite orbit longitude and latitude of an observation area; calculating a slope limit minimum angle theta according to DEM data and the orbit height of the stationary meteorological satellite to obtain a slope limit range [ theta, 90 DEG ]; calculating the distance between the static meteorological satellite and the observation point and the distance between the observation point and the equator according to the longitude and latitude of the observation point and the longitude and latitude of the orbit of the static meteorological satellite to obtain a slope direction limiting initial angle beta and obtain a slope direction limiting range [ beta, beta +180 degrees ]; and if the slope angle of the observation pixel is within the slope limiting range, and the elevation value of the observation pixel is greater than 0, judging that the observation pixel is a forest fire monitoring blind area of the observation area. title_en: Sound and light alarm system and method for dead zone of rotary machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of excavators, in particular to a sound-light alarm system for a dead zone of a rotary machine, which comprises a controller, wherein the output end of the controller is electrically connected with a detection radar in a bidirectional way through a lead; according to the invention, the detection radar is arranged on the tail end of the machine right behind the cab, the detection radar is utilized to scan and monitor people or objects in the mechanical rotation range in real time, if people or objects in the mechanical rotation range are scanned by the detection radar and generate electric signals, the electric signals are converted into acousto-optic signals through the controller after the detection radar generates signals, and the acousto-optic alarm in the cab is controlled to give out an alarm, so that the alarm is given to mechanical operators, the drivers can know whether people or objects exist in the mechanical blind area in time, the casualties and injuries of the machines to the people in the blind area are avoided, the safety of the nearby people can be ensured to the maximum extent during the operation of the machines, and the potential safety hazards are avoided.

title_en: Safety coefficient data model construction method and early warning device based on AI (Artificial Intelligence)
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI-based early warning device for monitoring the safety state of a building, which comprises: the device comprises a data acquisition unit, an alarm unit and an AI processing platform; the data acquisition unit is used for detecting shaking data, three-dimensional deformation data, noise data and foreign matter invasion data of the building; the data acquisition unit is connected with the AI processing platform and transmits the acquired data to the AI processing platform; the AI processing platform compares and analyzes data with a preset safety factor based on a safety factor data model, performs early warning and fault warning on the unnatural regular shaking, displacement and abnormal sound of the building, provides event warning and severity evaluation for three-dimensional deformation and foreign object intrusion, and simultaneously evaluates the safety state of the building. The AI-based early warning device provided by the invention can monitor the safety state of a building in real time based on the safety coefficient data model, realize disaster prevention and early warning, and further reduce the hazard of accidents.

title_en: Method and system for generating and guiding indoor evacuation route for blind people
title_ko: 시각장애인을 위한 실내 대피 경로를 생성하고 안내하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for generating and guiding an indoor evacuation route for a visually impaired person. The method includes: a step of receiving a disaster alert signal indicating the occurrence of a disaster in an indoor space; a step of collecting current location data on the current location of a user terminal from the user terminal; a step of acquiring indoor map data indicating the indoor space where the user terminal is located and data on a facility for a visually impaired person related to the indoor space based on the current location data on the user terminal; a step of generating an evacuation route for the visually impaired person based on the current location data, the indoor map data, and the visually impaired person-related facility data; and a step of transmitting the evacuation route for the visually impaired person to the user terminal. With the present invention, visually impaired persons can quickly and safely escape to a shelter in the event of a disaster in the indoor space.

title_en: Power grid foreign matter detection method and device based on satellite image deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid foreign matter detection method and device based on satellite image deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite images of a power transmission corridor and/or a transformer substation and peripheral areas thereof; marking foreign matters in the satellite image to generate a marked sample set; dividing the marked samples in the marked sample set to generate a training set and a test set; inputting the training set into a machine learning training model for training; and inputting the satellite image to be detected into the trained training model, and sending early warning information if a foreign body is detected. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an acquisition module, a marking module, a dividing module, a training module and an early warning module. The method and the system can find the potential risk of the foreign matters possibly existing in the power grid in time, improve the efficiency of power grid operation and maintenance personnel, perform defense and treatment on corresponding disasters in time, and reduce economic loss caused by untimely hidden trouble investigation.

abstract_ko: 본 발명은 1인 여성 안전 지킴 도어 스토퍼에 관한 것으로서 적외선 센서에 의하여 아두이노 적외선 거리측정센서로 적외선을 방출하는 부분과 보낸 적외선이 다시 돌아올  그 빛을 감지하는 특성을 이용해 물체를 감지할 수 있게 하고, 비콘에 의하여 스마트 기기를 자동으로 인식하여 필요한 데이터를 전송할 수 있는 무선장치로써 일정시간 이상 물체가 감지될 경우 스마트 기기에 알림이 울릴 수 있게 하고, 도어 스토퍼 에 의하여 사용자가 불특정한 사람이라고 판별하면 아두이노 회로를 통해 자동적으로 온오프할 수 있게 함으로써 불특정한 사람이 CCTV 사각지대를 이용하여 침입하는  문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 불특정한 사람이 CCTV 사각지대를 이용하여 침입하는  문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, CCTV에 있어서 아두이노 적외선 거리측정센서로 적외선을 방출하는 부분과 보낸 적외선이 다시 돌아올  그 빛을 감지하는 특성을 이용해 물체를 감지할 수 있게 작은 모듈로 구성한 적외선 센서, 스마트 기기를 자동으로 인식하여 필요한 데이터를 전송할 수 있는 무선장치로써 일정시간 이상 물체가 감지될 경우 스마트 기기에 알림이 울릴 수 있게 작은 칩 형태로 구성한 비콘, 비콘으로 수신자가 경보음을 울리라고 데이터를 전송할 경우에 지체 없이 경보음이 울릴 수 있게 원형으로 구성한 경보기, 비콘에게 수신자가 경보음을 울리라고 데이터를 전송할 경우에 LED 표시등이 점멸될 수 있게 전구로 구성한 LED 표시 등, 사용자가 불특정한 사람이라고 판별하면 아두이노 회로를 통해 자동적으로 온오프할 수 있게 문을 고정하고 열 수 있는 단단한 막대로 구성한 도어 스토퍼 으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 적외선 센서에 의하여 아두이노 적외선 거리측정센서로 적외선을 방출하는 부분과 보낸 적외선이 다시 돌아올  그 빛을 감지하는 특성을 이용해 물체를 감지할 수 있게 하고, 비콘에 의하여 스마트 기기를 자동으로 인식하여 필요한 데이터를 전송할 수 있는 무선장치로써 일정시간 이상 물체가 감지될 경우 스마트 기기에 알림이 울릴 수 있게 하고, 도어 스토퍼 에 의하여 사용자가 불특정한 사람이라고 판별하면 아두이노 회로를 통해 자동적으로 온오프할 수 있게 함으로써 불특정한 사람이 CCTV 사각지대를 이용하여 침입하는  문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 불특정한 사람이 CCTV 사각지대를 이용하여 침입하는  문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Building monitoring system, building monitoring method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of building monitoring, and particularly discloses a building monitoring system, a building monitoring method, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the building monitoring method provided by the embodiment of the invention judges whether foreign matters exist outside a building by analyzing camera video data, and intercepts the camera video data when the foreign matters exist, so as to generate foreign matter video data; analyzing the foreign body video data, judging whether the outer wall falls off or not, and generating an interception alarm signal and sending the interception alarm signal to an interception alarm subsystem when the outer wall falls off is determined; and generating interception position data according to the shooting position data and sending the interception position data to an interception warning subsystem. Can carry out the omnidirectional control to the building outside, when the foreign matter appears in the building outside, carry out the analysis to the foreign matter, judge whether the outer wall drops to when the outer wall drops appearing, generate interception alarm signal and interception position data, make the interception report an emergency and ask for help or increased vigilance the subsystem can accurate interception and report an emergency and ask for help or increased vigilance, avoid causing casualties and loss of property.

This emergent broadcasting system of digital communication network fire control gathers/surveys the fire control hidden danger that takes place through the fire control monitoring unit, and managers accessible fire control linkage alarm unit sends alarm signal and pronunciation broadcast information simultaneously to this reduces the fire control hidden danger, so has the advantage that the system is perfect, practical value is high.

title_en: Monitoring device and method for preventing external damage of power transmission line
abstract_en: An external damage prevention monitoring device and method for a power transmission line belong to the technical field of power transmission line protection. The intelligent monitoring system comprises a power supply unit, a control unit, a multifunctional communication module, a video image acquisition unit, a linkage alarm unit and a monitoring center, wherein the power supply unit is respectively connected with the control unit, the multifunctional communication module, the video image acquisition unit and the linkage alarm unit, the control unit is input and respectively connected with the linkage alarm unit and the video image acquisition unit, the output is connected with the monitoring center through the multifunctional communication module, image data and alarm data are transmitted to the monitoring center through the multifunctional communication module, and site information acquired by the monitoring center is issued to the control unit. According to the method, a weather picture background library is established, the current image is extracted and compared with weather pictures in the background library, the updating time of the background image and a foreign matter invasion judgment standard V are established based on weather, and foreign matter invasion recognition is carried out; real-time and remote monitoring of the transmission line and high-speed transmission and feedback of information can be realized.

abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a service decision device and method based on environmental elements, wherein the service decision device includes: the terminal support subsystem is configured to perform data interaction with the server-side equipment, acquire environment monitoring information, send the analyzed environment monitoring information to the server-side equipment, enable the server-side equipment to determine influence factors of a strategy pool corresponding to a service scene, corresponding to the environment monitoring information, and determine service decision information according to the environment monitoring information and the influence factors; and receiving service decision information fed back by the server side equipment. Through the embodiment of the disclosure, the pertinence and the reliability of the meteorological service of remote areas are improved, the method is widely applied to the work of guaranteeing local major activities by meteorological service organizations in various areas, the problem of blind areas of meteorological observation data of areas without meteorological observation stations is solved, and powerful support is provided for natural disaster early warning decision.

title_en: Device for assisting deaf-mute to distinguish indoor sound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for assisting deaf-mutes in distinguishing indoor sound, which comprises a movable vehicle body, and a main controller, a power supply device, an obstacle avoidance device, a monitoring device, an image acquisition device and an alarm device which are arranged on the vehicle body, wherein the obstacle avoidance device, the monitoring device, the image acquisition device and the alarm device are electrically connected with the main controller. The device for assisting the deaf-mute to distinguish the indoor sound can position and track the sound source, collect and send the image information of the sound source, and the deaf-mute can comprehensively analyze the travelling route of the trolley and the image of the sound source to determine the position and reason of the sound, thereby realizing the auxiliary function of distinguishing the indoor sound for the deaf-mute. In addition, the invention can detect the infrared signal of the human body, when the deaf-mute is alone at home, if the deaf-mute is detected, the invention can send out the sound and light alarm to warn the invasion of strangers.

title_en: Communication Connector Equipment For Connecting Indoor Communication Cables
abstract_en: The present invention relates to communication connector equipment for connecting indoor communication cables, which comprises: a table (10); a connection mechanism (30); a communication device case (70); a fire detection sensor (80); a warning speaker (90) which outputs a warning sound to the surroundings when receiving a fire detection signal from the fire detection sensor (80); an oxygen measuring sensor (100) which outputs an oxygen warning signal when oxygen concentration is measured to be a reference value or less; a temperature measuring sensor (110) which outputs a temperature warning signal when the temperature inside the communication device case (70) is measured and the temperature is measured to be a reference value or greater; a humidity measuring sensor (120) which outputs a humidity warning signal when the humidity inside the communication device case (70) is measured and the humidity is measured to be a reference value or greater; a transmitter (130) which wirelessly transmits the oxygen warning signal from the oxygen measuring sensor (100), the temperature warning signal from the temperature measuring sensor (110), or the humidity warning signal from the humidity measuring sensor (120); a plurality of guiders (20); a door (50); and a foreign material removal mechanism (60). title_en: Universal configuration, control and monitoring of disparate devices via an SaaS interface and mobile application

The local system contains a microprocessor, communications components and related software all of which enable communications with the server and external components coupled with the local system. The local system software and server software combine with the mobile application and website interface to enable a user to monitor, configure, and control external devices coupled with the local system and the local system itself via the server. The system replaces multiple disparate control devices with a single, configurable device and system. The system integrates multiple disparate devices and systems from multiple manufacturers. The system provides emergency alerts based on examination of information from external devices provided to the local system and the server.

title_en: Responding to Emergency-Alert Audio Tone by Abandoning Dynamic Content Modification

An example method includes detecting presence of an emergency-alert audio tone in a media stream accessible to a media client, and responsively causing the media client to abandon a dynamic content modification, such as to forgo a planned dynamic content modification or to discontinue an in-progress dynamic content modification. This method could occur while the media client is processing a given media stream for presentation, and the method could include detecting presence of the emergency-alert audio tone in the given media stream or alternatively in another media stream accessible to the media client. And in the latter case, the method could further involve causing the media client to switch from processing the given media stream for presentation to instead processing the other media stream for presentation, which could facilitate presenting of an associated emergency alert.

title_en: Security access
abstract_en:
This invention consists of 2 main parts: 
     1. a smoke detector or fire/smoke alarm detection unit which includes a wireless transmitter. The wireless transmitter communicates with an electronic locking mechanism which is incorporated into each security bar assembly unit found at all the doors and windows in a building. The locking mechanism includes a receiver and actuator incorporated into the bar assembly unit. The wireless transmitter communicates with the receiver. The security bar assembly also includes spring hinges as well as a battery back up and low battery warning system featuring both a flashing light (for the hearing impaired) and a buzzer (for the visually impaired. There is also a manual release button. In the event that the smoke detection unit is activated, the wireless transmitter sends a signal to the receiver which in turn activates the electronic lock to the open position. Since smoke detectors and fire/smoke alarm detection units are interconnected, all the bars throughout the building would be activated regardless of where the fire originates thus allowing multiple exiting options for the occupants and multiple ingress options for emergency responders. The spring hinges then cause the bars to swing to the open position. The integrated battery provides power to activate the locking mechanism in case of loss of ac power. The low battery warning system provides a flashing light (for the hearing impaired) as well as a buzzer (for the visually impaired) to indicate that the battery needs replacing. The manual release button provides a means of egress in the event that both ac and battery power are non existent. 
     2. The electronic lock system also includes an actuator which allows for wireless communication via the internet using a mobile phone or computer app which would be installed on the devices of local emergency responders. 
     Each security bar assembly would be programmed with its own unique access code. This code would be provided to and filed with the local emergency dispatch center. The app would consist of a numeric key pad that when the user punches the correct code sends a signal to the actuator in the security bar assembly activating it into the open position. In the event of a 911 call, dispatch would provide the emergency responders with the access code and they would in turn use their mobile device to remotely activate the security bar assembly to the open position. The system would also include an integrated Knox type lock to provide a manual access option for emergency response personnel in the event of an electrical power outage and the battery has run dry or in the event of a more widespread loss of power.

title_en: Underground personnel state sensing system based on head posture monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a head posture monitoring-based underground personnel state sensing system which is used for monitoring the fatigue state of workers in a working site such as a coal mine underground in real time. The system mainly comprises an inertia measurement unit, a data processing unit, an acousto-optic early warning unit, a wireless communication unit and the like; the system acquires inertial data related to the head posture through an inertial measurement unit arranged on the safety helmet, processes the data through a data processing unit to obtain the fatigue state of personnel, and performs early warning when the conditions are met. Because the working sites such as underground coal mines and the like must be worn with safety helmets, the invention can realize the blind-corner-free comprehensive sensing detection of personnel states; the invention has the characteristics and advantages of easy implementation, good safety, accuracy, reliability and the like, and can be widely applied to the field of safety production monitoring in the industries of mines, capital construction, traffic and the like.

title_en: Space Sterilization Machine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a space sterilization device which is attached to a wall surface of a building, is configured to detect whether a person exists in a space, and is configured to generate, when it is determined that there is a person, a warning sound to evacuate people in the space or to automatically carry out disinfection when it is determined that there is no persons. The space sterilization device comprises: a nozzle unit which sprays a sterilization solution; an operation unit which includes a UV unit that emits UV rays and is attached to one side of a wall surface of a building; a pump unit connected to the operation unit and configured to transmit the sterilization solution to the nozzle unit; a control unit which controls the operation unit and the pump unit; and a filter unit configured to filter out foreign substances between the nozzle unit and the pump unit. The pump unit includes: a storage tank in which the sterilization solution is stored; a pump configured to transmit the sterilization solution from the storage tank to the nozzle unit; and a compressor which transmits high-pressure air into the pump so that the sterilization solution is sprayed in the form of mist from the nozzle unit. In this case, the control unit includes: a detection sensor provided in the operation unit and configured to detect the presence of a person in the space; and a pressure sensor which detects leakage of a pipe connected from the pump unit to the nozzle unit. In addition, the present invention further comprises an alarm unit which generates a warning sound when the presence of a person in the space is detected by the detection sensor, and the alarm unit is provided on one side of the operation unit.

title_en: Bedside voice communication medical multimedia integrated machine terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bedside pronunciation communication medical treatment multimedia integrated machine terminal, including placing case, heat dissipation fan, slide rail, mainboard and hot plate, the equidistant universal wheel that is provided with in bottom surface edge of placing the case, and the laminating of the top surface intermediate position of placing the case is provided with the control box, it is provided with the battery to place to connect on the bottom of case on the jade, and places one side surface of case and run through and be provided with the bearing board. This bedside pronunciation communication medical treatment multimedia all-in-one terminal, can type oneself main treatment doctor's contact means through the display screen reserve, can clear away it through the memory disc simultaneously, when needs contact main treatment doctor, through voice module's setting, the patient can directly carry out pronunciation and call, need not dial through the button, and the operation is simple, it is intelligent, use especially to in the old person, accessible loudspeaker direct broadcast simultaneously or carry out the switch-on of ear broadcast through picking up the telephone, simultaneously through the warning light.
assignees: YIXUEZHOU MEDICAL CARE SERVICE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent voice prompt device for barrier-free toilet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent voice prompt device for an accessible toilet, which solves the problems that the existing voice prompt device has no functions of voice interaction, acousto-optic prompt, voice trigger alarm and the like and is insufficient in operation portability; the relay module is connected with a plurality of acousto-optic prompt lamps, the acousto-optic prompt lamps are positioned outside the circuit box, and the sensor module and the emergency alarm device are electrically connected to the outside of the circuit box; the program control module is used for receiving signals provided by the sensor module and the voice communication module and controlling the emergency alarm device and the acousto-optic prompting lamp to work, and the voice communication module is used for receiving voice and analyzing the received voice.
assignees: HANGZHOU HAZHOU SCIENCE AND TECH CO

title_en: Safe deposit box intelligence alarm system based on STC89C52
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent alarm system of a safety box based on STC89C 52. The system comprises an ultrasonic ranging and buzzer alarm module, an alarm system, a voice module and a display module, wherein the ultrasonic ranging and buzzer alarm module is used for detecting a real-time distance and giving an alarm, the alarm system takes an HC-SR04 ultrasonic module as a core and is used for detecting the distance between a safety box and a nearby object, the voice module takes WT588D as a core and can give out voice to prompt a supervisor to make an emergency response, an STC89C52 chip is taken as a core to form a main controller, and the display module is additionally arranged and can display the distance between a foreign object and the safety box. The system can prompt safety information in three-section type including a display screen, voice and a buzzer. The system meets the requirements of an anti-theft system, has the characteristics of convenience in operation and accurate measurement, and is simple in design and convenient to use.

title_en: Fire engineering management sign
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting warning boards, and discloses a fire-fighting engineering management indication board, which comprises a base, a pillar, a fixed frame and a rotating device, wherein the pillar is fixedly arranged on the base; the rotating device is arranged at the top of the base, and the base is connected to the support column through the rotating device; the fixed frame comprises a left frame and a right frame. According to the utility model, the fire-fighting indication board is rotated by arranging the rotating device, the prohibition signs on the indication board can be noticed by people around more quickly by rotating, the existence of blind areas is avoided, and thus the warning effect is improved.

title_en: Complex road blind area intelligent monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring device for a complex road blind area, which comprises: the road traffic monitoring system comprises a main control station, branch monitoring devices and an LED screen, wherein the branch monitoring devices are used for collecting traffic information of monitoring point positions, the main control station analyzes and processes the traffic information and then transmits the traffic information to the LED screen and an urban traffic management platform, the LED screen can display dot matrix images of road and vehicle positions, the main control station comprises a main control module, a main power supply module, a 4G module, a WIFI module, a 485 interface circuit and a LAN interface module, the branch monitoring devices are provided with a plurality of groups, each group of branch monitoring devices is respectively connected with the main control station through cables and comprises a branch power supply conversion module, a camera module, an acousto-optic alarm module, a voice module, a correlation detection module and a radar detection module; the invention has the function of the Internet of things, can automatically detect in all weather, actively display road vehicle information and send out an alarm, and has good market application value.
assignees: HAIZHOU SCENE SCIENCE AND TECH GROUP LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Intersection collision AI early warning system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI early warning system for intersection collision and a control method thereof. The system adopts a radar and video integrated machine (a radar and camera integrated device) and an active alarm device. The time and the running speed of a vehicle arriving at the intersection on a main road and the time and the running speed of a non-motor vehicle and a pedestrian arriving at the intersection on a branch road are obtained by adopting the radar and vision all-in-one machine, different reminding and alarming modes in 6 are adopted according to the states of the vehicle and the pedestrian, the motor vehicle, the non-motor vehicle and the pedestrian are actively reminded through the LED high-definition variable information screen, the voice alarm device and the flashing light, the targeted reminding and alarming are achieved, and the concentration degree and the pre-judgment force of traffic participants when the traffic participants pass through the intersection are improved. The method can effectively detect the states of the vehicles, the non-motor vehicles and the pedestrians in the blind areas of the intersections, ensure the safety of the passing vehicles, the non-motor vehicles and the pedestrians, and reduce the occurrence of accidents.
assignees: NANJING YOUDRIVING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: System and method for geo-targeted automated emergency alerting through analog radio broadcast
abstract_en: A system and method for automatic broadcasting alert messages is disclosed. The disclosed system and method are based on interworking devices operatively coupled with analog radio transmitters; and an emergency alerting engine configured to receive data packets comprising audio data associated with the alert messages, and a target geographical area data associated with a target geographical area; and identify at least one of the analog radio transmitters having a broadcasting coverage area that corresponds to the target geographical area. The emergency alerting engine translates the audio data into audio alert messages; and transmit audio alert messages to at least one of the interworking devices associated with the identified analog radio transmitter. The interworking device converts the audio alert messages to analog audio alert messages signals; and transmit the converted analog audio alert messages signals to the identified analog radio transmitter to broadcast the converted analog audio alert messages to devices.

title_en: Intelligent photovoltaic power generation system capable of positioning and fault identification
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, and discloses an intelligent photovoltaic power generation system capable of positioning and identifying faults, which comprises a photovoltaic power generation board, wherein the lower end of the photovoltaic power generation board is connected with a fault alarm box, a partition board is fixedly arranged in the fault alarm box and is divided into a working cavity and a power supply cavity through the partition board, the upper cavity wall of the working cavity is fixedly provided with a positioner, the lower cavity wall of the working cavity is connected with a fault detection mechanism, a single chip microcomputer and a wireless signal emission mechanism, and the lower end of the fault alarm box is fixedly connected with an audible and visual alarm. The photovoltaic power generation panel fault locating device can quickly and accurately locate a photovoltaic power generation panel with a fault, can ensure that fault and position information can be sent out in time through the redundancy design of a power supply, and can automatically clear foreign matters on the surface of the photovoltaic power generation panel.
assignees: HUA HYDROGEN ENERGY POWER TECH JIANGSU LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Disaster relief hub box system
abstract_en: A disaster relief hub box system includes a hub box, instructions, and damage assessment materials. The hub box may comprise a door that is hingedly coupled to the hub box. To open the door, a user may use a key or coin to turn a lock. Once the door is opened, clipboards with instructions, a radio, and the damage assessment form may be provided to community members to organize the community and address any emergency situation. The hub box may be opened by any individual without the need of a key, allowing it to be accessible to anyone day or night. To deter vandalism and notify community members of a possible emergency, an alarm may be positioned inside the hub box and activated when the door is opened.

title_en: Systems and methods for information gathering, managing and disseminating for assessments and notifications in law enforcement and other environments
abstract_en: An information exchange system is configured to improve an operation of a computing device to enable a public safety agency to exchange information with a citizen on a mobile communication exchange device in a language understood by the citizen. The system includes a storage media configured to implement a database of information. The information of the database includes mobile device information, citizen information and event information. The computing device is configured to enable mobile device communication including text message communication between the citizen and the public safety agency, conduct an exchange between the citizen and the public safety agency, including text message exchanges, and enable, both of the system user of the public safety agency and the citizen to translate a message of the exchange from one language to another prior to transmission or receipt when the system user and the citizen do not regularly communicate in a common language.

title_en: Intelligent cap capable of giving safety early warning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent cap capable of giving a safety early warning, which comprises a cap body, a control unit, a positioning module, a communication module, a visual sensor, an alarm device and a power supply module, wherein the cap body is provided with a control unit; the control unit, the positioning module, the communication module and the power supply module are all arranged in the cap body, the positioning module, the communication module and the power supply module are all connected with the control unit, and the intelligent cap is connected with an external mobile terminal through the communication module; the visual sensor is arranged at the rear side of the cap body, the alarm device is arranged on the outer surface of the cap body, and the visual sensor and the alarm device are both connected with the control unit. This intelligence cap has the function of safety precaution, urgent contact, real-time location, can monitor the user the condition in the blind area behind one's back, and when abnormal conditions, the intelligence cap sends safety precaution signal, reminds the user in time to react.

title_en: Novel fire control smoke exhaust fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel fire-fighting smoke exhaust fan which is connected with an air duct through a cylinder body, wherein a motor fixing cylinder is fixed inside the cylinder body, a plurality of locking bolts penetrate through the outer wall of the motor fixing cylinder, an internal motor is fixed through the locking bolts, and a driving seat is fixed at the front end of the internal motor to fix a plurality of fan blades; the driving seat is of a U-shaped structure, a plurality of outer U-shaped grooves are formed in the inner wall of the driving seat, fireproof materials are arranged in the outer U-shaped grooves, and fire prevention is achieved through the matching of the inner U-shaped grooves and the outer U-shaped grooves; through setting up the fixing base in luring the wind downthehole and being used for realizing sound generating mechanism's fixed, can realize the warning effect after this device starts, moreover, its fixed protection network of tip through outside ventilation pipe realizes the protection, prevents that foreign matter from getting into under the state that the device portion used, influences its normal work.
assignees: TEXAS ASIA TAITAO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Blind-aiding obstacle-avoiding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blind assisting and obstacle avoiding equipment, in particular to blind assisting and obstacle avoiding equipment which comprises a casing and a bottom shell, wherein a main board is fixedly arranged inside the bottom shell, keys are uniformly arranged on the outer surface of the main board, key holes are uniformly formed in the outer surface of the casing, the keys are inserted into the key holes, and an induction module and a hardware processing module are respectively arranged on the outer surface of the main board. According to the utility model, by arranging the mainboard and the keys, utilizing the sensing module, matching with the signal sensor and the hardware processing module, touching the keys by a user, simulating human eyes to convert visual information into touch signals, simulating indoor layout in a protruding mode, converting dangerous distances into auditory sense through the ultrasonic ranging system and the vibration alarm system, enabling the user to more intuitively sense the surrounding world, taking the dangerous distances as sense extension of visually impaired people, assisting the user to sense the specific condition of the external environment, and enabling the user to go out each time more conveniently, safely and comfortably.

title_en: Coal rock instability destruction precursor information identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the information of a coal rock instability destruction precursor, which comprises the following steps: carrying out real-time acoustic emission monitoring on the loaded coal rock mass, and acquiring the spatial coordinates and the seismic time of an acoustic emission event corresponding to the loaded coal rock mass to obtain an acoustic emission event sequence; establishing a single-key group structure of an acoustic emission event sequence; calculating a unit vector of each single key, translating the starting point of each unit vector to the sphere center of the unit sphere, and converting the direction characteristics of each single key into discrete points on the spherical surface of the unit sphere for representation; obtaining the distribution characteristics of discrete points on the spherical surface by adopting a spherical crown surface covering method, and obtaining the fractal dimension of the distribution characteristics in the single bond direction; and acquiring the precursor information of coal rock instability damage by analyzing the change rule of the fractal dimension of the single-bond direction distribution characteristics, and realizing the early warning of coal rock instability damage. The method for judging and identifying the coal rock instability damage precursor information is convenient to solve and reliable in result.
assignees: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Internet of things smoke alarm with camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an Internet of things smoke alarm with a camera, which comprises an alarm body and a monitoring camera arranged below the alarm body, wherein a control module and a smoke sensor are arranged in the alarm body, a control key, a working indicator lamp and a plurality of smoke induction holes are arranged below the alarm body, the smoke induction holes are arranged on two sides of the monitoring camera, the working indicator lamp is arranged on two sides of the control key, and a buzzer is arranged on the side surface of the alarm body. This take thing networking smoke alarm of camera, through central processing unit direct electric connection communication unit, the mobile device of the user of accessible communication unit direct signal connection looks over the state or with seeing through the camera and observe the indoor circumstances, but the external internet of communication unit radio connection carries out the working display simultaneously, is worth promoting.
assignees: GUANGDONG UNIVERSAL INDUSTRY DETECTION SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Well drilling water level measuring instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a drilling water level measuring instrument which comprises a sleeve, wherein a hoisting shaft is movably arranged in the sleeve, supporting shafts are fixedly arranged on the outer wall surfaces of the centers of the front side and the rear side of the sleeve, the front side of the hoisting shaft sequentially penetrates through the sleeve and the supporting shafts and extends to the outer side of the supporting shafts, a shaking assembly is fixedly arranged on the front side of the hoisting shaft, and the front side and the rear side of the hoisting shaft are respectively connected with the supporting shafts and the inner wall of the sleeve through ball bearings. It is rotatory to drive the hoist axle through rotating the crank, it increases the measurement depth to change paired line length, be the on-state when two becket on the bakelite rod contact the surface of water, the paired line gives the singlechip with signal transmission, singlechip control music chip and LED etc. send out the reputation alarm, the water level depth is known to the scale on the sheath of rethread paired line, adopt the paired line, the bakelite rod, four structures of control assembly and hoist axle constitute whole device, moreover, the steam generator is simple in structure, the measurement numerical value is accurate, the installation is light, complete machine weight accessible manual handling operation.
assignees: ZEARALER COAL INDUSTRY LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Dangerous goods alarm
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of alarms, and discloses a dangerous article alarm which comprises an alarm shell, a buzzer, an ultrasonic object distance sensor, a control circuit board and battery components, wherein the buzzer, the ultrasonic object distance sensor and the control circuit board are all fixedly installed on the inner wall of the alarm shell, the buzzer is located right below the ultrasonic object distance sensor, the control circuit board is located on the left side of the ultrasonic object distance sensor, the inner top wall of the alarm shell is fixedly connected with battery installation shells, and the number of the battery components is two and the battery components are installed inside the battery installation shells. According to the utility model, the distance is detected by the ultrasonic object distance sensor, when the distance is smaller than a set value, the control circuit board receives a signal and enables the buzzer to sound for alarming, when the blind person approaches a dangerous object, the alarm is given in time to remind the blind person to go away so as to avoid danger, and a plurality of accidents can be reduced.

title_en: Fire alarm equipment with compare function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting alarm device with a comparison function, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the bottom of the mounting plate is provided with a mounting cover, one side of the bottom of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with an alarm device body, the other side of the top of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a processing module, and one side of the bottom of the mounting cover is fixedly provided with a camera in an inserting manner. This fire alarm equipment with compare function, this practicality is through the mounting panel, the installation cover, the camera, processing module, the alarm equipment body, the through-hole, the cleaning plate, the brush, the apparatus further comprises a rotating shaft, the rack, the fixed plate, electric putter and gear's cooperation is used, make this alarm equipment, the contrast function has been possessed, it is more rigorous to use, simultaneously in the daily use of camera, the external dust of unavoidable can be attached to the outside glass of camera and cover, accessible on-off control electric putter begins work this moment, electric putter's drive end drives the rack and carries out vertical removal.
assignees: BIG DIPPER UNITED ZHEJIANG SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Underground pressure monitoring device and method for petroleum production
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oil exploitation auxiliary system and method, in particular to an underground pressure monitoring device and method for oil exploitation. The technical scheme is as follows: the bottom of the process pipe column is provided with a monitoring early warning device, the upper part of the process pipe column is provided with a signal terminal receiver, the upper end of a system carrier of the monitoring early warning device is connected with the lower end of the blind plug, a pressure limiting carrier, an induction protection block and a sensor are sequentially arranged in an inner cavity of the system carrier, the lower end of the system carrier is provided with a limiting cover plate, the middle part of the induction protection block is provided with an induction contact and a sensing support spring, and the upper end of the induction contact is electrically connected with the sensor. The beneficial effects are that: the pressure signal and the blowout signal of the stratum are converted into electric signals by using the sensor, the stratum change in the well is transmitted to the ground in a wireless electromagnetic wave mode, and due to the fact that the transmission speed of the electromagnetic wave is high, personnel on the ground have time to rapidly start an emergency treatment scheme and rapidly evacuate and avoid risks, and casualties and partial property loss are reduced.

title_en: Intelligent internet-of-things heat-insulation fire-fighting well cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent Internet of things heat-preservation fire-fighting well cover which comprises a well cover and a detector, wherein the well cover comprises a first well cover body and a second well cover body; the detection device is arranged on the well cover; when the well lid is misoperated, the detector generates an alarm signal. This well lid can prevent that personnel or foreign matter from getting into the fire well at will and destroying the facility in fire well and the fire well, can also prevent rain and snow etc. to get into in the well. Thereby protecting and insulating the fire well. The detector is used for detecting whether the well lid is operated by mistake, and if yes, an alarm signal is generated. The alarm signal can be sent to the client or the monitoring terminal in a wireless or wired transmission mode to carry out early warning. Before operation, the well lid is opened after the identity is confirmed by the detector, otherwise, the system gives an alarm to prevent the misoperation of irrelevant personnel, and the well lid is automatically recovered when being covered again. The detector can also automatically inspect.

title_en: Edge server eviction alarm method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of edge servers, in particular to an edge server eviction alarm method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps that a baseboard management controller receives pressure data sent by a pressure sensor, wherein the pressure sensor is arranged on an upper cover of an edge server; judging whether the pressure data exceeds a set pressure threshold value, and if so, marking the pressure data as abnormal data; and monitoring the duration of the abnormal data, and generating alarm information if the duration reaches a set time threshold. The invention can detect whether a foreign object touches the edge server, can protect the edge server deployed in the field, and plays a role in warning people or field animals touching the edge server.
assignees: SUZHOU INSPUR INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system and method for liquid level of molten iron tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring system and method for liquid level of a hot metal ladle, which comprises an industrial personal computer, a Web server, a display screen, an alarm and an access terminal, and also comprises a liquid level identification camera, a liquid level detection radar, an electronic scale, a foreign matter identification module, a liquid level characteristic library and a liquid level comparison module, wherein the detection method comprises the following steps: s1, identifying the hot metal ladle; s2, aligning the molten iron tank and the swinging nozzle; s3, identifying foreign matters; s4, detecting the liquid level of molten iron and weighing the molten iron; s5, monitoring the liquid level of molten iron; the invention relates to the technical field of liquid level monitoring. The system and the method for intelligently monitoring the liquid level of the molten iron tank can perform data information fusion analysis processing on the acquired liquid level polarization image information of the molten iron tank and the liquid level radar data information of the molten iron tank by means of artificial intelligence, realize real-time monitoring on the process of pouring the molten iron tank, can be connected with the existing production statistics and recording system of an iron plant, store the relevant data of the molten iron yield, and facilitate workers to check and analyze the data of the steel plant yield and the like.
assignees: ZHENGFENGZHENG PHOTOELECTRIC SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Building falling object intelligent detection and interception system based on CPU
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building falling body intelligent detection and interception system based on a CPU (central processing unit), which comprises a line sensor array, an interception net, a monitoring camera, an audible and visual alarm, a control system and an intelligent terminal, wherein the line sensor array is connected with the interception net; on sensor array, interception net and surveillance camera head located building window outdoor wall, control system connected sensor array, interception net, surveillance camera head and audible-visual annunciator respectively, through sensor array and surveillance camera head with building fall object or invasion foreign matter information transmission to control system, control system control interception net interception is connected the audible-visual annunciator and is reported to the police, accurately detects the object type on mobile terminal, intelligent terminal carries out building fall object and handles. Accurately realize the tracing of falling source. The intelligent detection system can provide real-time and effective intelligent detection, positioning and interception of falling objects for a high-rise system, guarantee the existence of the falling objects and accurate detection and early warning of the positions, and can effectively prevent thieves from invading and throwing objects from high altitude.

title_en: Railway foreign matter intrusion detection and alarm device based on mesh sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a railway foreign matter invasion detection and alarm device based on a reticular sensor, which comprises a sensor module, a data communication module and a data processing and alarm center which are connected in sequence, wherein the sensor module is arranged at the outer side of a railway, the sensor module comprises an upright post, a reticular structure, a lead, a protection resistor, an address module and a power supply, the reticular structure is supported by the upright post, the lead is distributed along the horizontal direction of the reticular structure, and the lead, the protection resistor and the power supply are connected in sequence to form a loop; the address module is connected in parallel at two ends of the protective resistor, the conducting wire is of a sectional type structure, and two adjacent conducting wire sections are detachably connected through a plug connector; and the data processing and alarming center reads the output level data of each sensor module through the data communication module to realize railway foreign matter intrusion detection and alarming. Compared with the prior art, the invention can accurately monitor the invasion of debris flow, landslide and falling rocks along the railway in real time, and ensure the safe operation of the railway.

title_en: Steel wire rope strand breakage alarm device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel wire rope strand breakage alarm device, which comprises: the steel wire rope breakage detection device comprises an alarm, a cover plate and a buzzing horn, wherein the cover plate is arranged on one side of the alarm, the alarm is used for detecting broken strands of steel wire ropes, the buzzing horn is arranged on one side of the alarm and used for sending out buzzing alarms, and a flash lamp is arranged on the other side of the alarm and used for sending out flashing alarms; the hinge is connected between the cover plate and the alarm, the cover plate is connected with a fixed block, and the fixed block is internally provided with a through groove. This disconnected thigh alarm device of wire rope, at first, open the apron to in overhaul the alarm inside, then, can also avoid the dust foreign matter to block up the horn hole of buzzing loudspeaker through the dust screen when not influencing loudspeaker and sounding, be convenient for prevent dust buzzing loudspeaker, at last, can clean the dust on the flash light when clean cotton rotatory swing, thereby can clear up the dust on the flash light.
assignees: SHENZHEN DEEP DAY SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Fire fighting helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire fighting helmet in the field of fire fighting helmets, which comprises a helmet, wherein a bracket is arranged on the left end wall of the helmet, a hanging rod is arranged at the left end in the helmet, an adjusting rod is arranged at the front end of the hanging rod, a voice receiver is arranged at the front end of the adjusting rod, an alarm is arranged on the upper part of the front end wall of the helmet, a mounting seat is arranged above the alarm, a telescopic rod is arranged at the front end of the mounting seat, and a gas sniffer is arranged at the front end of the telescopic rod; and fire fighters accessible speech receiver communicates with outside commander in real time, need not to communicate through the intercom, and convenient and practical effectively improves its functionality and practicality.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHANGZHENG FIRE FIGHTING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: WEB site instant monitoring device with warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a WEB instant monitoring device with a warning function, which comprises a front plate, a case and side plates, wherein dust-proof nets are arranged on one sides of the front plate, a dehumidifying structure is arranged at the bottom end of one side of the front plate, a wiring board is arranged at the top end of one side of the front plate, a protective structure is arranged on one side of the wiring board, the case is arranged on the outer side of the front plate, a warning mechanism is arranged on one side of the top end of the case, the side plates are arranged on one side of the case, and a single chip microcomputer is arranged in the case. According to the utility model, the baffle is pulled to rotate around the mounting base, so that the first magnet block is moved to the front of the data transmission interface, foreign matters are prevented from entering the data transmission interface, the second magnet block is adsorbed by the first magnet block, the baffle is firmly placed, the shielding and protecting functions of the device are realized, the data transmission interface of the device is isolated and protected, the data transmission interface is prevented from entering the foreign matters to cause poor contact, and the protection performance of the device is improved.

title_en: Intelligent transfer trolley for ward articles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transfer vehicles, and discloses an intelligent transfer vehicle for ward articles, which comprises a transfer vehicle, wherein the top of the transfer vehicle is provided with a universal wheel for driving the transfer vehicle to move, the outer wall surface of the transfer vehicle is provided with a storage chamber for placing articles, the opening of the storage chamber is movably connected with a matched movable door, four corners of the outer wall surface of the storage chamber are respectively provided with a first movable groove, an infrared sensor and an alarm lamp, when medical personnel pushes the transfer vehicle to move in a hospital aisle, when the front half section of the transfer vehicle is pushed to the corners of the aisle, the infrared sensors in the first two movable grooves at the front side of the transfer vehicle can sense whether other personnel approach, when other people approach the transfer vehicle, the alarm lamp can give out alarm sound and twinkle light for warning the approaching personnel and the medical personnel pushing the transfer vehicle, the medical personnel to the propelling movement transfer car (buggy) play intelligent warning in the turning blind area.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUJIANG MEDICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Emergency power supply device for engineering emergency
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency power supply device for engineering emergency, which belongs to the technical field of emergency power supply devices, and particularly relates to an emergency power supply device for engineering emergency, which comprises a box body, wherein a solar cell panel is installed at the top end of the box body, a lithium battery is arranged in the box body, a first output interface, a second output interface, a third output interface, a fourth output interface, a fifth output interface and a sixth output interface are arranged on the lithium battery, and a first input interface, a second input interface and a third input interface are arranged on the lithium battery, so that the emergency power supply device has the beneficial effects that: through setting up the box, set up the lithium cell in the box, accessible solar cell panel charges to it, also can charge to the lithium cell through external power source, can also charge to the lithium cell through the generator, has prolonged the operating time of this device, sets up second output interface, third output interface and first output interface on the lithium cell to set up LED lamp, liquid crystal display and audible-visual alarm, satisfied the demand of speedily carrying out rescue work.
assignees: PEARL HAI BRIGHT CODE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Acousto-optic alarm device for high-voltage distribution room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sound-light alarm device for a high-voltage distribution room, which comprises a detection mechanism, a power supply device, an infrared human body sensor and a dust cover, wherein the detection mechanism comprises a door frame and the power supply device; prompt device constructs, including reputation detection mechanism, set up in the right side of power supply unit bottom, reputation detection mechanism includes controller, audible-visual alarm, speaker and down lamp. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: through power supply unit for install infrared human sensor and acoustic detection mechanism, can supply power to it simultaneously, make infrared human sensor and acoustic detection mechanism can normally function with this, through setting up infrared human sensor, be used for detecting the human body, and transmit the data signal who detects to the controller, control acousto-optic warning and down lamp with this accessible controller, and then can make the down lamp throw light on to the electricity distribution room.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA JINGDA POWER GENERATION LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for notifying danger zone and social distancing
title_ko: 위험지역 및 사회적 거리 알림 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and system for notifying of dangerous zones and social distance. According to the present invention, a transmission/reception device carried by a user transmits a unique ID thereof at regular intervals, receives a unique ID sent from another transmission/reception device, and calculates a distance between the transmission/reception devices by using the strength of signals when the unique ID is received. On the basis of the traditional Lora networking technology, an NB-IOT technology is added, so that an original 'end-cloud' network is changed into a 'cloud-fog-end' intelligent sensing network; through cloud computing of cloud layer with fog computing of fog layer realizes the unified maintenance and the management of system, alleviates the operational pressure of cloud layer reduces data throughput, solves the fortune dimension problem of basic unit's computer lab, network, system, reduces the fortune dimension pressure of basic unit, has increased the interactive ability with the terminal equipment layer of bottom, has reduced the communication blind area, has also alleviateed staff's work burden, has improved monitored control system's real-time efficiency, also very big improvement data monitoring's real-time and rate of accuracy.

The utility model discloses automatic move along way side guide rail and carry out automatic recognition, discernment of shooing to its license plate to the vehicle position of parking violating the regulations, the recognition of shooing is carried out warning, is driven away from vehicle violating the regulations with discernment result accessible robot machine-carried LED screen and voice broadcast.

title_en: Neighborhood emergency help device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency help device for neighborhood, which comprises a plurality of alarm units and a control center; each alarm unit comprises a plurality of help seeking buttons, a plurality of defense area address code modules, an alarm and an electronic door lock; the control center comprises a bus alarm host and an alarm control keyboard; the plurality of alarm units are connected to the bus alarm host through buses. The utility model can effectively alarm in time at the first time even if the help seeker is difficult to move in case of emergency by dispersedly arranging a plurality of help-seeking buttons at different positions; by arranging the electronic door lock, the entrance guard opening can be provided for the rescuers, and the rescuers can be rescued in time; by arranging the defense area address code module, the position of the help seeker can be visually judged, and the help seeker can be helped to carry out rescue at the first time; by arranging the control center, the alarm can be conveniently turned off after nearby neighbors confirm the rescue; through setting up the surveillance center, the condition of suing and labouring is confirmed to the accessible monitor, is favorable to developing supplementary rescue.
