title_en: Embedded blind guiding system platform based on Arduino and Android
abstract_en: The invention relates to an embedded blind guiding system platform based on Arduino and Android, which comprises an Arduino platform 1, wherein the right end of the Arduino platform 1 is connected with an output HIGH level sounding 10, the upper end of the output HIGH level sounding 10 is connected with a buzzer module 6, and the left end of the Arduino platform 1 is connected with an obstacle signal 9; the auxiliary blind guiding box based on the Arduino + Android embedded system platform can realize independent traveling of visually impaired people under the condition of no accompanying person, the data acquisition end comprises an Arduino single chip microcomputer, an HC-06 Bluetooth module, an ultrasonic module, an active buzzer module and the like, and the data processing end adopts app developed by Android. The product has realized concrete functions at present, and the processing end function mainly has a positioning navigation function, a one-key emergency call function, a collision early warning function and the like. The acquisition end uses ultrasonic ranging, image recognition system, provides collision early warning for app through bluetooth module transmission information, and the posture detects, buzzing warning function.

title_en: Self-cleaning dining table residual food rancidity prevention early warning collecting box
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-cleaning dining table residual food anti-rancidity early warning collection box, wherein an audible and visual alarm is fixedly arranged on one side surface of the collection box, an oxygen concentration detection device is fixedly arranged below the audible and visual alarm, and a detection end of the oxygen concentration detection device extends into the collection box. When the device is used, the oxygen is consumed when the remaining food on the dining table is rancid, when the oxygen concentration is reduced to be below 5%, the rancid can be warned, the oxygen concentration detection device sends a signal to the controller, and the controller starts the audible and visual alarm to give an audible and visual alarm after receiving the signal, so that a worker is reminded of needing to process the food in time. After the dining table residual food inside the collecting box is cleaned, the water inside the water tank is pumped out by the accessible starting water pumping mechanism, the water is conveyed to the inside of the sprinkling plate through the first conveying pipe, and finally the water is outwards sprinkled through the through hole at the bottom of the sprinkling plate, so that the inside of the collecting box is cleaned automatically.

title_en: Tunnel risk avoidance early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel danger-avoiding early warning system and a tunnel danger-avoiding early warning method, wherein the system comprises a water level monitoring device, a control center, a tunnel early warning device and an emergency drainage device, wherein the water level monitoring device is used for monitoring tunnel water level data and sending the tunnel water level data to the control center; through setting up tunnel early warning device and urgent drainage device, can effectively drain off water to tunnel ponding to show early warning information, effectively remind the driver to be cautious current or forbid current, the driver can in time learn that traffic signal is current by detour in advance, reduce traffic jam, the driver can not blindly drive the tunnel that gets into ponding after learning traffic signal simultaneously, driving safety has reduced the emergence of traffic accident and has avoided the casualties, goes out for the public and provides the safety guarantee.

title_en: Subway station monitoring system, method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of monitoring, and provides a subway station monitoring system, a method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the system comprises: the first camera is arranged on a sliding door of the platform door and used for acquiring images within a first set range; the second camera is arranged on a fixed door of the platform door and used for collecting images within a second set range; the third camera is arranged on the top box of the platform door and used for collecting images within a third set range; the processing device is used for identifying whether a person crosses an early warning line of the platform according to images acquired by the first camera, the second camera and the third camera in real time; the first infrared sensing device and the first heat sensing device are arranged in the rail and used for detecting whether foreign matters fall into the rail or not; and the processing device is also used for sending alarm information to the administrator terminal when a person crosses an early warning line of the platform or a foreign body falls into a rail. The embodiment of the application can find the emergency situation of the platform in time.

title_en: Multifunctional monitoring equipment for factory building production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control technical field's a multi-functional supervisory equipment is used in factory building production, including watch-dog and switch box, the top of watch-dog one end is provided with the signal transmission box, and the lateral wall fixedly connected with camera of signal transmission box one end is kept away from to the watch-dog, and the watch-dog is close to the top fixedly connected with bee calling organ of camera one end, and bee calling organ's top fixedly connected with warning light, bottom fixedly connected with smoke transducer that the watch-dog is close to camera one end. Carry out smog through smoke transducer and detect in to the factory building, if smoke transducer triggers in, then indicate to have conflagration potential safety hazard in the factory building, start bee calling organ and warning light immediately and carry out the early warning, simultaneously, when smoke transducer does not trigger, the touch switch on the accessible switch box initiatively triggers the potential safety hazard early warning, makes this device carry out video monitoring to the factory building while, can monitor conflagration potential safety hazard, further improves the factor of safety of factory building production.

title_en: Detection device for preventing human body from entering non-passing area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a detection device for preventing human body from entering a non-passing area, which comprises a controller and a plurality of tof distance meters, wherein the tof distance meters are arranged on a door frame of a shield door and face to the direction of a train; the controller is arranged in the upper cover plate of the shielding door or in the side box electric appliance box; the controller is respectively connected with the warning device and the plurality of tof distance measuring instruments; the tof distance measuring instrument is used for detecting a real-time gap between the shielding door and the train; and the controller compares the real-time clearance with a preset reference clearance and controls the warning device to give an alarm when the real-time clearance is smaller than the preset reference clearance. The utility model discloses can detect the foreign matter that gets into the non-current region.

title_en: Electric safety alarm method and system for the blind person and hearing-impaired person
title_ko: 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric safety alarm method and device for the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person which detects risk factors for electrical disasters occurring in electrical facilities, directly alerts the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person, and guides a third party through wired communication in order to quickly remove the risk factors of electrical disasters and inconveniences caused by power outages. The electric safety alarm method for the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person of the present invention comprises: a step of detecting the power of a secondary side of an earth leakage breaker when any one of leakage, short circuit, or overcurrent occurs in the electrical facility; a step of providing an alarm notification directly to the visually impaired person or hearing-impaired person in the event of an abnormality or fire in the electrical facility; and a step of displaying an alarm-phrase or playing an alarm-voice using an application installed on a smartphone of the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person through wireless communication to provide an indirect alarm notification when the alarm notification is directly provided.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기설비에서 발생하는 전기재해 위험요소를 감지하여 시청각장애인에게 직접 경보를 알리고, 전기재해의 위험요소 및 정전으로 인한 불편사항을 신속히 제거하기 위해 제3자에게 유선통신을 통해 안내하는 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법은 전기설비에서 누전, 단락, 과전류 중 어느 하나가 발생시 누전차단기 2차측의 전원을 감지하는 단계와, 상기 전기설비의 이상 발생 또는 화재 발생시 시각장애인 또는 청각장애인에게 직접 경보 알림을 제공하는 단계와, 상기 직접 경보 알림과 동시에 무선통신을 통해 시청각장애인의 스마트폰에 설치된 어플리케이션을 이용하여 경보문구 표시 또는 경보음성이 재생되어 간접 경보 알림을 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Guidance apparatus for visually impaired
abstract_en: Disclosed is a guidance apparatus for a visually impaired person to transmit a location and dangerous situation of a visually impaired person to a smart terminal and a service server. According to the present invention, the guidance apparatus for a visually impaired person comprises: a main body fixed to an upper handle of a cane for a visually impaired person; an operation switch actuating the guidance apparatus; a front detection unit detecting front obstacles; an upper detection unit detecting upper obstacles; a gyro sensor detecting movement of the visually impaired person; a vibration generation unit generating vibration; a warning generation unit outputting a warning sound; and a first control unit detecting the front and upper obstacles through the front and upper detection units according to a selection of the operation switch to generate vibration by operating the vibration generation unit when there are obstacles within a set distance, and outputting an emergency situation signal through the warning generating unit when it is determined through the gyro sensor that the visually impaired person has fallen.

title_en: Deceleration strip capable of judging direction of vehicle coming and road turning blind area early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pavement facilities, in particular to a deceleration strip capable of judging the direction of a vehicle coming and a road turning blind area early warning device. The speed-reducing belt comprises a speed-reducing belt and a warning device linked with the speed-reducing belt, wherein the speed-reducing belt is of a combined structure and comprises a base, a front pedal, a rear pedal and a plurality of pedal linkage assemblies; the rear pedal is lapped above the front pedal; the bottoms of the front pedal and the rear pedal are both supported on the base through spring telescopic rods or hydraulic springs; the pedal linkage assembly comprises a first sliding block, a second sliding block, two vertical sliding blocks, a horizontal sliding block, a first push rod and a second push rod; the first and second sliding blocks are respectively provided with a guide rail which can be pushed by a first and second push rods. And the sliding block, the push rod and the base are respectively provided with a driving gear, a driving rack, an energy storage gear and an energy storage rack. Through the linkage of the sliding block and the push rod, when a vehicle entering the intersection presses the deceleration strip, the warning device is started through the driving gear, and the vehicle is charged through the energy storage gear.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining intelligent warning device with automatic detection alarm, which relates to the technical field of mining warning equipment, in particular to a mining intelligent warning device which can send out sound and light signals, has the function of recording and broadcasting warning prompts in real time, reminds operators by voice that the operators can not enter dangerous operation areas of any type, and can read the information of the mine personnel positioning card through an independent personnel positioning card signal transmitting and receiving device compatible with a mine personnel positioning system, can automatic recording personnel's information violating the regulations, the recording broadcasts personnel's image violating the regulations, and the equipment of information such as accessible display screen display personnel's image, locator card information, electric quantity, operation interface, the primary structure includes four cavities, including cavity one, cavity two, cavity three and cavity four, solves traditional warning and lays the technical problem that the device has the use drawback in coal mine safety production.

title_en: Vehicle blind area early warning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle blind area early warning method, a vehicle blind area early warning system and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle running information of a target vehicle, and determining a vehicle running state of the target vehicle according to the vehicle running information; determining a target detection device for detecting a vehicle blind area of the target vehicle according to the vehicle running state, and acquiring target detection information of the vehicle blind area through the target detection device; generating a blind area early warning instruction according to the target detection information and the vehicle running information, and controlling target early warning equipment of the target vehicle to perform early warning according to the blind area early warning instruction. The method and the device realize accurate monitoring of the obstacles in the vehicle visual field blind spot area under the vehicle running state under the influence of different factors, and timely early warning is carried out aiming at the running states of the obstacles and the vehicle, so that potential traffic accident danger is avoided.

title_en: Car washer place cleanliness monitoring system based on visual analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of car washers, in particular to a car washer field cleanliness monitoring system based on visual analysis, which comprises a control center, a monitoring system and an alarm system, wherein the control center, the monitoring system and the alarm system are interconnected through an intranet; the control center comprises a data analysis system, a storage database, a foreign matter marking system and an alarm feedback system; the monitoring system comprises a sensor and a full-coverage monitoring camera. title_en: Separate fire detection device for the disabled
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a separate alarm type fire detector to which a universal design is applied. The fire detector detects the occurrence of a fire independently without going through a fire receiver and notifies a non-disabled person as well as the visually or hearing impaired of the occurrence of a fire. The separate alarm type fire detector to which a universal design is applied according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a detection body installed and fixed to the ceiling; a detection sensor installed inside the detection body to detect one or two or more of heat, smoke, or gas together and generate a fire signal; a warning sound output unit audibly notifying occurrence of a fire through sound when the fire signal is generated from the detection sensor; and a flashing output unit visually notifying the occurrence of a fire through light when the fire signal is generated from the detection sensor. In addition, the warning sound output unit includes: a first speaker installed on one side of the detection body to output a first sound; and a second speaker installed on the other side of the detection body and installed on a straight line with the first speaker to output a second sound. As the first sound and the second sound are sequentially output, an escape direction for the hearing-impaired person is induced. Therefore, people with disabilities, non-disabled people, and the elderly can easily know the occurrence of a fire and can evacuate quickly.

title_en: Community monitoring video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT (reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer) optical flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community monitoring video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT optical flow, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. A community surveillance video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT optical flow is characterized in that a surveillance camera video flow is obtained in real time, a RAFT optical flow algorithm is used for calculating motion vectors between two continuous frames in a surveillance video in real time, a RANSAC algorithm is used for filtering motion features inconsistent with a main motion direction to optimize the motion vectors and calculate a homography matrix, translational and rotational motion parameters between two frames of the video are calculated based on the homography matrix, then a Gaussian filter is used for denoising, the denoised motion parameters are accumulated and whether a set threshold value is exceeded or not is judged, and if the motion parameters exceed the set threshold value, a disaster early warning event is output; the dependence on manpower can be reduced, the disaster advance early warning of a certain degree is realized, the emergency plan of community property operation management is convenient to generate, and the life and property safety of residents is guaranteed.

title_en: Security related systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods relating to security for buildings and/or facilities and/or individuals. The invention realizes the monitoring, identification and analysis of the characteristics of the track line intrusion event and the event occurrence process, further improves the risk prevention and control capability of the track traffic system, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Rail line foreign matter intrusion monitoring and risk early warning method and system

Under the condition that the risk coefficient reaches a certain emergency degree, the possible flowing condition of the staff in the stadium is predicted by further combining the risk coefficient, the predicted flowing condition is used as reference information for staff evacuation, managers are assisted to find possible staff congestion or staff blind areas, reference is provided for fast and orderly evacuation of the staff, and better safety guarantee is provided for the staff in the stadium.

title_en: Fire safety guidance system for apartment houses
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety guiding device for firefighting of an apartment house comprising: a sensing unit; a controlling unit; a display unit; a visibility securing unit; and an interlocking unit. The sensing unit measures temperatures of a plurality of front doors, each household, stairs from a front door to a household, and an elevator; and transmits a temperature signal. The controlling unit calculates a fire generating area and a fire diffusion expecting area through the temperature signal received from the sensing unit, and determines an evacuation path. The display unit allows an evacuee to confirm the evacuation path depending on a driving signal transmitted from the controlling unit, and is provided in a common area among the household, the stairs, and the elevator. The visibility securing unit secures visibility to allow the evacuee to confirm the evacuation path by discharging foreign substances accumulated in the display unit or smoke generated during fire to a far direction from the display unit. The interlocking unit bypasses firewater to drive the visibility securing unit by hydraulic pressure of the firewater when the firewater is supplied to a sprinkler by outputting a fire alarm. The present invention can reduce time and a cost required to install the safety guiding device for firefighting.

title_en: disaster and safety urgent alarm system for the hearing-impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster and safety urgent alarm system for the hearing-impaired, which allows the hearing-impaired to recognize a current disaster situation in an easy and accurate manner even while asleep indoors at night by installing a smart pillow generating vibrations to a residential area of the hearing-impaired by wired and wireless communication, a plurality of multicolored lamps lit by disaster grade, and a smart display displaying a pictogram that enables instant recognition of various disaster information. The disaster and safety urgent alarm system for the hearing-impaired of the present invention comprises: a smart pillow which is provided in a bedroom of a house in which a hearing-impaired person lives to generate vibrations to notify a disaster alarm when the hearing-impaired person is asleep; a smart lamp which consists of lamps generating a plurality of light sources with different colors to display a currently occurring disaster situation by type or grade for the hearing-impaired person; a smart display which displays the currently occurring disaster situation through a pictogram or a sign language image that can be immediately recognized by the hearing-impaired person; and a house gateway which is installed in the house, in which the hearing-impaired person lives, to parse disaster information received from an external disaster and safety management server through a wired and wireless communication network and transmits disaster information according to a parsed result to the smart display, the smart lamp, and the smart pillow through the wired and wireless communication network.

title_en: Evacuation guidance apparatus for the blind that can be evacuated by self in case of fire and method thereof
title_ko: 피난경로를 제공하기 위한 사용자 단말기 및 그의 피난경로 제공 방법
abstract_en: A user terminal for providing an evacuation route and an evacuation route providing method thereof are provided. A user terminal for providing an evacuation route service to a user in a building including one or more evacuation floors and one or more general floors comprises: a communication unit receiving positioning signals from indoor positioning beacons provided in the building and receiving sub-signals from sub-route guidance beacons installed at each evacuation landmark on each floor of the building; a memory storing an evacuation guidance program that automatically recognizes a fire alarm occurring in the building in a standby mode and provides an evacuation route to a user in an active mode; a processor switching the evacuation guidance program to the active mode if a fire alarm is automatically recognized, measuring the current position of the user in real-time by making communications with the indoor positioning beacons, and providing an evacuation route including at least one between a main evacuation route preset based on the measured current position and sub evacuation routes including whether or not to enter the evacuation landmark received from the sub-route guidance beacons; and a speaker providing a user with the evacuation route in a voice. Evacuation routes can be provided more safely and accurately.

title_en: Real-Time Position Tracking and Alerting
abstract_en: A wearable device is described that is configured to alert a subject prior to encountering an obstacle. The subject may be visually-impaired. The device includes: a mobile transceiver tag adapted to be worn by a subject within a designated area (e.g., a swimming pool); three or more stationary transceiver beacons in spaced apart, fixed positions; a wearable signal output device (e.g., headset); and a processor with software that can calculate the subject's position relative to one or more obstacles (e.g., end of swimming lane) and sends a left, right, or reverse signal to the signal output device.

Pedestrians around the vehicle can be sensed in time and notified to drivers and passengers, and meanwhile, alarming is started to warn the pedestrians; meanwhile, drivers and passengers inform pedestrians of the distance through voice; meanwhile, the camera is connected to monitor the periphery and blind areas of the vehicle, and traffic accident responsibilities can be clearly divided.

title_en: Intelligent inspection well cover device

The monitoring device is provided with a battery, a buzzer, a first ultrasonic water level sensor, a second ultrasonic water level sensor, a water immersion sensor and a main control module. When the underground water level is within the range of the first ultrasonic water level sensor, the first ultrasonic water level sensor triggers monitoring, when the underground water level rises to the first ultrasonic water level sensor monitoring blind area, the second ultrasonic water level sensor triggers monitoring, and when the underground water level continues to rise to the second ultrasonic water level sensor monitoring blind area, the water immersion sensor triggers monitoring. When the water level is monitored to reach or be higher than the early warning water level, the warning lamp emits light, and the buzzer emits warning sound. The utility model discloses a three kinds of sensors can avoid only using an ultrasonic wave level sensor to have the problem of monitoring blind area, and warning light and warning sound enable the maintainer to find the inspection shaft lid device of super early warning water level sooner to and remind the personnel that are close to notice safety.

abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic safety early warning, in particular to an internet-based traffic blind area early warning system, which comprises: collecting a terminal; the acquisition terminal comprises a first transmission unit and an acquisition module; the acquisition module takes acquisition equipment as a carrier and is used for acquiring a moving path of a vehicle; the acquisition module transmits acquired data to the first transmission unit; a data center; the data center comprises a second transmission unit and an early warning module; the second transmission unit is used for receiving the data transmitted by the first transmission unit; the second transmission unit transmits the data of the first transmission unit to the early warning module; the early warning module takes data processing equipment as a carrier; the invention simulates the moving path of the vehicle or the person on the road in advance through the early warning module, thereby judging the cross space condition of the vehicle or the person at the later time, realizing the timely warning through the warning module, avoiding the occurrence of accidents and maintaining the public safety.

title_en: All-in-one fire alarm system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an all-in-one fire alarm system capable of being installed in a facility such as a refrigeration warehouse; sensing occurrence of fire through smoke sensing; improving a fire sensing performance by removing foreign substances such as dust or moisture of the facility. The all-in-one fire alarm system comprises: an enclosure unit; an air supplying line; a fire sensing device; a repeater; a cyclone hopper; an inline filter; and a water trap. The enclosure unit is installed in the refrigeration warehouse and forms an inner space to be opened and closed. The air supplying line supplies air of the refrigeration warehouse in which the enclosure unit is installed to the enclosure unit. The fire sensing device is installed in the enclosure unit, and senses smoke caused by fire in the air supplied through the air supplying line. The repeater receives sensing of the smoke from the fire sensing device and fire occurrence in the refrigeration warehouse to a control center or a manager terminal. The cyclone hopper is installed inside the enclosure unit, and removes dust included in the air while sucking the air to a direction of the enclosure unit through the air supplying line. The inline filter receives the air passing through the cyclone hopper, and removes the dust included in the air once more. The water trap collects moisture generated by condensation from the inside of the enclosure unit and drains the moisture to the outside of the enclosure unit.

title_en: Wearable system for detection of environmental hazards
abstract_en: The disclosed wearable device systems include several features for alerting and guiding persons who are approaching or near to potentially hazardous or high-risk conditions in their nearby environment. Sensor data from wearable devices (also referred to herein as “wearables”) are used to determine the presence of various unsafe environmental conditions and phenomenon, including dangerous terrain or other unusual conditions. The wearable would be used to warn a person, for example via auditory or haptic-based feedback, if the person is about to encounter an unsafe condition. In particular, the proposed systems can be of great benefit to the visually impaired, those persons with physical disabilities, or persons otherwise vulnerable to particular environmental conditions.

abstract_en: In an integrated emergency bell enclosure, camera sets consisting of a high-focal distance camera and a low-focal distance camera are installed to and monitor 90 degrees in all directions on all four sides on top of the enclosure, such that a total of eight emergency bell cameras are installed with a fixed camera function for 360-degree surveillance without blind spots. The integrated emergency bell enclosure consists of a switch hub, a power supply, a broadcasting device, a video storage memory, and an Eve SERVER, wherein the Eve SERVER and a Bob SERVER communicate through an unlicensed frequency wireless communication device, videos from crime prevention surveillance cameras are transmitted to an integrated crime prevention center through the switch hub for real-time monitoring, and videos from emergency bell cameras are stored in the video storage memory. In a wireless integrated enclosure, four wireless cameras with a low focus distance are installed to monitor each 90 degrees in all directions on top of the enclosure, and the Eve SERVER and Bob SERVER communicate through the unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. When an emergency bell button is inserted in a front surface of the integrated wireless enclosure and the emergency bell button is activated, the Eve SERVER connects to a network with the Bob SERVER through an unlicensed frequency wireless private network and then establishes a two-way call with an Alice SERVER inside the integrated crime prevention center. Accordingly, performance is improved for surveillance without blind spots and distortion and effective dissemination of civil defense warnings.

title_en: Apparatus for deriving a dangerous section of a road based on noise generated from the road and method therefor
title_ko: 소리 분석 기반의 위급 상황을 인식하기 위한 장치 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_en: A method for recognizing a dangerous situation of the present invention, which can recognize a dangerous situation even in a non-detected area such as a blind spot of a CCTV to quickly handle the situation, comprises: a step of receiving, by a signal processing unit, an audio signal collected by one or more sensor devices; a step of detecting, by the signal processing unit, an interested audio signal, which is an audio signal having a pre-set interested frequency band, from the received audio signal; a step of analyzing, by a situation recognition unit, the interested audio signal through a trained recognition model to check whether the received audio signal is a rescue request sound signal, which is a sound signal requesting rescue in a dangerous situation; and a step of sending, by a warning unit, a rescue request message requesting rescue to a pre-set contact number when the received audio signal is the rescue request sound signal as a checking result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 위급 상황을 인식하기 위한 방법은 신호처리부가 하나 이상의 센서장치가 수집한 오디오 신호를 수신하는 단계와, 신호처리부가 상기 수신된 오디오 신호로부터 기 설정된 관심 주파수 대역을 가지는 오디오 신호인 관심 오디오 신호를 검출하는 단계와, 상황인식부가 학습된 인식모델을 통해 상기 관심 오디오 신호를 분석하여 상기 수신된 오디오 신호가 위급 상황에서 구조를 요청하는 음성 신호인 구조요청음성신호인지 여부를 확인하는 단계와, 상기 확인 결과, 상기 수신된 오디오 신호가 상기 구조요청음성신호이면, 경보부가 기 설정된 연락처로 구조를 요청하는 구조 요청 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: User device and method for displaying disaster alarm message and server for providing disaster alarm message
title_ko: 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 사용자 단말, 방법 및 재난 경보 메시지를 제공하는 서버
abstract_en: A user terminal for outputting a disaster alarm message comprises: a message receiving unit receiving a disaster alarm message from a disaster alarm message provision server; an extraction unit extracting, from the received disaster alarm message, at least one character included in a zero-padding area; a detection unit detecting, from the extracted at least one character, a recognized character and a keyword located next to the recognized character; a reconstruction unit determining specific display information corresponding to the keyword among predetermined display information, based on the recognized character, and performing reconstruction so that the determined specific display information is to be included in the disaster alarm message; and an output unit outputting the reconstructed disaster alarm message. Therefore, the user terminal enables vulnerable groups such as foreigners and illiterate people who are not familiar with the character of a corresponding country to recognize the text of a disaster text message.
abstract_ko: 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 사용자 단말은 재난 경보 메시지 제공 서버로부터 재난 경보 메시지를 수신하는 메시지 수신부, 상기 수신한 재난 경보 메시지로부터 제로 패딩 영역에 포함된 적어도 하나 이상의 문자를 추출하는 추출부, 상기 추출된 적어도 하나 이상의 문자로부터 인식 문자 및 상기 인식 문자의 다음에 위치한 키워드를 검출하는 검출부, 상기 인식 문자에 기초하여 기지정된 표출 정보 중 상기 키워드에 대응하는 특정 표출 정보를 결정하고, 상기 결정된 특정 표출 정보가 상기 재난 경보 메시지에 포함되도록 재구성하는 재구성부 및 상기 재구성된 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 출력부를 포함한다.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting fire alarm flame detection device for a tunnel, which comprises a tunnel fire-fighting cabinet arranged in the tunnel, wherein a semi-arc-shaped strip is arranged at the front side of the top of the tunnel fire-fighting cabinet, and an arc-shaped sleeve block is sleeved on the semi-arc-shaped strip in a sliding manner; through the cooperation of the semi-arc strip that sets up, arc cover piece, triangle piece and flame detection device body, remove the position of arc cover piece on the semi-arc strip, thereby adjustable flame detection device's detection height in the tunnel, very big the condition that flame detection device in having avoided present tunnel is fixed and can't be adjusted, the detection effect of flame detection device has been improved, simultaneously, the piston rod of still accessible electric telescopic handle extends or shortens, the cooperation of rethread spliced pole and flame detection device, the different detection angles of flame detection device body are adjusted according to different tunnels and actual demand, the flexibility is strong, the detection effect of flame detector has been greatly improved.

title_en: Inner wheel difference warning risk avoiding method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inner wheel difference warning risk avoiding method and system, which belong to the field of inner wheel difference blind area risk avoiding, and the method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle starts to turn, starting a projection real-time display area blind area range, and detecting whether an object is positioned in an inner wheel difference blind area or not through an ultrasonic sensor; if yes, starting a primary alarm, and judging whether the object is a heat source entity by utilizing the infrared pyroelectric sensor; if yes, a secondary alarm is started, and whether the heat source entity is located within the dangerous distance limit is judged by the Beidou foundation enhancement system; if yes, starting an automatic emergency braking system of the vehicle-mounted terminal. The invention can display the blind area of the inner wheel difference in real time when the large truck turns right and can carry out multi-element and multi-level warning and danger avoidance aiming at each responsible party of traffic, solves the problem of hidden danger of traffic accident of each relevant party Shi Ce facing traffic and accurately 'perspective' the blind area of the inner wheel difference, and fundamentally solves the problem of hidden danger of traffic accident of the blind area of the inner wheel difference.

title_en: Railway line geological disaster early warning system adopting pressure and buoyancy omnibearing monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway line geological disaster early warning system adopting pressure and buoyancy omnibearing monitoring, which comprises a disaster monitoring module, a disaster occurrence judging module, a signal processing and converting module and a disaster judging module; the disaster monitoring module comprises a flood disaster monitoring device and an omnibearing debris flow disaster monitoring device and is used for monitoring the track water accumulation condition and the invasion of foreign matters; the disaster occurrence judging module is used for judging whether a disaster occurs or not by using a rail disaster warning platform and signal mechanism hardware equipment; the signal processing and converting module is used for modulating, demodulating and analog-to-digital converting analog signals and judging the types and position signals of the sent alarm signals through the signals; the disaster distinguishing module is used for distinguishing the occurrence condition of the disaster and sending out an alarm signal to deal with the two disasters. The invention realizes the early warning of the torrential flood and the debris flow on the road sections with multiple accidents, such as tunnels or tunnel mouths, solves the problems of single monitoring function and limited monitoring direction, and ensures the safe operation of railways in the sections with multiple accidents.

title_en: Heat and humidity detection plant pot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heat and humidity detection plant pot, which is to detect changes in temperature and humidity through a plant pot body, and allows enough sound to be heard indoors through a speaker so as to solve the problem of difficulty in management by beginners and the visually impaired, such that the existing simple preservation function allows subjective observation of soil and plant conditions during cultivation, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired. According to the present invention, the heat and humidity detection plant pot comprises: a pot body which is formed to turn red in the temperature and humidity environment set through LED lights to indicate changes in temperature and humidity detection in the plant pot; a soil temperature and humidity sensor designed to display real-time temperature and humidity values so that soil humidity and temperature can be measured; and a speaker configured to sound a notification at a set time and frequency intervals in a temperature and humidity environment in which the sound is set to be sufficiently audible indoors. Therefore, the present invention displays the detected changes in temperature and humidity by the pot body, and allows enough sound to be audible indoors through the speaker, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired. Therefore, the existing simple preservation function allows subjective observation of soil and plant conditions during cultivation, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired.

title_en: Pipeline regulating valve group
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pipeline regulating valve group, which comprises a regulating valve, wherein sealing rings are fixedly arranged on two sides of the regulating valve through a plurality of screws, one sides of the two sealing rings are respectively provided with a fixed ring, one sides of the plurality of screws are respectively connected with nuts in a threaded manner, the other sides of the plurality of screws are respectively provided with a fixer, and the middle parts of the two sides of the regulating valve are respectively provided with a leakage-proof mechanism: the cooperation of user accessible leak protection ring and go-between has avoided liquid to leak from the junction of governing valve and pipeline, and when transporting petroleum, the temperature in the pipeline can not surpass the combustion value of petroleum, if surpass will cause the disaster, when temperature detection stick detects that the temperature is too high, will transmit the information to the warning light and make it send out the police dispatch newspaper to transmit the information to the governing valve, make it close the valve, further reduction loss.

title_en: Intelligent earthquake early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent earthquake early warning device, which sends early warning to an installation place after receiving earthquake information sent by an earthquake table network or an earthquake early warning center (for an area where the earthquake early warning center is built), and relates to the field of earthquake early warning. The system is characterized by comprising a signal receiving module, a satellite positioning module, a seismic data analysis module, an early warning signal output module, a system setting module and a dual-mode power supply module. The intelligent earthquake early warning device solves the defects that the coverage area of an earthquake early warning system is limited, an early warning blind area exists, terminal equipment can work only after the earthquake early warning information sent by an earthquake early warning center is passively received in the existing earthquake early warning mode through a ready-to-install and ready-to-use installation mode and the capability of independent analysis and operation of the earthquake information, thereby realizing full-coverage non-blind area early warning and being beneficial to popularization and application of earthquake early warning service in all areas.

title_en: Indoor mobile and positioning auxiliary system convenient for visually impaired people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile and positioning auxiliary system convenient for visually impaired people to use indoors, which belongs to the field of mobile and positioning auxiliary, and comprises an indoor positioning module of WIFI, an RSSI indoor ranging module, an AI voice recognition and processing module, a YOLO V4 image recognition module, a deep learning-based obstacle recognition early warning algorithm module and handheld interactive induction equipment, wherein a WIFI-based fingerprint matching algorithm is adopted for the calculation of an initial position, and a user starts the handheld interactive induction equipment according to fingerprint matching, so that mobile and positioning auxiliary service is started; a mapping relation between a coordinate point and a WIFI signal intensity vector is established, so that a fingerprint library is established. The indoor positioning system and the indoor positioning method provide greater help for the mobility inconvenience of visually impaired people by combining a series of technical services from indoor positioning equipment, indoor positioning software to an indoor positioning solution and the like.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning equipment and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses fire disaster early warning equipment and a system thereof, wherein the fire disaster early warning equipment comprises an early warning equipment bottom plate, plug boxes positioned at the left side and the right side of the early warning equipment bottom plate, and an anti-drop assembly fixed in the plug boxes; the front end of the early warning equipment bottom plate is provided with a connecting base, the inside of the connecting base is provided with a waterproof shell, the inside of the waterproof shell is provided with an explosion-proof lampshade, the inside of the plug box is provided with a sensor main body, the output end of the sensor management module is connected with a control module, and the output end of the control module is respectively connected with an emergency response module and a wireless transmission module. This conflagration early warning equipment and system thereof can install the sensor main part fast through plug box to carry out spacingly to the sensor main part through the inside anticreep subassembly of plug box, avoid the sensor main part slippage plug box, at the in-process of sensor main part plug simultaneously, accessible sensor management module manages the sensor main part.

title_en: Water regime early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water condition early warning device which comprises a tubular pile, wherein the upper end of the tubular pile is fixedly connected with a threaded block, the threaded block is connected with a floating plate in a threaded manner, the upper end of the threaded block is provided with a clamping block, a tube seat is arranged on the clamping block, the lower end of the tubular pile is provided with a balancing weight, the tubular pile is provided with a first liquid level meter and a second liquid level meter, the first liquid level meter and the second liquid level meter are arranged on the tubular pile one by one, and the outer sides of the first liquid level meter and the second liquid level meter are respectively provided with a buffer cover. According to the utility model, the balancing weight is arranged at the bottom of the pipe pile, when the device is used, the balancing weight can enable the early warning device to be vertical to water through gravity, the possibility of rollover of the early warning device when encountering rapid flow is reduced, and the device is provided with the buffer cover outside the liquid level meter, so that foreign matters can be blocked, meanwhile, the water flow can be buffered, the impact force when the liquid level meter is contacted with water is reduced, and the possibility of measuring misalignment of the liquid level meter is reduced.

title_en: "wearable device for collecting physiological health data"
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are disclosed for collecting vital physiological health data from a user, using a wearable device, such as a watch. The data can comprise heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, blood pressure, and fall detection, amongst other. The collected data can be translated to information presented to the user on a local device, such as a smart phone, and/or provided to a remote device or service and integrated into an electronic medical record, be used by the user's clinicians, and can help detect alert situations of the user. Such a wearable device may also be used to detect user activity, and/or fall detection, and provide emergency alerts to medical and emergency personnel.
assignees: N SQUARED TECH LLC;N SQUARED TECH INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED

title_en: Substation live equipment overhauls regional safety device
abstract_en: A safety protection device for an overhaul area of a transformer substation live equipment comprises four supporting structures distributed in a quadrilateral manner and isolation belts arranged between two adjacent supporting structures; an audible and visual alarm is arranged at the top of the supporting structure; the upper part of the supporting structure and the lower part of the audible and visual alarm are provided with detection radars, and the detection radars on each supporting structure face to a middle area surrounded by the four supporting structures along the horizontal direction, so that the detection radars form a radar detection area which is horizontally unfolded at the top of the supporting structure; this radar detection area keeps 2 meters apart from electrified equipment of transformer substation, when the staff examine the maintenance activity, touches the safe distance of 2 meters distance, and audible and visual alarm at accessible bearing structure top sends the warning to the staff, reminds the staff to need keep 2 meters safe distances apart from electrified equipment to play safety protection's effect.

title_en: Intelligent voice response system and method for weather disaster early warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent voice response system and method for weather disaster early warning information, which relate to the technical field of the release of the weather disaster early warning information and currently propose the following scheme, wherein the intelligent voice response system comprises an intelligent voice response Web front end for early warning information and is used for being responsible for the interactive operation of users; the intelligent voice call Web back end of the early warning information is used for being responsible for audience user management, call result inquiry, call policy configuration and early warning information message generation and pushing; the intelligent voice call terminal is used for carrying out audio generation and multi-line Cheng Yuyin outbound according to the pre-alarm text content. Before the occurrence of disastrous weather, intelligent voice response of early warning information is carried out for government decision-making layers, emergency contacts of related departments and emergency responsibilities of enterprises, the problems that the traditional early warning information mobile phone short message has low accessibility for audience users, lacks interaction, is unknown in conveying effect, has poor effectiveness of manual telephone call and the like are solved, and the intelligent voice response method is beneficial to supporting the related departments to timely develop disaster defense.

title_en: Leak detection device for air suction pipe of compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leak detection device for an air suction pipe of a compressor, and relates to the technical field of vehicle air conditioners. Including fixed body, fixed body inside cavity just is provided with the moving structure, and moving structure is including inserting the moving pipe of locating fixed body both ends, and the outside one end of moving pipe is provided with the jam structure, and fixed body outside is provided with detection structure, and detection structure is including the slip lantern ring of cover locating the fixed body outside, and slip lantern ring one side is fixed with the handle, and opposite one side is fixed with the connecting block. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the detection structure, the detection ring is sleeved outside the air suction pipe to be detected during detection and is used for moving detection along the air suction pipe, so that the whole air suction pipe can be detected to leak, when the air flow sensor detects leakage air, the warning lamp blinks and the voice broadcasting device generates larger sound, so that the air leakage position is convenient to determine, the problem of leak detection blind areas is not easy to exist, and the usability of the device is better improved.

title_en: fire alarm apparatus for hearing impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm device. The fire alarm device according to the present invention comprises: an accommodation case accommodating a circuit board; a detachable case coupled with the accommodation case; a fixing case having one side formed to be detachable from the detachable case and other side formed to be fixable to a predetermined surface; a fire detection unit installed in the accommodation case and detecting a fire; a fire alarm output unit installed in the accommodation case and outputting an alarm signal through an LED module; and a control unit installed in the accommodation case and controlling operations of the fire detection unit and the fire alarm output unit. The control unit controls the output of the fire alarm output unit according to the fire detection by the fire detection unit. Accordingly, unexpected accidents caused by the fire to the hearing impaired can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 경보 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 청각장애인용 화재 경보 장치는 회로기판을 수용하는 수용케이스; 상기 수용케이스와 결합되는 탈부착케이스; 일면이 상기 탈부착케이스와 탈부착되고, 타면이 소정 면에 고정 가능하도록 형성되는 고정케이스; 상기 수용케이스 내에 설치되고, 화재를 감지하는 화재감지부; 상기 수용케이스 내에 설치되며, LED모듈을 통해 경보신호를 출력하는 화재경보출력부; 및 상기 수용케이스 내에 설치되고, 상기 화재감지부 및 상기 화재경보출력부의 동작을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 상기 화재감지부가 화재를 감지하는 것에 따라 상기 화재경보출력부의 출력을 제어하는 것에 기술적 특징이 있다.

title_en: Wearable intelligent blind-assisting sports shoulder strap and blind-assisting interaction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a wearable intelligent blind-assisting sports shoulder strap and a blind-assisting interaction method thereof, comprising the following steps: the system comprises an information acquisition module, a processor module, a voice feedback module and a vibration warning module. The information acquisition module sends acquired data information to the processor module for processing, the processor module sends processed information to the vibration warning module and the voice feedback module respectively, the voice feedback module converts the received information into audio frequency and transmits the audio frequency to the human ear in real time, and the vibration warning module carries out emergency reminding on visually impaired people through vibration. The intelligent shoulder strap is arranged in the intelligent shoulder strap and is worn on a human body. The invention processes the information by using the RGB-D camera to sense the external environment and by using the deep learning method, and navigates the visually impaired person by means of voice and vibration, thereby helping the visually impaired person to run on the sports ground and improving the sensing capability of the sports ground environment and the self action capability.

This fire control is patrolled and examined and is dealt with integrated robot through being equipped with adjustment mechanism in the robot main part, and adjustment mechanism links to each other with the spray tube, and after patrolling and examining camera and smoke transducer and detecting the condition of a fire, accessible adjustment mechanism drives the spray tube and carries out the multi-angle and adjust for spray tube subtend condition of a fire, and through spraying the fire extinguishing agent to the condition of a fire, thereby restrain the condition of a fire, convenient to use.

The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the system realizes integration of various sensors, has stronger environmental adaptability to community application scenes, has the functions of autonomous navigation, automatic obstacle avoidance, automatic alarm, automatic data uploading, video intelligent analysis and the like, solves the problems of current obstacle shielding and monitoring blind areas to a greater extent, further helps to timely discover special conditions different from industrial scenes, such as public facility damage, violation behaviors and the like in a community, and can replace security personnel in property, not only can avoid the conditions of abnormal personnel coming in and going out and fire disasters and the like in the community neglected by the monitoring blind areas, but also can make up the defect of patrol efficiency caused by the limitation of the working time of personnel, insufficient experience and the like, realizes key monitoring and patrol in the community, and timely processes the safety patrol and environmental maintenance problems in the community.

title_en: Notification device for disaster situation for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a notification device for each disaster situation for the hearing impaired. The notification device includes: a sensor which is mounted on an indoor fire hydrant and transmits a signal; a wearable band which is worn on a wrist of the hearing impaired and receives signals from the sensor to recognize disaster situations. The present invention installs a vibration detection sensor on the indoor fire hydrant, so that when a disaster such as an earthquake occurs, a wearable band worn on the wrist of the hearing impaired can quickly recognize the disaster and evacuate, thereby preventing safety accidents in advance.

abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic fire alarm control system which comprises a driving box, a lifting table and a sliding rail, wherein one end of the lifting table is fixedly connected with a lifting motor, the power output end of the lifting motor is fixedly connected with a transmission assembly, the power output end of the transmission assembly is fixedly connected with a rope reel, one end of the rope reel is fixedly connected with the driving box through a rope, a butt joint inserted link is fixedly connected above the driving box, a driving assembly is fixedly connected inside the driving box, a turntable is rotatably connected below the driving box, a detection assembly is fixedly connected below the turntable, a fire extinguishing bottle is fixedly connected above the driving box, one end of the fire extinguishing bottle is fixedly connected with an electromagnetic valve, one end of the electromagnetic valve is fixedly connected with a rotary joint, and one end of the rotary joint is fixedly connected with a nozzle; through when elevator motor during operation, accessible rope reel rotates and drives the drive case and reciprocate, just can overhaul at ground directly and need not personnel to use the ladder climbing, has improved maintenance efficiency and has reduced unexpected emergence.

abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent equipment for monitoring special operation, which comprises a shell and a monitoring module, wherein the monitoring module is used for monitoring the personnel and the environment of the special operation, the monitoring module is arranged on the shell and comprises an explosion-proof camera, a gas sensor, an image acquisition unit, a gas concentration acquisition unit, a data acquisition module, an intelligent data acquisition unit, a data processing unit, a data display unit and a data storage unit, and the monitoring module is arranged to monitor the personnel and the environment of the operation through the explosion-proof camera and the gas sensor, so that the problems that only the personnel can know the alarm information when the gas alarms, the guardian cannot easily obtain the alarm information, blind rescue is easily caused, video signal shielding in a limited space cannot be transmitted in real time, video monitoring is not in time, no on-site monitoring display picture cannot be found in time, the storage space is small, and frequent export is required are avoided.

title_en: Safety warning indicator for power grid maintenance

abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting electrical control cabinet with a high-temperature early warning function and an early warning system, which comprise an electrical cabinet body and a component mounting rack arranged at the position close to the back inside the electrical cabinet body, wherein two groups of vertical fan assemblies are arranged in front of the electrical cabinet body, a positioning assembly capable of driving the fan assemblies to move relatively or oppositely is arranged below the inner part of the electrical cabinet body, threaded metal rods are arranged on two sides of the electrical cabinet body, and two groups of fan assemblies capable of being aligned to the component mounting rack in the front are arranged in the fire-fighting electrical control cabinet, so that the heat dissipation effect on electronic components is improved; temperature sensor, wireless transmitter and controller have been set up, and temperature sensor accessible controller and wireless transmitter carry out high temperature early warning to master control cabinet, and then the whole regulator cubicle main part outage of master control cabinet control, have set up the screw thread metal pole, and screw thread metal pole temperature is lower, and the air of damp and hot can condense into the water droplet on the screw thread metal pole to down along the screw thread, play the effect of dehumidification.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based supporting structure top deformation monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supporting structure top deformation monitoring and early warning method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of setting a monitoring datum point; burying monitoring identification points at the top of the supporting structure; acquiring the position and the height difference of the monitoring identification point by using an unmanned plane in combination with the datum point; acquiring coordinate information of the monitoring identification points again by taking different datum points as references; judging whether the coordinate recognition error meets the requirement; comparing and calculating to obtain deformation of the monitoring point; judging the safety of the foundation pit according to the standard or the early warning threshold value; the unmanned aerial vehicle starts an early warning signal lamp and notifies the command part; emergency rescue treatment; alarm release; and returning to the take-off position after the deformation monitoring is finished. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for monitoring and early warning of the deformation of the top of the supporting structure, and is combined with an emergency treatment process to realize automation and remote monitoring, so that management personnel are helped to carry out risk assessment emergency command after an emergency situation occurs, the remote emergency rescue and command requirements are met, and the blindness and hysteresis defects of emergency management after the emergency situation occurs are overcome.

title_en: AI intelligent image recognition method based on road disaster early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI intelligent image recognition method based on road disaster early warning, which comprises the following steps: real-time monitoring is carried out on the road through monitoring equipment of the far-end point location, and a road video is obtained; AI analysis is carried out on the road video through the local side centralized equipment, and a road invasion image with foreign matter invasion is output; and displaying the road invasion image invaded by the foreign matters through the upper computer cloud platform, and storing monitoring operation data. The road disaster monitoring and early warning centralized processor transmits the monitoring and processing result of the AI intelligent image recognition algorithm to the upper computer server cloud platform through the 4G/5G network, alarms abnormal conditions in time, intervenes and processes in advance after manual confirmation, avoids the occurrence of driving accidents, and improves the safety of road operation.

title_en: Video identification method suitable for accurate automatic fire extinguishing in tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel fire control, and discloses a video identification method suitable for accurate automatic fire extinguishment in a tunnel, which comprises the following steps: s1: the method comprises the steps of monitoring in real time, starting a fire alarm host, setting the fire alarm host into an automatic state, and acquiring a real-time picture in a tunnel through monitoring and transmitting the picture to a display screen; s2: alarming, namely when a fire disaster occurs in the tunnel, the flame detector detects that the flame can transmit information to the display screen, alarming occurs in the display screen, staff clicks and selects an alarm to be treated in an alarm list in the display screen, and selects options according to actual conditions of the fire disaster site. The invention not only can realize accurate spraying and avoid the occurrence of spraying blind areas, but also can carry out fire extinguishing operation with the shortest reaction time, reduce the damage degree of road tunnel fire to the minimum, and also can ensure the reliability of automatic fire extinguishing, thereby ensuring the reliable and safe operation of the fire extinguishing method.

title_en: Household security equipment based on Internet of things
abstract_en: A family security device based on the Internet of things belongs to the field of security. The utility model aims at giving out corresponding alarms for blind patients and blind patients under different dangerous conditions, and comprises a PCB circuit board and a WeChat electric spraying device, wherein the PCB circuit board comprises a singlechip, a decoder and an amplifier wireless communication module, the wireless communication module is used for receiving signals transmitted by various external sensors, the micro electric spraying device comprises a plurality of storehouses, the storehouses respectively store compressed odorous agents with different odors, and when dangerous conditions occur, the singlechip analyzes the signals transmitted by the wireless communication module and controls the corresponding storehouses to be opened, and the WeChat electric spraying device sprays the compressed odorous agents out of a cavity to quickly gasify and diffuse the compressed odorous agents. According to the utility model, the gas with different smell can be sprayed under different dangerous conditions to remind the blind person of dangerous situations.

title_en: Right-angle induction precaution device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of early warning devices, in particular to a right-angle induction early warning device. The novel intelligent early warning device comprises an early warning device body, wherein a V-shaped groove is formed in one side of the early warning device body, a rear shell is arranged on the other side of the early warning device body, a rear cover is arranged on one side, far away from the early warning device body, of the rear shell, human body movement sensors are arranged on two sides of the early warning device body, an audible-visual alarm is arranged on the early warning device body, and a power supply assembly and a control main board are arranged in the early warning device body. According to the utility model, the early warning device main body is arranged at the right angle, so that the human body movement sensors at the two sides of the early warning device main body sense the two right angle positions, when the two groups of human body movement sensors sense the movement of the human body at the same time, the audible and visual alarm gives out audible and visual alarm, and people or vehicles in the process of traveling in the blind area of the video line are early warned in advance, so that the people or vehicles are not easy to collide, accidents are reduced, personnel are not easy to be injured, potential safety hazards are reduced, and the safety of the personnel is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic lightning protection system with thunderstorm early warning function
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation lightning protection equipment, and discloses a photovoltaic lightning protection system with a thunderstorm early warning function, wherein an installation cavity is arranged in a box body part; the translation component is arranged in the mounting cavity; the first limiting component is arranged on the box body component; the rotating part is arranged on the first limiting part, and the rotating part at the bottom of the rotating part is connected with the translation part; the first driving part is arranged on the box body part and is connected with the translation part; the lifting component is arranged on the rotating component and is fixedly connected with the rotating component; the lightning protection component is arranged on the telescopic end of the lifting component; according to the application, the first driving part is adopted to drive the translation part to move, so that the lifting device is changed into a vertical state from a horizontal state, then the lightning protection part is lifted to a corresponding height through the lifting part, the first driving part is reversed during recovery, the transverse moving part is driven to reset, and then the lifting part is reset, so that the rapid lifting and recovery are realized; through adopting the lightning-arrest part of combination formula, be convenient for equipment and dismantlement, it is more convenient to install.

title_en: Method and system for deliverying outdoor disaster alert signals for deaf
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 실외 재난 알림 신호 전달 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for delivering outdoor disaster notification signals for hearing-impaired people. The method comprises: a step in which a disaster management server obtains surrounding state data of the disaster management server; a step in which the disaster management server determines whether a disaster has occurred in an outdoor space where the disaster management server is located based on the surrounding state data; a step in which the disaster management server generates, when it is determined that a disaster has occurred, a disaster occurrence signal indicating that a disaster has occurred; a step in which the disaster management server outputs the disaster occurrence signal; a step in which a user terminal located around the disaster management server detects the disaster occurrence signal; and a step in which the user terminal outputs, when the disaster occurrence signal is detected, a disaster notification signal to inform a user of the user terminal that a disaster has occurred. Here, the disaster occurrence signal is output as an audio signal, and the disaster notification signal is output as a vibration or text. Accordingly, it is possible to effectively notify hearing-impaired people that a disaster has occurred.
abstract_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 실외 재난알림 신호 전달 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난관리서버에서 재난관리서버의 주변 상태 데이터를 획득하고, 주변 상태 데이터에 기초하여 재난관리서버가 위치하는 실외공간에서 재난이 발생하였는지를 결정하고, 재난이 발생하였다고 결정한 경우 재난이 발생하였음을 나타내는 재난발생신호를 생성하고, 재난발생신호를 출력하고, 재난관리서버 주변에 위치하는 사용자 단말에서 재난발생신호를 감지하고, 재난발생신호를 감지한 경우 사용자 단말의 사용자에게 재난이 발생하였음을 알리는 재난알림신호를 출력하고, 여기에서 재난발생신호는 오디오 신호로 출력되고, 재난알림신호는 진동 또는 문자로 출력됨으로써, 청각장애인에게 재난이 발생하였음을 효과적으로 알릴 수 있다.

title_en: Fire control thing networking wisdom system that can real-time supervision water electricity state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting Internet of things intelligent system capable of monitoring a water-electricity state in real time. This but real-time supervision water electric state's fire control thing networking wisdom system is provided with data acquisition module, wisdom fire control data acquisition module can store the data that wisdom fire control data transmission module carried, wisdom fire control data monitoring module carries out real-time monitoring to water electric state through its various monitoring facilities that include, wisdom fire control data transmission module carries data to wisdom fire control data acquisition module and alarm module, alarm module accessible wisdom fire control data monitoring module is collected various data and is carried out corresponding judgement, if data surpass the warning value, alarm module can send the alarm and send the notice to appointed staff, make each below system can be connected to the same backstage equally, thereby realize interconnection intercommunication.
assignees: ZHENJIANG ERLING ELECTRIC AUTOMATION SYSTEM EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for rapidly matching limited fracture templates based on seismic P-wave characteristic parameters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of earthquake early warning, in particular to a method for rapidly matching a limited fracture template based on an earthquake P wave characteristic parameter, which comprises data collection and pretreatment, optimal vibration prediction model construction, limited fracture template library generation, limited fracture template matching mode and software system inspection, compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the result obtained at the same time after earthquake is about 3 seconds faster than the FinDer algorithm result, and the individual earthquake result is about 5 seconds faster, so that the result is more rapidly approaching to a standard reference value; multiple-report early warning information and a release strategy from inside to outside can be adopted, and the number of times of report is gradually increased along with the increase of the fracture length, so that the blind area range is reduced as much as possible, and the effective early warning time is increased.

title_en: Portable intelligent monitoring robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable intelligent monitoring robot, which relates to the technical field of monitoring robots and comprises a bracket system, wherein the bracket system is rotationally connected with a wheel assembly, the wheel assembly moves integrally, and the wheel assembly can climb when encountering stairs; the support system is provided with a monitoring system, and the monitoring system monitors the multi-angle rotation in the up-and-down lifting process; the bracket system is fixedly provided with a reaction component, and when the reaction component is collided, the reaction component can make a sound and light along with the reaction component; the support system is fixedly connected with the fire alarm system, and when the monitoring system monitors that a fire occurs, signals are transmitted to the fire alarm system, and the fire alarm system continuously knocks to give out an alarm; the invention is provided with the monitoring system, the camera can rotate up and down to monitor at multiple angles, thereby reducing monitoring blind areas and improving the utilization rate of the monitoring system.

title_en: Protection method of guard post for military
abstract_en: A method and a system for protecting a garrison for a military guard post are used to enhance the reliability of garrison protection by recognizing the entry and exit status of security guards working at the military guard post and remotely monitoring the intrusion through a perimeter network. More specifically, the system for protecting a garrison for a military guard post comprises: a guard post (100) which includes a guard shift switch (120) for detecting the shift changes of the security guards stationed at the guard post (100), an emergency switch (130) for alerting unauthorized intrusion of foreigners according to the selection of the security guards stationed at the guard post (100), and a surveillance control device (110) installed to transmit signals detected through the guard shift switch (120) and the emergency switch (130) to a central control server (300) located remotely via a communication network; and a perimeter network (200) which includes intrusion detection sensors (210), each of which has an identification code to detect the unauthorized intrusion of a foreigner through the perimeter network (200) and transmit the detected results to either the central control server (300) or the guard post (100) located in remote place via the communication network, thereby enabling the monitoring of the entry and exit status of security guards doing shift work at the military guard post and remotely monitoring the intrusion through the perimeter network.

title_en: Visual monitoring hidden trouble identification method and device for overhead transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying hidden dangers of visual monitoring of an overhead transmission line, and belongs to the technical field of electric power. The method comprises the steps of firstly detecting hidden danger of a timing snap shot image through a hidden danger identification model, judging as critical alarm when the hidden danger type is a wire foreign matter, judging as general alarm, important alarm or critical alarm according to the movement trend of construction machinery or smoke mountain fire and the position relation of an alarm position and a protection area of an overhead transmission line when the hidden danger type is the construction machinery or smoke mountain fire, carrying out timing intensive snap shot on the important alarm, collecting video streams of the alarm position for the critical alarm, and analyzing the video streams. The invention reduces the workload of operation and maintenance personnel on alarm processing, avoids serious accidents such as tripping or casualties caused by untimely alarm processing, vehicle damage and the like, and can realize effective monitoring on hidden danger development and change processes while saving the electric quantity of equipment.

title_en: Systems And Methods For Emergency Event Capture
abstract_en: An emergency event system may allow for the capture of emergency event data in real time. Users may be able to initiate capture when they believe they are in an emergency event, such as an assault, a robbery, a shooting, an automobile accident, or other threatening situation. In some aspects, when an emergency event is initiated, notifications may be sent out to third parties, such as emergency contact list or emergency response teams. Captured emergency event data may be transmitted and stored in an emergency event database, which may be accessible to third parties and third-party systems, such as for law enforcement. An emergency event capture device may comprise multiple cameras that may concurrently capture media.

title_en: Fire-fighting evacuation safety warning device
