abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire control access control, in particular to a fire control evacuation safety warning device, which comprises an outer shell, a fire control evacuation safety warning device and a fire control evacuation safety warning device, wherein the outer shell is configured into a shell which can be fixed on a wall and is provided with two cavities; the fire alarm comprises a rotary drum and a lamp, wherein at least two hollowed-out alarm marks are arranged on the surface of the rotary drum and used for 'passing' and 'forbidden passing', the lamp is configured to be luminous equipment, when the lamp emits light, light can project corresponding indication through the alarm marks to guide evacuation personnel to advance or not, the external fire alarm system is connected with the external fire alarm system through a control module, when a fire disaster occurs on site, the external fire alarm system obtains the accurate site position and transmits the position to the control module, the control module controls a driving motor to rotate through fire disaster information, so that an intersection close to the fire disaster site is set to be forbidden to pass, escape efficiency is improved, and the situation that trapped personnel enter the fire disaster site to cause danger under the condition of blindness is avoided.

title_en: Intercom for security patrol
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of interphones, and discloses a security patrol interphone, which comprises a security patrol interphone body, an alarm mechanism and an interphone mechanism, wherein the alarm mechanism is positioned at the top end of the security patrol interphone body, the interphone mechanism is positioned at the front end of the security patrol interphone body, and the alarm mechanism comprises a microcomputer, a rain-proof sheet, an illuminating lamp, a lamp switch, a buzzer and a switch button. This security patrol is with intercom, alarm mechanism has been installed, be used for the user to throw light on under the dark surrounds and carry out the scintillation alarm through the light, the lamp switch is used for controlling the switch of light, press the lamp switch, the light is bright always for the illumination uses, press two lamp switches, the light scintillation, buzzer is convenient for carry out the alarm warning and uses, under being in the highlight environment, accessible buzzer warns, the other people of being convenient for can be direct quick discernment current user's position, the security patrol of being convenient for uses.
assignees: HUAQIAO XIAMEN PROPERTY MAN CO LTD

title_en: Antitheft monitoring device with smoke alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-theft monitoring device with a smoke alarm, which comprises a fixing mechanism, a main body mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, wherein the main body mechanism is arranged on one side of the fixing mechanism, and the monitoring mechanism is arranged in the main body mechanism. This fixed establishment can make monitoring devices stabilize the multipoint mode installation, reduce the possibility that drops, can carry out outside protection to monitoring devices through main part mechanism, can effectively avoid outside physical touching, thereby guarantee the stability of detection, can make this monitoring devices in use effectively dustproof simultaneously, can strengthen the warning suggestion to the abnormal conditions, the rethread monitoring devices can detect discernment to smog in the carriage, and carry out the warning and remind, adopt light to assist simultaneously, strengthen the warning effect, still can be used for this monitoring devices and discern detection environment, can avoid this monitoring devices to receive the foreign object to shelter from and seal the separation, thereby influence monitoring devices to smog detection's condition.

title_en: Safety type multi-source audible and visual alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe multi-source audible and visual alarm which comprises an alarm main body, a buffer component and an anti-collision component, wherein a long rod is arranged at the bottom end of the alarm main body, a round hole is formed in the alarm main body, the buffer component comprises a T-shaped rod penetrating through the round hole, a spring arranged on the T-shaped rod and a mounting plate arranged on the right side of the T-shaped rod, and the anti-collision component comprises a transparent cover sleeved on the left side of the alarm main body and a metal net rack arranged on the outer side of the transparent cover. According to the utility model, the transparent cover of the anti-collision assembly can well protect the alarm, so that foreign objects are prevented from damaging devices, the metal net rack has a certain blocking effect, the anti-collision and anti-explosion effect can be improved, and meanwhile, the spring of the buffering assembly has a certain elasticity, so that the alarm main body can move on the T-shaped rod through the spring, the buffering effect can be achieved, the anti-collision and anti-explosion effect is improved, and the anti-collision and anti-explosion alarm is convenient to use.
assignees: RIZHAO KERUIJIA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Warmhouse booth fire monitoring system based on independently remove robot platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a greenhouse fire monitoring method based on an autonomous mobile platform. The training and improvement of yolo5s is carried out by utilizing the thought of edge calculation, then the design is light-weighted, and the training and improvement is transplanted to an industrial personal computer, so that the robot has the capabilities of autonomous navigation and fire disaster identification, unmanned patrol of the greenhouse and autonomous data processing are realized, and the system has an alarm function. Finally, a man-machine interaction QT interface is designed at the PC end, so that the functions of forcedly controlling the robot, displaying fire images, maps, sensor data and the like in real time are realized. The application solves the problems of complex arrangement, high cost and monitoring blind areas of fire detection in the greenhouse, has unique flexibility, can increase functions required by fire extinguishment, irrigation and the like on a platform in the later stage, and realizes diversified purposes.

title_en: Public safety early warning method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of big data analysis, and discloses a public safety early warning method and a public safety early warning system based on big data analysis, wherein a thermal imaging module in an acquisition unit acquires thermal imaging image data of a public place and sends the thermal imaging image data to an analysis unit, the analysis unit calculates duty ratio data information ZB according to the received data, and a judgment unit receives the duty ratio data information ZB calculated by the analysis unit and compares the duty ratio data information with a dangerous threshold W and then sends a dangerous instruction to a processing unit; according to the application, the data information ZB, the sound information data SY and the people number information data RS are used for calculation, the people number information data RS can reflect the people number information in the public place in a future period of time to play a role in prediction, and the sound information data SY can reflect the order degree of the site, so that the calculated early warning value J can predict the situation in the public place to play a role in early warning, and can accommodate accessible people to the greatest extent.
assignees: TIANJIN CHENHANG SAFETY TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Bus blind area pedestrian detection device with risk avoiding function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bus blind area pedestrian detection device with risk avoids function, including power expansion bracket, pedestrian identification module, audible and visual alarm, environment identification module, geographical position identification module, urgent danger prevention module and embedded singlechip, power expansion bracket installs the outer roof of head at the bus, pedestrian identification module, environment identification module and urgent danger prevention module all set up on power expansion bracket, audible and visual alarm and embedded singlechip are all installed on the bus in the ceiling and are located the power expansion bracket under, geographical position identification module installs on embedded singlechip, embedded singlechip respectively with power expansion bracket, pedestrian identification module, audible and visual alarm, environment identification module, geographical position identification module and urgent danger prevention module signal connection. The invention can effectively identify pedestrians in the dead zone of the bus, reminds drivers of paying attention to driving safety through the audible and visual alarm, avoids traffic accidents, and also has a risk avoiding function and an emergency risk avoiding function.

title_en: Active earthquake early warning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses active earthquake early warning equipment, and relates to the field of earthquake early warning. The system comprises a built-in signal receiving module, a satellite positioning module, a data analysis module, an early warning signal output module and a dual-mode power supply module. The active earthquake early warning device integrates the analysis processing of earthquake information, the output of early warning information and the early warning emission, obtains the early warning information after the analysis processing of the information by receiving the earthquake information sent by the earthquake table network and combining with positioning data, and emits the early warning to an installation place, thereby realizing the active earthquake early warning. The active earthquake early warning device solves the defects that the construction difficulty of an earthquake early warning system is high, the cost is high, the coverage area is limited, early warning blind areas exist, early warning terminal equipment can work only by passively receiving early warning information sent by an earthquake early warning center and the like in the existing earthquake early warning mode by a ready-to-install and ready-to-use working mode and analysis processing capability of earthquake information, so that full-coverage earthquake early warning without blind areas can be realized, and popularization and application of earthquake early warning service are facilitated.

title_en: Photoelectric fire detector comprising a plurality of dark chamber
abstract_en: Disclosed is a photoelectric fire detector having a plurality of dark chambers. The photoelectric fire detector according to the present invention comprises: a first dark chamber and a second dark chamber surrounded by a base, a cover, and a plurality of outer walls protruding downward from the edge of the base and divided by an inner partition; a first light-emitting unit and a first light-receiving unit installed inside the first dark chamber; a first light-blocking wall installed between the first light-emitting unit and the first light-receiving unit; a second light-emitting unit and a second light-receiving unit installed inside the second dark chamber; a second light-blocking wall installed between the second light-emitting unit and the second light-receiving unit; and a control unit using the detection signals from the first and second light-receiving units to determine whether a fire has occurred. According to the present invention, since a fire detection signal is transmitted only when smoke is detected in the plurality of dark chambers, false fire warnings due to the inflow of foreign substances or temporary malfunctions can be prevented, thereby greatly increasing the detection accuracy of a fire detector. In addition, waste of firefighting manpower due to false fire warnings can be prevented and the reliability of firefighting facilities can be increased.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 암실을 구비하는 광전식 화재 감지기를 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 광전식 화재 감지기는, 베이스, 커버, 및 베이스의 가장자리에서 하부로 돌출된 다수의 외벽으로 둘러싸이고, 내부 격벽에 의해 서로 분할된 제1 암실과 제2 암실; 제1 암실의 내부에 설치된 제1 발광부와 제1 수광부; 제1 발광부와 제1 수광부의 사이에 설치된 제1 차광벽; 제2 암실의 내부에 설치된 제2 발광부와 제2 수광부; 제2 발광부와 제2 수광부의 사이에 설치된 제2 차광벽; 제1 수광부와 제2 수광부의 감지신호를 이용하여 화재발생 여부를 판단하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 다수의 암실에서 모두 연기가 감지된 경우에만 화재 감지신호를 송출하므로 이물질 유입이나 일시적인 오작동으로 인한 비화재보를 예방할 수 있고, 이를 통해 화재 감지기의 감지 정확도를 크게 높일 수 있다. 또한 비화재보로 인한 소방인력의 낭비를 방지하고 소방시설에 대한 신뢰성을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Glasses for night driving
abstract_en: The utility model provides glasses for night driving, which belong to the technical field of glasses, and comprise two glasses frames, lenses, glasses legs and vibrators, wherein the two glasses frames are fixedly connected side by side, the lenses are fixed in the two glasses frames, the outer sides of the two glasses frames are respectively provided with the glasses legs, the tail ends of the glasses legs are fixedly provided with vibrators for reminding, the tail ends of the glasses legs are connected with wires, the other ends of the wires are connected with earphone reminding mechanisms which can be worn in ears, and the wires and the earphone reminding mechanisms can be fixed on the outer side walls of the glasses legs; the two mirror frames are provided with clamping mechanisms which are pulled outwards to clamp the corrective lenses placed in the mirror frames. Glasses wear in driving the in-process, and the vibrator on the accessible mirror leg and the earphone of extension remind the mechanism to realize the warning effect to the driver, wear timely musical reminding behind the earphone to can last the on-hearing function of reminding.
assignees: HEBEI SUPER VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for monitoring mountain tourist attraction based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster early warning equipment, and provides equipment and a method for monitoring mountain tourist attractions based on radar, wherein the equipment comprises a support column, a spherical shell and related components; the support column is anchored in the slope bedrock and provided with a first blind hole, and a first negative pressure pipe and a negative pressure rod are connected inside the support column; the spherical shell consists of a hemispherical base and a cover body, and a sealing ring is arranged at the joint. The outer side of the base is provided with a limit column which is inserted into the first blind hole and is provided with a through hole and a one-way valve which are connected with the second negative pressure pipe; the equipment is internally provided with a lifting component, radar equipment, a GPS positioning module, a wireless communication module, a power supply and a central controller; the central controller is connected with each module to realize the monitoring function. The invention can monitor the condition of mountain tourist attractions by radar technology, and transmit data by wireless communication, and has higher reliability and stability.
assignees: UNIV LESHAN NORMAL;UNIV YUNNAN FINANCE & ECONOMICS;INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Decision-making assistance system for firefighting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a decision-making assistance system for firefighting (1), comprising: - a server (2) hosting at least one interactive digitized map (3) of a site (4) and a main interface (5) integrating said map (3), - at least one fire alarm (11), - at least one sensor (7), the main interface (5) making it possible to display or not display, on the map (3), relevant information comprising data dependent on the measurements of the sensor (7) and, in the event of a fire, at least one zone in which a fire has been detected. The system is special in that it further comprises a confirmation interface (17), wherein the confirmation interface (17) is accessible in the event of the fire alarm (11) being triggered, the confirmation interface (17) integrates a confirmation means (18) for confirming the alarm, and the means is configured to allow firefighters to access the main interface (5).

title_en: Fire control passageway occupies alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting channel occupation alarm device, which relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment and comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body comprises a base, an adjusting component is arranged in the base, the upper surface of the device main body is movably connected with a connecting component, and one end of the connecting component is fixedly connected with the monitoring component; the adjusting component comprises a rotating rod. According to the utility model, the rotating rod in the adjusting component drives the worm gear to move, so that the connecting component is driven to move up and down, the height of the monitoring component can be adjusted according to actual conditions, when cleaning or maintenance is needed, the monitoring component can be directly lowered through the adjusting component, so that workers cannot climb to a high place to repair, the safety of the workers is ensured, the panoramic camera can prevent the occurrence of monitoring blind spots to a certain extent, the workers can be reminded through the alarm, and meanwhile, the workers can be reminded through the loudspeaker without occupying a fire-fighting channel.
assignees: MOBILITY & MOTIVATION SYSTEMS BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Door-closing-free judging and alarming distribution box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a door-unclosed judging and alarming distribution box, and belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment. The distribution box comprises: the box body is provided with an opening and closing door at one side; the controller is arranged in the box body; the alarm is arranged outside the box body; the mounting base is arranged in the box body; the proximity switch is connected in the mounting base and is used for judging the distance between the opening and closing door and the box body; the proximity switch and the alarm are electrically connected with the controller. The proximity switch judges whether the opening and closing door of the distribution box is closed in place or not, after maintenance, the opening and closing door is prevented from being not fully locked or locked, if the opening and closing door is not locked, the controller controls the alarm to alarm, reminds workers to close in time, prevents foreign matters from entering the distribution box to damage equipment, and prevents the box door from falling.
assignees: SHAANXI HUI QI ELECTRIC TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Alarm check valve that allows self-cleaning of foreign substances
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alarm check valve capable of self-cleaning foreign substances, which comprises: a valve body installed in a fire water line, having a first chamber and a second chamber which are partitioned by a seat ring and through which fire water passes, a plurality of seat holes formed in the seat ring, and a clapper to which elastic force is applied by an elastic member and which isolates the first chamber from the second chamber by being in contact with the seat ring; an alarm line connected to the seat holes and led outward; a pressure switch installed on the alarm line; a cleaning line connected from the front end of the primary side chamber to the alarm line in the fire water line; a cleaning valve installed on the cleaning line; and a switching valve switching the fire water supplied from the cleaning line to be supplied toward the seat holes, or switching the fire water supplied from the seat holes to be supplied toward the pressure switch. According to the present invention, the alarm check valve can remove foreign substances remaining between the clapper and the seat ring crucial for securing the reliability the reliability of operation, enable efficient removal of foreign substances, and enhance the reliability of operation during a fire, thereby preventing loss of life and property damage caused by fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방수라인에 설치되고, 소방수가 통과하기 위한 1차측챔버와 2차측챔버가 시트링을 사이에 두고 구획되도록 마련되며, 상기 시트링에 시트홀이 다수로 형성되고, 탄성부재에 의해 탄성력이 인가되는 클래퍼가 상기 시트링과의 접촉에 의해 상기 1차측챔버와 상기 2차측챔버를 서로 격리시키도록 하는 밸브바디; 상기 시트홀에 연결되어 외부로 인출되는 알람라인; 상기 알람라인에 설치되는 압력스위치; 상기 소방수라인에서 상기 1차측챔버의 전단으로부터 상기 알람라인에 연결되는 클리닝라인; 상기 클리닝라인에 설치되는 클리닝밸브; 및 상기 클리닝라인으로부터 공급되는 소방수가 상기 시트홀 측으로 공급되도록 전환하거나, 상기 시트홀로부터 공급되는 소방수가 상기 압력스위치 측으로 공급되도록 전환하는 전환밸브;를 포함하도록 한 이물질 자가 청소가 가능한 알람체크밸브에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 동작의 신뢰성 확보를 위해 중요한 클래퍼와 시트링 사이에 잔존하는 이물질을 제거할 수 있고, 이러한 이물질의 제거가 효율적으로 이루어지도록 할 수 있으며, 이로 인해 화재시 동작의 신뢰도를 높임으로써, 화재로 인한 인명 및 재산 피해를 방지하도록 하는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: Wireless voice alarm device for blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind area wireless voice alarm device which comprises a wireless voice alarm arranged at the blind area and a wireless transmitter arranged at the top of a vehicle, wherein the wireless voice alarm and the wireless transmitter are in data connection through Bluetooth data transmission, the wireless voice alarm comprises a shell, a control main board and a transformer, wherein the control main board and the transformer are arranged in the shell, first brackets for being fixedly connected at the blind area are arranged at four corners of one side of the shell, a voice loudspeaker is arranged at the other side of the shell, and an alarm lamp with a flashing reminding function is arranged at the upper end of the shell. The utility model discloses a wireless voice alarm device of blind area receives wireless transmitter's signal when the vehicle goes to the blind area, and wireless voice alarm can in time send voice alarm and light scintillation and remind the driver when the vehicle reaches the distance of settlement, has improved the vehicle and has gone safely in producing mill and workshop, has reduced the potential safety hazard.
assignees: WENZHOU YIHE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Detection method for near-ground detection blind area range of weather radar
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection method of a near-ground detection blind area range of a weather radar, belonging to the technical field of radar detection, comprising the following steps: acquiring radar site information and topographic data of the range of the radar site; calculating the altitude of a radar feed source, the altitude of each distance library, the longitude and latitude of each distance library and the terrain height of the position of each distance library; and judging the actual maximum detection distance of each azimuth angle of the radar by using the lowest elevation angle in the radar body scanning mode, and obtaining the shielding range close to the ground in the radar theoretical maximum detection range according to calculation. The application has guiding function for adjacent radar site selection and radar networking jigsaw work, and provides reference information for solving the problem of compensating detection blind areas in low altitude when constructing adjacent radars; the automatic rainfall station is distributed in the detection blind area to provide important information, the effect of certain blind supplement can be achieved, the accuracy of quantitative rainfall estimation is improved, and accordingly the response time of mountain torrent disaster early warning in mountain areas is prolonged.

title_en: Intelligent anti-collision system of road roller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road construction, in particular to an intelligent anti-collision system of a road roller. The utility model provides a road roller intelligence collision avoidance system, includes power, vehicle control ware, anticollision controller, light curtain sensor, radar induction system, image acquisition device, video display, light curtain display, vehicle arresting gear and alarm device, power and vehicle control ware are connected with anticollision controller electricity respectively, and the input of anticollision controller is connected with light curtain sensor, radar induction system and image acquisition device electricity respectively, and the output of anticollision controller is connected with video display, light curtain display, vehicle arresting gear and alarm device electricity respectively. The utility model adopts the camera, the ultrasonic radar and the light curtain sensor to detect the obstacle simultaneously, and detects the surrounding environment through the complementary fusion of the multiple sensors, thereby realizing the detection of no blind area in a certain range, effectively improving the detection reliability and the construction safety of engineering mechanical equipment, effectively avoiding personal injury and reducing equipment injury.
assignees: DALIAN YILUDA ENG MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting manual alarm abnormality detection method and system based on inspection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting manual alarm abnormality detection method and system based on a patrol robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring point location data of the fire-fighting manual alarm, wherein the point location data comprises coordinate positioning parameters, installation type parameters and wall-attached position parameters of the fire-fighting manual alarm; controlling the inspection robot to move to the corresponding point position based on the point position data so as to acquire the visual data of the fire-fighting manual alarm, wherein the control of the inspection robot comprises aligning a camera of the inspection robot when the inspection robot moves, and performing translation calibration and/or scaling calibration when the visual data is acquired; and carrying out anomaly detection based on the acquired video data to acquire an anomaly result and carrying out output alarm, wherein the actual flicker frequency and/or the actual flicker frequency of the alarm indicator lamp are specifically detected. The invention breaks through the traditional scheme of detecting by using security personnel, has higher overall detection efficiency, and can reduce the occurrence of the problems of false alarm, missing alarm and the like.

title_en: Platform door detection device based on photoelectric sensor
abstract_en: The platform door detection device based on the photoelectric sensor comprises an internal interface and an external interface, wherein the internal interface comprises a signal processing circuit, a central processing unit, a communication circuit, an audible and visual alarm circuit and a power supply circuit; the signal processing circuit, the central processing unit and the audible and visual alarm circuit are electrically connected with the power supply circuit; the signal processing circuit, the communication circuit and the audible and visual alarm circuit are electrically connected with the central processing unit; the external interface comprises a gate control unit, a bypass switch and a photoelectric sensor; the gate control unit, the bypass switch and the photoelectric sensor are connected with the internal interface; the invention detects the foreign matters of the platform door through the photoelectric sensor, improves the safety and reliability of the platform door system, and provides a safe and comfortable riding environment for passengers.
assignees: CSSC HAIWEI HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent greenhouse, which comprises a first supporting rod, wherein a second supporting rod is arranged on one side of the first supporting rod, a first sliding groove and a second sliding groove are respectively formed in the upper surfaces of the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod, a first arc-shaped rod and a second arc-shaped rod are respectively connected to the inner walls of the first sliding groove and the second sliding groove in a sliding mode, and an arc-shaped supporting plate is arranged between the first arc-shaped rod and the second arc-shaped rod. This intelligent greenhouse, through the setting of LED human body induction lamp, controller and alarm, when someone got into warmhouse booth at night, LED human body induction lamp lights and sends the signal to the controller sends the signal and then the alarm lights and send the sound to the alarm, thereby the manager accessible bluetooth of alarm and mobile phone are connected and thereby warmhouse booth's accessible mobile phone learn that someone breaks into warmhouse booth at night inside, thereby can in time know warmhouse booth's condition and can in time seek to support, the security performance is high.

title_en: Mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on microseism monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine early warning, and particularly discloses a mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on microseism monitoring, wherein the mine dynamic disaster early warning device comprises a mounting base, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, and a mounting mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the supporting frame; through adjusting the slide in the inboard slip of spout, slide inboard through the slide and slide into the spout, and then alright install the inboard of vertical guide rail with the microseism detector, the clamping spring resets and drives the fixture block and insert to the draw-in groove is inboard this moment, and then alright supplementary closure fixed slide, when the microseism detector needs to overhaul, the accessible pulling pull ring drives the even axle and draws the fixture block and contradicts clamping spring shrink, clamping spring shrink while the fixture block leaves the draw-in groove, the slide has lost the prescribing a limit this moment, alright be quick with the microseism detector follow vertical guide rail's inboard and take out for this equipment is wholly convenient for quick assembly disassembly overhauls.

title_en: real time diaster information service system for the diaster weak
title_ko: 재난 약자를 위한 실시간 재난정보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates a real-time disaster information system for disaster-vulnerable individuals. In a disaster information service method, the system comprises: a service server (100) comprising a subscriber information storing part (110) for storing subscriber information storing information on whether a user who uses an application is a hard-of-hearing person or a foreigner, a disaster information collecting part (130) receiving disaster information including a disaster text message, a sign language video generating part (140, a sign language video processing part, a sign language video storing part) generating sign language video information (I1) to be transmitted to the hard-of-hearing person terminal based on the disaster information, a foreign language translation service part (150, a foreign language translation server) generating disaster information (I2) translated in foreign languages to be transmitted to foreigners based on the disaster information; and a user terminal (200) which receives sign language video information (I1) or the translated disaster information (I2) from the service server (100) and displays the same on a display, and has an application program (200a) installed to generate a user interface (UI) for interfacing with the service server (100). According to the present invention, provided is a real-time disaster information system for disaster-vulnerable individuals and a disaster information service method providing a sign language video to a hard-of-hearing person and an online disaster notification service based on a native language for each country to foreigners.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난정보 서비스 방법에 있어서, 애플리케이션을 사용하는 사용자의 청각 장애인 여부, 외국인 여부에 관한 정보를 저장하는 가입자 정보를 저장하는 가입자 정보 저장부(110)와, 재난문자를 포함하는 재난정보를 입력받는 재난 정보 수집부(130)와, 상기 재난 정보에 기초하여 청각 장애인 단말기에게 전송될 수어 영상 정보(I1)를 생성하는 수어 영상 생성부(140, 수어 영상 처리부, 수어 영상 저장부 )와, 상기 재난 정보에 기초하여 외국인에게 전송될 외국어로 번역된 재난 정보(I2)를 생성하는 외국어 번역 서비스부(150, 외국어 번역 서버)로 구성된 서비스 서버(100)와; 상기 서비스 서버(100)로부터 수어 영상 정보(I1) 또는 번역된 재난 정보(I2)를 수신하여 디스플레이에 표출하고 상기 서비스 서버(100)와 인터페이스 하기 위한 유저 인터페이스(UI)를 생성하는 애플리케이션 프로그램(200a)이 설치된 사용자 단말기(200);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 약자를 위한 실시간 재난정보 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: User preferences in responder network responder selection
abstract_en: Methods, user interfaces and systems are described that enable responder preferences to be considered during deployment of a public responder network. In some embodiments, a user is able to set preferences such as a mobility status, a public accessibility preference, a incidents notifications preference or a geographic preference associated with a medical device that is a part of the public responder network. In some embodiments, the user is able to select or define an area for which incident notifications are desired or are to be restricted in some manner. The described approach is well suited for public responder networks that include medical devices such as defibrillators (e.g., AEDs) in the network.

title_en: Blind zone induction alarm for highway engineering construction machinery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blind area induction and discloses a blind area induction alarm for highway engineering construction machinery. The intelligent alarm device comprises a base, wherein a standing groove is formed in the top of the base, a motor is fixedly connected to the bottom of the base and arranged in the middle of the base, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft penetrates through the base and extends to the inside, the outer surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a rotating ring, the rotating ring is of a concave structure, and the inner wall of the rotating ring is provided with a box body.

title_en: Fire information notification method based on IoT
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT-based fire information notification method, which can quickly notify the elderly or visually or hearing impaired having a lack of detection ability that a fire has occurred when an emergency situation such as a fire occurs and can evacuate the same. More specifically, the IoT-based fire information notification method comprises the steps of: 1) requesting access approval from a wireless terminal through a user terminal; 2) providing user information received in the wireless terminal to a relay server through an administrator terminal; 3) transmitting fire occurrence information to the relay server through the administrator terminal when an emergency situation due to a fire occurs; 4) enabling the relay server to transmit the fire occurrence information to the user terminal based on stored user information; and 5) enabling the user terminal receiving the fire occurrence information to execute a notification means provided in the user terminal so that a user confirms whether the emergency situation has occurred. The notification means is an alarm function including sound and vibration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재와 같은 비상상황이 발생시에 감지 능력이 부족한 노약자나 시각 또는 청각장애인들에게 화재가 발생하였음을 신속하게 알리고 대피시킬 수 있는 사물인터넷을 기반으로 하는 화재정보 알림방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 1)사용자단말을 통해 무선단말부에 접속 승인을 요청하는 단계와, 2)상기 무선단말부에 수신된 사용자정보를 관리자단말에 의해 중계서버로 제공하는 단계와, 3)화재발생에 따른 비상상황이 발생시에 상기 관리자단말을 통해 상기 중계서버에 화재발생정보를 전송하는 단계와, 4)상기 중계서버는 저장된 사용자정보를 기반으로 상기 사용자단말에 화재발생정보를 송출하는 단계 및 5)화재발생정보를 수신한 상기 사용자단말은 상기 사용자단말에 구비된 알림수단을 실행하여 비상상황 발생 여부를 사용자에게 확인시키는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 알림수단은 음향과 진동을 포함하는 알람기능인 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: GYEONGBUK COLLEGE OF HEALTH IND ACADEMY COOPERATION GROUP

title_en: Fire piping structure for building
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting piping installation structure, which connects pipes for piping discharged to a building. The firefighting piping installation structure comprises: a pipe with a first O-ring and a first stopper ring joined at each end by an outer circumferential surface; a connection pipe which allows the ends of the pipes inserted from both sides to be spaced apart by a certain length, and allows the pipes to be movably coupled to a certain length while preventing the pipes from both sides from deviating to the outside; a heat dissipation sheet which surrounds the outer peripheral surface of the connection pipe to block heat transfer to the pipe through the connection pipe; a heat-resistant pipe made of heat-resistant material to block heat transfer to the heat dissipation sheet; a buffer member which prevents moisture from flowing into the connection pipe from the outside and absorbs shock from the outside; and a pair of pipe caps in which a seal ring is inserted between flange surfaces on both sides and are pressed together by fastening nuts and bolts between the flange surfaces. According to the present invention, the firefighting piping installation structure ensures a tight connection between pipes, prevents the inflow of any foreign substances from the outside, provides buffering against earthquakes or shocks generated from the outside, prevents heat transfer to the pipe by the heat dissipation sheet and heat-resistant pipe even if high temperature heat is applied due to a fire, and prevents damage to pipes and poor connections due to pipe deformation, contraction, or expansion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방 배관 설치구조에 관한 것으로서, 건물에 배설되는 배관용 파이프들간을 연결하는 구성에 있어서, 각 단부에는 외주면으로 제1 오링과 제1 스토퍼 링이 결합되는 파이프; 내주면의 길이 중간부에는 상기 파이프의 외경보다 작은 내경으로 일정 길이의 걸림돌기가 형성되도록 하여 양측으로부터 각각 삽입되는 파이프들간의 단부가 일정 길이로 이격되도록 하고, 양측단부의 내주면에는 파이프들의 외주면에 밀착되도록 하는 제2 오링과 함께 상기 제1 스토퍼 링의 외경보다 작은 내경을 갖는 제2 스토퍼 링이 결합되도록 하여 양측으로부터 파이프들이 외측으로 이탈되지 않도록 하면서 일정 길이가 이동 가능하게 결합되도록 하는 연결 파이프; 상기 연결 파이프의 외주면을 감싸도록 하여 상기 연결 파이프를 통해 파이프로의 열전달이 차단되도록 하는 방열 시트; 상기 연결 파이프의 길이와 동일한 길이로 형성하고, 상기 방열시트의 외주면을 감싸면서 밀착되도록 하여 방열시트로의 열전달이 차단되도록 내열성 소재로 형성하는 내열 파이프; 반원형으로 분할되도록 하여 단면간 맞춤돌기와 맞춤홈간 맞춤결합에 의해 상기 내열 파이프의 외주면과 동시에 양측단면에 밀착되게 하면서 양측단부의 내주면은 상기 연결 파이프의 양측으로 삽입되는 각 파이프들의 외주면에 밀착되도록 하여 외부로부터 상기 연결 파이프의 내부로 물기가 유입되지 않도록 하고, 외부로부터의 충격에 대해 흡수할 수 있도록 하는 완충부재; 상기 완충부재의 양측으로부터 각각 상호 마주보는 방향으로 상기 완충부재의 외주면과 양측단면을 감싸도록 하면서 상호 마주보는 단부에는 각각 플랜지면을 형성하고, 양측의 플랜지면 사이에는 시일 링이 삽입되도록 하여 플랜지면간 너트와 볼트 체결에 의해 압착 결합되도록 하는 한 쌍의 파이프 캡의 결합으로 이루어지는 구성이다.

title_en: Rain and flood drainage road risk early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic flood early warning, in particular to a method and a device for early warning of risk of a rainfall flood drainage road. The rainfall flood drainage road risk early warning method is applied to a risk early warning device and comprises the following steps: acquiring a water depth value; judging whether the water depth value is larger than the first water depth value, if so, acquiring the water flow velocity; determining a risk level according to the water depth value and the water flow velocity; according to the risk grades, grading risk alarm is carried out, monitoring of the rain and flood drainage road water conditions is achieved, corresponding alarm is carried out on different risk grades, and the situation that pedestrians cannot accurately judge the water conditions and blindly wade water brings risks to self safety is avoided.

title_en: Rail transit anomaly analysis system false alarm elimination method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and a medium for eliminating false alarms of a rail transit anomaly analysis system, which comprise the following steps: in the defined detection area, detecting the foreground of the image to obtain a moving target existing in the image; detecting the moving target by an image illuminance algorithm and a linear programming algorithm, and determining whether the moving target is an interfering object; detecting the moving target with the interference removed by a target detection algorithm to determine whether the moving target is an intrusion foreign matter, and giving an alarm if the moving target is determined to be the intrusion foreign matter. According to the method for detecting the all-weather multi-category interferents along the railway based on the image illumination and the linear programming and combined with the deep learning target detection, the disaster detection system can be effectively assisted to accurately detect abnormal conditions, and the real railway intrusion foreign matters can be identified.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring environment and foreign matter invasion of equipment and facilities along railway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the environment of equipment along a railway and monitoring the invasion of foreign matters, which are characterized in that the condition of the roadbed and the track along the railway and the comprehensive perception of the surrounding environment and the facilities along the railway are realized through a space-based remote sensing platform, an air-based remote sensing platform, a track moving platform detection, a fixed detection platform and a direct steel rail condition detection device singly or in combination, an expert diagnosis system is formed through data accumulation, hidden danger and fault recognition capability are improved through establishing deep learning training, maintenance and repair are reasonably arranged, the condition of the railway along the roadbed and the track along the railway and the early warning and warning of the hidden danger of the surrounding environment and the facilities are realized, the foreign matters invaded into the track are timely warned, the geological disasters along the railway are early warned and warned in combination with weather, and on-site rescue after the guiding faults and disasters are guided, and the running safety of a train is ensured.

title_en: Marine alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of alarm systems, and discloses a marine alarm system which comprises an alarm lamp and an alarm lamp protection device, wherein when equipment senses an abnormal environment, a smoke detector and a temperature detector can sense the detected information to the equipment through an induction module and a control module in a main board module, and an alarm lamp body carries out flashing alarm and can protect the alarm lamp body from entering the foreign matters in the alarm lamp body. This marine alarm system makes the detection accuracy of equipment obtain improving through setting up the response detector in the outside of equipment, compares with leading-in equipment, and the response detector is circumference array form and distributes at the outer wall of sensing intercommunication ware and make the equipment obtain improving to the accuracy that external environment detected, has reduced the probability that equipment detected the mistake.
assignees: HUBEI GUOYANG ELECTRICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Building fire alarm intelligent alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of intelligent alarm devices and discloses an intelligent alarm device for building fire protection, which comprises supporting seats, wherein two sides of the top end of each supporting seat are fixedly connected with first installation seats respectively, the top ends of the two first installation seats are respectively connected with a loudspeaker in a threaded manner, one side of the top end of each supporting seat is fixedly connected with a controller, the top end of each controller is fixedly connected with a smoke sensor, the top end of each supporting seat is linearly and fixedly connected with a plurality of second installation seats, the top ends of a plurality of fixing seats are respectively connected with alarm lamps in a threaded manner, the top ends of a plurality of fixing seats are respectively and fixedly connected with lamp covers near the side walls, and the lower positions of the side walls of the fixing seats are respectively and fixedly connected with a plurality of radiating grooves. The utility model provides the intelligent building fire alarm device which improves visual impact by arranging a plurality of alarm lamps, supplements visual blind areas by using a loudspeaker and improves personnel response efficiency.
assignees: SHAANXI RUIHE JUNXING FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic rescue safety monitoring method and system for trapped elevator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic rescue safety monitoring method and system for trapped people in an elevator, which belong to the technical field of elevators, and the method comprises the following steps: the elevator stopping instant auxiliary encoder obtains the position of the elevator car, and the controller drives the elevator car to a nearby leveling layer; if the car cannot reach the nearby leveling floor, the detecting head acquires a state image in the car; voice pacifying dialogue and prompt are carried out with trapped personnel through a human-computer interface operation device; when the detecting head collects that someone is raking or smashing the door, the alarm bell in the car acts, and the man-machine interface operating device expands voice conversation and warning prompt for trapped people. The system uses an automatic rescue safety monitoring method for elevator trapped people. When the phenomena of closing or trapping people and the like of the existing elevator are solved, maintenance personnel are required to enter the elevator field from the foreign place in an emergency mode, and trapped personnel are required to be rescued in a machine room by turning. And because the condition in the fault car is difficult to obtain, the trapped passengers can have anxiety or endanger personal safety.
assignees: FOSHAN HEZHONG ELEVATOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote security linkage monitor box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a remote security linkage monitor box which comprises a heat radiation box, wherein an operation box is fixed at the top of the heat radiation box, an alarm and a camera are fixed at the top of the operation box, a display screen is fixed on the rear side wall of an inner cavity of the operation box, an access door is hinged to the front surface of the heat radiation box, an air cooling mechanism is fixed on the inner surface of the heat radiation box, and a semiconductor refrigerator is fixed at the top of the inner cavity of the heat radiation box. This remote security and elimination linkage monitor case monitors the environment around through the camera, and accessible display screen and keyboard carry out the operation on the spot, and the camera is conducted the picture to manager department and is made the siren sound when the conflagration appears, and manager accessible remote control makes security protection facility and fire control facility operation to cool down to the monitor case through forced air cooling mechanism and semiconductor refrigerator, the normal operation of accessible heat dissipation protection monitor case, develop the fire relief in the first time, reduce casualties and loss of property.
assignees: HEBEI SHENGMIAO SAFETY TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Collision early warning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a collision early warning method, a system and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of constructing a target detection area in an electronic map based on target vehicle action information of a target vehicle, defining at least one auxiliary vehicle in the target detection area, determining an auxiliary vehicle blind area for each auxiliary vehicle, acquiring road side perception data of the auxiliary vehicle blind area through road side perception equipment, calculating a target vehicle action track of the target vehicle when the road side perception data of the blind area contains early warning target action information, calculating an early warning target action track of the early warning target, and generating collision early warning information corresponding to the early warning target according to the target vehicle action track and the early warning target action track. The road side sensing equipment on two sides of the road can acquire global visual field information of the blind area, effectively predicts whether a target vehicle collides with an early-warning target, sends collision early-warning information to remind the target vehicle before predicting collision, and helps the target vehicle to avoid collision events in advance.

title_en: Infrared temperature control system of disk body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared temperature control system of a disc body, which comprises: the infrared detection unit is used for detecting the temperature of the wafer and forming an input signal, and is arranged on a blind plate hole site of the processing cavity; the control unit is in communication connection with the infrared detection unit and is used for receiving input signals and generating control instructions; the output unit is in communication connection with the control unit and is arranged to display the wafer temperature detected by the infrared detection unit; and the alarm unit is in communication connection with the control unit and is used for sending out an alarm signal based on the control instruction. According to the utility model, an infrared temperature measurement system is additionally arranged, the system can monitor the temperature of the wafer in the implantation process in real time, the system can carry out linkage alarm and stop implantation when necessary, and the temperature is quantized, so that compared with the result of temperature test paper, the system is more accurate; the temperature is controlled to discover the faults of the machine tray in advance, so that the scrapping of the whole batch of products is avoided, and the economic benefit is improved.

title_en: Railway line foreign matter intrusion monitoring information uploading device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway line foreign matter intrusion monitoring information uploading device, which belongs to the technical field of railway disaster prevention and early warning, and comprises a radar module, a camera module, a clock timing module, a core board module and a monitoring information uploading module; the radar module, the camera module and the clock timing module are all connected with the core board module; the core board module is connected with the monitoring information uploading module. The utility model solves the problem that the position and time information of the road barrier in the railway line monitoring information are missing or inaccurate by arranging the radar module, the camera module, the clock timing module, the core board module and the monitoring information uploading module.
assignees: SHAANXI JINGSHEN RAILWAY CO LTD;RESEARCH AND TECH SUPERVISION INSTITUTE CHINA RAILWAY LANZHOU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Centralized charging control method for precise rolling body manufacturing on-site trolley bus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a centralized charging control method for an on-site trolley bus for manufacturing a precise rolling body, which comprises the following steps: step 1, fixing a charging pile centralized placement area in a factory, marking each charging pile in the area, and setting a charging time limit value for each charging pile; step 2, defining the responsible person of each trolley, and marking each trolley; step 3, collecting facial information of the charging personnel, connecting the electric vehicle with the charging pile, and identifying whether the electric vehicle is matched with the connected charging pile; step 4, after the pairing is successful, the charging pile starts to charge the electric car, when the charging time reaches the charging time limit value, the charging pile is powered off, an audible and visual alarm of the completion of charging is sent out, and a short message reminding of the completion of charging is sent out to a responsible person of the electric car; step 5, taking a vehicle; the invention realizes the standardized management of the centralized charging of the on-site electric car, reduces the management blind area, effectively avoids the occurrence of the management vacuum phenomenon and the safety accident, and ensures the orderly progress of the production beat.
assignees: JIANGSU LIXING GENERAL STEEL BALL CO LTD

title_en: Steel fire window with alarm function
abstract_en: The invention provides a steel fireproof window with an alarm function, and belongs to the technical field of fireproof windows. The steel fireproof window with the alarm function comprises a steel frame, the semi-open window is installed in the steel frame in a rotating mode, a fixing frame is fixedly installed on the inner top surface and the bottom surface of the steel frame, two translation windows are arranged between the fixing frames, a mounting frame is fixedly installed on one side surface of the steel frame, the escape assembly comprises an equipment box, the equipment box is fixedly installed on the bottom surface of the steel frame, and a rope ladder is arranged in the equipment box. According to the invention, in the moving process of the translation window, the limiting plate is separated from the inside of the limiting groove, the rotating shaft is out of limit, the rope ladder is separated from the inside of the storage roller under the action of gravity and falls downwards, indoor personnel can escape along the rope ladder from the opened translation window through the rope ladder, and the completely opened translation window enables a steel frame at the equipment box to be free from face shielding and barriers, so that rapid escape of higher-floor households is realized.
assignees: HUNAN XINSHENG DOOR AND WINDOW CURTAIN WALL CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster and corona detection dual-purpose early warning system and method based on gallium oxide solar blind detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire and corona detection dual-purpose early warning system and method based on a gallium oxide solar blind detector. According to the invention, the device is placed at the position to be monitored, so that strong interference of sunlight on monitoring signals is not required to be considered, real-time remote monitoring can be carried out outdoors in all weather, and once fire or corona discharge occurs, the system can send out an alarm to timely inform related personnel to catch up with the place, thereby minimizing loss.
assignees: BEIJING JIAHE SEMICONDUCTOR CO LTD;GUANGZHOU HAICHUANG INDUSTRIAL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Intelligent monitoring equipment of 5G communication base station and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent monitoring equipment of a 5G communication base station and a monitoring method thereof, which belong to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, wherein a central controller can be used for connecting a monitoring device, an illumination mechanism and an alarm mechanism, when foreign matters approach, a photoresistor receives laser and is blocked, a distance detector generates a passage to send out an alarm, a rotating mechanism and an adjusting mechanism synchronously move and adjust to enable a camera to be opposite to the blocked laser, so that an intruder is exposed under the camera, the central controller can flexibly adjust and control the device, the accident cause can be photographed and stored timely, the illumination mechanism can be synchronously controlled by the central controller, the illumination mechanism can irradiate an unknown object, the intruder can be frightened, the 5G communication base station is far away, the destructor can be photographed timely even after the demolition is forced, and therefore reliable evidence is provided when the accident is pursued, and the base station is prevented from suffering economic loss.
assignees: HUBEI LIANWEI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: An unauthorized dumping prevention system to detect dumping in blind spots
title_ko: 사각지대에서 투기하는 행위를 적발할 수 있는 쓰레기 무단투기 방지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unauthorized garbage dumping prevention system capable of detecting a dumping action in a blind spot. The unauthorized garbage dumping prevention system comprises: a camera unit formed in a unauthorized dumping prohibition area or a garbage discharge area to photograph a monitoring area and store an image when a dumper carrying a dumped object is detected; a sensor unit formed in the camera unit to recognize an approach state of the dumper and formed to measure and collect surrounding environment information; a control unit extracting a basic background image including only a fixed object that does not move among the images photographed by the camera unit, and comparing the extracted background image with a real-time image photographed in real time by the camera unit to detect a dumped state of the dumped object to determine whether unauthorized dumping has occurred; and a warning unit operating at least one of a warning sound output, a warning light output, and a photographed unauthorized dumping action output when unauthorized dumping is determined by the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사각지대에서 투기하는 행위를 적발할 수 있는 쓰레기 무단투기 방지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 무단투기금지구역 또는 쓰레기 배출장소에 형성되어 투기물을 소지한 투기자가 감지되면 감시구역을 촬영하여 영상을 저장하도록 형성되는 카메라부와, 상기 카메라부에 형성되어 투기자의 접근 상태를 인식할 수 있도록 형성되고, 주변 환경정보를 측정 및 수집할 수 있도록 형성되어 센서부와, 상기 카메라부에서 촬영된 영상 중 움직이지 않는 고정된 객체만 포함된 기본배경영상을 추출하고, 상기 카메라부에서 실시간으로 촬영되고 있는 실시간 영상과 비교하여 상기 투기물이 투기된 상태를 감지하여 무단투기 발생여부를 판단하는 제어부와, 상기 제어부에 의해 무단투기가 판단되면 경고음성 출력, 경고등 출력, 촬영된 무단투기 행위 출력 중 어느 하나 이상이 동작되는 경고부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Signal transmission method, system and device of warning lamp and computer equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a warning light technical field discloses a signal transmission method, system, device and computer equipment of warning light, obtain the environmental characteristic that waits to search regional correspondence, accessible environmental characteristic knows local topography feature like this, thereby can set for a plurality of first search points according to different environmental characteristics, again according to the characteristic of every first search point, for this point equipment warning light, in order to make can carry out signal transmission between the warning light, be equipped with radio communication module on every warning light, when the warning light searches first search point, can transmit the search result to dispatch platform in real time, thereby be convenient for dispatch platform comprehensively, objectively master holistic search and rescue condition, reduce the rescue degree of difficulty, shorten the rescue time.

title_en: Monitoring system and method for right turn stop of intersection of large-sized vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring and controlling right turn stop of a large-scale vehicle intersection, comprising the following steps: collecting data required by right-turning parking of a large-sized vehicle intersection, wherein the data comprise the width of a right-turning lane, the distance between a laser radar and a stop line of the right-turning lane, the width of the right-turning lane, geometric characteristic data of vehicles in the right-turning lane, video data of vehicles in the right-turning lane, geometric characteristic data of vehicles in a right-turning area of the intersection and pedestrian and non-motor vehicle data in a right-turning blind area of the intersection, which are collected by a video device, and initializing a large-sized vehicle license plate set; the working states of the electronic police, the stroboscopic lamp and the voice prompt equipment are controlled according to the analysis result by data analysis; and analyzing video data acquired by the electronic police and sending the video data to the traffic command center. According to the invention, through arranging perfect detection, control, warning, propaganda and other equipment on the road side, the right turn non-stop behavior of the large-sized vehicle intersection is effectively monitored, so that the accident injury risk to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles is reduced.
assignees: NANJING LES INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for monitoring running appearance state of direct-current screen storage battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring the operation appearance state of a direct current screen storage battery, wherein the system comprises an MCU, a power module and a memory, wherein the power module and the memory are interconnected with the MCU; the signal detection module is provided with a signal receiving end and a signal output end, wherein the signal receiving end is connected with a detection unit, and the signal output end is provided with a plurality of independently arranged audible and visual alarms; the system also has an I/O expansion interface, the detection unit comprising: the temperature sensors are arranged in the storage battery and distributed on all sides of the storage battery; the device can adapt to storage batteries with various volumes, timely sense whether the shell has abnormal expansion trend such as heating expansion, crushing and the like, and remind operation and maintenance personnel to intervene in advance; can timely detect the leakage caused by the shell breaking without dead angles, and avoid blind areas of vision.
assignees: POWER ENERGY BRANCH OF CHONGQING AIRPORT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: AI fire control robot on duty
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an AI fire-fighting robot on duty, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting robots and comprises an alarm host, wherein one side of the alarm host is fixedly connected with a plurality of keys, one side of the alarm host is movably connected with a translation mechanism, and the opposite side of the translation mechanism is movably connected with a lifting rod. According to the utility model, through the arranged translation mechanism, the servo motor II is started, so that the servo motor II drives the translation rod to rotate, and at the moment, the translation rod drives the conveyor belt to rotate the other translation rod through the conveying wheel, so that the translation rod drives the sliding block to horizontally move on the guide rail, and the sliding block drives the camera and the key hand to horizontally move, and the device block drives the camera and the key hand to horizontally move, so that the definition of each key is analyzed through a video, and each key is automatically positioned, so that the control operation of the key is automatically performed, and the supervision execution pressure of a supervision and management department is relieved.
assignees: SUZHOU GUOWANG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

abstract_en: The present invention provides a hearing-impaired assistance system and a device thereof. The hearing-impaired assistance system according to an exemplary embodiment includes: a first user terminal that is wearable on a body of a hearing-impaired user and generates a notification according to pre-arrival notification information received from the outside; a second user terminal that transmits a pre-arrival notification request including destination information and transportation means information input by the user, transmits the user's location information, and receives pre-arrival notification information corresponding to the pre-arrival notification request from the outside and transmits the same to the first user terminal; and a service device that receives a pre-arrival notification request and the user's location information from the second user terminal, respectively, generates pre-arrival notification information based on the pre-arrival notification request and the user's location information, and transmits the pre-arrival notification information to the second user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 청각 장애인 보조 시스템 및 장치가 개시된다. 예시적인 실시예에 따른 청각 장애인 보조 시스템은, 청각 장애인인 사용자의 신체에 착용 가능하게 마련되고, 외부로부터 수신되는 도착 전 알림 정보에 따라 알림을 발생시키는  제1 사용자 단말기, 사용자로부터 입력되는 목적지 정보 및 교통 수단 정보를 포함하는 도착 전 알림 요청을 전송하고, 사용자의 위치 정보를 전송하며, 외부로부터 도착 전 알림 요청에 대응하는 도착 전 알림 정보를 수신하여 제1 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 제2 사용자 단말기, 및 제2 사용자 단말기로부터 도착 전 알림 요청 및 사용자의 위치 정보를 각각 수신하고, 도착 전 알림 요청 및 사용자의 위치 정보를 기반으로 도착 전 알림 정보를 생성하며, 도착 전 알림 정보를 제2 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 서비스 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Power line detection device for digital twin platform area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power line detection device for a digital twin platform area, which comprises a shell, wherein both ends of the bottom of the shell are fixedly connected with arc plates, one end, far away from the shell, of each arc plate is rotationally connected with a clamping plate, and one side, far away from the shell, of each clamping plate is fixedly connected with an inclined plate; a conductive wire mounted between the housings; the cutting knife is arranged in the detection groove, and a longitudinal groove is formed in one side, far away from the power-off alarm, of the inner wall of the detection groove; electric putter, and power detection equipment technical field. The invention has the characteristics of strong practicability, simple structure, reduced cost of equipment, automatic triggering and alarming when foreign matters appear on the power line, no need of continuously detecting the conductive wire and reduced use cost of the equipment, and achieves the aim of automatically clamping and fixing the equipment on the power line when the equipment moves around the power line.

title_en: Deaf person early warning method and device based on binocular camera relative speed measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deaf person early warning method and device based on binocular camera relative speed measurement, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the camera acquires a visual image; calibrating the visual image obtained in the previous step by using a Zhang Zhengyou calibration method; detecting the visual image calibrated in the previous step; measuring the distance and the relative speed of the moving object detected in the previous step; the hand-wearing device is connected with the head-wearing device, a threshold value of relative collision time TTC is set, and when a target object is smaller than a certain relative TTC, a user is reminded of the surrounding through a dual early warning mode of light emission and vibration of the hand-wearing device. The device comprises: the head-mounted device comprises a head-mounted device body, a front-view binocular camera, a rear-view binocular camera, a binding belt, an algorithm processor and a power supply. According to the invention, the speed relative to the user is calculated, so that the complex calculation of the actual speed and direction of the target object is reduced, the user is reminded of the vehicle coming from the rear, and the defect that the deaf cannot hear the sound of the rear vehicle is overcome.

title_en: Anechoic room air conditioner refrigerant monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioners, in particular to a refrigerant monitoring device for an anechoic room air conditioner, which comprises a mounting box body, a programmable controller, an anechoic room ventilation fan and an anechoic room air conditioner, wherein the programmable controller is nested in the mounting box body and is fixedly connected with the mounting box body through screws, an audible and visual alarm is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting box body, a connecting wire is fixedly connected at the bottom of the mounting box body, and a monitoring assembly is fixedly connected at one end of the connecting wire. This anechoic room air conditioner refrigerant monitoring devices through setting up a plurality of monitoring components with programmable controller complex, can arrange a plurality of monitoring components in a plurality of positions of anechoic room air conditioner week side, realizes the omnidirectional monitoring to anechoic room air conditioner, shows monitoring data through programmable controller, when arbitrary monitoring component monitoring refrigerant content exceeds standard, the accessible programmable controller control audible and visual alarm reports to the police, improves the sensitivity of monitoring.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGJIA ZHIRUI INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent geological disaster early warning method and system for 5G high-speed rail
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G high-speed rail oriented intelligent geological disaster early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1: arranging sensing monitoring equipment along the railway, collecting seismic waveform time domain signals by the equipment and uploading the signals to an edge server; s2: the edge server preprocesses the data acquired by the sensing monitoring equipment in real time, and the preprocessed data is input into the pre-training model to obtain a prediction result; s3: the railway early warning control center acquires a landslide area displacement time sequence based on a synthetic aperture radar of an interferometry technology, judges a landslide distribution area, performs early warning judgment according to a prediction result, and immediately controls the running state of the high-speed rail; the invention also discloses an intelligent geological disaster early warning system for the 5G high-speed rail, which comprises sensing detection equipment, an edge server and a railway early warning control center, and can reliably detect longitudinal waves and transverse waves of extremely small to extremely large earthquakes without a definite waveform template, thereby realizing comprehensive geological monitoring and timely early warning without blind areas.
assignees: NANJING TICOM TECH CO LTD;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method, a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management system, electronic equipment and a dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management medium, wherein the dangerous chemical leakage personnel evacuation management method comprises the steps of dividing areas of a park, and carrying out corresponding numbering and position association on leakage monitoring modules in the divided areas; when monitoring data are obtained to judge leakage of dangerous chemicals, analyzing and obtaining the position of a target leakage area and an evacuation route; the method comprises the steps of sending a protection product scheduling instruction to a protection product scheduling module and early warning and evacuating information in each factory to a broadcast early warning and evacuating module in each internal and external area of each factory, obtaining monitoring data through automatic regional monitoring, planning a route avoiding a leakage area, carrying out path walking voice prompt along the evacuation route, simultaneously carrying out protection product scheduling on the leakage area, and carrying out on-line protection product or rapid evacuation on personnel according to the voice prompt, so that personnel can be prevented from blindly escaping, the optimal rescue and evacuating time can be missed, and the occurrence probability of major safety accidents can be reduced.

title_en: Communication device suitable for hearing impaired people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication device suitable for hearing impaired people, which comprises a handheld terminal, wherein a voice recognition module, a processing module, an output module and a communication module are arranged in the handheld terminal, and the voice recognition module, the output module and the communication module are respectively connected with the processing module; the voice recognition module recognizes languages when the communication device communicates; the processing module processes the identified languages into target languages according to the target languages with preset values; the output module translates the target language into the target text according to the selection of the user and then outputs or outputs voice; the communication module communication device communicates with an external terminal. The technical scheme provided by the invention can realize barrier-free communication among hearing impaired people, improve the quality of life, relieve psychological stress and meet the mutual communication among specific people in different languages; in addition, the system can also remind dangerous information such as emergency whistle of a vehicle, fire, flood, earthquake alarm and the like by specific vibration and ringing alarm, and improve the risk avoiding capability of the hearing-impaired people.

title_en: Slope monitoring module and monitoring system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope monitoring module and a monitoring system thereof, and belongs to the field of slope early warning. In the monitoring system, a plurality of groups of information transmission units are arranged along the extending direction of the slope top of the slope; the information acquisition units are arranged at the sides of the information transmission units and can be used for carrying out signal transmission with the information acquisition units; the information acquisition unit is provided with a plurality of groups of monitoring modules, the monitoring modules are connected with each other, the monitoring modules are arranged along the slope bottom to the slope top of the slope, the monitoring modules are used for monitoring deformation information from the slope bottom to the slope top, the monitoring modules are arranged on the information acquisition unit through the plurality of groups of monitoring modules, so that the monitoring modules cover to form a monitoring surface, once the slope is displaced, the accessible monitoring data are fed back into the information acquisition unit, the data are transmitted to the information acquisition unit for information sharing through the Beidou system, and disaster early warning information is transmitted to the receiving terminal through the mobile network in time for disaster information propagation.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring method and system based on big data cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring method and a geological disaster monitoring system based on a big data cloud platform, and relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, browsing a three-dimensional live-action model and marking model data in real time: surrounding browsing of a three-dimensional live-action model and three-dimensional analysis are realized through the operation categories of zooming in, zooming out, translation, left rotation, right rotation and inclination, and a data labeling function is introduced in the browsing process, and S2, data acquisition and resource management of ground disaster prevention and control are carried out: disaster point and hidden danger point data of a geological environment and a geological disaster space are acquired through space data calculation, and the data are managed in a centralized mode. According to the invention, the ground water level drop depth, the ground accumulated settlement and the ground inclination are selected as the monitoring parameters of the ground settlement of the research area, so that the early warning grade is judged according to the monitoring parameters, and the insar is utilized to observe the observation results of various ground disaster data at intervals to obtain comprehensive monitoring information.

title_en: Wisdom whistle tower system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent whistle tower system which consists of a radar detection system, a photoelectric identification system and an acousto-optic rejection system, wherein when a target invades a monitoring area, the radar detects the data such as the azimuth, the number and the speed of the target, and the like, the photoelectric equipment on a heavy-duty turntable is linked to carry out video rechecking, and the acousto-optic rejection device receives alarm information and suspicious target positions sent by the radar and the photoelectric equipment and drives away the target through an acousto-optic means. The problems of multiple monitoring blind areas, insufficient intelligence, weak adaptability to complex environments and the like of the whistle tower system can be solved.
assignees: CHINA CHANGFENG SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY IND GROUP CORP

title_en: Rail transit line disaster grading alarm method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rail transit line disaster grading alarm method and a system, which are characterized by comprising the following steps: collecting video streams of continuous image frames in preset time; defining a detection area in a range including a stock along a track of each frame of image in the acquired video stream; respectively carrying out moving target detection, difference detection and target detection on each frame of image after a detection area is defined in a video stream, detecting the position of a foreign object in each frame of image, the confidence degree of whether the foreign object exists or not and the type of the foreign object, and outputting a result; based on the predefined disaster type and the corresponding response thereof and the output results of all single-frame images of the video stream within the preset time, the method and the device for outputting the alarm output are used for carrying out corresponding alarm output, and can be widely applied to the disaster detection field.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for identifying external damage prevention of distribution overhead line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-external-damage identification method, device, equipment and medium for a distribution overhead line.
