The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an overhead line image to be identified; inputting the overhead line image to be identified into a pre-trained external damage prevention identification model to obtain an external damage area identification result and an external damage type; the method comprises the steps that a parallel segmentation subtask is added in a detection network by the anti-outward-breaking recognition model, an outward-breaking type is obtained through the detection network, an outward-breaking region recognition result is obtained through the parallel segmentation subtask, and the outward-breaking type comprises at least one of the following components: foreign matter short circuit, mechanical construction, violation construction, forest fire and smoke short circuit. According to the invention, the pre-trained external damage prevention recognition model is used for carrying out early warning and recognition on the external damage area of the distribution overhead line, so that the environment around the power grid is monitored in real time, abnormal conditions are rapidly found, the recognition accuracy is improved, and the input cost is reduced.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Distance measuring equipment for construction of rotor is worn in generator drawing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the generator drawing through rotor, in particular to a distance measuring device for the construction of the generator drawing through rotor, which comprises a rotor, an automatic measurement reminding structure and an auxiliary structure, wherein the automatic measurement reminding structure is arranged on the surface of the rotor; the automatic measurement reminding structure comprises an outer ring sleeved on the surface of the rotor. The utility model discloses a distance measurement equipment is used in construction of rotor is taken out to generator, this device accessible infrared sensor's automatic measure is with the interval between rotor and the stator and show on intelligent monitor, when interval distance is less than the inside default of intelligent monitor, then the accessible alarm sends out alarm sound, also can make the running water lamp produce dynamic colorful light simultaneously, also can make atomizing piece blowout unobtrusive atomizing gas remind the operating personnel simultaneously, utilize alarm sound, obvious running water colorful light and obvious fog can make strong warning effect, make the operating personnel can learn the change of interval between rotor and the stator very first time.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY ENG GROUP JIANGSU NO 1 ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Prompting device applied to road visual field blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prompting device applied to a road visual field blind area, which relates to the technical field of traffic safety and comprises a first monitoring unit arranged on a first road section and a second monitoring unit arranged on a second road section, wherein the second monitoring unit is respectively used for monitoring moving targets on the first road section and the second road section; both are infrared shielding induction devices; the system also comprises a prompt module which is used for sending prompt information in preset prompt time; in the prompting module, a first prompting unit and a second prompting module are respectively arranged at the junction of a road intersection and a first road section and a second road section and are respectively used for sending prompting information to a moving target on the first road section or the second road section. The infrared shielding induction equipment can be used for rapidly identifying people or vehicles passing through and shielded by the department, then sending signals to the controller, and the control module invokes the prompting module to send prompting information so as to achieve the effect of causing the driver to be alert to drive and meet the vehicles, and the system is free from networking, quick in response, simple in logic and easy to maintain.
assignees: GUANGDONG KELU ZHIBO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;GUANGDONG ZHONGWEI ZHIBO PARKING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for detecting fire by using smart glasses for blind
title_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 스마트 안경을 이용한 화재 감지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and device for detecting a fire using smart glasses for a visually impaired person. According to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the present invention performs machine learning for a fire scene using big data for the fire scene, receives a received photographed image from a smart glasses, determines whether being a fire situation or not by using the received photographed image, and transmits an alert to the smart glasses to indicate a fire situation when determined to be the fire situation. According to the present invention, the present invention has an advantage of enabling the visually impaired person to recognize whether a fire has occurred before recognizing the heat or smoke caused by the fire even if a fire breaks out in a situation where being alone and there are no other people around, and enabling the visually impaired person to be safe from the risk of fire due to the accuracy of fire detection being high.
abstract_ko:
시각 장애인을 위한 스마트 안경을 이용한 화재 감지 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따르면, 화재 장면에 대한 빅데이터를 이용하여 화재 장면에 대한 머신 러닝을 수행하고, 스마트 안경으로부터 수신된 촬상 영상을 수신하여, 수신된 촬상 영상을 이용하여 화재 상황인지 여부를 판단하고, 화재 상황으로 판단되는 경우 스마트 안경으로 화재 상황임을 알리는 알림을 전송한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 주변에 다른 사람이 없이 혼자 있는 상황에서 화재가 발생하는 경우에도 화재로 인한 열이나 연기를 인식하기 전에 화재의 발생 여부를 시각 장애인이 인지할 수 있게 하고, 화재 감지 정확도가 높아 시각 장애인이 화재 위험으로부터 안전할 수 있는 장점이 있다.
assignees: UNIV GACHON IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: disaster and safety urgent alarm method for the hearing-impaired
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a disaster safety emergency notification method for a hearing-impaired person that enables the hearing-impaired person to easily and accurately recognize a current disaster situation during the day as well as at night while sleeping indoors. The disaster safety emergency notification method for the hearing-impaired person comprises: a step of transmitting, by a home gateway installed in a home wherein the hearing-impaired person resides, to a smart display installed in the home of the hearing impaired person, a smart lamp with multiple colors, and a smart pillow that generates vibrations, after parsing disaster information received from an external disaster safety management server through a wired or wireless communication network; a step of displaying a pictogram corresponding to a disaster content and disaster level included in the disaster information when the smart display that normally functions as a digital photo album receives the disaster information; a step of driving, by the smart lamp, a lamp of a color corresponding to a disaster level included in the disaster information; and a step of generating, by the smart pillow, a vibration.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 각종 재난 발생시 청각장애인의 주거지에 설치된 댁내 게이트웨이를 통해 이와 유/무선 통신으로 연결되어 진동을 발생하는 스마트 베개, 재난 등급별로 점등되는 복수의 다색 램프 및 다양한 재난 정보를 즉각 인지할 수 있는 픽토그램을 표시하는 스마트 디스플레이를 적절히 동작시킴으로써 주간은 물론 실내 야간 취침시에도 청각장애인이 쉽고도 정확하게 현재의 재난 상황을 인지할 수 있도록 한 청각장애인 재난안전 긴급 알림 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 청각장애인 재난안전 긴급 알림 방법은 청각장애인이 거주하는 댁내에 설치된 댁내 게이트웨이가 유무선 통신 네트워크를 통해 외부의 재난안전 관리서버로부터 수신하여 파싱한 재난 정보를 청각장애인이 거주하는 댁내에 설치된 스마트 디스플레이, 복수 색상으로 이루어진 스마트 램프 및 진동을 발생하는 스마트 베개에 전송하는 단계; 평상시 디지털 포토 앨범으로 동작하는 스마트 디스플레이가 재난 정보를 수신한 경우 재난 정보에 포함된 재난 내용 및 재난 등급에 대응하는 픽토그램을 디스플레이하는 단계; 스마트 램프가 재난 정보에 포함된 재난 등급에 대응하는 색상의 램프를 구동하는 단계 및 스마트 베개가 진동을 발생시키는 단계를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Night early warning device for split gaps in highway bridge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a night early warning device for a split gap in a highway bridge, which comprises a solid early warning module and a flashing lamp, wherein a pyroelectric infrared sensor is arranged on one side surface of a shell, a Fresnel lens is covered outside the pyroelectric infrared sensor, a solar power supply plate is adhered to the top of the shell, a photoresistor is arranged above the solar power supply plate, and an energy storage battery, the pyroelectric infrared sensor, the photoresistor and the solar power supply plate can be electrically connected with a single chip. The device can monitor pedestrians close to the split gap area in the high-speed bridge in real time, provide early warning information for the split gap position in the bridge at night, warn drivers and passengers who blindly cross the split gap position in the bridge, and achieve the effect of preventing and reducing the occurrence of bridge falling accidents; the early warning device has the advantages of small power consumption, good concealment, low price and strong practicability, and can have the effects of economy and practicability.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUALU TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Online monitoring device for early warning of line stay wire for preventing external breakage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an online early warning device for preventing an external break of a line wire, which comprises a box body, wherein a wireless transmission device and a containing ring groove are fixedly arranged in the box body, a control board and a plurality of warning lamps are arranged on the outer side of the box body, a wire penetrates into the box body through the cooperation of a moving assembly and the moving board, a motor is started to adjust the positions of two groups of mounting rods, then an electric telescopic rod is started, the moving board is adjusted to a proper position, the axes between the two groups of mounting rods and the moving board are on the same horizontal line, the position of the wire can be accurately detected by an electronic horizontal sensor in the wire pulling process, the diameter of the inside of the ring groove can be adjusted, a signal is transmitted to the control board through the arrangement of the warning lamps and the warning lamps, the control board can control the warning lamps to flash, the warning lamps start sounding to remind approaching objects, and the warning function is achieved when the infrared sensor detects that the foreign objects are approaching.
assignees: TONGLIAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;KAILU COUNTY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID INNER MONGOLIA EASTERN POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Alarm device for quickly and accurately positioning smoke and fire based on transmission visualization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission line protection, in particular to a smoke and fire rapid and accurate positioning alarm device based on power transmission visualization, which comprises a shell, wherein a smoke and fire detection alarm system is arranged in the shell, one end of the smoke and fire detection alarm system penetrates through the outside of the shell, and one end of the shell is fixedly connected with a protection device; the self-cleaning protection mechanism can separate dust from the image acquisition module, so that the image acquisition module always operates in a clean environment, and when dust on the surface of the self-cleaning protection mechanism is accumulated to a specified amount, the controller can control the self-cleaning protection mechanism to automatically complete cleaning, the structure of cleaning operation is always in a blind area of the image acquisition module in the operation process of the self-cleaning protection mechanism, and the protection structure of the self-cleaning protection mechanism is always covered at an observation port, so that the shooting view angle of the image acquisition module is not blocked, and the whole smoke and fire detection alarm system can operate in real time.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Vehicle-mounted blind area millimeter wave radar with built-in Bluetooth communication debugging function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted blind zone millimeter wave radar with built-in Bluetooth communication debugging, which comprises a shell, a millimeter wave radar PCBA main board, an in-vehicle alarm device and intelligent terminal equipment, wherein the millimeter wave radar PCBA main board is arranged in the shell, the shell comprises an upper cover and a bottom shell, the millimeter wave radar PCBA main board is arranged between the upper cover and the bottom shell, the millimeter wave radar PCBA main board is connected with the in-vehicle alarm device through a wire harness, and the millimeter wave radar PCBA main board is connected with the intelligent terminal equipment through wireless. The millimeter wave radar PCBA main board comprises a Bluetooth module, an attitude sensor, a radar main control unit, a power supply unit, a CAN transceiver and a detection input/control output circuit, wherein the radar main control unit is communicated with the Bluetooth module through a UART, and the Bluetooth module is connected with intelligent terminal equipment in a wireless Bluetooth communication mode. The vehicle-mounted blind area millimeter wave radar can be accurately installed and rapidly debugged through the built-in Bluetooth and attitude sensor, different vehicle installation environments and detection areas can be flexibly configured, and the detection target visualization can be realized.
assignees: CHANGSHA MICROBRAIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for differently abled persons
abstract_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for disabled and/or differently abled persons are disclosed. Upon receiving an alert message, the system translates the alert message to an audio message (text to speech) when the text to speech feature is enabled. In some implementations, the system waits fora threshold period of time (e.g., 30 seconds) to receive a user acknowledgment of the alert message, and translates the alert message to an audio message if no acknowledgment is received within this time. The user acknowledgment can be received via a selection of an option (e.g., by clicking an “OK” button) and/or via an audio option (e.g., by saying “Ok, received”) when the text to speech feature is enabled. The system then outputs (e.g., reads out loud) the translated message so that the disabled or differently abled persons can be informed of the emergency situation. After outputting the translated message, the system can further wait for a user acknowledgment of the translated audio message.

title_en: Automatic guiding method for emergency plan
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic guiding method for an emergency plan, and relates to the field of hospital area safety emergency management. The emergency plan automatic guiding method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an end sensor, a data information monitoring input module, an equipment maintenance module, an alarm rule engine module, an alarm management module, an emergency plan management module, a dispatching terminal module and an alarm situation studying and judging module, wherein the end sensor monitors and uploads an environment or an object; the data information monitoring input module processes, translates and uploads data. The paper version emergency plan is electronized, so that the daily safety guard management of units or institutions is met, when dangerous situations are in burst, the resource processing alarm requirements are coordinated according to the guiding rules of the electronic emergency plan, the situation that how to carry out emergency processing is effectively avoided, the occurrence of processing alarm time events is delayed, and the units or institutions are helped to effectively remove the dangerous situations.

title_en: Wisdom access & exit invasion alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent entrance intrusion alarm system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent entrance intrusion alarms and comprises an entrance body, wherein the outer surface of the upper end of the entrance body is provided with a controller and a warning lamp, two groups of first fixing frames are symmetrically arranged on the outer surface of the front side of the entrance body, a transmission rod is arranged between the two groups of first fixing frames, one end of the transmission rod is provided with a motor, the outer wall of the transmission rod is provided with a movable frame, the lower end of the movable frame is provided with a first connecting frame, the two ends of the first connecting frame are provided with first air cylinders, the lower end of the first air cylinders is provided with a second connecting frame, a screw rod is arranged in the second connecting frame, one end of the screw rod is provided with a wiping rod, and the lower end of the first connecting frame is provided with a camera body. According to the camera body, the camera body and other structures are arranged, so that the position of the camera body can be moved, and the occurrence of monitoring blind areas is prevented.
assignees: HUNAN BOEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent anti-pinch alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent anti-pinch alarm device, which belongs to the field of anti-pinch alarm equipment, and comprises a main barrier machine, wherein the upper end and the lower end of the left side of the main barrier machine are respectively provided with a main rod in a rotating way, the inner side of the main rod is provided with a plurality of auxiliary rods in a distributed way, the cleaning cloth is arranged on the two sides of the plurality of auxiliary rods, the left cleaning cloth is positioned above a linear light source, the right cleaning cloth is positioned below a photoresistor, when the main rod and the auxiliary rods are lifted, the main rod is lifted upwards by taking the joint of the main barrier machine as the center of a circle and drives the plurality of auxiliary rods to translate and shrink, and before the main rod and the auxiliary rods are completely contracted, the surfaces of the photoresistor and the linear light source are rubbed with the cleaning cloth, so that the cleaning cloth can automatically complete the cleaning of the photoresistor and the linear light source when the main rod and the auxiliary rods are lifted, the cleaning cost of the photoresistor and the linear light source can be reduced, and the maintenance of the photoresistor and the linear light source can be automatically completed, and the use effect and safety of the intelligent anti-pinch alarm device are improved.
assignees: NANJING XIAOYU ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency exit guide and guidance broadcast speaker
abstract_en: A speaker for emergency guidance includes: a front case (10) in which a speaker unit (20), a transformer (30), and a circuit board (17) are mounted, and in which a plurality of sound emission holes (11) are formed; and an emergency light (40) which is mounted on the outer surface of the front case (10) and is operated to blink by the control of the circuit board (17) in the event of an emergency. The present invention can effectively deal with evacuation by providing guidance and evacuation broadcasts through the speaker.
abstract_ko:

용하는 것으로, 보다 상세히는 스피커의 전면케이스 외부면에 비상조명이 구비되어 화재와 같은 비상사태

title_en: Intelligent power metering box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent power metering box, and belongs to the technical field of power metering boxes. The device comprises a box body, an outer box door, an inner box door, a coded lock, a magnetic lock, a first infrared device, a controller, a drying tank, a second infrared device, a timer, a camera, an alarm device and a user side; the timer is internally provided with a time value for periodically replacing the drying agent, when the timing time reaches the replacement time, the controller can send information to the user side to remind the user of replacing the drying agent, and the drying agent can be periodically replaced to enhance the dehumidification effect and prevent the equipment operation from being influenced by the humidity in the box body; the box is equipped with outer chamber door and interior chamber door, when the illegal personnel illegally opened outer chamber door, the controller would control alarm device and report to the police, stops illegal personnel to continue to destroy the box, simultaneously sends the information to the user side, and the user side accessible camera looks over the environment around the box and sees clearly the trouble-making person, and the device can report to the police after outer chamber door is destroyed and inform the user, avoids causing bigger loss.

title_en: Dangerous area construction progress management system
abstract_en: The invention designs a construction progress management system for a dangerous area, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data display module and an auxiliary function module; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data display module and an auxiliary functional module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises an environment data acquisition sub-module, an equipment operation data acquisition sub-module, a personnel working data acquisition sub-module and a safety monitoring sub-module, the data processing module comprises a data analysis sub-module and an early warning sub-module, the data display module comprises a monitoring interface module and a progress management interface module, the auxiliary functional module comprises a personnel management module, a material management module, a system control module, a data storage and backup module, a training and guiding module, a multilingual support module and an emergency response module, and the system can effectively integrate information resources of different departments and links, break information island phenomenon and improve the efficiency and accuracy of information transmission and sharing.
assignees: SICHUAN MINGXING NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building fire safety precaution equipment
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a building fire-fighting safety early warning device, which comprises a base, wherein a barrel is rotationally arranged on the end surface of the bottom of the base, a camera is rotationally arranged on one side of the barrel, a plurality of water spray heads are arranged on the end surface of the bottom of the barrel, a plurality of water storage rings are arranged outside the water spray heads, a water supply assembly is arranged on one side of the water storage rings, a throwing barrel is rotationally arranged on one side of the water supply assembly, a fire extinguishing ball is filled in the throwing barrel, an arc surface seat capable of falling outwards is arranged in the arc surface of the fire extinguishing ball, and an induction alarm is arranged in the arc surface seat: through throwing in section of thick bamboo and fire ball and sprinkler bead and water storage ring setting for equipment accessible sprinkler bead is accomplished the processing of putting out a fire of local position, when the condition of a fire lasts seriously, not only can throw in inductive alarm to the position that has put out a fire, makes outside personnel can know fast, ensures the alarm effect, still can protect the processing to the equipment body, the condition that the effectual inside primordial qi piece of reduction equipment damaged appears.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JIANHONG CONSTRUCTION ENG TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Panoramic vision-based intelligent target identification method and device for distribution network overhead line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a panoramic vision-based intelligent target identification method and device for a distribution network overhead line, comprising the following steps: based on the multi-physical field simulation environment, constructing a multi-dimensional and full-range power distribution area simulation environment; building a visual monitoring device model in a multi-dimensional simulation environment; and (3) carrying out multifunctional integration on the multi-ocular integrated design and image target identification. The device comprises a calculation module, a three-eye high-definition night vision lens, a one-machine integrated temperature and humidity sensor, a loudspeaker and a microphone; and the three-eye high-definition night vision lens is used for intelligently monitoring the information of the double-side line and the surrounding environment of the overhead line in real time and performing wide-angle monitoring on the tower foundation of the tower. The invention ensures all-weather online intelligent monitoring through a video image artificial intelligent recognition algorithm, and can recognize functions of construction machinery vehicles, wire foreign matters, forest fires, smoke and the like in a line channel side and surrounding environment in real time and synchronously upload event alarms.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Method to provide fire information for hearing-impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for identifying a hearing-impaired person based on an image photographed by a cctv when a fire occurs, and providing fire information to the hearing-impaired person. according to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for providing fire information to a hearing-impaired person comprises the steps of: obtaining a sensing value from a fire detection sensor to determine whether a fire occurs; identifying a hearing-impaired person based on an image photographed by a cctv when it is determined that a fire occurs; and outputting a warning signal to a terminal of the hearing-impaired person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생 시 CCTV에 촬영된 영상에 기초하여 청각장애인을 식별하고, 청각장애인에게 화재정보를 제공하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 청각장애인에게 화재정보를 제공하는 방법은 화재 감지 센서로부터 센싱값을 획득하여 화재 발생여부를 판단하는 단계, 화재가 발생하였다고 판단되면, CCTV에서 촬영된 영상에 기초하여 청각장애인을 식별하는 단계, 상기 청각장애인 단말에 경고신호를 출력하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: FOUND RES & BUSINESS SEOUL NAT UNIV SCI & TECH

title_en: GNSS ground disaster monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides GNSS ground disaster monitoring equipment, wherein a radio frequency channel module processes GNSS electric signals into digital intermediate frequency signals; the baseband processing module is connected with the radio frequency channel module and is used for processing the digital intermediate frequency signal sent by the radio frequency channel module to obtain GNSS measurement data; the RDSS short message module is connected with the baseband processing module, and is connected with the Beidou RDSS integrated machine to transmit GNSS measurement data to the ground disaster monitoring and early warning system; the storage module is connected with the baseband processing module and at least stores GNSS measurement data of the baseband processing module. According to the utility model, the storage module is used for storing GNSS measurement data, the Beidou RDSS integrated machine connected through the RDSS short message module is communicated with satellites, so that the phenomenon that GNSS excessively depends on a base station is avoided, and the communication blind area in a remote area does not influence GNSS geological monitoring of GNSS ground disaster monitoring equipment.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCE NATURAL RESOURCES DEPT;CRSC ENG GROUP CO LTD;CETC XINGHE BEIDOU TECH XIAN CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for life safety monitoring and rescue
abstract_en: The application discloses a life safety monitoring and rescuing method, system, equipment and medium, which are based on a wireless ad hoc network technology, form a network topology structure by a dynamic ad hoc network protocol, divide the area where a neighbor terminal node is located into a first area, a second area, a third area and a fourth area which extend towards four directions based on traffic distribution of the place where the target terminal node is located, avoid rescuing personnel from being delayed due to congestion, ensure the timeliness of rescuing, divide the neighbor terminal node of each area into a first ladder, a second ladder and a third ladder, and participate in batches by the rescuing personnel so as to save manpower resources. The on-site environment is subjected to environment safety early warning and the life body is subjected to life body health early warning, so that rescue personnel are prevented from blindly performing rescue, and further, the environment data and the life body sign data are combined to judge the living state of the life body in the current environment, so that a more targeted rescue plan is formulated, and the rescue success rate is improved.

title_en: Railway disaster simulation evaluation deduction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway disaster simulation evaluation deduction method and a system, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster early warning, and are used for constructing and managing a railway disaster scenario chain library, a prevention and control strategy library and a risk evaluation algorithm library, and simultaneously establishing a disaster scenario chain, an evaluation analysis algorithm and a prevention and control strategy evaluation system; the railway disaster monitoring data are subjected to risk assessment analysis of railway meteorological environment, infrastructure state, foreign matter intrusion conditions and the like by utilizing a risk assessment algorithm component; carrying out deduction prediction based on a disaster scenario chain according to the disaster with higher risk level in the evaluation analysis module, and recommending a corresponding prevention and control strategy; and evaluating the disaster scenario chain, the evaluation analysis algorithm and the prevention and control strategy based on the evaluation component, and continuously optimizing the simulation evaluation deduction method and the system. The method effectively fills the blank of railway disaster risk assessment and deduction prediction capability, improves the railway disaster deduction prediction and risk prevention and control capability, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Monitoring equipment with smoke sensing function for fire control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of household kitchens and discloses a fire-fighting monitoring device with smoke sensing, which comprises a mounting box, a smoke sensor, a cross-shaped rotating plate and a camera, wherein a rotary telescopic mechanism for driving the cross-shaped rotating plate to rotate and translate is arranged at the lower end of the mounting box, a rotating mechanism capable of adjusting the angle of the camera is arranged on the cross-shaped rotating plate, the camera is arranged on the rotating mechanism, and the smoke sensor is arranged on the mounting box. According to the utility model, the smoke sensor is arranged on the mounting box, when the rear end monitoring equipment is unattended during fire occurrence, the smoke sensor can timely detect and give out an alarm when smoke or flame appears, fire extinguishing measures are carried out as soon as the fire occurs, and when the monitoring camera works, the smoke sensor can timely regulate the direction and the angle when detecting the smoke, and the fire occurrence part is captured at the first time through the arrangement of the first driving motor and the second driving motor.
assignees: ZHUHAI VCARECITY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and alarming method for monitoring line external damage disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring alarm method for monitoring a line damage disaster, which belongs to the technical field of line damage monitoring and comprises the following steps: carrying out transmission line image difference analysis through a remote video module; the radar module is used for monitoring foreign object invasion and preventing false bird interference; the solar panel and the storage battery are managed through the power module, so that charge and discharge control between the solar panel and the storage battery is realized, and the working state of a system of the solar panel and the storage battery is reported to the host in real time; and the information transmission module is used for interacting with an external system. The invention can realize the monitoring and alarming of the power transmission line for preventing the damage of external force, and the system can work stably and efficiently by combining the radar video module, the power module, the information transmission module and the alarming module and connecting the modules through a wireless network.
assignees: BEIXIANG COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Converting ATSC 3.0-based Disaster Information into Media Content
title_ko: Atsc 3.0 기반의 재난정보를 미디어 콘텐츠로 변환하기위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and device for converting ATSC 3.0-based disaster information into media content. According to one aspect of the present disclosure, the device for converting disaster information comprises: an extraction module for extracting text related to a disaster from an alarm message; a content generation module for extracting feature data from the text, and generating media content for a person who is vulnerable to disaster information by using the text and the feature data, wherein the media content includes at least one of sign language content, voice content, and image content; and a signaling module for generating signaling information for transmitting the media content to a receiving terminal.
abstract_ko:
ATSC 3.0 기반의 재난정보를 미디어 콘텐츠로 변환하기위한 방법 및 장치를 개시한다. 
본 개시의 일 측면에 의하면, 경보메시지로부터 재난과 관련된 텍스트를 추출하는 추출모듈; 상기 텍스트로부터 특징 데이터를 추출하고, 상기 텍스트 및 상기 특징 데이터를 이용하여 재난정보인지 취약자를 위한 미디어 콘텐츠를 생성하는 콘텐츠 생성모듈 - 상기 미디어 콘텐츠는, 수어 콘텐츠, 음성 콘텐츠 및 영상 콘텐츠 중 하나 이상을 포함함 -; 및 상기 미디어 콘텐츠를 수신 단말에 전송하기 위한 시그널링 정보를 생성하는 시그널링 모듈을 포함하는, 재난정보 변환장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted intelligent anti-collision early warning triangular warning board
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vehicle-mounted intelligent anticollision early warning triangle warning sign, includes the triangle tablet, and triangle tablet front end is equipped with the stroboscopic lamp area, and triangle tablet front end still is equipped with collision sensor, and triangle tablet rear end is equipped with positioning module and communication module, and communication module signal connection has the shoulder lamp, is equipped with the receiver on the shoulder lamp, and the collision signal is received to the receiver, is equipped with bee calling organ on the shoulder lamp, is equipped with the lamp pearl on the shoulder lamp, bee calling organ and lamp pearl respectively with receiver signal connection. The device carries out visual reminding through the stroboscopic lamp area for the rear driving, still transmits the accident site to the navigation platform through the positioning module, makes the rear vehicle in time predict the risk, even the rear vehicle is not noticed and still collides the triangle tablet, the accident personnel can also predict the risk in advance in the place ahead, the secondary incidence of accident is reduced through the combination of multiple modes, traffic management department also accessible security protection applet monitoring accident handling condition in time provides the rescue guarantee.
assignees: GS UNIS INTELLIGENT TRANSP SYSTEM & CONTROL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Integrated acousto-optic alarm anchor rod cable stress sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stress sensors, in particular to an integrated audible and visual alarm anchor rod rope stress sensor, which comprises a sensor body and a butt joint mechanism, wherein the butt joint mechanism comprises a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, an inserting piece is arranged on the first connecting piece, a positioning piece matched with the inserting piece is arranged on the second connecting piece, the integrated audible and visual alarm anchor rod rope stress sensor also comprises a locking component, the locking component comprises a clamping piece, an abutting piece is arranged on the positioning piece, the clamping piece abuts against the abutting piece, a movable piece is arranged in the abutting piece, a translation piece matched with the movable piece is arranged in the positioning piece, and an unlocking piece is also arranged in the locking component.
assignees: SHANDONG XINWEI INTELLIGENT CONTROL MINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Train operation line environment early warning system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a train operation line environment early warning system and application thereof, wherein the early warning system comprises: the line environment early warning ground equipment is used for meteorological monitoring, earthquake monitoring, landslide collapse monitoring, flooding monitoring, bridge displacement monitoring and foreign matter intrusion monitoring; the line early warning vehicle-mounted equipment receives basic information of the whole operation line environment, weather information of a line to be operated in front, geological disaster early warning, train operation plan information, train control information and vehicle state, comprehensively analyzes danger early warning or warning in front of a train, the state of the train and train control vehicle-mounted ATP protection operation curve information, and gives an optimal mode for assisting train driving through expert system analysis. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of greatly reducing potential safety hazards of train operation caused by dangerous factors such as severe weather, geological disasters and the like.

title_en: Voice recognition and broadcasting circuit of electric vehicle charging gun
abstract_en: The utility model provides a voice recognition and broadcasting circuit of an electric vehicle charging gun, and relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging guns. According to the utility model, the original light indication system of the mode two charging gun is supplemented by the voice technology, so that a user can remotely control the opening and closing of the charging circuit through voice, the problem of complicated operation of the user is solved, and the operation time of the user is greatly shortened; this product still accessible voice broadcast information makes the user need not to observe the light scintillation, can know current charge state comprehensively, when the charging process goes wrong, lets the user know the risk fast through audible and visual alarm, gives the user more response time, quick selection coping mode to reduce the loss.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUANYU NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bend blind area vehicle meeting warning system and method combining vehicle meeting warning and linear induction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-crossing warning system and method for a curve blind zone combining vehicle-crossing warning and linear induction, comprising a vehicle-crossing warning unit, a linear induction unit and a cloud platform, wherein the vehicle-crossing warning unit and the linear induction unit are connected with the cloud platform in a wireless mode for data interaction, the vehicle-crossing warning unit is responsible for collecting vehicle-crossing information, and the linear induction unit can receive a control instruction sent by the cloud platform and the vehicle-crossing information collected by the vehicle-crossing warning unit. The invention changes the outline mark from uncontrolled to controlled state, combines the controlled double-sided outline mark with the road meeting warning device, combines the audible and visual warning and the vehicle track warning in advance, has more sustainable warning effect, and can effectively reduce the occurrence of vehicle accidents.
assignees: JIANGSU POLICE INST;NANJING RUIMIN TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent switch cabinet foreign matter detection early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent switch cabinet foreign matter detection and early warning device, which comprises: the intelligent electronic device comprises a rectangular insulating shell, an information acquisition module, an information processing module, a power module, a wireless communication module, an audible and visual alarm module and a compensation illumination lamp, wherein the information processing module and the wireless communication module are integrated on a core circuit board, the core circuit board is arranged inside the rectangular insulating shell, and the information acquisition module, the power module, the audible and visual alarm module and the compensation illumination lamp are electrically connected to the core circuit board through wires. According to the intelligent switch cabinet foreign matter detection early warning device, foreign matters intruding into the switch cabinet can be automatically detected, detection data are uploaded to the service terminal through the wireless communication module, and an alarm is sent out through the audible and visual alarm module to remind a worker of processing when abnormality is detected, so that the operation reliability of the switch cabinet is improved. Meanwhile, the utility model considers the influence of the detection blind area, improves the efficiency of detecting the foreign matters of the switch cabinet, and reduces the workload of maintenance personnel.

title_en: Ship automatic broadcasting system
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an inboard automatic broadcasting system capable of clearly transmitting warning information from a long distance through a communication network without noise, and allowing a sailor to recognize and cope with a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source when an alarm is generated and to avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape by allowing a converted digital voice signal to include accident occurrence source information, corresponding emergency zone information, corresponding dangerous situation information, countermeasure instruction information, and emergency escape information. The inboard automatic broadcasting system comprises: a sensor unit; a monitoring server; an inboard broadcasting server; a plurality of IP speakers; an inboard network broadcasting unit; and a TCP/IP-based communication network, thereby replacing any one of the IP speaker and the analog speaker in case of an error thereon to propagate an emergency situation. According to the present invention, when an alarm is generated, a sailor can recognize and respond to a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source and avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape, and a network-based system can enable inboard broadcasting through satellite communication even on land.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 항해정보와 환경정보와 모션정보와 선내상황정보를 계측하는 센서부(110), 계측값을 모니터링하고 분석하여 경고정보를 생성하는 모니터링서버(120), 이벤트신호에 따라 네트워크 제어 음원소스(137)를 추출하여 TTS 프로그램 모듈(138)을 통해 경고정보를 디지털음성신호로 변환하는 디지털음성변환모듈(139)로 구성되어, 스케쥴방송과 마이크방송과 전화방송에 해당하는 디지털음성신호 및 경고정보에 해당하는 디지털음성신호를 비상구역정보에 포함된 해당 방송구역 또는 콜 스테이션(134)에 의해 선택된 해당 방송구역으로 전송하는, 선내 방송 서버(130), 선내 방송 서버(130)에 연결되어 디지털음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 IP 스피커(140), 증폭된 음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 아날로그 스피커(153)로 구성되는, 선내 네트워크 방송부(150), 및 센서부(110)와 모니터링 서버(120) 사이, 모니터링 서버(120)와 선내 방송 서버(130) 사이, 선내 방송 서버(130)와 IP 스피커(140) 사이, 및 선내 방송 서버(130)와 선내 네트워크 방송부(150) 사이를 유무선 네트워크로 연결하는 TCP/IP 기반의 통신망(160);을 포함하여, IP 스피커(140) 또는 아날로그 스피커(153) 중 어느 하나의 오류시에 대체하여 노이즈없이 비상상황을 전파하도록 하는, 선내 자동 방송 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Ship fire monitoring system using drones
title_ko: 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a ship fire surveillance system using a drone. A ship fire surveillance system using a drone includes: an access point; a plurality of drones that fly over blind spots of multiple CCTV cameras in an autonomous ship and perform filming to create images of the blind spots; an alarm generator that generates audible and visual fire alarms; and a controller that performs communication with multiple drones through the access point, sets flight paths of multiple drones so that multiple drones fly over blind spots and perform filming to acquire images of the blind spots, determines whether a fire has occurred through image analysis of the acquired images of the blind spots, and controls the alarm generator to generate a fire alarm if it is determined that a fire has occurred.
abstract_ko: 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템이 개시된다. 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템은, 액세스 포인트, 자율운항선박 내에서 복수의 CCTV 카메라의 사각지역을 비행하면서 촬영을 수행하여 사각지역 영상을 생성하는 복수의 드론, 화재경보를 청각적 및 시각적으로 발생시키는 경보 발생기 및 액세스 포인트를 통해 복수의 드론과 통신을 수행하고, 복수의 드론이 사각지역을 비행하면서 촬영을 수행하도록 복수의 드론의 비행경로를 설정하여 사각지역 영상을 획득하고, 획득된 사각지역 영상에 대한 영상분석을 통해 화재발생 여부를 판단하고, 판단 결과, 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단한 경우, 경보 발생기가 화재경보를 발생시키도록 제어하는 제어기를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire extinguisher for the blind
abstract_en: Provided is a fire extinguisher for a blind person, which comprises: a flame reaction sensor for detecting a fire in a direction to which a hose head is directed; an infrared sensor for detecting an obstacle in the direction to which the hose head is oriented; an alarm sound generator for generating an alarm sound according to the flame reaction sensor; a vibration handle vibrated according to the infrared sensor; a lever for spraying a fire extinguishing agent; a body for storing the fire extinguishing agent; a handle on which the flame reaction sensor, the infrared sensor, and the lever are mounted; and a hose for connecting the body and the handle. The fire extinguisher for a blind person according to the present invention has an effect of effectively suppressing the fire by accurately informing a blind person of the position of the fire through sound and vibration by mounting a flame detection sensor. In addition, the fire extinguisher has an effect of enabling smooth movement by informing the blind person of an obstacle in the process of using the fire extinguisher in the event of a fire by mounting an infrared sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화기에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 시각 장애인이 화재 발생 시 소화기로 앞의 장애물의 유무를 적외선 센서를 통해 판단하고, 화재를 불꽃 감지 센서로 감지해 화재의 위치에 소화기를 분사할 수 있도록 하는 소화기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent early warning, prevention and control device for mechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent early warning, prevention and control device for mechanical equipment, which comprises: the intelligent mechanical early warning system comprises an early warning monitoring device, an audible and visual alarm and a display, wherein the early warning monitoring device is arranged at the top of the cockpit, and the audible and visual alarm is arranged on the surface of a body of the crane. The intelligent mechanical early warning system is arranged on the crane body and consists of a BSD camera, a display and an audible and visual alarm, wherein the system can preset the working radius range, and the BSD camera is used for collecting personnel information in the working radius range; when personnel enter the working radius range, the audible and visual alarm warns to drive away the entering personnel, and the visual blind area of the driver is developed through the assistance of the display, the driver is prompted to operate carefully through the alarm, the safety of mechanical operation is improved through double warning, and the risk of mechanical injury is reduced.
assignees: QINGDAO MUNICIPAL CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Railway line foreign matter intrusion monitoring alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foreign matter intrusion monitoring alarm device along a railway, which belongs to the technical field of railway alarm devices and aims at the problem of railway operation safety, and the device comprises a data acquisition and processing device and a core control unit, wherein the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with the core control unit, the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with a control center and a monitoring center through the core control unit, the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with alarm equipment and drives the alarm equipment after data analysis, and the alarm equipment is reserved to be electrically connected with a driving warning and a working warning; the method mainly aims at sudden dangerous situations such as collapse of tunnel openings, landslide, falling rocks, entrance and exit of wild animals and the like, realizes an advanced forecasting function through corresponding data processing of an early warning platform by means of technologies such as online monitoring and early warning, ensures railway operation safety, has the characteristics of high alarm accuracy, zero missing report and the like, and provides technical guarantee for driving safety of high-risk road sections.
assignees: SHANXI DAQIN TIANCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with emergency medicine storage box and emergency call method using the same
title_ko: 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기 및 그를 이용한 응급비상호출 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with an emergency medicine storage box, and an emergency call method using the same, wherein the emergency pager is linked to a smartphone and allows users to request assistance through emergency calls to acquaintances, public officials in public institutions or fire stations through the smartphone without separate equipment like repeaters or gateways. Provided is a portable emergency pager (100), which includes: an emergency medicine storage box (180) which has upper and lower surfaces each formed in a semicircular shape, and is configured to store emergency medicine at the bottom thereof; a volume output unit (110) for producing a warning sound, a call button (120) for emergency calls, and a call cancel button (140) for call cancel which are configured to be exposed to a front cover (101) of the portable emergency pager (100); and a charging indication LED (160) for notifying the charging status and a charging port (170) which are configured to be located on the side of the portable emergency call device (100). The portable emergency call device (100) is paired with a smartphone via Bluetooth, and when the call button (120) for emergency calls is pressed, the device is configured to sound a warning sound through the volume output unit (110) and transmit the GPS information of the paired smartphone to a plurality of pre-set contacts to request rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기본적으로는 응급약을 보관하면서도 응급이나 비상상황 시 주변에 도움을 요청할 수 있는 경고음을 출력하도록 하면서도 스마트폰과 연동되어 중계기나 게이트웨이등 별도 장비없이도 스마트폰을 통해 지인이나 공공기관의 공무원이나 소방서 등에 도움을 응급비상호출을 통해 도움을 요청할 수 있으며, 시각장애인을 위한 점자표를 각인하여 시각장애인들도 유용하게 이용할 수 있고, 상시휴대가 가능한 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기 및 그를 이용한 응급비상호출 방법에 관한 것이다.  이러한 본 발명은 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기로써, 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기는, 상부면와 하부면은 각각 반원형 형태로 구성되고, 저면부에는 응급약을 보관하도록 구성된 응급약 보관함(180); 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기의 전면에 노출되도록 구성된 것으로, 경고음을 출력하는 음량 송출부(110), 비상호출을 위한 호출버튼(120) 및 호출취소를 위한 호출취소 버튼(140); 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기의 측면에 구성되는 것으로 충전표시를 알리는 충전표시 LED(160) 및 충전포트(170); 스마트폰과 블루투스 페어링되어 상기 비상호출을 위한 호출버튼(120)이 눌려지는 경우 상기 음량 송출부(110)를 통해 경고음을 송출함과 함께 미리 설정된 복수의 연락처로 상기 페어링된 스마트폰의 GPS 정보를 송출하여 구조를 요청하는 것을 특징으로 하는 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기를 제공한다.

title_en: Strong and weak electricity integrated building equipment control cabinet
abstract_en: The application provides a strong and weak electricity integrated building equipment control cabinet which comprises a control cabinet body, wherein a radiating device is arranged on the side wall of the control cabinet body, an anti-collision buffer device and an alarm device are fixedly arranged on the control cabinet body, a waterproof plate and a rubber plate are fixedly arranged at the top of the control cabinet body, and alarm lamps are arranged around the control cabinet body; the electric appliance control cabinet is safer in protection, if a high-altitude falling object is crashed and falls on the top rubber plate of the electric appliance control cabinet to protect and play a role in buffering, the controller is not damaged, when a large-scale vehicle is backed up, even if a worker encounters a vision blind area and cannot see the vision blind area, if the vehicle bumps the anti-collision buffer device to a certain position, the alarming device is triggered to remind the worker, even if the worker does not see the vision blind area, property loss cannot be caused, and the heat dissipation device is arranged, so that short circuit cannot occur due to overhigh temperature, and the service life of the electric appliance control cabinet is prolonged.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCE INSTITUTE OF ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RES

title_en: Novel functional fire prevention valve actuating mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel functional fire-proof valve actuating mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of fire-proof valves. Including the main part, place the intracavity portion and be provided with the fire tank, the main part inner wall still is provided with the fire sensor, the protective housing the place ahead is provided with the alarm, the water storage chamber has been seted up to the main part inside, the joint board outer wall is provided with the exhaust fan, available fire tank cooperation fire pump and burst pipe are erupted the fire disaster area and are put out a fire, effectively control the intensity of a fire and spread, because extinguishing device's increase can improve the whole fire prevention ability of fire damper, further protect personnel life safety and property safety, and still accessible a plurality of induced draft pumps cooperation guide fan inhale inside smog or harmful gas, utilize the water pump cooperation to change fog shower nozzle and spray smog, effectually still can discharge smog when preventing that the flame from spreading, keep the ventilation situation inside the building, make things convenient for rescue personnel to evacuate and rescue to the crowd, ensure personnel's safety.

title_en: Building evacuation stairwell evacuation indication system and evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building evacuation stairwell evacuation indication system and an evacuation method, comprising a smoke detector, a temperature sensor and an electric roller shutter which are arranged at the top of each layer of evacuation stairwell, and the evacuation indicator lamps above each layer of fireproof door and in each room are connected with audible and visual alarms. According to the invention, whether smoke exists in the evacuation stairway or not is judged by the smoke detector, the evacuation indicator light indicates that smoke exists when the smoke exists, and the audible and visual alarm is used for assisting in alarming, so that the rolling curtain is lowered to the height that evacuation personnel can stop the smoke from spreading through the stairway, and the personnel can evacuate orderly under the ground projection indication of the evacuation indicator light in the stairway; when the temperature sensor detects high temperature, the evacuation indicator light indicates danger, the roller shutter is lowered to the bottommost part, smoke spreading in the evacuation stairwell is limited while personnel are prevented from entering by mistake, the personnel close the entrance door to wait for rescue in a room when the audible and visual alarm gives an alarm, the smoke of strong airflow is prevented from flowing backwards, and personnel injury caused by blind escape is reduced.
assignees: SCEGC EQUIPMENT INSTALLATION GROUP COMPANY LTD;SHAANXI CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid safety warning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of power grid alarms, in particular to a power grid safety alarm, which comprises a base and a dynamic alarm structure, wherein the dynamic alarm structure is arranged at the top of the base; the dynamic warning structure comprises a driving motor which is arranged at the top of the base at intervals, a rotating rod is arranged at the output shaft end of the driving motor, three warning signs are uniformly distributed on the surface of the rotating rod, warning slogans are arranged on two sides of each warning sign, alarms are fixedly connected with the surface of the driving motor, and the number of the alarms is four and uniformly distributed on the surface of the driving motor. The utility model discloses a power grid safety warning ware, accessible pivoted three warning sign and alarm carry out effectual warning to different positions to improve the conspicuous degree of whole alarm, reach efficient warning, compare in current warning sign, this device has and can carry out obvious warning effect to multi-direction masses.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blind crutch capable of emitting light through body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a blind crutch capable of emitting light through a whole body, which comprises a blind crutch main body, a warning component, a control module and a battery. The whole crutch body of the blind crutch provided by the invention can emit light, and can transmit audible prompts to other people by using the loudspeaker, thereby obviously improving the visibility of the blind person to the blind person user, and further greatly improving the travel safety of the blind person. The lamp strip used by the invention can emit light with various colors, and has the applicability in daytime and at night, so that the blind can travel in all weather.
assignees: SUZHOU XINXINLIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: AI algorithm blind area early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AI algorithm blind area early warning method. The method comprises the following steps of S1, image acquisition and input, S2, image detection of a target object in a road blind area needing early warning, S3, image tracking of the target object in an early warning area, S4, drawing a line parallel to the early warning area to determine a direction L1, S5, drawing an early warning area to determine an area m, S6, determining a moving direction L2 of the target object, S7, calculating an included angle theta of the L1 and the L2 and judging whether the included angle theta is larger than a threshold value C, S8, judging whether the target object is far away in an area m of the current early warning area or near the area m of the current early warning area if the target object passes through the early warning blind area, wherein the target object can be judged to be near or far away by comparing position changes of the target object in continuous frames, and sending out early warning signals if the threshold value of the target object near or far away in the early warning area reaches an early warning value, and S9, and outputting results.

title_en: Intelligent anti-collision early warning protection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent anti-collision early warning protection system, and relates to a man-vehicle anti-collision terminal applied to an operation area. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises a plurality of mobile tags, an intelligent anti-collision terminal and an engine server. The intelligent anti-collision terminal provided by the utility model integrates all functional modules, supports various communication modes, is convenient to install and is plug and play; the anti-collision early warning device realizes anti-collision early warning between the working vehicle and the working personnel, and avoids unnecessary loss caused by factors such as blind areas of the working vehicle, blocked sight of the driving personnel and the like.

title_en: Point cloud data transmission method and system for foreign matter monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a point cloud data transmission method and a system for foreign matter monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the laser radar scans initial point cloud data and subsequent point cloud data corresponding to the environment, and the data acquisition terminal correspondingly acquires the initial point cloud data and sends the initial point cloud data to the data analysis server; the data acquisition terminal correspondingly acquires subsequent point cloud data, cuts the subsequent point cloud data to obtain differential point cloud data, compresses the differential point cloud data and sends the differential point cloud data to the data analysis server; the data analysis server integrates the real-time point cloud data and sends the real-time point cloud data to the data center for storage; meanwhile, performing foreign matter analysis on the real-time point cloud data, sending an analysis result to a platform server, and performing audible and visual alarm and displaying a point cloud picture by the platform server according to the foreign matter analysis result; the data center station classifies the real-time point cloud data and analyzes the reasons of abnormal analysis results. According to the invention, through cutting and compressing the difference point cloud data, the data can be quickly, stably and efficiently transmitted, and meanwhile, the networking cost is reduced.
assignees: NANJING PAI SMART PERCEPTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing impaired person
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for a hearing-impaired person and, more specifically, to a voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for a hearing-impaired person, which converts information provided by various voices into a digital code, and converts the converted digital code into vibration at a level that the hearing-impaired person can detect, so that the hearing-impaired person can recognize voice information. According to the present invention, the voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing-impaired person enables the hearing-impaired person to equally recognize voice information with the general public in real time, thereby promoting convenience of life and, in particular, actively coping with public transportation and disaster warning. In addition, the voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing-impaired person according to the present invention utilizes vibration that can be detected by the skin of the hearing impaired person, thereby improving information recognition ability that can be easily missed by sight, and contributing to popularization with optimal expenses by using a personal smart device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 각종 음성으로 제공되는 정보들을 디지털 코드로 변환하고, 변환된 디지털 코드를 청각장애자가 감지할 수 있는 수준의 진동으로 변환하여 시정착 장애자가 음성 정보를 인식할 수 있도록 하는 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치는 청각장애자들이 음성정보를 일반인과 대등하게 실시간으로 인식할 수 있어 생활의 편리함 도모할 수 있고, 특히, 대중교통 및 재난 경보에도 능동적인 대처가 가능하다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따른 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치는 청각장애자들의 피부로 감지 가능한 진동을 활용함으로서 시각에 의한 놓치기 쉬운 정보인지능력을 개선하고, 개인 소지의 스마트기기를 활용함으로 최적의 경비로 대중화에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION SUNCHEON FIRST COLLEGE

title_en: Expressway traffic condition evaluation and early warning integrated system based on distributed optical fibers
abstract_en: The invention relates to an expressway traffic condition evaluation and early warning integrated system based on a distributed optical fiber, which comprises a sensing optical fiber, a sensor optical fiber and a sensor optical fiber, wherein the sensing optical fiber is paved along the extending direction of an expressway road to capture sound waves or vibration signals; the distributed optical fiber signal receiving assembly and the data processing module are used for receiving sound waves or vibration signals transmitted by the sensing optical fibers and processing the signals into practical information; the input end of the expressway traffic condition evaluation module receives the practical information transmitted by the distributed optical fiber signal receiving assembly and the data processing module, and the practical information is output as an expressway traffic condition evaluation result of each road section; and the expressway traffic early warning response module receives the evaluation result transmitted by the expressway traffic condition evaluation module and controls the alarm lamps on the expressway to display different colors and flashing frequencies or simultaneously give out alarm sounds according to the evaluation result. The invention is a monitoring mode which has low cost, is not influenced by external conditions such as weather and the like and has no blind area, and effectively monitors the traffic condition of the high-speed road section.
assignees: NINGBO DIGITAL TWIN DONGFANG INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Portable high-integration emergency evacuation broadcasting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable high-integration emergency evacuation broadcasting system, which comprises a portable shell, wherein the portable shell is provided with a first evacuation module and a second evacuation module; portable shell: the middle part of the front wall of the portable shell is provided with a loudspeaker, the left and right ends of the upper side of the portable shell are respectively provided with a variable focus searchlight and a super-bright explosion flash warning lamp, the bottom wall of the portable shell is provided with a storage battery, the rear wall of the portable shell is respectively provided with a wireless transmitter and a Bluetooth module, the left side of the portable shell is provided with a voice remote controller, and the voice remote controller is matched with the wireless transmitter; wherein: still include the singlechip, the singlechip is located the left side of portable shell, the input of singlechip is connected with the output electricity of battery, the output of singlechip is connected with megaphone, but varifocal searchlight and super bright explosion flash warning lamp's input electricity respectively, this portable high integration emergent evacuation broadcasting system, the system is succinct, easy operation, the function is abundant, convenient to carry, high integrated control, the multi-functional switching is realized to the accessible wireless remote control, environmental suitability is strong.
assignees: HENAN SMART TRAFFIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Train traveling disaster early warning analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of train early warning analysis, in particular to a train traveling disaster early warning analysis system, which comprises a support main rod, wherein an early warning component is arranged on one side of the support main rod, a photovoltaic component is arranged above the support main rod, a mounting component is arranged at the bottom of the support main rod, and the early warning component comprises a sleeving frame body. This disasters nature early warning analysis system that marches of train through the cooperation between parts such as installation early warning subassembly, the accessible cup joints components such as framework and terminal storehouse, can realize bearing the weight of the record camera of loop bar top and can carry out the circuit monitoring with the district that easily appears the calamity to on the terminal module in the terminal storehouse is passed through the transmission line with the record picture transmission, then terminal module can analyze the picture, realizes the rating of calamity, then shows and broadcast through display screen and the sound production stereo set in the display storehouse, has avoided the alarm part to expose in the external world for a long time, has promoted its life.
assignees: URBAN VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF SICHUAN;CHENGDU CHENGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Protective helmet for blind person based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent helmets for blind persons, and discloses a protective helmet for blind persons based on big data, which comprises an AI model, wherein the protective helmet module comprises: sensor integration module: a microprocessor integrating a high-speed GPU and an environment sensor, and collecting environment and position data; and a language interaction module: a microphone array integrating noise suppression and echo cancellation technology captures user voice, and an AI model is used for voice recognition; and an intelligent planning module: combining GPS positioning data, a map AP I and an AI model, and dynamically planning a safe and convenient route; anti-tracking security module: the camera captures a rear image, the AI face recognition algorithm recognizes and analyzes the facial expression and the behavior mode of the follower, and judges whether tracking behaviors exist or not by combining the position and time data; an emergency alert and communication module.

title_en: Fire protection facility shielding prevention alarm system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire protection facility shielding alarm system, which comprises: the radar detection system comprises a 220V power supply, an air switch, a 220V-to-12V transformer, a relay, a radar host, a detection radar and a proximity switch, wherein the 220V power supply, the air switch, the 220V-to-12V transformer and the relay are electrically connected in sequence, the relay is electrically connected with the radar host and the proximity switch respectively, and the radar host is electrically connected with a buzzer and at least one detection radar; the invention has the advantages that: by introducing the intelligent real-time monitoring device, the monitoring of the fire fighting facilities, especially the hidden areas and the easily-shielded parts, is obviously improved. The problem of the monitoring blind area that leads to because of the operation is busy has not only been effectively solved, the hidden danger that fire control facility sheltered from for a long time has been prevented, still through strengthening the cognition of on-the-spot personnel to the fire control safety, cultivated must not shelter from the consciousness of fire control facility to provide powerful support for promoting the whole safe management level of enterprise and building safe cultural environment.
assignees: CHANGCHUN FAWAY TONG YANG AUTOMOBILE COMPONENTS CO LTD

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer program for providing hazard detection notification service to people with hearing impairments
title_ko: 청각 장애인에게 위험 감지 알림 서비스를 제공하기 위한 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: According to the present disclosure, disclosed is a method for providing a dangerous situation detection notification, which comprises the steps of: receiving an auditory notification generated from the outside; identifying a situation corresponding to the auditory notification by analyzing the auditory notification; and outputting a visual notification and a tactile notification corresponding to the identified situation.
abstract_ko: 본 개시에 따르면, 위험 상황 감지 알림을 제공하는 방법으로서: 외부에서 발생하는 청각적 알림을 수신하는 단계; 상기 청각적 알림을 분석하여 상기 청각적 알림에 대응하는 상황을 식별하는 단계; 상기 식별된 상황에 대응하는 시각적 알림 및 촉각적 알림을 출력하는 단계를 포함하는, 위험 상황 감지 알림을 제공하는 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Wearing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wearing device, which comprises a shell, a processing system arranged on the shell, a camera module, a sensor module and a loudspeaker module, wherein the camera module is connected with the processing system; the camera module is used for picking up the environment image and sending the environment image to the processing system; the sensor module is used for detecting the gesture information of a wearer and the distance information between the wearing device and an object in the environment and sending the gesture information to the processing system; the processing system is used for determining action guidance and early warning according to the environment images, the gesture information and the distance information, and sending the action guidance and the early warning to a wearer through the loudspeaker module. By utilizing the utility model, accurate navigation can be provided for the blind and the use comfort of the user is improved.

title_en: Foreign matter prevention control area access control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of nuclear power maintenance and discloses foreign matter prevention control area access control equipment, which comprises a door frame, a grating module, a face recognition module, an article recognition module, a controller and an alarm module, wherein a channel for personnel to pass through is formed inside the door frame; the grating module is arranged on the inner side of the portal frame and used for judging whether personnel pass through the channel or not; the face recognition module is arranged on the door frame; the article identification module is arranged on the door frame and used for identifying articles carried by personnel; the controller is in communication connection with the grating module, the face recognition module and the article recognition module; the alarm module is in communication connection with the controller, and when a setting condition occurs, the alarm module gives an alarm to a manager, and the setting condition means that any recognition result in the face recognition module and the article recognition module does not meet a preset condition. The foreign matter prevention control area access control equipment can automatically detect whether personnel belong to authorized personnel and articles carried by the personnel, and is high in detection and reliability.

title_en: Remote control fireproof door
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fireproof doors, in particular to a remote control fireproof door which is installed in a building factory building, and comprises a fireproof door, wherein a personnel entrance is formed in the front side of the building factory building, the fireproof door is arranged on one side of the personnel entrance through a remote control mechanism, the remote control mechanism comprises a monitoring component, a driving component and an alarm component, the monitoring component is arranged in the building factory building, the driving component and the alarm component are both arranged on the front side of the building factory building, the fireproof door is fixedly arranged on the driving component, and the driving component and the alarm component are both electrically connected with the monitoring component, and the remote control mechanism has the beneficial effects that: the fire disaster emergence in the accessible monitoring assembly real-time supervision building factory building, then prevent fire door automatic movement shutoff personnel access & exit through the drive assembly drive to effectively isolated fire smoke and flame, and accessible alarm assembly in time warns external personnel, need not more intelligent device, and the cost is lower promptly, suitable popularization.
assignees: FUZHOU HUAMIN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Server cabinet with intelligent protection alarm function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a server cabinet with an intelligent protection alarm function, which belongs to the field of server cabinets, and comprises a main cabinet body, wherein a plurality of partition plates which are uniformly distributed are arranged in the main cabinet body, and a sub-frame is arranged between two adjacent partition plates; the sub-frame comprises a pair of vertical supports, a plurality of supporting plates are arranged between the pair of vertical supports, and heat exchange tubes are arranged in the supporting plates in a penetrating manner; the server main body is arranged on the supporting plate; the division board includes the main baffle, installs a pair of water conservancy diversion pipeline in the main baffle, and the closing frame is installed to the lower extreme of main baffle, and the closing frame includes the C type roof beam with a pair of perpendicular support sliding connection, and fluid regulation and control portion is installed to the bottom of the main cabinet body, through real-time supervision, realizes the comprehensive control and the warning to server main part and operational environment in the rack, and when detecting server work abnormality or operational environment abnormality, all accessible closing frame seals the server of this subregion, realizes the isolation protection of local server.

title_en: Forest fire early warning method, system and equipment based on satellite Internet of things
