abstract_en: The invention provides an image equipment displacement abnormity early warning system and method based on feature point detection, which belong to the technical field of abnormity early warning and specifically comprise the steps of carrying out feature point detection and descriptor calculation on a reference image and a current acquisition image, utilizing feature descriptors of the reference image and the current image to match to obtain image comparison image feature points, utilizing a distance function to determine feature point similarity coefficients of different comparison image feature points, utilizing the feature point similarity coefficients to carry out different comparison image feature points to match the feature points, constructing a homography matrix based on the matching feature points, extracting geometric transformation information based on the homography matrix to obtain a rotation angle, a scaling and a translation amount, and combining a preset threshold to determine whether the image equipment is deviated and send out early warning signals, thereby improving the reliability of monitoring processing.

title_en: Railway natural disaster monitoring method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for monitoring natural disasters of railways, which relate to the technical field of railway monitoring and comprise the steps of receiving infrared monitoring information of monitoring points acquired in real time by an infrared beam sensor and video monitoring information of the monitoring points acquired in real time by a monitor, wherein a plurality of the monitoring points are respectively arranged in key areas along the railways, sending the infrared monitoring information and the video monitoring information to data processing equipment through an encryption algorithm so that the data processing equipment adopts time sequence analysis to judge whether foreign matter invasion exists in the monitoring points, receiving a judging result of the data processing equipment, confirming whether an alarm signal is sent or not according to the judging result, and sending the alarm signal, the video monitoring information and the infrared monitoring information to a monitoring terminal for displaying if the alarm signal is required to be sent.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY ENG CONSULTATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent acousto-optic integrated alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent acousto-optic integrated alarm which comprises an alarm assembly and a monitoring assembly, wherein the monitoring assembly comprises a mounting plate, the bottom surface of the mounting plate is rotationally connected with a rotary table, the center of the bottom surface of the rotary table is vertically fixedly connected with a vertical plate, the bottom end of the vertical plate is provided with a rotary opening, the rotary opening is rotationally connected with two sides of the rotary plate, the end part of the rotary plate is fixedly embedded with an ultraviolet flame detector and an infrared flame detector, the rotary shaft end of the rotary plate is positioned in the vertical plate and fixedly connected with a driven belt pulley, the inside of the vertical plate is rotationally connected with a driving belt pulley, and the driven belt pulley and the driving belt pulley are sleeved with a synchronous belt. According to the utility model, the on-site flame is monitored through the monitoring component, the turntable continuously rotates in the horizontal direction to adjust the position, and the first variable frequency motor drives the rotating plate to continuously change the angle, so that the ultraviolet flame detector and the infrared flame detector can monitor at more positions, the monitoring range is wider, the blind area is smaller, and the phenomenon that the flame cannot be monitored is avoided.
assignees: JIANGSU ANCHENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydrogeology monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a hydrologic geological monitoring method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a hydrologic geological monitoring area, acquiring an early warning task, transmitting the early warning task to an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring video data of the monitoring area by utilizing video monitoring equipment which is pre-integrated in the unmanned aerial vehicle, judging whether trapped personnel exist in the monitoring area, if so, recording the real-time position of the trapped personnel, establishing a shouting tracking mechanism, starting a pre-integrated shouting device in the unmanned aerial vehicle, and playing evacuation voice; and activating the shouting tracking mechanism, selecting a safety area from the monitoring area, and generating emergency guiding information. According to the invention, by determining feedback information, rescue activities can be coordinated, blind search and rescue are avoided, distribution of trapped personnel is accurately mastered, a rescue scheme is optimized, invalid search can be reduced, a rescue path is optimized by generating rescue guidance, and early warning efficiency of hydrogeology monitoring is greatly improved.

title_en: Blind spot warning lamp capable of realizing two brightness levels according to external illumination conditions and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle warning lamps, in particular to a blind spot warning lamp for realizing two brightness levels according to external illumination conditions and a control method, wherein the blind spot warning lamp comprises an upper lamp shell and a lower lamp shell, and the upper lamp shell and the lower lamp shell are connected by adopting ultrasonic welding; the upper lamp housing is provided with a plurality of groups of indicator lamps, and the upper lamp housing is also provided with a transparent mask for protecting the indicator lamps. The blind spot warning lamp can realize IP65 level waterproof without coating pouring sealant, has more stable waterproof performance, is directly integrated on the lamp housing, has no problem that the wire-to-wire connector needs to be fixed, is stable in plugging and good in shock resistance, provides two brightness levels, ensures that the indicator lamp is still clearly visible under the condition of strong illumination, avoids overlarge stimulation to human eyes under the condition of low illumination, and reduces uncomfortable feeling.
assignees: WUHAN YOULAIYI AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Quick translation of beam-pumping unit motor, belt lax warning and pretension device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motor equipment, and provides a motor rapid translation, belt relaxation alarming and pre-tightening device of an oil pumping unit. The motor rapid translation, belt looseness alarming and pre-tightening device of the oil pumping unit comprises a base, a translation mechanism, a motor, a pressure detection mechanism and an alarming mechanism. According to the rapid translation, belt loosening alarming and pre-tightening device for the oil pumping machine motor, radial rapid translation of the motor can be realized through the arranged translation mechanism, the belt can be quickly loosened or pre-tightened, belt replacement of belt transmission equipment is quicker and more labor-saving, radial rapid movement at any position can be realized on the basis of not disassembling foundation bolts, the belt can be conveniently kept in a proper state of tightness at any time without stopping equipment, the service life of the belt is prolonged, the steps of poking the motor by using crowbars and tightening the loosened foundation bolts are avoided, a belt pulley is not required to be coiled, and the operation is safer.
assignees: SONGYUAN XINCHUANG MACHINERY EQUIPMENT REPAIR CO LTD

title_en: User preferences in responder network responder selection
abstract_en: Methods, user interfaces and systems are described that enable responder preferences to be considered during deployment of a public responder network. In some embodiments, a user is able to set preferences such as a mobility status, a public accessibility preference, a incidents notifications preference or a geographic preference associated with a medical device that is a part of the public responder network. In some embodiments, the user is able to select or define an area for which incident notifications are desired or are to be restricted in some manner. The described approach is well suited for public responder networks that include medical devices such as defibrillators (e.g., AEDs) in the network.

title_en: Satellite image super-resolution-based change monitoring algorithm and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an algorithm and a system for high-efficiency super-resolution processing and accurate change monitoring based on satellite images. The system combines a blind image super-resolution model and a change monitoring model based on a transducer architecture, and aims to solve the problems of insufficient satellite image resolution and low change monitoring precision in the prior art. Experimental verification results show that the method is excellent in super-resolution reconstruction and change monitoring, and can remarkably improve image resolution and change monitoring precision. The system has wide application prospect in the fields of urban planning, environmental protection, disaster early warning and the like, and provides powerful technical support for the related fields.

title_en: Super long auxiliary system of entry that road was used
abstract_en: The invention discloses an entrance overlength auxiliary system for a road, which comprises a monitoring system, a warning system and a control switch, wherein the monitoring system comprises a monitoring camera arranged on a monitoring rod of a toll plaza, a front-end switch and a hard disk video recorder are sequentially connected to a camera connecting circuit, and finally the monitoring camera is connected to a desktop display of a toll window, the warning system comprises two LED display screens which are arranged on the toll plaza and are separated by 20m, the LED display screens are arranged by adopting round iron pipes, meanwhile, 2 iron pipes are welded with side guardrails of the toll site, the sight blind area of toll staff can be compensated by the monitoring system, and the loading condition of vehicle cargoes, in particular whether overlength is ensured or not, can be timely found when the vehicle enters the toll plaza. The method ensures that the toll collector can intervene in advance, changes the passive situation that the problem is found when the vehicle passes through the window, greatly simplifies the later operation flow and improves the overall management efficiency.
assignees: ZHEJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT GROUP EXPRESSWAY OPERATION MAN CO LTD WENZHOU MAN OFFICE

title_en: Distribution-based limited space operation safety management base station device system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a base station device system for safety management based on distributed limited space operation. According to the invention, through a three-level networking architecture and a multi-mode data fusion technology, the problems of multiple monitoring blind areas and scattered data in the traditional operation environment are effectively solved. The system adopts the hierarchical deployment of the first router, the second router and the third router, combines a wired and wireless mixed transmission mode, realizes the full coverage of network signals in a limited space, and ensures the complete acquisition of environmental parameters and video monitoring data. The localization data processing mechanism of the industrial personal computer can directly trigger the audible and visual alarm and the ventilation fan when the gas concentration exceeding standard or the abnormal behavior of personnel is detected, so that a decision chain from data acquisition to emergency response is greatly shortened, the delay risk of command transmission of a remote server is avoided, and the accident prevention capability is remarkably improved.
assignees: GUONENG GUOHUA BEIJING GAS THERMOELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: Smart hub system for prevention of industrial accidents for the hearing impaired and control method thereof
title_ko: 청각 장애인의 산업재해 예방을 위한 스마트 허브 시스템 및 이의 동작방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart hub system for preventing industrial accidents of the hearing impaired and an operating method thereof. In addition, the present invention comprises: a collection unit for collecting sound generated in an industrial site to which the hearing impaired belong and an image obtained by photographing the industrial site; an analysis unit for applying the collected sound and image to an artificial intelligence model to analyze whether a dangerous situation causing a risk to the hearing impaired occurs; and a notification unit for transmitting a warning notification for notifying the dangerous situation to a notification terminal carried by the hearing impaired according to the analysis result of the analysis unit, thereby more effectively preventing safety accidents and industrial accidents that may occur to the hearing impaired.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각 장애인의 산업재해 예방을 위한 스마트 허브 시스템 및 이의 동작방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 청각 장애인이 소속된 산업현장에서 발생되는 음향과 산업현장을 촬영한 영상을 수집하는 수집부와, 수집된 음향과 영상을 인공지능 모델에 적용하여 청각 장애인에게 위험을 야기하는 위험상황의 발생 여부를 분석하는 분석부와, 분석부의 분석 결과에 따라 청각 장애인이 소지한 알림용 단말로 위험상황을 알리기 위한 경고 알림을 전송하는 알림부를 구비함으로써, 청각 장애인에게 발생할 수 있는 안전사고 및 산업재해를 보다 효과적으로 예방할 수 있다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGWOON UNIV

title_en: Electronic bulletin board apparatus and the operating method thereof
title_ko: 전자 게시판 장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an electronic bulletin board device capable of displaying a disaster notification message and enabling smooth communication between a hearing-impaired person and a manager in an emergency situation, and an operating method thereof, thereby supporting people to take measures for safety more quickly in an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 알림 메시지를 표시할 수 있고, 비상 상황에서 청각 장애인과 관리자 간의 원활한 소통을 가능하게 하는 전자 게시판 장치 및 그 동작 방법을 제시함으로써 비상 상황에서 사람들이 안전을 위한 조치를 보다 빠르게 취할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Visual-based falling stone impact structure risk assessment and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a visual-based falling stone impact structure risk assessment and control method and system. According to the visual falling stone impact structure risk assessment and control method, a camera and a stereoscopic vision sensor are used for capturing a moving video, a three-dimensional form and a dynamic position of falling stone in real time, first hand data can be timely obtained, the camera and the stereoscopic vision sensor can cover a large-range area, comprehensive falling stone activity monitoring is provided, the blind area of a traditional monitoring method is made up, further, calculation of falling stone impact force and falling stone movement tracks is facilitated timely and more accurately, then falling stone risk assessment is carried out by using the falling stone impact force and the falling stone movement tracks, a risk map is generated, assessment accuracy is higher, an early warning system is built according to the risk map, a protective measure arrangement scheme is built, and falling stone risks can be prevented more safely.

title_en: Debris flow monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow monitoring and early warning method and device, and belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of dividing a debris flow channel after investigation, acquiring geological basic information, deploying 'double fishbone' -shaped optical fiber monitoring networks along two sides of the channel, collecting environment parameters, presetting temperature difference and amplitude difference threshold values, judging whether debris flow is started at the i moment according to air temperature at the i moment, temperature of a temperature sensor and temperature difference threshold values, extracting the temperature of the temperature sensor at each level if the temperature sensor is started, searching an active sensor to determine a debris level height value and an elevation speed value, judging the position of an caving object, counting, calculating the change of the sound wave amplitude of an acoustic wave sensor from the i-1 moment to the i moment, comparing the change with the threshold values, judging whether foreign matters are intervened, if yes, collecting the sound wave characteristics of a first acoustic wave sensor at the left side and a first acoustic wave sensor at the right side, judging the occurrence of debris flow when the sound wave is matched, and calculating the flow speed and early warning. The invention improves the accuracy, stability and precision of the debris flow early warning.

title_en: Intelligent parking lot safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent parking lots and discloses a safety management system and method of an intelligent parking lot, wherein the system comprises a gait recognition module, a track prediction module, an intelligent light projection module, a warning light control module, an environment perception module and a central control unit, wherein the gait recognition module acquires gait data of pedestrians and analyzes walking directions; the system comprises a track prediction module, an intelligent light projection module, a warning light control module, an environment sensing module, a central control unit, a central processing unit and a system, wherein the track prediction module predicts a future path of a pedestrian based on gait characteristics and historical tracks, the intelligent light projection module projects a real-time state of the pedestrian in a visual field range of a driver of the vehicle, the warning light control module adjusts a warning light signal according to a pedestrian risk level, the environment sensing module monitors illumination conditions and optimizes light display, the central control unit comprehensively processes data of each module and dynamically adjusts projection information and a warning mode, and the system is interacted with intelligent light through gait recognition, so that the visibility of the pedestrian is improved, the blind area risk is reduced, and the driving safety of an underground parking garage is improved.
assignees: GUANGXI DESIQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scenic spot safety monitoring equipment capable of achieving intelligent tour guide and electronic equipment power supply
abstract_en: The invention provides scenic spot safety monitoring equipment taking account of intelligent tour guide and electronic equipment power supply, which belongs to the technical field of scenic spot safety monitoring and comprises a portable monitoring main body, a background management system and an auxiliary equipment system, wherein the monitoring main body comprises a plurality of sensors and chip integrated units, a communication module, a positioning module, a power module and an intelligent tour guide module, the sensors acquire a plurality of information, the communication module flexibly switches signal transmission data, the power module has a large capacity for supplying power for the intelligent tour guide module and other equipment, the intelligent tour guide module provides multilingual explanation based on a digital twin technology, the background management system carries out safety monitoring and early warning, tour guide service management, equipment management and maintenance, and the auxiliary equipment system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle nest and an emergency unmanned aerial vehicle for tour inspection and emergency.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BEIDOU ANPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire control alarm device is used to office building safety for fire engineering based on internet platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire alarm device for building safety for fire engineering based on an Internet platform, and relates to the technical field of fire alarm. The fire-fighting alarm device for the office building safety based on the Internet platform comprises a fire-fighting alarm box, wherein a smoke sensor is arranged on the outer side of the fire-fighting alarm box, a controller is arranged in the fire-fighting alarm box, a servo motor is arranged in the fire-fighting alarm box, a rotating rod is connected to the bottom of the servo motor in a transmission mode, and an alarm assembly is arranged in the fire-fighting alarm box. This fire control alarm device is used to office building safety for fire engineering based on internet platform, when smoke transducer detects smog, accessible controller start servo motor, cooperation dwang, hydraulic pressure storehouse first, hydraulic pressure storehouse second, elastic expansion plate, sliding block, arc push rod, arc atress pole, baffle and elastic expansion rod for bee calling organ shifts out fire control alarm box, carries out corresponding alarm operation, the warning effect when improving the device and uses.
assignees: XUZHOU PURUIMA MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data acquisition device for fire alarm control
abstract_en: The utility model provides a data acquisition device for fire alarm control, which comprises alarm control equipment, wherein a fixed seat is fixed on the outer side of the alarm control equipment, a data collector is inserted on the fixed seat, a smoke collector is arranged on one side of the data collector, an explosion-proof frame is fixed on the outer side of the alarm control equipment, and a translation plate is arranged on one side of the fixed seat. The data acquisition device for fire alarm control provided by the utility model solves the problems that when the existing data acquisition equipment is used for acquiring data in a fire disaster, the temperature acquisition head and the combustible gas detector are exposed outside the protective cover, and as the temperature of the site environment can be instantaneously increased and a large impact force exists in the fire disaster, the temperature acquisition head and the combustible gas detector are easily affected by the impact force, so that the temperature acquisition head and the combustible gas detector are damaged, and the acquisition efficiency of the data acquisition equipment is reduced.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA BAIYINHUAMENG DONGLUTIAN COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices
abstract_en: Foreign emergency notification, activity notification, and suspicious movement detection for mobile devices are disclosed. An application running on a mobile device of a user may be used to automatically detect when a call is made to emergency services in a foreign country, when an issue or unpermitted behavior may be occurring, when the mobile device has moved to an anomalous or unpermitted location and/or is moving with an unexpected speed, etc. The application then notifies family members and/or other contacts in the user's home country via a domestic carrier network. An over-the-top Internet Protocol (IP) message can be sent by the application on the mobile device back to the home network core.

title_en: Production equipment with safety reminding structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses production equipment with a safety reminding structure, which comprises a production equipment body (1), wherein a turning hand wheel (2) and a protective cover (3) are arranged on the production equipment body (1), a first sensor (6) is arranged at the position of the turning hand wheel (2), a second sensor (4) is arranged at the position of the protective cover (3), an alarm lamp (5) is arranged at the top of the production equipment body (1), and the first sensor (6), the second sensor (4) and the alarm lamp (5) are electrically connected with a controller of the production equipment body (1). The utility model can give an alarm when a worker checks and maintains the equipment so as to prevent safety accidents caused by the work of the worker in the blind area.

title_en: Deformation monitoring system for foundation pit vertical supporting body of hydraulic reclamation area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformation monitoring system for a foundation pit vertical support body in a hydraulic reclamation area, which relates to the technical field of deformation monitoring and comprises a multi-source signal acquisition module, a dynamic environment acquisition module, a fusion identification module, a dynamic analysis module and a dynamic early warning module, wherein a distributed fiber grating sensor is cooperated with an MEMS inclination sensor to realize millisecond deformation signal capture, and simultaneously acquire 5 key parameters of axial strain, lateral displacement, earth pressure, pore water pressure and water level, so that the problem of blind area of single index monitoring is solved, the comprehensive deformation value Q is calculated, then the pore water pressure change rate U3 and the water level change rate W3 are introduced to correct a safety coefficient K, the data fusion efficiency is improved, the problem of data island is solved, multi-stage response is triggered according to the K value, the early warning response efficiency is improved, and the engineering defense value of the deformation monitoring system under the complex working condition of the hydraulic reclamation area is improved.

title_en: Monitoring alarm device for metalware of cane feeding table in sugar refinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cane feeding table metalware monitoring and alarming device of a sugar refinery, which comprises a cane feeding structure, a plurality of metal foreign matter detection structures, a control structure and an alarming structure, wherein the cane feeding structure comprises a conveying component and a bottom frame, the conveying component is movably connected to the bottom frame, the metal foreign matter detection structures are distributed on the bottom frame along the vertical conveying direction and are used for detecting whether metal foreign matters exist in raw cane, the control structure is electrically connected with the cane feeding structure and the metal foreign matter detection structure, the alarming structure is electrically connected with the control structure and is used for giving position information and sound and light alarming for detecting the metal foreign matters, the metal foreign matters carried by the raw cane are detected through the metal foreign matter detection structure, the control structure controls the alarming structure to give an alarm, and the conveying component is controlled to stop running. Whether the raw sugarcane carries the metal foreign matters or not is detected by the metal foreign matter detection structure, the sound and light alarm and the position indication are realized by combining the control structure, and the damage to the next working procedure equipment due to the influence of the metal ware is effectively avoided.
assignees: GUANGXI BAISE WANLIN SUGAR IND CO LTD

title_en: Breaker automatic alarm device for slag treatment and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic alarm device of a crusher for slag treatment, which comprises a crusher, wherein the front end of the crusher is fixedly connected with a motor, the left end of an output shaft of the motor is fixedly sleeved with a belt pulley I, the left end of a crushing shaft of the crusher is fixedly sleeved with a belt pulley II, the belt pulley I and the belt pulley II are connected through belt transmission, the automatic alarm device also comprises a feeding monitoring mechanism and a bracket, the feeding monitoring mechanism comprises a belt conveyor, a metal detector and a supporting plate, the rear end of the crusher is provided with the belt conveyor, the front end of the belt conveyor is fixedly connected with the supporting plate, the upper surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with the metal detector, the crusher and the motor are both positioned at the lower end of a thermal infrared imager, and the automatic alarm device and the system for the crusher for slag treatment realize multi-azimuth monitoring through diversified monitoring such as metal foreign matter monitoring and temperature monitoring, and the triggering range of automatic alarm is more comprehensive.
assignees: GUANGDONG YOUCHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROT INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Fire safety warning device based on internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire safety warning device based on the Internet of things, and belongs to the technical field of fire safety. The fire safety warning device based on the Internet of things comprises a fire-fighting lamp plate and a beam-splitting screen assembly, wherein the beam-splitting screen assembly is arranged inside the fire-fighting lamp plate, the fire-fighting lamp plates are connected through a pipeline channel, and the pipeline channel is connected with the fire-fighting lamp plate through a clamping groove. For solving the top that current fire door was all equipped with the pilot lamp tablet for guide under the conflagration environment, the condition of stranded personnel can't judge the opposite side when taking place the conflagration, the problem that the blind opening fire door can lead to the flow of flue gas, fire control lamp tablet is installed respectively in the inside and outside both sides of fire door, can monitor passageway and the inside environment of building respectively through the sensing element at lamp tablet both ends, can trigger the warning when sensing high temperature flue gas to remind stranded personnel not to open the fire door and lead to spreading of flue gas and fire behavior.
assignees: MAANSHAN NITE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Atsc 3.0-delivered alerts for people with accessibility needs
abstract_en: Techniques are described for expanding and/or improving the Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC) 3.0 television protocol in robustly delivering the next generation broadcast television services. Advanced Emergency Alerts (AEA) are received via ATSC 3.0 and filtered according to end user desire. Signaling commences between the ATSC 3.0 receiver and nearby consumer electronic (CE) devices to cause the CE devices to activate to indicate to a person that he should access the ATSC 3.0 receiver to discern what AEA is being broadcast.

title_en: Sickroom patient out-of-bed behavior monitoring and falling early warning method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical care, and provides a ward patient out-of-bed behavior monitoring and fall early warning method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps of driving the millimeter wave radar to release radar signals and receiving rebound signals; the method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out a first step of detecting the position of a patient on a sickbed, secondly, carrying out gesture anchoring on the state of the patient at regular time, carrying out continuous monitoring on the position and the action gesture of the patient through a rebound signal, setting forbidden regions and removing abnormal values based on the position of a rebound reinforcement signal received by a millimeter wave radar and based on the direction of the reinforcement signal, and dividing the regions to confirm the region positions of the sickbeds. The patient position and the action posture can be continuously monitored, the dynamic real-time monitoring of the patient is realized, the monitoring blind area existing in the traditional manual inspection and patient autonomous calling mode is avoided, the monitoring timeliness and the monitoring accuracy are improved, the falling risk of the patient after leaving the bed is effectively reduced, and the safety of the patient is ensured.

title_en: Overrun detection device for transfer platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overrun detection device for a transfer platform, which comprises a portal frame, wherein the portal frame consists of a left upright post, a right upright post and a cross beam arranged at the upper ends of the left upright post and the right upright post, a plurality of mounting plates are symmetrically arranged on the left upright post and the right upright post, photoelectric sensors are arranged on the mounting plates, and the photoelectric sensors are connected with an alarm. When the photoelectric sensor is arranged on the upper part of the portal frame, whether the railway vehicle has an ultrahigh condition or not can be detected when the railway vehicle passes through the portal frame, so that an operator can conveniently and quickly judge whether the railway vehicle exceeds the limit height of a factory building. When foreign matters block the infrared rays of the photoelectric sensor, the audible and visual alarm signal is triggered, so that the aim of reminding operators is achieved, and the safety of the track traffic industry vehicle adjusting and pulling operation is improved.

title_en: Expressway maintenance early warning method and device based on road event and readable medium
abstract_en: Expressway maintenance early warning method and device based on road events and readable medium. The method comprises the steps of responding to the detection of a road event, obtaining the occurrence time of the road event as a target time, executing maintenance early warning processing based on the target time, collecting expressway geological monitoring data and expressway traffic monitoring data corresponding to a preset expressway mark in a preset time period where the target time is located, generating expressway geological disaster early warning information, carrying out traffic abnormal event identification processing, carrying out highway maintenance cooperative early warning, responding to the expressway road environment monitoring data sent by a patrol equipment in the preset time period, determining the expressway road environment monitoring data as data to be detected of a road foreign matter road section, generating the road foreign matter road section information, and sending the road foreign matter road section information to a cleaning maintenance equipment. The embodiment reduces the resources consumed in the maintenance early warning process.
assignees: CHONGQING SHILI HIGHWAY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Double camera personnel security detection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of personnel security detection and discloses a double-camera personnel security detection method. The RGB camera and the thermal infrared camera are cooperatively deployed and accurately calibrated, so that all-weather and full-scene reliable monitoring is realized, a detection blind area of a single sensor in a complex environment is effectively overcome, a RETINANET target detection algorithm for deep learning can be used for greatly improving the detection rate of personnel targets in images by combining thermal infrared imaging while the detection accuracy and robustness are further improved, the images are processed by a Gaussian mixture model, stable performance can be kept no matter illumination change, temperature fluctuation or equipment interference, excellent universality and expandability are shown, personnel safety protection is realized by alarming and stopping control, and the detection accuracy of personnel in a dangerous area is improved as a whole.
assignees: CHENGDU ANMUSEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Switchgear system with Consecutive peak current control function
title_ko: 지속성 피크전류 감시제어 기능을 구비한 수배전반 시스템
abstract_en: A switchgear system(100) including a power opening and closing unit(110) inputted to a power load comprises a control unit(101) monitoring and controlling a load current, a current detection unit(120) detecting the load current, a current conversion unit(130) converting the detected current into a digital signal, a current feature detection unit(140) detecting a persistent peak current by receiving the converted current signal, a translation unit(160) converting detected feature data into a display unit segment signal, a display unit(170) displaying a current feature result, an alarm, a cut off output unit(173), and a power supply unit(180) for operating power of the control unit. The present invention has effects of preventing biased overload loss of electric equipment, preventing biased heating accidents, optimizing device capacity reduction, and improving the utilization efficiency of equipment by the convenience of monitoring the angular unbalanced load and the unbalanced load balance adjustment simplicity by a three-phase unbalanced persistence peak current simultaneous indication function.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 과전류 지속으로 인해 발열사고를 유발하는 불평형 지속성 피크전류에 의한 편중 위험 상태를 효과적으로 파악하고, 불평형 부하 재분배와 사고 예방조치를 취할 수 있도록 하는 수배전반 시스템을 제공하는 것으로, 전력부하에 입력되는 전원 개폐부(110)를 구비한 수배전반 시스템(100)에 있어서, 수배전반 시스템은 제어부(101)와, 부하전류를 검출하는 전류검출부(120), 검출된 전류를 디지털신호로 변환하는 전류 변환부(130) 상기 변환된 전류신호를 받아 지속성 피크전류를 검출하는 전류 특징 검출부(140), 검출된 특징데이터를 표시부 시그먼트 신호로 변환하는 번역부(160), 전류 특징 결과를 표시하는 표시부(170) 및 설정치에서 경보를 하고 전로를 차단하는 경보, 차단 출력부(173), 감시제어부의 조작전원용 전원부(180)를 포함하고, 상기 제어부(101)는 부하특성에 따라 탐색대역시간(T)을 설정하고, 상기 탐색대역시간(T)을 전류 특징분석을 위해 N등분하되, 등분한 1개의 미분대역시간( )에 상기 수배전반 시스템의 1사이클 (1주기) 이상의 전류 변화가 적용되도록 하고, 상기 등분된 미분대역시간( ) 동안 나타나는 전류값으로 부터 대표전류값를 산출하여 지속성 피크전류로 산정하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이로인해 불시정전사고예방, 과전류 발열사고와 불평형에 의한 편중과부하사고, 전로손실 및 설비이용 효율을 향상시킬수 있다.
assignees: WONBANG ENG CO LTD;SON MYOUNG HEE

title_en: Deep Learning Sound Conversion Device for Deaf People
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 딥러닝 소리 변환 장치
abstract_en: A deep learning sound conversion device for a hearing-impaired person, in a sound notification device, is characterized in being configured with: (1) a jetson nano; (2) a microphone; (3) a pico w; (4) an OLED display; (5) a vibration sensor; and (6) a battery The present invention improves information providing efficiency by classifying/analyzing sounds of various situations through a central control device and a sensor and transmitting to a user in a visual/tactile manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 딥러닝 소리 변환 장치에 관한 것으로서 아기의 울음소리, 가전제품 종료음, 초인종 소리, 화재경보음 등 다양한 상황의 소리의 오디오 샘플 파일을 수집하여, 1500 여개의 오디오 샘플 파일을 딥러닝 하여 모델을 학습시키, 해당 딥러닝 AI 모델을 통해 음성인식 AI 웹사이트를 제작하고, 젯슨 나노에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치로서 다양한 상황의 소리를 분류 및 분석할 수 있게 하고, 마이크에 의하여 다양한 상황의 소리를 입력받을 수 있게 하고, 피코W에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치인 젯슨 나노로부터 신호를 전달받을 수 있게 하고, OLED 디스플레이에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 시각적으로 전달할 수 있게 하고, 진동센서에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 촉각적으로 전달할 수 있게 함으로써 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 소리 알림 장치에 있어서 중앙 제어 장치로서 다양한 상황의 소리를 분류 및 분석할 수 있게 소리입력장치에 설치한 젯슨 나노, 다양한 상황의 소리를 입력받을 수 있게 소리입력장치에 설치한 마이크, 중앙 제어 장치인 젯슨 나노로부터 신호를 전달받을 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 피코W, 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 시각적으로 전달할 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 OLED 디스플레이, 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 촉각적으로 전달할 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 진동센서, 여러 센서와 부품에 전력을 전달할 수 있게 사용자가 착용하고 있는 스마트 디바이스에 결합한 배터리로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 아기의 울음소리, 가전제품 종료음, 초인종 소리, 화재경보음 등 다양한 상황의 소리의 오디오 샘플 파일을 수집하여, 1500 여개의 오디오 샘플 파일을 딥러닝 하여 모델을 학습시키, 해당 딥러닝 AI 모델을 통해 음성인식 AI 웹사이트를 제작하고, 젯슨 나노에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치로서 다양한 상황의 소리를 분류 및 분석할 수 있게 하고, 마이크에 의하여 다양한 상황의 소리를 입력받을 수 있게 하고, 피코W에 의하여 중앙 제어 장치인 젯슨 나노로부터 신호를 전달받을 수 있게 하고, OLED 디스플레이에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 시각적으로 전달할 수 있게 하고, 진동센서에 의하여 분석 및 분류한 소리를 사용자에게 촉각적으로 전달할 수 있게 함으로써 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 비교적 특수한 상황에서 소리 발생 여부만을 기준으로 정보를 제공하는  문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent navigation system for blind person
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent blind person navigation system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent wearable blind person navigation and comprises a multi-mode sensing unit, A I decision centers, a two-way feedback module and an emergency response system, wherein the intelligent wearable blind person navigation system still keeps 94% obstacle detection rate under 5l ux low illumination through a three-layer sensing framework of a double-light fusion camera, a laser radar and an ultrasonic array, and the effective detection distance is 8 meters. The semantic segmentation algorithm enables the detection rate of suspended obstacles to be increased from 12% to 92%, and the recognition error of the glass door in the underground garage scene is only 2.1cm. The multi-sensor space-time alignment technology reduces the false alarm rate from 25% to 3.2% in a complex scene, and realizes the accurate perception of all-weather and full-height obstacles. The biological characteristics and environmental risk multi-level triggering mechanism automatically alarms and shares positioning within 2.1 seconds when a user falls, and the falling rescue success rate of the underground garage is improved from 62% to 100%. And (3) automatically recording environment video with positioning when no operation is overtime, and constructing a closed-loop safety net for 'prevention-early warning-rescue'.
assignees: XIAYU INTEGRATED CIRCUIT SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Port yard coal pile temperature real-time monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of coal pile temperature monitoring equipment, and discloses a real-time monitoring device for the temperature of a coal pile in a port yard, wherein a plurality of temperature sensors are arranged at different positions of the coal pile, the outer ends of the temperature sensors are connected with LoRa wireless signal transmitters, the LoRa wireless signal transmitters are connected with data transfer stations through wireless signals, the data transfer stations are connected with an upper computer through the Internet, and the upper computer is connected with an audible and visual alarm through a connecting line and is connected with a remote mobile terminal through wireless signals; the data transfer station is internally fixed with a wireless signal receiver and a data processor, and a wireless/wired communication interface and a power supply interface are embedded on the outer side of the shell. Through arranging the temperature sensor in different positions of the coal pile, combining with the LoRa wireless signal transmission technology, the full coverage and real-time monitoring of the temperature of the coal pile are realized, the monitoring blind area existing in the traditional wired monitoring system is eliminated, and the comprehensive and accurate monitoring of the temperature of the coal pile is ensured.
assignees: JINING GANGHANG TAIPING PORT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency management early warning issuing system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management early warning release system based on big data, which relates to the technical field of information technology and public safety intersection, and comprises the following hierarchy structures connected in sequence: breaking through the limitation of the traditional system data island, integrating heterogeneous data sources such as meteorological sensors, social media and unit platforms through a multi-mode data fusion gateway, combining federal learning technology to realize anonymization processing and safety protection of user data, remarkably improving real-time performance and comprehensiveness of disaster situation awareness, and enabling a dynamic space-time feature extraction engine to capture space-time coupling rules of disaster propagation by using an attention mechanism so as to improve risk assessment precision to millimeter-level geographic resolution, thereby effectively eliminating monitoring blind areas existing in the traditional static model.
assignees: JIANGSU EMERGENCY WARNING INFORMATION PUBLISHING CENTER

title_en: Foreign matter early warning system for converter buggy ladle track
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of auxiliary equipment used in the metallurgical industry, and particularly discloses a converter buggy ladle track foreign matter early warning system which comprises an infrared emitter, an infrared receiver and an alarm device. The infrared emitter is installed and is located the track directly over near the converter end of buggy ladle, the infrared receiver is installed and is located the track directly over near the converter end of slag car, the infrared receiver corresponds and infrared receiver and infrared emitter electric connection each other, alarm device electric connection infrared receiver, send audible and visual alarm when infrared interrupt, through the combination of infrared detection and camera, whether there is the foreign matter on the buggy ladle track of system real-time supervision, send audible and visual alarm immediately in case discovery is unusual, the incident that leads to because of the track foreign matter has effectively been prevented, the security of production operation has been improved.

title_en: Mine microseism positioning control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, in particular to a mine microseism positioning control system and a method, wherein microseism signals are synchronously collected through a geophone, an accelerometer, an acoustic emission sensor and an optical fiber sensor, and data time stamps are aligned based on a GPS/Beidou clock; the method comprises the steps of carrying out blind source separation on a signal after wavelet filtering, extracting independent seismic source components, fusing multi-sensor characteristics through a graph neural network, constructing a space-time joint characteristic matrix, classifying microseism event types through a ResNet-LSTM hybrid model, generating a seismic source coordinate initial solution based on deep reinforcement learning, iteratively converging the seismic source coordinate initial solution to an optimal solution through a particle swarm optimization algorithm, mapping a positioning result to a three-dimensional geological grid model, simulating an energy diffusion path, triggering three-level alarm according to event energy density, and automatically pushing an emergency instruction to a mine safety management system. Thus, the problem of lower precision of the existing mine microseism positioning control system is solved.

title_en: Fault automatic diagnosis and alarm processing method for dust management and control integrated platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and automatic control, in particular to a fault automatic diagnosis and alarm processing method of a dust management and control integrated platform, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring dust concentration time sequence data C (t) and current characteristics I (t) of associated equipment; step 2, when the C (t) exceeds a set threshold value, a fault decision tree containing equipment states and environmental parameters is established, step 3, the power of the dust removing equipment and the starting strategy of the emergency device are dynamically adjusted according to the fault grade, and step 4, a grading alarm signal is sent to a central control room according to the fault grade, and a maintenance work order is generated. The method has the advantages that the false alarm rate is obviously reduced through multi-sensor data fusion and equipment state linkage judgment, the classification alarm mechanism can accurately position fault types, energy consumption waste caused by blind equipment load lifting is avoided, and the voice alarm and forced spraying functions ensure emergency response timeliness and effectively inhibit dust diffusion.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD JIUTAI ELECTRIC FACTORY;WODA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel emergency lighting electronic fence triggering type linkage alarm device and protective housing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel emergency lighting and alarming, and particularly discloses a tunnel emergency lighting electronic fence triggering type linkage alarming device and a protective shell, wherein the device comprises a box body, an electronic fence monitoring module, a control module and an acousto-optic module, wherein the electronic fence monitoring module is positioned at the front end position of the lower part of the box body and is used for monitoring and collecting abnormal events in a tunnel and interacting monitoring and collecting abnormal event signals to the control module; the control module is arranged in the box body and used for receiving and processing the collected abnormal event signals monitored by the electronic fence monitoring module and correspondingly sending emergency lighting signals and alarm signals to the acousto-optic module, and an adjusting mechanism is further arranged between the electronic fence monitoring module and the box body and drives the electronic fence monitoring module to swing at an angle through the adjusting mechanism, so that dynamic monitoring is realized, the monitoring range is effectively enlarged, and the monitoring blind area is reduced.

title_en: Remote monitoring equipment with warning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment and discloses remote monitoring equipment with a warning function, which comprises a mounting seat, a monitoring body and a clamping piece, wherein a first connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the mounting seat, a camera is fixedly arranged in the monitoring body, a light supplementing lamp is fixedly arranged in the monitoring body, a protective cover is inserted and arranged on the outer side of the clamping piece, a connecting sleeve is fixedly arranged in the monitoring body, and a loudspeaker is fixedly arranged in the connecting sleeve. This remote monitoring equipment with warning function, through the cooperation of speaker and control panel, when the unexpected circumstances takes place, accessible remote end signal transmission to control panel department, can make the opening and shutting of control panel control speaker afterwards, makes the speaker in time send out warning sound, lets relevant personnel can be the very first time perceive abnormal situation to in time take corresponding measure, and through dismantling the gim peg two, can conveniently take off the shield from the adapter sleeve and change.
assignees: XIAN YUNHAI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Soil body infiltration early warning device for geotechnical engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil body seepage early warning device for geotechnical engineering, and belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering. The soil body infiltration early warning device for geotechnical engineering comprises a landslide, the top surface on landslide top layer is provided with the intercepting drain, the top surface on landslide top layer is provided with the escape canal, the inside of landslide all is provided with detection component, detection component is including setting up at shallow layer and the inside bleeder and the alarm mechanism of weathered mudstone sandstone interbedded. Through the cooperation of intercepting ditch, escape canal and drop groove to the landslide surface drainage, and because of falling the rainwater infiltration water or the interior itself of slope by force own groundwater that contains, the accessible bleeder is faster gathers and discharges fast, can effectually reduce the subsurface infiltration body to keep lower floor soil body intensity, dead weight, reduce the osmotic force, when the inside water content of the slope body reaches dangerous value, the inside water level of bleeder increases and drives alarm mechanism work and send out the police dispatch newspaper, alarm mechanism can accelerate the discharge of the inside ponding of bleeder simultaneously.

title_en: Intelligent community public safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of community public safety monitoring, in particular to a smart community public safety monitoring system and a method, which are used for acquiring the total number of monitoring cameras in a community, sending an image acquisition command, continuously acquiring image frames by the monitoring cameras to form an image sequence of the monitoring cameras, carrying out image processing on each frame in the image sequence of the monitoring cameras, calculating a definition evaluation index and a sharpness evaluation index of the monitoring cameras corresponding to each frame image, screening out abnormal frame images of the monitoring cameras, carrying out depth analysis on the abnormal frame images marked as the monitoring cameras, extracting light parameters of the monitoring cameras, comprehensively judging the lens fouling index of the monitoring cameras, further generating corresponding cleaning early warning signals, effectively monitoring the lens state of the monitoring cameras, timely sending out cleaning early warning, ensuring the quality and safety of the monitoring images, and effectively reducing the risk of monitoring blind areas caused by lens fouling.

title_en: Earthquake early warning method of emergency early warning broadcasting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to an earthquake early warning method of an emergency early warning broadcasting system, which comprises the steps of obtaining the longitude and latitude coordinates of a seismic source and earthquake monitoring data, determining the distribution area range of broadcasting sites according to the longitude and latitude coordinates of the seismic source, wherein the range is represented by longitude and latitude, constructing an earthquake risk topological space based on historical earthquake data, dividing earthquake risk grades in the topological space, determining corresponding broadcasting emergency degree parameters according to the earthquake risk grades, generating broadcasting message codes, transmitting the broadcasting message codes to broadcasting sites in the distribution area of the broadcasting sites through a power line carrier and a wireless communication network to trigger earthquake early warning broadcasting, combining geological structure data through a topological space mapping technology, accurately determining an early warning range, obviously reducing early warning blind areas and avoiding excessive early warning.

title_en: Binary all-solid-state navigation radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radar systems, and discloses a double-system all-solid-state navigation radar. The invention comprises an antenna base turntable, a low-profile waveguide slot antenna, a servo unit, a power supply unit, a radio frequency switching unit, a pulse receiving and transmitting unit, a continuous wave receiving and transmitting unit, a main control unit and a display control terminal. The invention utilizes the design of an all-solid-state and all-phase-coherent dual-system radar system, overcomes the inherent technical defects of the traditional magnetron monopulse system and the single-solid-system marine radar, integrates the technical advantages of a pulse compression system and a linear frequency modulation continuous wave system, improves the radar performance, integrates more abundant functions, and can meet the use requirements of modern ships in application scenes such as open sea navigation, narrow water passage, port entry and exit, search and rescue, collision early warning, panoramic blind compensation and the like.

title_en: Intelligent corner alarm
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of alarms, and particularly relates to an intelligent corner alarm which comprises a shell capable of being installed at a corner, wherein a PCB (printed circuit board) and a battery are fixedly connected inside the shell, equipment installation sides are arranged on two sides of the shell, radar sensor units are fixedly connected on the equipment installation sides, warning equipment is further arranged on the shell, the battery, the radar sensor units and the warning equipment are electrically connected with the radar sensor units, the warning equipment comprises a buzzer and two radar sensor units, the buzzer and the two radar sensor units are electrically connected with the PCB, the buzzer is fixedly connected on the shell, the two radar sensor units are respectively and fixedly connected on the two equipment installation sides, two connection sides are arranged on the rear side of the shell, and first magnetic attraction pieces are fixedly connected on the two connection sides. The utility model can reduce collision accidents caused by blind areas of sight at corners.
assignees: NANJING JIZHI LANTU AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for providing digital emergency alarm based on nfc sticker
title_ko: Nfc 스티커 기반의 디지털 비상벨 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for providing a digital emergency bell based on an NFC sticker. The apparatus comprises: an NFC sticker recognition unit for recognizing an NFC sticker installed near a specific space through a user terminal and reading an NFC tag of the corresponding NFC sticker; an access address detection unit for detecting an access address matching the NFC tag from a database; an operation initiation unit for initiating an emergency call operation while providing a web page accessible through the access address to the user terminal and controlling the emergency call operation according to a user input received from the user terminal; and a situation propagation performing unit for propagating an emergency call situation using a pre-registered emergency contact network according to the emergency call operation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 NFC 스티커 기반의 디지털 비상벨 제공 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 장치는 사용자 단말을 통해 특정 공간의 인근에 설치된 NFC 스티커를 인식한 후 해당 NFC 스티커의 NFC 태그를 독출하는 NFC 스티커 인식부; 데이터베이스로부터 상기 NFC 태그에 매칭되는 접근 주소를 검출하는 접근 주소 검출부; 상기 접근 주소를 통해 접근 가능한 웹페이지를 상기 사용자 단말에 제공하면서 긴급호출 동작을 개시하고 상기 사용자 단말로부터 수신된 사용자 입력에 따라 상기 긴급호출 동작을 제어하는 동작 개시부; 및 상기 긴급호출 동작에 따라 사전 등록된 긴급 연락망을 이용하여 긴급호출 상황을 전파하는 상황 전파 수행부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire extinguisher bracket for driving position of household car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire extinguisher bracket for a household car driving position, which comprises a fixing device and a protecting device, wherein one end of the fixing device is provided with a lifting device, the lifting device comprises a support column, one side of the support column is provided with a rack chute in the vertical direction, a rack is arranged in the rack chute, the lower end of the support column is provided with a motor and an electronic device box, a motor rotating shaft is provided with a transmission gear which is meshed with the rack, one side of the lifting device is provided with the protecting device, the protecting device comprises a limit sleeve ring arranged on one side of the support column provided with the chute and a sleeve arranged on the lower part of one side of the rack, and the upper end of the limit sleeve ring is connected with a safety bolt through an elastic rope. The fire extinguisher can give an alarm when a fire disaster occurs in the automobile, and the fire extinguisher is lifted to a position where the feeler is accessible, so that the safety pin is automatically separated, a driver can take the fire extinguisher by one hand, and the fire extinguisher can be taken and used at any time.
assignees: LINYI RUITENG BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gesture recognition and remote translation bracelet for deaf-mute urgent help
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent wearing equipment, and discloses a deaf-mute emergency help gesture recognition and remote translation bracelet. Including bracelet body, gesture recognition module, central processing module, translation module, communication module, alarm module, display module and power module, gesture recognition module includes a plurality of miniature cameras and inertial sensor, the inside of central processing module is placed degree of depth and is learned neural network model, just translation module is used for converting gesture information into characters and pronunciation, just the bracelet body contains display screen subassembly and two belts, the surface of a belt is provided with a plurality of buckles, and one end of a belt is provided with the clamp, fuses the gesture image information that gathers a plurality of miniature cameras and the dynamic data that inertial sensor obtained, and is better to the recognition effect of complicated urgent help gesture, can rapidly, accurately catch the help intention of deaf dumb, synchronous transmission user's positional information realizes quick response and rescue.

title_en: Visual field blind area early warning method and device, vehicle and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a visual field blind area early warning method, a visual field blind area early warning device, a vehicle and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of identifying a vision blind area of a vehicle on a running road, and projecting a warning signal into a warning area corresponding to the vision blind area. Therefore, the warning signal is directionally projected in the warning area corresponding to the visual field blind area, the moving obstacle in the visual field blind area is warned in a targeted manner, pedestrians or vehicles in the visual field blind area are effectively reminded to take countermeasures in advance, the warning efficiency and the warning effect are improved, the occurrence of collision accidents is avoided, and the driving safety is further improved.

title_en: Crack detection device for geological disaster early warning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crack detection devices, in particular to a crack detection device for geological disaster early warning; the utility model provides a crack detection device for geological disaster early warning, which comprises a translation sliding rail, an early warning controller, a translation assembly, a measurement assembly, a guide assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein compared with the traditional crack detection device, when a graduated scale is aligned with a crack in the use process, the graduated scale is easy to incline and deviate, so that the time consumption for aligning the graduated scale with the crack is required, the problem of inconvenient realization of quick measurement is caused, and when the crack detection device is in the use process, firstly, the translation assembly is started to drive the measurement assembly to transversely move, the transverse dimension of the crack can be measured through the measurement assembly, and in addition, the guide assembly is started to drive the adjusting assembly to adjust and rotate, and the longitudinal dimension of the crack can be measured through the adjusting assembly, so that the quick measurement effect can be realized.

title_en: Electrical cabinet monitoring and fire extinguishing equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to electrical cabinet monitoring and fire extinguishing equipment which comprises an infrared area temperature sensor, an ultraviolet light sensor, an infrared light sensor, a fire extinguishing device and a controller. The infrared area temperature sensor is used for scanning the temperature field of the inner area of the cabinet in real time, the area monitoring replaces a point type probe, the covering capacity and the early warning precision are improved, and the blind area and the missing detection probability are reduced. When the temperature of a certain area exceeds a preset temperature threshold, the controller judges that the temperature is abnormal, at the moment, the ultraviolet band spectrum and the infrared band spectrum in the gas holder are acquired through the ultraviolet light sensor and the infrared light sensor, the characteristic spectrum of the real flame can be identified, false alarm caused by non-fire factors is avoided, and accurate identification of fire is enhanced. When a fire source appears in the electrical cabinet, the controller can complete accurate decision under no intervention, and is linked with automatic fire extinguishing equipment, so that the intervention is completed at the initial stage of fire, and the accident loss and the diffusion risk are obviously reduced.
assignees: TIANDUN HUIAN BEIJING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Router structure with self-protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a router structure with self-protection, which relates to the technical field of routers and comprises a first mounting plate and a protection frame, wherein the protection frame is connected to the first mounting plate, a second slidable mounting plate and two rotatable access plates are connected to the inner side of the protection frame, a router is mounted at the top of the second mounting plate, the bottom of the second mounting plate is abutted against the tops of the two access plates, a net wire pulling and inserting mechanism and an antenna folding mechanism are respectively connected to the protection frame. The system realizes active disaster prevention by forming a system for monitoring, responding, protecting and recovering, the vibration alarm detects vibration, the controller synchronously triggers the antenna folding, the net wire pulling-out and the air bag inflating action to form quick protection, the system is suitable for earthquake, equipment falling and foreign object impact scenes, the protection effect is improved, the functions of dust prevention, heat dissipation, buffering and cable management are integrated, and the router protection can be automatically completed without manual intervention.

title_en: Shale gas informatization environment early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shale gas informatization environment early warning system which comprises a plurality of integrated monitoring systems arranged at monitoring points of a shale gas exploitation area, wherein the integrated monitoring systems interact information with an informatization monitoring platform through a first wireless communication module, and the informatization monitoring platform is connected with a mobile monitoring terminal through a second wireless communication module. Through integration monitoring system with air monitoring and seismic monitoring combine monitoring facilities as an organic whole, accessible installation this equipment can be realistic air monitoring and seismic monitoring to the check point, in addition, through setting up shock insulation structure in seismic monitoring device's installation department, avoid it to receive its top structure's influence, simultaneously through being connected all integration monitoring systems with informationized monitor platform, can realize information interaction, and then utilize informationized monitor platform to handle the data that integration monitoring system was collected, and send the alarm when exceeding standard, realized the effect of comprehensive monitoring.
assignees: SINOPEC CHONGQING FULING SHALE GAS EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Forestry ecological environment real-time monitoring and managing method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large data-based forestry ecological environment real-time monitoring and management method, which belongs to the technical field of forestry ecological environment management and comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and sensor network deployment, S2, multi-mode data fusion and intelligent transmission, namely, developing a self-adaptive communication protocol dynamic switching module, automatically switching to a satellite communication link in a 4G/5G network blind area, S3, mass data storage and distributed computation, namely, constructing a hybrid cloud storage architecture, storing real-time monitoring data into a Redis cache queue, S4, intelligent extraction of ecological environment indexes, S5, dynamic assessment of ecological bearing capacity, S6, multi-level early warning and emergency response, S7, accurate forestry management decision, S8, system self-optimization and closed-loop management. The method and the system remarkably improve the comprehensiveness and instantaneity of forestry ecological environment perception by constructing the space-world integrated monitoring network, and complement multi-source data of unmanned aerial vehicles, satellite remote sensing and ground sensors.

title_en: Power grid fault detector for high-speed railway natural disasters and foreign matter invasion limit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a power grid fault detector for natural disasters and foreign matter invasion of high-speed railways, which comprises a power supply module, an induction inductor, a coupling capacitor and an operational amplifier Lu Hesheng light alarm circuit, wherein the induction inductor, the coupling capacitor and the operational amplifier Lu Hesheng light alarm circuit are sequentially connected, the power supply module is connected with the operational amplifier circuit and the audible and visual alarm circuit to provide power, one end of the induction inductor is connected with one end of the coupling capacitor, the other end of the induction inductor is exposed out of the power grid fault detector for natural disasters and foreign matter invasion of the high-speed railways and is used for sensing whether electricity exists in a wire of a tested double-power-grid sensor, if electricity exists in the wire of the tested double-power-grid sensor, an electric signal sensed by the induction inductor enters the operational amplifier circuit through the coupling capacitor, and the operational amplifier circuit amplifies the electric signal and then drives the audible and visual alarm circuit to perform audible and visual alarm. The power grid fault detector adopts a non-contact mode to conduct fault detection of the double-power-grid sensor, does not need to open a splice box, and is convenient to use.

title_en: Landslide monitoring device for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine restoration, and discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, which comprises an equipment rod body and a supporting plate which is arranged at the top of the equipment rod body and can be adjusted in height, wherein a control assembly and an alarm are arranged at the top of the supporting plate, an inductor is arranged at the bottom of the equipment rod body, a protective cylinder is connected with the bottom end of the equipment rod body in a threaded manner, a limiting ring is fixedly arranged in the middle of an inner cavity of the protective cylinder, a reset mechanism is arranged on the limiting ring, the reset mechanism comprises a reset slide column which is in sliding connection with the inner part of the limiting ring and a positioning cone head which is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the reset slide column, and the top of the outer side wall surface of the positioning cone head is matched with and in fit contact with the bottom wall surface of the inner cavity of the protective cylinder. According to the utility model, the reset mechanism and the detection mechanism are arranged, and the device is in contact with the side wall surface of the inner cavity of the protective cylinder through the wall surface of the positioning cone head to form a sealing structure, so that the influence of foreign matters such as external earth stones on the use of the device is avoided, and the practicability of the device is improved.
assignees: LIAONING METALLURGICAL FOUNDATION ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional emergency broadcasting system based on Beidou short message
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional emergency broadcasting system based on Beidou short messages. According to the invention, the voice recognition module in the intelligent voice interaction broadcasting module can quickly convert voice instructions input by a user through a microphone into text information, so that tedious and possible misoperation of manual input is avoided, user feedback is more direct and efficient, the natural language processing and demand analysis module carries out semantic analysis on the recognized text, core content of user demands is accurately extracted, emergency keyword libraries in a system are associated, the system can quickly understand user intention, the multilingual voice synthesis module can convert broadcasting text generated by the system into language or dialect familiar to the user, and the interaction efficiency of the system and the user and the accuracy of demand response are remarkably improved, and the coverage breadth of information transmission is improved, so that emergency broadcasting is upgraded from unidirectional notification to bidirectional interaction, and the practicability and reliability of the system under a complex scene are further enhanced.
assignees: HUNAN CHUANGXIN WEILI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster chain monitoring and early warning method and system based on Internet of things-InSAR cooperation
abstract_en: The application provides an Internet of things-I nSAR collaborative disaster chain monitoring and early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out quality assessment on acquired Internet of things data to obtain a situation assessment matrix, identifying and extracting abnormal nodes according to the situation assessment matrix to obtain normal node data, calculating a partition data integrity rate based on the normal node data, determining a region with the data integrity rate lower than a preset threshold value as a monitoring blind region, acquiring I nSAR data of the monitoring blind region, extracting ground surface deformation data, fusing the ground surface deformation data with the normal node data to generate a global continuous deformation dataset, carrying out space-time feature analysis on the global continuous deformation dataset to obtain a fused feature vector, and inputting the fused feature vector into a pre-trained disaster chain prediction model to generate a disaster risk thermodynamic diagram. By adopting the method, the prediction precision of disaster chain evolution can be improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU INSTITUTE OF GEOLOGICAL SURVEY GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUIZHOU GEOLOGICAL AND MI

title_en: Integrated authorized public alert and artificial intelligence aided news and information aggregation, creation and distribution system and method for its use
abstract_en: An artificial Intelligence generated multilingual alerting and news creation and distribution system comprising a software and hardware system and method for their use, that act together to gather, aggregate, curate, verify, content, characterize, distribute and disseminate news content including follow-up i.e. for broadcast media distribution and wherein that system can generate and incorporate AI read news content optionally in multiple languages as a feature of the system. The invention relates to a fully integrated cloud-based broadcast system which has the ability to address and interact with external sources, including for example, Federal, State, and Local Emergency Operation Centers, including, EAS (Emergency Alert System), and IPAWS (Integrated Public Alert Warning System), as well as more local alert systems. The system is designed to provide safety protocols which include audio fingerprinting which the system uses for further authentication and verification of the audio files in an aspect of the invention.

title_en: Mesh-Based Village Broadcasting Device and Method
title_ko: 메시 기반 마을 방송 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A message-based village broadcasting apparatus is proposed according to an embodiment of the present invention to solve problems of a smart village broadcasting system, including technical accessibility issues, a requirement for an Internet connection, privacy concerns, cost issues, and participation rate issues. The apparatus comprises: a speech recognition unit configured to recognize content spoken through a microphone by a user and convert the recognized speech into text; a message management unit configured to manage editing of the recognized text, schedule management such as setting a transmission time and retransmission, transmission and reception of text messages, reception confirmation and inquiry through a touchscreen, history management of emergency situation dissemination, message transmission/reception requests, expansion of additional functions (for example, situation dissemination when an emergency occurs through video monitoring, warning lamp notification during an emergency situation, etc.), and other functions; a message transmission/reception unit configured to manage transmission and reception of messages and processing of transmission/reception errors according to a request from the message management unit; and a speech synthesis unit configured to synthesize the received text into voice and output the synthesized voice through a speaker. In addition, the apparatus and method can minimize the amount of transmission and reception data by converting broadcast content, which is voice, into text and transmitting the text, and can eliminate dependence on Internet infrastructure by synthesizing the text back into voice at a receiving side for listening.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실 시예에 따른 스마트 마을 방송의 기술접근성 문제, 인터넷 연결 필요, 개인정보 보호 우려, 비용 문제, 참여율 문제를 해결하기 위한 메시 기반 마을 방송 장치가 제안되며, 상기 장치는 전달하려고 하는 내용을 마이크로 통해 말로하면 이를 인식하여 문자로 변환하는 음성 인식; 상기 인식된 문자를 편집하거나, 언제 보낼지, 재전송하는 등의 스케줄 관리, 문자의 전송이나 수신, 터치스크린에 의한 수신확인 및 조회, 응급상환 전파 등에 대한 이력관리, 문자를 전송이나 수신 요청하는 메시지 전송/수신, 추가 기능(예: 영상감시를 통한 응급상황 발생 시 상황전파, 비상 상황시 경광등 알림, ...) 확장 및 기타 등을 관리하는 메시지 관리; 상기 메시지 관리 요청에 의해서 문자의 송수신, 송수신 오류 처리 등의 관리를 하는 메시지 송수신; 상기 수신된 문자를 음성으로 합성해서 스피커로 전달하는 음성 합성 등에 대한 상기 장치 및 방법으로 구성된다. 이외에 방송 내용인 음성을 문자로 변화해서 송수신 데이터의 량을 최소화해서 전송후, 수신측에서 다시 문자를 음성으로 합성하여 청취함으로써 인터넷 인프라의 의존성을 제외할 수 있다.

title_en: Indoor natural gas leakage protection and alarm device
