abstract_en: The indoor natural gas leakage protection and alarm device comprises a device main body and a smoke exhaust ventilator, wherein the device main body comprises a natural gas detector and a pushing assembly, a micro controller is arranged on the natural gas detector, a wireless transmission end is arranged on the micro controller, the pushing assembly comprises a supporting block, a sliding rail and a motor, the motor is respectively connected with the supporting block and the sliding rail, the sliding rail is positioned above a translation sliding door, and the supporting block is positioned on the side edge of the translation sliding door and is in contact with the translation sliding door. When the natural gas leakage detection device is used, after the natural gas detector detects natural gas leakage, leakage information is transmitted to the micro controller, the micro controller receives the information and transmits the information to the smoke exhaust ventilator, the motor, the audible and visual alarm and the mobile terminal respectively, the audible and visual alarm immediately starts to flash and give an alarm, the mobile terminal receives the information of the natural gas leakage of the kitchen, meanwhile, the smoke exhaust ventilator is started to extract the gas in the kitchen, and the motor drives the supporting block to move on the sliding rail so as to close the translation sliding door of the kitchen, and the natural gas is prevented from leaking to other rooms.

title_en: Combination led lighting and danger detection lamp/fixture apparatus host, with a paired supporting satellite, including utility elements, and method therefore
abstract_en: The improved combination lighting-danger detection apparatus and system generally comprises a host device wirelessly paired with a network of remote sensing and utility satellites, where the host receives signals from the sensing satellites to extend its monitoring range, creates a distributed network by issuing commands to the utility satellites, includes audible and visual alarms, and transmits alerts across the network, and a base station that enables users to configure preferences, manage settings, test features and control operations through an application. With a series of such devices, networked throughout a building structure, provides a ‘whole-house’ complement to security, accessibility, and efficiency providing greater, danger protection, hazard warning, and utility operations, convenience functionality.

title_en: System and method for monitoring a dwelling
abstract_en: Provided herein is a system for monitoring dwellings. The system includes a server; a plurality of sensors located at one or more dwellings, the plurality of sensors configured to generate sensor data and communicate the sensor data to the server; and monitoring software configured to run on the server. The monitoring software is configured to process the sensor data and generate at least one user interface. Additionally, the at least one user interface is accessible through a remote compute device and is configured to display at least one of the sensor data and one or more alerts. Also provided are a method of monitoring a multi-unit dwelling using the system and a non-transitory, processor-readable medium storing instructions for executing the method.

title_en: Underground operator positioning and communication method and system based on RFID and communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety Internet of things, in particular to a method and a system for positioning and communicating underground operators based on RFID and communication. According to the method, passive RFID tags can be arranged on key nodes of a roadway roof or a side wall, unique position coordinate data are stored, an explosion-proof terminal worn by an operator obtains the coordinate data through scanning the RFID tags and uploads the coordinate data to a ground monitoring center through a gateway, and the ground monitoring center monitors the positions of the operator in real time. According to the invention, a traditional mine positioning communication architecture is subverted through RFID scanning and LoRa ad hoc network, a trilateral positioning algorithm and an IMU inertial navigation Kalman filter are combined, positioning errors of underground key areas are compressed, the coverage rate of blind areas is greatly improved, a ray method electronic fence and a continuous position point judgment logic are adopted, the false alarm rate of dangerous areas is reduced, mining equipment is stopped and operated, passive monitoring is updated into an active protection system, and full-chain closed loop in a mine environment is realized.
assignees: BEIJING XINGUANG MICRO ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning cable of integrated detection module
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent early warning cables and discloses an intelligent early warning cable integrated with a detection module, which comprises a cable conductor, wherein a cable core is fixedly connected inside the cable conductor, a connecting terminal is fixedly connected to the left side of the surface of the cable core, a monitoring optical fiber module is fixedly connected inside the cable conductor, an early warning fire extinguishing piece is arranged at the top of the cable conductor and used for early warning and extinguishing fire when the temperature of the cable core is abnormal, and the early warning fire extinguishing piece comprises a guide sleeve. According to the invention, through the transmission structure of the double-shaft motor linkage speed reducer, the sliding sleeve, the sliding rod and the concave plate, the powder spraying pipe, the temperature sensor and the flame sensor are driven to swing in a reciprocating manner, each cable core and the connecting terminal can be scanned, a monitoring blind area is avoided, the controller opens the miniature electromagnetic valve, so that fire extinguishing powder in the fire extinguishing tank is rapidly injected into the powder spraying pipe in a swinging state, the spraying range covers a plurality of installation positions, and the comprehensiveness of hidden danger detection is improved.

title_en: Alarm device for personnel tracking in specific area
abstract_en: The application provides an alarm device for personnel tracking in a specific area, which comprises a support frame, a marking rod which is rotatably connected with the support frame and can be locked to a first setting position and a second setting position, a power supply is arranged on the support frame, a signal receiving device, an infrared detector, an alarm device and a first indicator lamp which are used for receiving a marking signal are arranged on the marking rod, the power supply is conducted with the signal receiving device, the infrared detector and the alarm device through a control switch when the marking rod is locked at the first setting position, the power supply is conducted with the first indicator lamp through the control switch when the marking rod is locked at the second setting position, and the alarm device is controlled to give an alarm when the infrared detector detects that personnel enter and does not receive the marking signal. By locking the marking rod in different positions, different indications of the accessible state and the non-accessible state in the dangerous area can be realized. In addition, the entering personnel are detected through the identification signal and caution is carried out.
assignees: ZHONGYAN MEIFU ECOLOGICAL FERTILIZER IND CO LTD

title_en: Self-reaction time-delay alarm device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-reaction time-delay alarm device which comprises a self-reaction electric energy device and an alarm device. The invention can spontaneously perform chemical reaction with electrolyte solution, and generate current after a specific time to supply power for the alarm device to start alarm, so as to realize the effect of alarm prompt after the end of the pipeline tightness test, remind workers of timely dismantling the temporary blind plate after the end of the pipeline tightness test, avoid leaving the temporary blind plate at the pipeline butt joint position, influence the normal use of the subsequent pipeline and cause quality accidents, and have convenient and wide application without configuring an external power supply.
assignees: Hudong zhonghua shipbuilding group co ltd

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting floor drain device for underground smoke exhaust water and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting floor drain device for underground smoke exhaust and a use method thereof, which belong to the technical field of underground construction engineering, floor drain smoke exhaust modules are nested in grooves, and smoke exhaust pipelines are built at the bottoms of the floor drain smoke exhaust modules. The invention carries out structural transformation on the warning top plate and the filter plate in the floor drain smoke-discharging water module through the two groups of supporting ring frames and the matched hydraulic telescopic shafts, under normal conditions, the device is in a closed state, and under fire conditions, the device is in a starting state, the service life of the device is prolonged, the effect of quickly and conveniently dispersing smoke in a fire region is realized through the arrangement of a smoke-discharging water pipeline, the safety of a factory is improved, whether the smoke sensor/smoke flow sensor intelligent monitoring device is blocked or not is realized, the foreign matters on the upper part of the filter plate are cleaned by means of a foreign matter cleaning conveyor belt and a foreign matter discharging frame, and meanwhile, the foreign matters in the filter plate are cleaned through the through frame, so that the aim of automatically cleaning the device is fulfilled.

title_en: Intelligent read-write terminal of unmanned storehouse
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent warehouse, in particular to an intelligent read-write terminal of an unmanned warehouse, which comprises a main control module, a face acquisition module, an Internet of things sensing interface group, an audible and visual alarm module, a voice interaction module, an RFID (radio frequency identification) expansion system, a touch display module, a data storage unit and a wall hanging installation structure, wherein the RFID expansion system adopts four externally-connected circularly polarized antennas to be distributed in a T shape, multi-tag anti-collision reading is realized through phase control, a security linkage mechanism integrates a millimeter wave radar, a pyroelectric infrared sensor and an electromagnetic electronic lock, a modular wall hanging structure supports a VESA standard support and quick disassembly buckle, and edge calculation optimization accelerates face recognition and offline voice instruction processing through a NPU (remote control unit) of the main control module. The terminal solves the problems of large RFID blind area, slow security response and stiff deployment in the prior art, and improves warehouse management efficiency.

title_en: Film type pressure-reducing starting audible and visual alarm paster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a film type pressure-reducing starting audible and visual alarm patch which comprises a patch body, a first extending sheet body and a second extending sheet body, wherein the first extending sheet body and the second extending sheet body extend in two opposite directions from any position on the patch body, and the first extending sheet body extends towards the direction of the center of a blind plate. The patch is attached to the temporary blind plate, and can remind workers of timely dismantling the temporary blind plate after the pipeline tightness test is finished, so that the temporary blind plate is prevented from being left at the pipeline butt joint position, the normal use of the subsequent pipeline is affected, and quality accidents are caused.
assignees: Hudong zhonghua shipbuilding group co ltd

title_en: Mixer truck blind area monitoring and safe operation alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical engineering, in particular to a stirring truck blind area monitoring and safe operation alarm device, which comprises an audible and visual alarm and a mobile monitoring system, wherein the audible and visual alarm is arranged at the side of a copilot door of a stirring truck; the movable monitoring system is arranged on the crawling ladders at two sides of the tail of the mixer truck. The device can in time monitor whether someone removes in the visual field blind area of trucd mixer to in time remind the driver someone to pass through or step on the cat ladder from the blind area, notice driving safety, in time remind the operation personnel of step on the cat ladder to make safety precautions, can also prevent that the workman from adding water and record workman from adding water evidence, improve the security.
assignees: XIAMEN TIANRUN JINLONG BUILDING MAT CO LTD

title_en: Anti-seismic monitoring method and system for server cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake-proof monitoring method and system for a server cabinet, which relate to the technical field of earthquake-proof monitoring, and are characterized in that an electronic map of the layout of the server cabinet in a data center is obtained in advance, a multi-mode vibration sensor and a noise reference sensor are distributed in key stress nodes and surrounding environments of the cabinet, vibration signals and environmental noise signals are processed through blind source separation and self-adaptive noise reduction algorithms, so that a noise suppression coefficient Nsc and a comparison signal quality threshold Nth are calculated to confirm data effectiveness, effective data are decomposed through multi-scale time-frequency, an image neural network classification model is utilized to output an earthquake-proof event confidence level Cev, a comprehensive earthquake risk index SRI is further calculated, when the comprehensive earthquake risk index SRI reaches a preset risk threshold Tth, early warning and emergency response measures are triggered, the system further uploads data to a cloud database through an edge gateway to support retraining and large data analysis, and the earthquake-proof capacity of the cabinet is optimized, and planning and enhanced.

title_en: High-pressure weeding protection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-voltage weeding protection system, and relates to the technical field of weeding equipment. The high-voltage weeding protection system comprises four functional modules, namely a grating monitoring module, a signal processing module, an execution control module and an acousto-optic warning module, wherein the grating monitoring module comprises a plurality of groups of grating transmitters and receivers, a high-voltage copper rod is used as a center along a high-voltage dangerous area, the edges of the range with the radius not smaller than 15000V of safe discharge distance are arranged in a ring shape or a rectangle shape, a three-dimensional protection net is formed, the grating distance is not more than 30cm, and no detection blind area is ensured. According to the invention, the safety fence is formed in the area near the high-voltage rod at an extremely high speed, and the high-voltage main circuit is rapidly turned off by the intrusion of people and animals, so that the safety of people and animals is increased, the safety accident is reduced, and the electric shock prevention is required to be met at the edge of the high-voltage 15000V discharge area in the discharge process, so that the influence of electromagnetic radiation is prevented.
assignees: YUANSHI ZHEJIANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Excavator safety operation monitoring method considering visual angle blind area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety control of excavators, in particular to a safety operation monitoring method of an excavator, which is characterized in that visual angle blind areas are considered, visual monitoring data are collected through a visual auxiliary monitoring and identifying early warning system arranged on the excavator, radar monitoring data are collected through a radar sensor environment scanning and monitoring early warning system arranged on the excavator, safety operation of the excavator is monitored according to the visual monitoring data and the radar monitoring data, safety operation monitoring results of the excavator are transmitted to a remote monitoring and managing system in a wireless mode, visual field and safety of operators are improved, and potential collision and accident risks are reduced. Meanwhile, the safety operation monitoring result of the excavator is wirelessly transmitted to a remote monitoring management system, so that the subsequent analysis and the optimization of the working efficiency and the safety of the excavator are facilitated.
assignees: Shanghai dongjie construction group co ltd;SHANGHAI GUOEN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent detecting device for defects of home textile products
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent detection device for defects of home textile products, which comprises a frame, a conveyor belt, an image acquisition assembly, a light source module, a control device and the like. The image acquisition assembly comprises at least two industrial cameras matched with the annular LED light source, a control device is internally provided with a deep learning algorithm, receives images and detects defects, and the speed of the conveyor belt can be adjusted. The device is provided with a position sensor for triggering and collecting, and comprises an alarm module and a storage module. The method can eliminate detection blind areas, improve the detection rate and the identification efficiency of the micro defects, realize real-time monitoring and alarming and data tracing, and meet the requirement of digital quality management.
assignees: ZHEJIANG MENGKANUO HOME TEXTILE CO LTD

title_en: Excavator operation safety monitoring method based on visual assistance and laser radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing and provides an excavator operation safety monitoring method based on visual assistance and a laser radar, which comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring images of continuous frames in the excavator operation process through a vehicle-mounted camera and acquiring three-dimensional point cloud data at a plurality of moments through the laser radar; the method comprises the steps of obtaining target movement degrees of all areas, screening and obtaining a plurality of moving targets and obtaining moving sequences of the moving targets, obtaining target influence degrees of all the moving targets at all moments, obtaining comprehensive influence degrees of the moving targets, screening interference targets based on the comprehensive influence degrees, combining moving sequences corresponding to all the vehicle-mounted cameras to obtain interference sequences of the interference targets, and carrying out collision early warning through an audible and visual alarm according to the interference targets and the interference sequences of the interference targets to realize safety monitoring of excavator operation. The invention aims to solve the problem that the error recognition problem of the computer vision and the laser radar can interfere the accuracy of fusion results on blind areas and collision detection.
assignees: Shanghai dongjie construction group co ltd;SHANGHAI GUOEN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Old person falls monitoring and multiport linkage emergency response system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fall monitoring and multi-terminal linkage emergency response system for old people, which relates to the technical field of medical treatment and comprises the steps of performing noninductive acquisition on human body dynamic information in a dim light vision blind area environment, wherein a voice interaction verification judgment module comprises a far-field voice excitation unit, and a priority queue management mechanism is arranged to confirm a behavior perception output fall instruction. The invention realizes closed-loop management of fall monitoring and emergency treatment of the old, has obvious beneficial effects, effectively protects user privacy, obviously reduces false alarm rate and invalid scheduling of nursing resources, improves the accuracy and individual suitability of event discrimination, ensures that high-risk events are not missed, improves the timeliness and accuracy of emergency response, and provides safe, intelligent and humanized technical support for intelligent care and home health monitoring.

title_en: Application method of intelligent zebra crossing early warning system for visual blind areas of construction channels
abstract_en: A method for using an intelligent zebra crossing early warning system for a visual blind area of a construction channel comprises the steps of carrying out deployment and use on an early warning system comprising a high-definition camera, an AI edge computing box, an integrated controller and an IP network loudspeaker, firstly installing the high-definition camera to fully cover the blind area range, installing the AI edge computing box, the integrated controller and the IP network loudspeaker at a proper position in an office area, establishing communication connection between the integrated controller and the AI edge computing box and between the integrated controller and the IP network loudspeaker, establishing data transmission connection between the AI edge computing box and the high-definition camera, training and optimizing collected engineering vehicle materials by the AI edge computing box, immediately generating a trigger signal when an engineering vehicle enters a designated area, transmitting the trigger signal to the integrated controller, and controlling the IP network loudspeaker to start and close a voice program. The application of the technology can be used for knowing the conditions of personnel and vehicles constructing the visual blind area of the channel in real time, and avoiding collision accidents caused by the response delay of the visual blind area or a driver.
assignees: GUANGXI ROAD CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Railway line early warning method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source data fusion railway line early warning method which comprises the following steps of A, inputting a railway line to be inspected and a ramp map into an unmanned aerial vehicle management platform, making an inspection route, setting a flight task including time and inspection route sequence, B, controlling unmanned aerial vehicle to fly and inspect by the unmanned aerial vehicle management platform, carrying out image acquisition through a high-definition camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle during inspection, C, carrying out image algorithm analysis on the acquired image by the unmanned aerial vehicle management platform, determining the real-time position of inspection, marking an object when an early warning object is found, automatically generating early warning information, D, carrying out inspection on a discharge train at a parking platform, checking whether a left object of loading and unloading is left, and E, popping up early warning reminding by a control terminal based on each early warning information. The invention can realize unmanned aerial vehicle timing inspection on whether the railway line has barriers, personnel and animals, whether the station stock road empty car has foreign matters left, whether the side slope has landslide and the like.
assignees: CHINALCO LOGISTICS GROUP SOUTHEAST ASIA INT LUGANG CO LTD

title_en: Road geological disaster monitoring and early warning method integrating road segmentation and visual detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway geological disaster monitoring and early warning method integrating road segmentation and visual detection, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring data through real-time monitoring video of a highway or tunnel portal, reading real-time data flow by corresponding edge computing equipment, configuring a visual large model algorithm, S2, running the visual large model algorithm by the edge computing equipment to realize road pavement segmentation and acquire pavement segmentation results, S3, running the image processing algorithm by the edge computing equipment to detect foreign matters on the pavement segmentation results and sending the detection results to a cloud server, and S4, identifying the road disaster results and sending dangerous information to early warn by the cloud server according to the detection results. The method integrates advanced AI algorithm, high-performance hardware equipment and flexible cloud service, and constructs a highway geological disaster monitoring and early warning system with high efficiency, intelligence and sustainable development.
assignees: ANHUI TRANSPORT CONSULTING & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Environment temperature compensation audible and visual alarm paster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment temperature compensation audible and visual alarm patch which comprises a self-reaction electric energy device and an alarm device. The invention can start the alarm device to alarm after a specific time so as to remind a worker to remove the temporary blind plate in time after the pipeline tightness test is finished, avoid the temporary blind plate being left at the pipeline butt joint position to influence the normal use of the subsequent pipeline and cause quality accidents, and effectively ensure the accuracy of the delay alarm time of the audible and visual alarm by arranging the temperature compensation alarm circuit on the alarm device and compensating the actual output voltage of the automatic reaction electric energy device by using the temperature compensation alarm circuit so as to avoid the influence of the temperature environment on the electrolyte reaction of the automatic reaction electric energy device to influence the starting potential of the audible and visual alarm.
assignees: Hudong zhonghua shipbuilding group co ltd

title_en: Deep mine rock burst risk grading early warning and active pressure relief system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep mine rock burst risk grading early warning and active pressure relief system and method, which relate to the technical field of rock burst risk early warning, and comprise multisource parameter sensing, risk grading early warning, active pressure relief execution, intelligent control centers and data storage and interaction modules, wherein real-time data interaction between the modules comprises a distributed sensor and a mobile inspection robot, the risk early warning is divided into four stages, sensitive characteristics are extracted after data are preprocessed, active pressure relief comprises fixed point and area pressure relief equipment, a control center uses a redundant framework, an automatic pressure relief scheme is matched, and data storage is reserved for more than or equal to 5 years so as to support multi-system butt joint. The method improves rock burst early warning accuracy and pressure relief pertinence, realizes multi-module closed loop coordination, has high emergency response efficiency, reduces false alarm omission and pressure relief blindness, ensures roadway stability and personnel safety, and provides support for safe and high-efficiency mining of deep mines.
assignees: SICHUAN CHUANYOU ENGINEERING TECH CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Marine temporary blind plate with delay alarm function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine temporary blind plate with a delay alarm function, which comprises a blind plate flange and a blind plate handle extending from any position of the periphery of the blind plate flange, wherein a plurality of bolt holes corresponding to flange holes of a pipeline flange are formed in the periphery of the blind plate flange. The marine temporary blind plate is provided with a blind plate patch in an attached mode, and an alarm mechanism is arranged in the blind plate patch and used for conducting chemical reaction under the extrusion force generated by tightening of the pipeline flange to spontaneously generate current and giving an alarm after a specific time to prompt the dismantling of the marine temporary blind plate. The invention can remind a worker to remove the temporary blind plate in time after the pipeline tightness test is finished, so that the temporary blind plate is prevented from being left at the joint of the pipelines, the normal use of the subsequent pipelines is influenced, and the quality accident is avoided.
assignees: Hudong zhonghua shipbuilding group co ltd

title_en: Intelligent travel environment monitoring and emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent travel environment monitoring and emergency rescue system which solves the problems of environment information deficiency, health risk blind areas and emergency rescue hysteresis in the existing travel service in a breakthrough manner. The method comprises the steps of deploying a multi-source sensor network to collect scenic spot microenvironment data in real time, predicting environmental risk threshold change by combining an ARIMA algorithm, generating a dynamic protection instruction based on a user health portrait, and synchronously executing high-precision positioning, optimal path rescue scheduling (Dijkstra algorithm), medical facility navigation pushing and emergency contact notification by a system after a one-key triggering-four-dimensional linkage rescue mechanism-tourist calling for help, wherein average response time is 12 minutes, and speed is increased by 85% compared with a traditional mode. Meanwhile, scenic spot resources are driven to be derived from optimization decisions through fusion analysis of environment and passenger flow data.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system, which are characterized in that an original displacement time sequence and an environment temperature time sequence of a plurality of GNSS measuring points are regarded as multichannel mixed signals by introducing a blind source separation technology combining independent component analysis and physical constraint, periodic environment noise, instrument random noise and drift and a real slope deformation signal are effectively separated from a mixed observation signal by utilizing statistical independence among signal sources, and then, the separated source signals are automatically calibrated through correlation verification of physical quantities such as field environment temperature, and the like, and temperature effect source signals with physical labels and long-term creep source signals are accurately identified and extracted, so that accurate rejection of noise components and high-fidelity reconstruction of pure deformation signals are realized. Therefore, the accuracy of monitoring the stability of the geotechnical engineering slope in real time can be effectively improved, and a solid data basis and a decision basis are provided for early warning and prevention and control of the slope disaster.
assignees: SHANDONG SANJIAN ENG TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Complex high-order landslide risk dynamic identification system based on multisource InSAR cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to a complex high-level landslide risk dynamic identification system based on multi-source InSAR cooperation, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module and a data analysis module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for constructing normalized feature vectors representing states of all monitoring nodes; the method comprises the steps of determining a state prediction module, a risk assessment module and a hierarchical early warning module, wherein the state prediction module is used for quantifying the physical influence degree among heterogeneous nodes, the state prediction module is used for iteratively updating the hidden state of each heterogeneous node by adopting a space-time diagram neural network model and translating the hidden state into incremental displacement, the risk assessment module is used for calculating the risk precursor index of each heterogeneous node deviating from a normal evolution mode based on the hidden state and judging and issuing hierarchical early warning according to a preset threshold system, and the method effectively relieves the overfitting problem easily occurring when the data of a pure data driving model is sparse and remarkably improves the generalization capability and the physical interpretability of a prediction result.

title_en: Life auxiliary system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life auxiliary system based on artificial intelligence, which belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and integrates five modules such as vital sign monitoring and hearing assistance into a single device through modularization integration and AI cooperative control, so that the weight is reduced by 60% compared with the weight of the traditional scheme, and the problems of functional fragmentation and complex carrying are solved. The voice/gesture interaction improves the response speed, has high multilingual translation accuracy, provides convenience for people and also provides convenience for the old and disabled people. The emergency response bidirectional authentication mechanism reduces the false alarm rate and has strong cross-scene adaptability. The module cooperates with the open interface to realize multi-equipment linkage, and can be connected with a hospital monitoring system or an intelligent home. The system realizes environment recognition and state evaluation through multi-modal analysis, provides intelligent and efficient life assistance for the aged people and disabled people, and improves the use frequency and convenience.

title_en: Z-Wave-based air suction type smoke sensing detection early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Z-Wave-based air suction type smoke sensing detection early warning system which comprises a sampling detection unit, a dynamic analysis unit and a linkage execution unit, wherein the sampling detection unit is used for extracting air samples of a monitoring area through a multipath air suction pipeline, generating smoke particle concentration data through a laser scattering sensor, the dynamic analysis unit is used for receiving the smoke particle concentration data based on a Z-Wave protocol and generating early warning signals in a grading mode according to concentration gradient changes and a preset threshold value, and the linkage execution unit is used for mapping the early warning signals to Z-Wave network equipment and driving a ventilation system, a spraying device and an alarm to execute grading response actions. Through initiative inspiration sampling and Z-Wave wireless networking deployment, the early smog detection of a large scale non-blind area is realized, and the timeliness, the accuracy and the cooperativity of emergency treatment of fire disaster early warning are obviously improved by combining concentration gradient intelligent analysis and equipment grading linkage response.
assignees: HUNAN LIANFAN FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway shielding door safety monitoring method and monitoring system based on multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway shielding door safety monitoring method and a monitoring system based on multi-source data analysis, which are characterized in that a multi-source data set of a target subway platform is obtained, the multi-source data set is subjected to space-time alignment processing to generate a multi-mode monitoring data set fused with space-time characteristics, foreign matter identification processing is performed based on the multi-mode monitoring data set to generate a foreign matter monitoring result and foreign matter position distribution information of a shielding door area, and carrying out density prediction processing according to the foreign matter monitoring result and the passenger flowing data sequence in the multi-source data set, generating a passenger linear density prediction result and density change trend information, generating a safety early warning strategy based on the foreign matter position distribution information and the density change trend information, and transmitting the safety early warning strategy to a subway platform control system to trigger emergency response operation. The invention effectively improves the emergency treatment efficiency and the passenger dredging accuracy of the subway platform in the sudden foreign matter blocking scene.
assignees: CHENGDU VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF IND

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for analyzing satellite meteorological data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for analyzing meteorological data of a power distribution network satellite, wherein the method comprises the following steps of acquiring multisource satellite meteorological data and preprocessing to generate a space-time continuous meteorological element distribution map; extracting disaster related features through a meteorological element distribution map, constructing a first calculation model to train the disaster related features, outputting disaster distribution confidence intervals, performing risk space mapping on the disaster distribution confidence intervals and a power distribution network topological structure to generate a tower overturning risk assessment result, building a multi-stage early warning mechanism through the tower overturning risk assessment result, generating a three-dimensional risk map and deploying mobile terminal application. According to the invention, through a multisource satellite data fusion preprocessing technology, the problem of space-time blind areas caused by a traditional single data source is effectively solved, the collaborative acquisition and space-time registration of stationary meteorological satellites, polar orbit meteorological satellites and radar data are realized, and the problems of different satellite system resolution differences and cloud noise interference are overcome.

title_en: Blind spot warning lamp capable of realizing two brightness levels according to external illumination conditions
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle warning lamps, in particular to a blind spot warning lamp for realizing two brightness levels according to external illumination conditions, wherein the blind spot warning lamp comprises an upper lamp shell and a lower lamp shell, and the upper lamp shell and the lower lamp shell are connected by adopting ultrasonic welding; the upper lamp housing is provided with a plurality of groups of indicator lamps, and the upper lamp housing is also provided with a transparent mask for protecting the indicator lamps. The blind spot warning lamp can realize IP65 level waterproof without coating pouring sealant, has more stable waterproof performance, is directly integrated on the lamp housing, has no problem that the wire-to-wire connector needs to be fixed, is stable in plugging and good in shock resistance, provides two brightness levels, ensures that the indicator lamp is still clearly visible under the condition of strong illumination, avoids overlarge stimulation to human eyes under the condition of low illumination, and reduces uncomfortable feeling.
assignees: WUHAN YOULAIYI AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional intelligent blind guiding crutch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional intelligent blind guiding stick, relates to the technical field of blind guiding sticks, and aims to solve the problems that the traditional blind guiding stick does not have voice prompt and fall alarm functions and can not help the blind to distinguish directions; the intelligent blind person reminding device comprises a handle and a crutch rod, wherein the handle is connected with the crutch rod, a battery, a control module and an earphone cabin are arranged in the handle, when the distance between a Bluetooth earphone and a blind guiding crutch exceeds five meters through a module in the control module in the design scheme, the singlechip detects change, the audible and visual reminding is realized through the control of the buzzer and the LED lamp together, a user is helped to retrieve an article, the singlechip is used for connecting a light sensor with a light source, and when external light is lower than a certain brightness, the brightness of the light source is gradually improved, so that people around the blind person can observe the existence of the blind person.

title_en: Safety protection equipment with acousto-optic and radar detection functions for transformer and distribution substation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to safety protection equipment for a transformer and distribution substation with acousto-optic and radar detection functions, which comprises a shell, wherein a mounting base is arranged at the bottom of the shell, a circuit module is arranged in the shell, the circuit module is connected with a plurality of laser lamps and radar alarms, radar fixing holes are formed near the upper end of the shell, a plurality of laser lamp fixing holes are longitudinally and equidistantly formed below the radar fixing holes, probes of the laser lamps and the radar alarms are fixedly spliced with the shell, the circuit module comprises a controller, a driving circuit and a power module, the input end of the controller is connected with the output end of the radar alarms, the controller is connected with the laser lamps through the driving circuit, and the controller is also connected with a communication module and is connected with an upper computer through the communication module. The utility model is provided with the shell and the mounting base, so that the installation is convenient, the radar alarm is arranged on the shell to detect whether a foreign object is approaching, the plurality of laser lamps are arranged to emit laser when the foreign object is approaching, and meanwhile, the radar alarm emits sound to warn.
assignees: HENAN LONGYU COAL CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: A system and method for delivering aggregated animal care services through a computing platform
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (100) and method (200) for delivering aggregated animal care services. The system (100) comprises a user interface (10) accessible via web or mobile platforms, a login module (20) for user authentication and role-based access, a data collection module (30) to store animal profiles, user data, and service provider details, and a repository (40) for maintaining structured records of pets, incidents, and services. An aggregation module (50) analyses data to generate case updates, alerts, and recommendations. A communication module (60) enables messaging, group interaction, forums, and feedback. A services module (70) provides access to emergency response, adoption, rescue, medical services, donations, volunteer coordination, and lifecycle tracking. The system (100) supports integrated animal welfare management by enabling real-time collaboration and streamlined access to services for all stakeholders through a unified platform, enhancing coordination and continuity in animal care efforts.

title_en: Voice fingerprinting system for detecting hoax emergency reports
abstract_en: The data capture system, coupled to the emergency response system, captures speech utterances from incoming callers and uses those utterances to construct embeddings representing the captured speech utterances, the embeddings collectively representing a latent vector space and being stored in a data store within computer readable media. The query system communicates with the data store and provides an interface accessible to the call center operators that alerts a call center operator—substantially while an incoming emergency call is being received—the number of times a voice print substantially matching that of the incoming caller has been heard by the emergency response system before, or other useful metadata such as dispositions of past calls with substantial matches of the caller's voice.

title_en: Fireproof partition board of air conditioner heat pump
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fireproof partition board of an air conditioner heat pump, which belongs to the technical field of fireproof partition boards and mainly aims at the problem of lower safety of the traditional fireproof partition boards, and the fireproof partition board comprises a partition board main body, wherein a first fireproof board is arranged at one end of the partition board main body, an audible and visual alarm is arranged at one side of the partition board main body, a fireproof box is arranged on the inner side surface of the bottom of the partition board main body, a control module is arranged in the fireproof box, a wireless communication module is arranged at one side of the control module, a digital infrared temperature sensor and a smoke sensor are arranged at one side of the wireless communication module, and a buffer assembly is arranged at one side of the partition board main body; through the setting of digital infrared temperature sensor and smoke transducer, can detect the temperature of air conditioner heat pump and whether fire produces smog to among the accessible signal of telecommunication's the mode sent control module, control module can handle it and judge, and when the fire, audible and visual alarm can carry out closely warning and remind, and wireless communication module can carry out the long-range warning to the user.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN ZHONGWANG HARDWARE ELECTRIC APPLIANCE CO LTD

title_en: Tornado induced high-speed rail foreign matter risk early warning method integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tornado-induced high-speed rail foreign matter risk early warning method integrating multi-source data. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining and preprocessing multi-source data, further carrying out macro-, medium-and micro-scale vortex decomposition based on the cyclone vortex horizontal diameter, adopting a gating fusion mechanism to adaptively weight and extract fusion feature vectors, then calculating five risk factors of public early warning, cyclone probability, track invasion and overhead contact system hanging, introducing a fractional order collision model to accurately describe a nonlinear rebound process after foreign matters collide with the overhead contact system, and finally carrying out optimization solution on the constructed Hamiltonian quantity containing fitting items and space-time smoothing items through a quantum annealing algorithm, and outputting a global early warning grade which is smooth and optimal in time and space. The method solves the problems of low early warning precision and high false alarm rate of the traditional method, and remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of the high-speed rail operation safety early warning.
assignees: HUAFENG METEOROLOGICAL MEDIA GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Early warning device for high-voltage near electricity and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power safety, in particular to an early warning device for high-voltage near electricity and a use method thereof, comprising a main control core module, a control module and a control module, wherein the main control core module is used for receiving input data of all modules, analyzing instructions, operating a core algorithm and issuing control instructions to each execution module so as to realize cooperative scheduling of a whole system; the intelligent early warning device has the advantages that systematic breakthrough is realized through multidimensional innovative design, and the intelligent early warning device has remarkable beneficial effects that on the environment adaptation surface, through a self-adaptive calibration mechanism of multi-sensor data acquisition and GIS information fusion, the device can dynamically counteract environmental interference and match regional line characteristics, early warning precision is improved compared with that of a traditional device, and on the cooperative protection surface, a regional early warning network is constructed by means of Mesh ad hoc network technology, multi-node linkage response is realized by combining UWB positioning, and the safety blind area of single-point early warning is effectively eliminated.

title_en: Multi-element intelligent safety monitoring and early warning method and system for overrun structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-element intelligent safety monitoring and early warning method and system for an overrun structure, and relates to the field of safety monitoring and early warning related of building structures; the method comprises the steps of carrying out pressure-bearing simulation analysis based on structural design and material properties, determining pressure-bearing simulation results, carrying out sensor point distribution analysis on the pressure-bearing simulation results according to a monitoring index set to generate a multi-element sensor network, obtaining multi-element data streams, transmitting the multi-element data streams to a risk analysis cloud platform for risk identification evaluation to obtain a risk region set and a region risk coefficient set, and carrying out grade evaluation and grade early warning based on a grade early warning mechanism. The technical problems that potential safety hazards cannot be found accurately due to blindness in data acquisition and rough risk judgment in the existing safety monitoring and early warning of the overrun structure are solved, and the technical effects of improving safety guarantee capability of the overrun structure through comprehensive and accurate data acquisition and accurate and timely risk judgment are achieved.

title_en: Main ventilator stop automatic alarm structure based on coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a based on main ventilation blower machine automatic alarm structure for colliery relates to colliery safety technical field, including the drive box, the inside middle-end fixed mounting of drive box has double-end cylinder, and double-end cylinder and main ventilation blower's control unit electric connection, double-end cylinder's two flexible ends all are fixed with the slider, and the top of slider all is connected with the protection casing through the lug, the utility model discloses a control unit electric connection with double-end cylinder and main ventilation blower opens double-end cylinder operation through the control unit when main ventilation blower inner sensor detects equipment and shut down, drives two protection casings and removes to both sides, opens alarm host's operation in step, then the accessible two protection casings carry out effective shielding protection to alarm host when daily use to this device is in follow-up dismouting maintenance, then opens two protection casings and can take off alarm host fast, need not to dismantle the bolt again and improves work efficiency.
assignees: NANJING ZHIHUI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Induction blind road brick, trigger type blind stick and blind road cooperative system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic equipment, in particular to an induction blind road brick, a trigger type blind stick and a blind road cooperative system. The induction blind road brick comprises a blind road brick body, a triggering device, an induction device and a signal connection device, wherein a cavity is formed in the blind road brick body, the triggering device is arranged on the blind road brick body and used for receiving a triggering signal triggered by short-distance wireless induction, the induction device is arranged in the cavity and connected with the triggering device in a signal connection mode, the induction device sends out a warning signal after receiving the triggering signal, the triggering device is a blind stick triggering device, and the triggering signal triggered by the short-distance wireless induction is sent out by the blind stick. In the invention, a point-to-point identification relationship is established by using short-distance induction (magnetic, metal and radio frequency), so that 'only a visually impaired person carrying a blind crutch arrives, the brick responds', and broadcasting inundation caused by scene noise (raindrops, steps, baby carriages and the like) is restrained by the selective triggering, thereby avoiding information fatigue and urban noise pollution.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted and mobile platform ground disaster multi-mode sensing, alarming and risk avoiding method and system
abstract_en: A vehicle-mounted and mobile platform ground disaster multi-mode sensing, alarming and risk avoiding method and system belong to the technical field of intelligent traffic and geological disaster monitoring. The technical scheme is that a multi-mode sensing data matrix under a unified space-time coordinate system is constructed by integrating multiple types of sensors such as vision, laser radar, millimeter wave radar, positioning navigation device and inertial measurement unit, so that timely, dynamic sensing and intelligent analysis of multiple types of geological disasters are realized, and the problems of coverage blind areas, sensing loss and information island of the traditional monitoring means are solved; the system comprises a functional module for environment sensing, disaster identification, risk assessment, collaborative early warning, active risk avoidance and the like, and is used for collecting multi-source environment data, identifying disaster types and positions, assessing risk grades and executing risk avoidance strategies. The method has the advantages of real-time sensing, high-precision identification, dynamic risk judgment and active risk avoidance, and is suitable for road and non-road scenes of various mobile platforms in geological disaster high-incidence areas.

title_en: Safety protection system for expressway construction
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of traffic control systems, in particular to a safety protection system for expressway construction, which comprises an isolation frame and an early warning frame, wherein the early warning frame is provided with a battery, a speed measuring probe, a voice broadcasting device and a controller which are electrically connected, the early warning frame is movably connected with a sign board, the early warning frame is provided with a power device for driving the sign board to move, the front surface of the early warning frame is provided with a flash lamp and a prompt slogan, the back surface of the early warning frame is provided with a display screen and a warning broadcasting device, and the controller transmits vehicles and vehicle speeds detected by the test probe to the display screen and the warning broadcasting device. On the one hand, the early warning frame monitors the vehicle and reminds the running vehicle. On the other hand, the early warning frame also sends the vehicle information that monitors to the isolation frame, and constructor accessible display screen and warning report ware know the vehicle condition on the safe buffering road to make safety protection measure in advance, thereby improve construction safety.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENJIANG ROAD AND BRIDGE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Storage fire-fighting channel occupation-preventing warning device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-occupation warning device for a storage fire-fighting channel and a use method thereof, and the anti-occupation warning device comprises a mounting frame, wherein a sliding rail device is fixed at the top of the mounting frame, a driving mechanism is arranged in the sliding rail device, a transmission mechanism is meshed with the driving mechanism, the top of the transmission mechanism is in threaded connection with an alarm assembly, a hinge seat is arranged on the outer surface of the alarm assembly, a monitoring device is hinged to the hinge seat, a second driving mechanism is arranged at the output end of the driving mechanism, the top of the second driving mechanism is rotationally connected with a connecting rod mechanism, one end of the connecting rod mechanism is connected with the monitoring device, and a timer is arranged on the outer surface of the driving mechanism. Realize lateral shifting through slide rail device, actuating mechanism and drive mechanism realize rotatory, and second actuating mechanism and link mechanism realize monitoring device every single move, and cooperation timer starts regularly, enlarges monitoring range by a wide margin, reduces the blind area, and when monitoring device caught the occupation condition, alarm subassembly in time warns, effectively solves current device in the limited, the untimely problem of warning of monitoring range in big space storage.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: A wearable safety device system to deter rape
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable safety system (100) designed to enhance personal security through integrated biometric authentication, real-time location tracking, and multi-sensor monitoring. The system comprises a wearable vest (102) with a plastic waistband and a triangular plastic plate, featuring an adjustable elastic belt mechanism for variable girth. A fingerprint sensor (106) for authorized activation and deactivation, a motion sensor (110) and infrared thermometer sensor for detecting wearer presence and unauthorized removal, and a GSM/GPRS module (112) configured to transmit alerts and GPS location data to pre-stored emergency contacts. The system further includes an audio alarm unit (114) emitting sirens and distress messages, a multi-color LED module (116) for visual alerts, an emergency push button (108), and a rechargeable lithium-ion battery (118) with a charging slot. A microcontroller-based control unit (117) processes sensor inputs and manages communications, enabling energy-efficient operation and timely alerts. The device also preserves foreign fingerprints on its plastic surface for forensic use.

title_en: LKJ train operation monitoring and intelligent lookout collision avoidance system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent identification, in particular to an LKJ train operation monitoring and intelligent observation anti-collision system, which comprises an LKJ train operation monitoring device and an LFK intelligent observation anti-collision device, wherein the LKJ train operation monitoring device and the LFK intelligent observation anti-collision device are in mutual cooperative work with each other in two-way information, the integrated system has the functions of train beyond-sight observation and anti-collision early warning, has the functions of identifying and alarming flood and debris flow disasters in front of a track line, can monitor train operation according to the information of the front line, can control automatic braking protection of the train in advance when foreign matter invasion occurs, and can automatically upload driving conditions, alarming conditions and obstacle conditions to a ground server. Therefore, the system can solve the technical problem that the train collision accident caused by foreign matter invasion and perimeter invasion is not provided with an auxiliary early warning device because the lookout of crews in the driving process is controlled by personnel.

title_en: Blind area early warning method, device and intelligent helmet
abstract_en: The application provides a blind area early warning method, an early warning device and an intelligent helmet, and relates to the technical field of helmets, wherein the blind area early warning method comprises the steps of obtaining running state information and current navigation data of a target vehicle; the method comprises the steps of generating a corresponding dynamic driving route, dividing the dynamic driving route into a plurality of navigation sub-road sections, extracting road section gradient, road section curvature and lane quantity information in each navigation sub-road section, calculating a dynamic blind area range of a target vehicle, acquiring the current navigation sub-road section of the target vehicle, adjusting an identification sensor and an adjusting camera device according to the road section gradient, road section curvature and lane quantity information corresponding to the navigation sub-road section, generating corresponding detection data again, collecting image information of surrounding environment, determining potential barriers and blind area vehicles at the side and the rear of the target vehicle according to the detection data, the image information and the dynamic blind area range, giving an alarm if the potential barriers or the blind area vehicles are within a preset risk distance, and transmitting prompt information to a vehicle display screen.
assignees: GUANGDONG XIAOLANGXING IOT CO LTD;SHENZHEN ANQIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety monitoring method for waste slag field
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering safety monitoring, in particular to a safety monitoring method for a waste slag field. Aiming at the problems of more monitoring blind areas, weak data integration capability, early warning lag and the like in the prior art, the method constructs a set of multi-level monitoring system by systematically arranging displacement, stress strain and osmotic pressure sensor networks on the key positions of the surface, the inside, the side slope and the like of the waste slag field. By adopting a wired and wireless mixed transmission mode and configuring a redundant communication link and encryption measures, the monitoring data is efficiently, stably and safely transmitted to a cloud server, the server terminal performs fusion processing and trend analysis on the multi-source real-time data based on an intelligent algorithm, and the hierarchical early warning is automatically triggered through a multi-level threshold comparison mechanism. The invention effectively improves the perception precision, the monitoring efficiency and the early warning timeliness of the safety state of the waste slag field, and provides a reliable technical means for preventing and controlling geological disasters.

title_en: Railway line multi-scene three-dimensional foreign matter intrusion monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene three-dimensional foreign matter intrusion monitoring method and a system thereof along a railway, which belong to the technical field of railway safety detection, wherein a foreign matter intrusion composite sensing network is arranged on a protective structure of the railway along the whole line, real-time sensing positioning data are acquired, abnormal positioning positions of a protective net are acquired according to the real-time sensing positioning data, foreign matter intrusion detection data acquired at the same time by a corresponding arranged radar integrated machine at the same position are acquired, the category and track of a foreign matter intrusion target are acquired, a preset foreign matter intrusion early warning and inspection scheme is generated to a terminal according to a preset intrusion judgment rule, and the real-time monitoring and early warning of the railway foreign matter intrusion are realized by arranging a foreign matter intrusion composite sensing network consisting of sensing optical fibers and the radar integrated machine on the protective structure in a prevention and control maintenance area along the whole line railway.
assignees: NANJING PAI SMART PERCEPTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Edge and cloud cooperative driver safe driving behavior monitoring and management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver safe driving behavior monitoring and managing system with cooperative edges and clouds, which comprises an image acquisition module, a vehicle-mounted data terminal, a cloud management platform and a driver safe driving behavior managing system, wherein the image acquisition module comprises a camera arranged in a cockpit, a driver behavior monitoring camera, an off-vehicle blind area camera, a camera in front of a vehicle and a camera behind the vehicle, the camera is used for acquiring image information of multiple visual angles in and out of the vehicle, the vehicle-mounted data terminal is connected with the image acquisition module, the lane vision module and a millimeter wave radar, the cloud management platform is connected with the vehicle-mounted data terminal, a time-space alignment evidence package of a panoramic video of the cockpit and a video of the driver behavior monitoring camera is generated in real time and stored in a distributed file system, and evidence videos, photos, vehicle warning information and driver warning information are generated, and the driver safe driving behavior managing system is connected with the image acquisition module, the vehicle detection management unit and the cloud management platform and is used for managing driving behaviors of a driver.
assignees: BEIJING FANGSHENG YOUCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent notification confirmation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent notification confirmation method, which optimizes a system-level notification flow of intelligent equipment and aims to improve the delivery reliability and trackability of notifications. In order to solve the inaccurate assumption that the prompt is closed, namely reading is indicated in the prior art, the invention introduces a double-stage interaction flow, and explicitly separates prompt triggering and response confirmation and notification content display and confirmation. In the prompt triggering stage, the system prompts the user in various modes, and the user can quickly close the prompt. The system optionally records the closing operation and/or sends a receipt. In the content display stage, the system displays or plays the complete notification content, and the user needs to manually close to complete confirmation. The system optionally records reading confirmation operations and/or sends a receipt. The invention effectively avoids information omission and security risk, and improves interaction efficiency, content accessibility and audit capability of a notification mechanism. The invention is suitable for important scenes such as alarm clocks, medical medication reminding, public safety early warning and the like.

title_en: Highway dangerous situation early warning telephone notification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway dangerous situation early warning telephone notification system, which relates to the technical field of highway dangerous situation early warning and comprises a dangerous situation information acquisition module, a feature extraction unit, an early warning information generation module, a telephone notification distribution module, an intelligent voice interaction module and a feedback verification module. The system collects multi-source data through the mobile terminal of the patrol personnel, identifies the dangerous situation type and severity degree through a deep learning algorithm, predicts the influence range by combining a traffic flow simulation model, plans an optimal notification path based on an improved Dijkstra algorithm, and initiates intelligent voice early warning to the affected vehicle through an operator network. The system supports multilingual interaction, multimodal feedback verification and blockchain storage, realizes quick discovery, accurate evaluation and efficient notification of highway dangerous situations, and remarkably improves the safety and emergency response capability of highway traffic.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode dynamic protection net system and method for actively defending unmanned plane and foreign matter invasion on bridge deck
abstract_en: A multi-mode dynamic protection net system for actively defending unmanned plane and foreign matter invasion on bridge deck belongs to the technical field of bridge deck safety protection and intelligent monitoring intersection. The system consists of a carbon fiber protective net, a pressure sensor, an alarm and the like. The system adopts a three-stage progressive protection structure, wherein the first stage is a telescopic high-strength carbon fiber protection net and integrates pressure-fiber bragg grating dual-mode sensing, the second stage is a rotary aviation aluminum interception rod array and has the functions of flexible buffering and servo driving for 0-360 degrees interception, and the third stage is a combined barrier of a laser curtain wall and a millimeter wave radar and can be linked with an electromagnetic interference device to implement forced landing on an illegal unmanned aerial vehicle. Each layer of protection is visualized in real time through a bridge BIM model expression system, so that impact positioning, deformation evaluation, track tracking and multi-source data fusion are realized. The system remarkably improves the low-altitude safety protection capability of large river-crossing/sea-crossing bridges, and can be widely applied to various bridge types such as girder bridges, arch bridges and the like.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted panoramic camera system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a vehicle mounted panoramic camera system, which relates to the field of vehicle imaging technology. The system includes a camera module, an image preprocessing module, an image stitching module, an intelligent analysis module, an early warning module, a display module, a power management module, a data storage module, a remote interaction module, and a fault self checking module. The camera module also integrates a night vision enhancement component and an angle adaptive adjustment mechanism. The early warning module also includes sound warning, visual warning, and tactile warning units. The present invention achieves 360 degree full coverage through multiple distributed cameras. Combined with night vision enhancement and angle adaptive adjustment, it completely eliminates blind spots in the field of view and can stably collect high-quality images in low light and complex road conditions. After pre-processing and optimizing the stitching algorithm, the panoramic image color is consistent, without misalignment or stuttering, and the stitching delay is low, Strong environmental adaptability, capable of stable output of high-quality images under different lighting and temperature conditions, and a multimodal grading warning system that can alert drivers in advance to avoid danger.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ECONOMIC MANAGEMENT MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES HEILONGJIANG SURVEYING AND MAPPING SC

title_en: Alarm method based on 5G new call scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm method based on a 5G new call scene, which comprises the steps of obtaining alarm telephone information of a user, automatically calling an alarm AS applet when the user starts a 5G call function, requesting to obtain video and positioning data, collecting the video and the positioning data through a mobile call terminal to form extension data, transmitting the extension data to an operator terminal through an extension data channel of the 5G call, displaying the video and the positioning data by the operator terminal, carrying out voice conversation with the user, obtaining conversation original voice streams of the user and the operator, calling a translation function in the 5G call to translate the voice conversation of both parties into text information of respective languages of both parties of the call and displaying the text information on respective call terminal interfaces, and triggering emergency response on the terminal by the operator according to the alarm information, synchronizing the alarm information into each department system of the cooperative response and obtaining real-time progress. The invention effectively improves the alarm efficiency, realizes the cross-language barrier-free alarm condition treatment and multiplies the cooperative efficiency.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM FUFU INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire prevention warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a forest fire prevention warning device, which belongs to the technical field of warning devices and comprises a concrete layer, and four mounting plates on the upper surface of the concrete layer. This forest fire prevention warning device can provide the rest place for the pedestrian of passing through setting up the seat that links on concrete layer's upper surface, can sunshade and hide rain through the shielding plate, can promote the stability of forest fire prevention warning device structure through setting up four bracing pieces, when people sit on the seat of linking to arrange, the speaker of side about can carry out the continuous broadcast warning sign language simultaneously, people around the suggestion are fireproof, generate electricity through the photovoltaic board, and save to group battery's inside, then supply power to left and right sides speaker and two lights through group battery, promote energy-conservation, can throw light on through the light at night simultaneously, and then be convenient for provide the rest place to the pedestrian of passing, promote the practicality.
assignees: HUBEI CHANGLIN ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Leveraging an embedded subscriber identity module and sensor data for near real-time event detection and alerting
abstract_en: Aspects herein capture methods, media, devices, and systems for a device having an embedded Subscriber Identity Module (eSIM), wherein the device can leverage sensors, networks, and machine learning capabilities to identify a behavioral pattern of a user of the device and to identify a deviation from that pattern based on a qualifying event. Based on identifying a deviation from that pattern, the device may initiate an action based on that deviation, and the action may include communicating an alert that the deviation might be associated with a hazardous condition or event. The device may alert a user of the hazardous condition or event by communicating the alert in a mode that is sensible to the user, based on the user preferences that define the accessibility setting that is specific to the physical characteristics of the user. Such modes may include audible, haptic, or optical presentations of the alert.

title_en: Road curve blind area warning device and warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road curve blind area warning device and a warning method thereof, and relates to the field of road traffic safety facilities, wherein the warning device is configured to be a wide-angle composite warning device based on multi-source sensing fusion and risk study and integrated early warning and emergency linkage multi-mode, the wide-angle composite warning device comprises a vertical rod, a wide-angle lens, a warning component and an emergency response component, the vertical rod is a steel hollow vertical rod, the bottom of the vertical rod is anchored with a concrete base through an expansion bolt, the upper end of the vertical rod is provided with the wide-angle lens which is an anti-dazzle convex lens, and the rear side of the wide-angle lens is provided with the warning component; the blind area warning device integrates multisource sensing fusion, intelligent risk assessment, grading early warning and accident emergency linkage technologies to construct wide-angle composite warning device integrating curve blind area dynamic monitoring, accurate risk research and judgment, grading acousto-optic early warning and automatic rescue response, and can realize full-link safety protection from risk pre-judgment-active intervention to accident disposal-life rescue.

title_en: Wearable blind guiding auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wearable blind guiding auxiliary device which comprises a helmet, wherein a power supply module, a loudspeaker module, an imaging module and a detection module are arranged outside the helmet, a central processing module and a plurality of uniformly arranged vibration modules are arranged inside the helmet, the imaging module is used for collecting, detecting and identifying obstacle information, blind road information and traffic light information in a road in real time, the detection module is used for detecting the distance between a user and obstacles in different directions, the central processing module is used for controlling the loudspeaker module to broadcast the obstacle information, the blind road information and the traffic light information in real time, and the central processing module is used for judging whether the distance between the user and the obstacles in the direction is a safe distance or not, if the direction is unsafe, the vibration module in the direction is controlled to vibrate, and meanwhile, the loudspeaker module is controlled to carry out voice warning. The device provides double feedback of touch sense and hearing sense for the user, so that the user can more intuitively and timely sense the direction and distance of the obstacle, and accurate blind guiding of the user is realized.

title_en: Engineering is managed and is used safety warning device
