abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety warning device for engineering supervision, which relates to the technical field of engineering management and comprises a connecting shell, wherein assembly grooves are formed in two sides of the bottom end of the connecting shell, positioning shafts are arranged in the two assembly grooves, mounting frames are arranged on the two positioning shafts, and display panels are arranged on the opposite sides of the two mounting frames. This kind of engineering is managed and is used safety warning device installs two mounting brackets side by side in the bottom of connecting the casing, can realize being the splayed with two mounting brackets or be horizontal distribution, accessible support frame places ground when two mounting brackets are the splayed distribution, and warning through display panel demonstration relevant warning sign or picture, and cooperate the audible and visual warning of warning light area and speaker, play better safety warning effect, two solar cell panel sets up and can be used to charge when two mounting brackets are horizontal distribution, make this kind of engineering manage and use safety warning device's function more, the service scene is richer.
assignees: SHAANXI RUIXING PROJECT CONSULTING MAN CO LTD

title_en: Emergency alarm method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency alert method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the emergency alert method comprises the steps of receiving emergency information; and sending the notification message through the vehicle-mounted Bluetooth chip so that other devices with Bluetooth chips within the preset range of the current vehicle receive the notification message. The application realizes the reutilization of the low-power-consumption Bluetooth chip in the vehicle, improves the utilization rate of the low-power-consumption Bluetooth chip and the emergency warning effect, and particularly in the scene of blind areas such as intersections, compared with the traditional emergency warning method of whistling and flashing lights, the application obviously improves the emergency warning effect by sending the emergency warning notice to the outside through the low-power-consumption Bluetooth chip in the vehicle.
assignees: CHONGQING SAILISI FENGHUANG ZHICHUANG TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning analysis system and method based on intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring and early warning, in particular to an earthquake early warning analysis system and method based on intelligent equipment. The system comprises a terminal sensing and initial judging module, a self-adaptive network transmission module, an edge aggregation and verification module, a cloud control fusion and calculation module, a high-precision positioning and shock level calculation module and a final early warning instruction issuing module, wherein the terminal sensing and initial judging module collects data through a sensor array, utilizes a dynamic weight adjustment model to identify P wave characteristics and generate encrypted initial alarms, the self-adaptive network transmission module is used for constructing a dynamic self-organizing network based on a D2D protocol, and realizing multi-hop relay transmission of the alarms through electing relay nodes, the edge aggregation and verification module is used for performing space-time matching and cross verification on a plurality of alarms in a specific area, judging event authenticity and generating hierarchical early warning information, and the cloud control fusion and calculation module is used for fusing the event data of the area and professional bench network data. According to the invention, a high-density sensing network is constructed by utilizing mass intelligent equipment, so that the early warning blind area is effectively eliminated, and the earthquake early warning with rapider, more accuracy and more robustness is realized.

title_en: System and Method for Locating, Supporting, and Ensuring the Safety of Local Vendors through a Mobile Application Platform
abstract_en: System disclosed herein aims to provide users with an easy way to locate and support local vendors like taco trucks and tamale vendors. For a monthly fee, vendors can register and list their locations on an interactive map, making them easily accessible to users. The app includes a distress button that vendors and users can activate in emergencies to alert nearby app users and authorities. Core features include user registration with email verification, vendor registration with detailed business information, a searchable map interface for locating vendors, and an emergency alert system. Additionally, the app offers a sponsorship section where users can support their favorite vendors through yearly subscriptions and donations via a secure payment gateway. The professional and business-oriented homepage prominently displays the app's logo and name, enhancing brand recognition. Overall, Vendor Finder improves local vendor visibility, community safety, and user engagement.

title_en: Artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and an application method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ship safety management and artificial intelligence technology intersection. According to the artificial intelligent auxiliary ship safety management system and the application method thereof, when an AIS device signal is interrupted, a shipborne offline regulation library and a navigation database are called for localized analysis, management blind areas are eliminated, an AIS data packet and a device operation parameter packet are synchronized, and the regulation library is combined for cross analysis, so that single data misjudgment is avoided, risk identification precision is improved, classified instructions are generated and pushed through automatic verification of data compliance, manual dependence is reduced, compliance records are truly and timely ensured, an AI analysis layer updates the database according to instruction feedback, an AI model is optimized regularly to reduce misinformation rate, active early warning is realized, shore bases view data in real time and issue instructions, a crew terminal feedback result is broadcasted in a grading manner, sudden accident handling time is shortened, and emergency response speed is effectively improved.
assignees: WUHU ANHANG E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-camera collaborative analysis dynamic locking vehicle safety early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine inclined shaft vehicle safety early warning system and a mine inclined shaft vehicle safety early warning method based on multi-camera collaborative analysis and dynamic locking mechanism. The system adopts a deep learning technology to detect the targets of the vehicle and personnel, extracts the appearance characteristics of the vehicle through ReID networks, and combines a Kalman filter to realize the tracking of the vehicle across cameras and the judgment of the movement direction. When the vehicle is detected to enter a specific road section, the system automatically updates the locking state of the area, starts the personnel detection module, immediately triggers an audible and visual alarm and reports to the monitoring platform once the personnel is found to enter the locking area. According to the technical scheme, curve monitoring blind areas are effectively eliminated, the accuracy and response instantaneity of collision early warning of people and vehicles are remarkably improved, reliable technical guarantee is provided for mine transportation safety, and good practicability and popularization value are achieved.

title_en: Overrun detection device for transfer platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overrun detection device for a transfer platform, which comprises a portal frame, wherein the portal frame consists of a left upright post, a right upright post and a cross beam arranged at the upper ends of the left upright post and the right upright post, a plurality of mounting plates are symmetrically arranged on the left upright post and the right upright post, photoelectric sensors are arranged on the mounting plates, and the photoelectric sensors are connected with an alarm. When the photoelectric sensor is arranged on the upper part of the portal frame, whether the railway vehicle has an ultrahigh condition or not can be detected when the railway vehicle passes through the portal frame, so that an operator can conveniently and quickly judge whether the railway vehicle exceeds the limit height of a factory building. When foreign matters block the infrared rays of the photoelectric sensor, the audible and visual alarm signal is triggered, so that the aim of reminding operators is achieved, and the safety of the track traffic industry vehicle adjusting and pulling operation is improved.

title_en: Fusion perception-based safety early warning system and method for operators under shore bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety early warning system and method for operators under a shore bridge based on fusion perception, the system comprises a multimode sensing terminal, a UWB positioning base station, an intelligent vision assembly, an acoustic ranging unit, a data fusion processing server and an early warning executing device. And respectively acquiring multi-source position information of the personnel in the operation area through UWB positioning, visual identification and acoustic ranging, dynamically selecting a fusion strategy based on signal quality, and resolving the position of the personnel in real time. On the basis, a dynamic electronic fence taking the lifting appliance as the center is constructed, the behavior of an operator entering a dangerous area or a forbidden area is judged in a level mode, and a multi-level response mechanism such as audible and visual alarm, terminal reminding or quayside bridge action control is triggered, so that high-precision, non-blind area, all-weather safety perception and closed-loop early warning intervention of the operator are realized. The invention can obviously improve the safety guarantee capability of personnel below the operation of the quay crane and has good engineering applicability and popularization value.

title_en: Synchronous gear box with closed-loop transmission chain interruption alarm device
abstract_en: The application discloses a synchronous gear box with a closed-loop transmission chain interruption alarm device, and relates to the technical field of gear boxes. This synchronous gear box with closed loop drive chain interruption alarm device, the emergent transmission of drive mechanism accessible gear engagement realization moment of torsion under the trouble operating mode, guarantee hoist short-time operation ability provides buffering time for fault handling, compromise operation safety and continuity, through floating subassembly and middle drive gear direct assembly, but real-time perception drive mechanism atress changes, and the lever structure of cooperation gangbar can enlarge the tiny displacement, ensures the accurate transmission of fault signal. The travel switch is linked with the audible and visual alarm, the response is rapid, the warning is visual, the warning can be sent out when the closed loop transmission chain is interrupted, the core problem of the existing device that the fault is found lagging is thoroughly solved, the timely warning can prompt the staff to stop and overhaul, and the secondary damage of the residual transmission parts caused by long-term overload operation is prevented.

title_en: Pyrotechnic target identification method based on multi-path video stitching
abstract_en: The invention provides a pyrotechnic target identification method based on multi-path video stitching, and belongs to the field of forest fire monitoring. The problems of large monitoring blind area, isolated data, difficult cooperation and high false alarm rate in the prior art are solved. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing images acquired by a multi-camera hardware system, carrying out image feature detection and matching, finding out association information among sequences, eliminating mismatching points through image registration verification to improve robustness, generating high-precision image matching points, carrying out necessary scaling and rotation transformation adjustment on the images, carrying out accurate estimation on camera focal length and three-dimensional rotation posture of each image, optimizing alignment precision among the images on a global level and minimizing joints by adopting a grid optimization technology, seamlessly fusing optimized image data by adopting a texture mapping synthesis technology, outputting high-quality panoramic spliced images, and constructing a fire intelligent analysis module to realize fire detection. It is mainly used for forest fire monitoring.
assignees: HARBIN XINGUANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source fusion real-time traffic perception and emergency early warning system and method based on vehicle Lu Yun cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource fusion real-time traffic perception and emergency early warning system and method based on vehicle Lu Yun cooperation, which relate to the technical field of traffic management and are operated cooperatively by a vehicle end, a road end and a cloud system, wherein the vehicle end system comprises an information acquisition and transmission module, a local decision module, a data receiving module, an emergency response module and a data feedback module, and the information acquisition and transmission module acquires vehicle peripheral information through a vehicle-mounted radar and a vehicle-mounted camera. According to the invention, the vehicle end acquires local information such as vehicle surrounding barriers, adjacent vehicle dynamics and the like through the vehicle-mounted radar and the camera, the road end acquires regional information such as road traffic density, road damage, traffic facility states and the like through the road side camera and the sensor, the cloud end integrates the data at the two ends and performs air synchronization through the multi-source fusion technology, the defect of a single vehicle end or road end perception blind area is filled, and the complete perception of the traffic state of the whole road network is realized.
assignees: CHUZHOU SHUANGXIAO LINGLI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gallium oxide film double-array device group for flame detection and identification and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gallium oxide film double-array device group for flame detection and identification and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor photoelectric devices and flame monitoring. The device group comprises two functionally complementary and structurally independent arrays, namely an array of Ga  2 O 3  ultraviolet detectors which are grown on the basis of a high-temperature annealed sapphire substrate and have consistent orientation and are used for rapidly detecting the solar blind ultraviolet radiation of flames with high signal to noise ratio, and an array of non-oriented Ga  2 O 3  photoelectric synapses which are deposited on an unannealed substrate, wherein the array of non-oriented Ga  2 O 3  photoelectric synapses utilizes the plasticity caused by defect capture to realize the learning and classification identification of the space-time characteristics of the flames. In the preparation process, the Ga  2 O 3  active layers with controlled orientation and no orientation are respectively obtained by controlling whether the sapphire substrate is subjected to high-temperature annealing treatment or not. The two arrays can form a "probe-recognition" integrated solution. The scheme has simple structure, low power consumption and easy expansion, and is suitable for industrial security, combustion monitoring, forest fire early warning and other scenes.

title_en: Ship collision early warning method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship collision early warning method, a device and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of ship early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of importing dynamic information of moving targets around a ship, acquiring an original ship environment image from a plurality of paths of video sensors arranged on the periphery of the ship, and acquiring original distance data from a laser radar; respectively carrying out fusion analysis on each original ship environment image and each original distance data to obtain a target panoramic video and preprocessed distance data; and performing collision analysis on the target panoramic video, the preprocessed distance data and the dynamic information to obtain collision data. The invention greatly improves the sensing, detecting and collision preventing early warning capabilities of the periphery of the ship, realizes full-view coverage, solves the problem of monitoring blind areas, simultaneously realizes the fusion of multi-source data, improves the target recognition precision, reduces the probability of misjudgment and missed judgment, and realizes the intellectualization of collision early warning.

title_en: Blind spot inertia detection warning system
abstract_en: A blind spot inertia detection warning system comprises a blind spot detection unit, an inertia detection unit, a warning unit and a processing unit. The blind spot detection unit is used for sensing and generating at least one mobile object speed information corresponding to at least one mobile object. The inertia detection unit is used for sensing and generating body angular velocity information, body velocity information and body acceleration information corresponding to the riding vehicle. The processing unit is used for generating collision notification information according to the at least one mobile object speed information, the body angular speed information, the body speed information and the body acceleration information, and driving the warning unit to generate at least one of emergency warning audio and emergency warning light according to the collision notification information so as to remind surrounding people at first time, thereby striving for precious rescue time.

title_en: Intelligent forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The intelligent forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device comprises a multi-source sensing module for collecting physical environment information of a monitoring area in real time and generating fusion sensing signals, an intelligent analysis module for receiving the fusion sensing signals and generating fire grade signals containing fire probability, position coordinates and preliminary evaluation results, an early warning decision module for receiving the fire grade signals and carrying out simulation deduction on fire development situation by combining pre-stored forest geographic information data to generate comprehensive early warning signals containing fire spread prediction, risk area demarcation and treatment advice, a self-adaptive communication module for receiving the comprehensive early warning signals and selecting communication channels according to preset communication strategies and external environment conditions, and a unified strategy library module for providing parameter configuration signals of a fire identification model for the intelligent analysis module. The intelligent forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device can solve the problems of high false alarm rate, response delay and large monitoring blind area of traditional forest fire prevention monitoring.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG QINGAN STATE OWNED FOREST FARM MAN BUREAU

title_en: Communication tower risk monitoring method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication tower risk monitoring method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of environmental monitoring and disaster early warning, and the method and system provided by the invention have the advantages that a voiceprint signal is used for replacing a failure vibration sensor, so that the continuous monitoring capability of an ice coating period is ensured, a monitoring blind area of a traditional system under extreme weather is avoided, 1D-CNN time sequence separation operation is combined with framing windowing and a Mel cepstrum coefficient, raindrop impact noise and ice layer falling sound are effectively stripped, the unique low-frequency resonance characteristics of metal cracks are accurately extracted, LSTM-Autoencoder reconstructs a theoretical vibration value based on historical data, the false judgment of tower body deformation caused by ice coating weight is eliminated, the similar signal characteristics of structural damage and environmental load are distinguished, a dynamic weighting fusion strategy is used for giving the main weight of voiceprint evidence, the decision ratio is adjusted to be high only when vibration deviation is obvious abnormality, and the false triggering risk of single-mode detection is avoided.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGCHENG COMMUNICATION ENG SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Key person positioning method and system based on multi-mode data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of personnel positioning, solves the problems that the accuracy of positioning and state judgment of key personnel in the prior art is low and the consistency of positioning and safety monitoring is poor, in particular to a method and a system for positioning key personnel based on multi-mode data analysis, wherein a plurality of ground micro base stations are arranged in a target area, an aerial micro base station and a camera module are carried on an unmanned plane, the key personnel wear a positioning terminal bound with an electronic tag module, whether the key personnel needing to enter the target area wear the electronic tag module in a preset authorization list is judged, if yes, the key personnel are allowed to enter the target area, and then the next step is carried out, if not, an acousto-optic alarm is triggered, and the camera module shoots a field picture. The invention effectively solves the problems of more positioning blind areas and low vertical dimension precision in the prior art, improves the positioning precision of key personnel, can quickly generate and push rescue instructions when dangerous situations occur, and shortens the rescue response time.
assignees: UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG;CHINA RAILWAY MATERIALS GENERAL OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic alarm fire control spray set
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and particularly discloses an automatic alarming fire-fighting spray device, which comprises a water pipe, wherein the water pipe is connected with a fire-fighting spray head through screw threads of a screw hole arranged in the water pipe, and is characterized in that: the utility model provides a fire control shower nozzle is equipped with the dust subassembly in the raceway outside, the inside of dust subassembly is provided with filters clean subassembly, the outside of raceway is provided with alarm component, this kind of automatic alarm fire control shower nozzle through setting up filters clean subassembly and not only can reduce or prevent that foreign matters such as dust from getting into inside the fire control shower nozzle through the filter screen, thereby reduce and avoid the condition that the fire control shower nozzle appears blockking up even, simultaneously can also get rid of the dust on the filter screen through the scraper blade, so as to prevent the filter screen from blockking up, thereby avoid leading to fire control shower nozzle to go out unsmooth problem of water because the filter screen blocks up, simultaneously can change or overhaul the fire control shower nozzle through the setting of dust subassembly in foreign matters such as dust get into the raceway.
assignees: SHANDONG XINKE CONSTRUCTION FIRE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Bicycle internet of things system based on intelligent glasses and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bicycle internet of things system based on intelligent glasses and a working method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of bicycle intelligent safety. The system comprises a millimeter wave radar, a front and rear lamp assembly, a vehicle controller, a vibration handle sleeve and intelligent glasses, wherein the millimeter wave radar is arranged behind a bicycle, distance, relative speed and movement direction information of a rear vehicle are collected in real time, a vehicle approaching signal is generated and transmitted to the vehicle controller through a CAN bus, the vehicle controller analyzes the signal, then judges the three-level danger level of early warning, danger and emergency danger, sends corresponding instructions to the intelligent glasses, the vibration handle sleeve and the front and rear lamp assembly according to the level, the vibration handle sleeve transmits touch reminding through vibration of different intensities, and the front and rear lamp assembly outputs visual warning to the periphery through adjusting the light state. The invention solves the problems of blind areas of the traditional riding field, low warning efficiency and interference in riding, obviously improves the riding safety, and is suitable for various riding scenes.

title_en: Open pit coal mine slope monitoring and early warning method and system by means of multimode satellite fusion AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open pit coal mine slope monitoring and early warning method and system by fusing multi-mode satellites with AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source data; S2, data transmission in real time, S3, data preprocessing and space-time registration, S4, multi-band InSAR phase reconstruction and deformation field extraction, S5, multi-source data depth fusion, S6, AI intelligent prediction and hierarchical early warning. By adopting the method and the system for monitoring and early warning the slope of the open pit coal mine by fusing the multimode satellite with the AI, the invention realizes the monitoring of the millimeter-level precision continuous deformation field of the whole area of the slope, reduces the vegetation topography shielding interference, expands the monitoring range, eliminates the monitoring blind area, improves the data processing efficiency, constructs the deformation field with high reliability, and reduces the early warning false alarm rate.
assignees: XINJIANG INST OF INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Digital twin evacuation early warning method for barrier-free channel of booster station
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin evacuation early warning method for a barrier-free channel of a booster station, which effectively solves the problem of path planning misalignment caused by insufficient fusion of multisource perception data. Through the spatial data integration of the digital twin model, the usable state and disaster influence range of the barrier-free facilities can be accurately identified. The dynamic path planning algorithm continuously optimizes the evacuation route in the disaster evolution process, and prevents personnel from entering the affected dangerous area. The multi-mode instruction generation mechanism ensures that people with different physiological characteristics can obtain adaptive evacuation guidance, the detention risk caused by single information transmission mode is reduced, the real-time state monitoring and path updating function further improves the response speed and reliability of the emergency evacuation system, the geometric dimension and the space coordinates of facilities are acquired excessively accurately, the consistency of a virtual model and an actual environment is ensured, and the data support is provided for evaluating the availability of the facilities in a disaster environment by configuring material characteristics and accessibility parameters.

title_en: Intelligent blind guiding system integrated on sole and Bluetooth health management bracelet system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent blind guiding system integrated on a sole and a Bluetooth health management bracelet system, which comprises a sensor, a miniature vibrator, a GPS (global positioning system) locator and a controller which are integrated in the sole, wherein the system is of a concealed embedded design, has no difference with an ordinary sports shoe in appearance and avoids the tagging of a user, is integrated with various ranging technologies, enhances the environmental adaptability of the system, is adjustable in vibration intensity and frequency, improves the perception precision of the user, supports a self-adaptive algorithm, optimizes detection sensitivity and feedback strategies, realizes remote monitoring through a wireless communication module, ensures the safety of the user, has a learning mode, reduces false alarm rate, works cooperatively with a health management bracelet to realize efficient data synchronization and health monitoring, supports an emergency response function, improves the safety of the user, realizes indirect monitoring of gait and heart rate through a plantar pressure sensing module, and ensures the instant response of high-risk events through priority management by a notify notification mechanism.

title_en: Smoke detection device with alarm function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of smoke detection, and particularly discloses a smoke detection device with an alarm function, which comprises a base frame, wherein the base frame is provided with sliding grooves, the number of the sliding grooves is two, sliding tables are connected in the two sliding grooves in a sliding manner, the bottom of each sliding table is movably connected with a first ball, the outer surface of each first ball is fixedly connected with a connecting shaft, the bottom of each connecting shaft is fixedly provided with a smoke alarm, the smoke alarm is provided with a magnetic attraction assembly, and the base frame is provided with a driving mechanism for adjusting the position of the smoke alarm. The smoke detection device with the alarm function can flexibly adjust the position and the angle of the smoke alarm according to different space layouts by introducing the driving mechanism and the magnetic attraction component, and the smoke alarm can cover a wider area by adopting the design, particularly in a complex or irregular space, the monitoring blind area is effectively reduced, and the timeliness of fire disaster early warning is improved.
assignees: HEFEI ZHONGFU INDUSTRIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent limited space monitor and risk linkage control system based on end Bian Yun cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent limited space monitor based on end Bian Yun cooperation and a risk linkage control system, and aims to solve the problems of monitoring blind areas, risk perception lag, multi-system isolated operation, slow emergency rescue response and the like in the existing limited space operation. The system consists of an intelligent limited space monitor, an edge computing gateway and a ' An Yu ' central safety management platform, and achieves global perception, advanced intelligent early warning, automatic emergency linkage closed loop and efficient transparent emergency rescue command on all elements of a limited space through real-time perception on the ' end ' side, intelligent analysis on the ' side, quick response, overall decision and linkage control on the ' cloud ' side, thereby remarkably improving the safety level of limited space operation and effectively avoiding group death group injury accidents such as poisoning, choking and explosion.
assignees: BEIJING GUOTAI MINKANG SAFETY TECH CENTER

title_en: Mobile emergency cabinet for hotel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency cabinets and discloses a mobile emergency cabinet for hotels, which comprises a cabinet body for accommodating emergency articles, wherein the cabinet body is provided with a cabinet door with an electronic lock, a room card reader and a controller are arranged on the cabinet door, the controller is electrically connected with the room card reader to control the electronic lock, an infrared sensor for detecting foreign matter invasion and a collision sensor for detecting external force vibration are arranged in the cabinet door, an alarm is arranged on the cabinet door, the infrared sensor and the collision sensor are respectively electrically connected with the alarm, an anti-theft support for fixing an external automatic defibrillator is arranged in the cabinet body, and the anti-theft support is in sliding connection with the cabinet body. The emergency rescue cabinet solves the problems that in the prior art, a common mechanical lock is adopted to delay gold rescue time, safety is poor, and rescue equipment is easy to abuse, steal, lose and damage.

title_en: Remote control locking key storage box interlocked with simultaneous alarm, remote control unlocking key storage system, and disaster countermeasure support system using remote control unlocking key storage system interlocked with simultaneous alarm
abstract_en: To provide a remote control locking / unlocking key storage box, a remote control locking / unlocking key storage system and a disaster countermeasure support system linked with a simultaneous alarm for realizing the opening of a shelter or the like without delay when a disaster occurs.SOLUTION: In this alarm cooperation remote control locking / unlocking key storage system, a remote control locking / unlocking box 7 incorporates a GPS, and transmits a position coordinate to an alarm cooperation remote control locking / unlocking key storage system management server 3 by an Internet communication service 5. The alarm-associated remote control locking / unlocking key storage system management server has a function of automatically transmitting an unlocking signal to the remote control locking / unlocking key storage box with a simultaneous alarm alert as a trigger through the simultaneous alarm system 2, communicates with the remote control locking / unlocking key storage system terminal 4 accessible from a personal computer of a local government, a rescue support person related to a shelter, or a mobile terminal of a person concerned, and can browse a locking / unlocking state of the remote control locking / unlocking key storage box and remotely control locking / unlocking.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to enhance safety and privacy protection of communication between a patient and a doctor in remote medical care.SOLUTION: A system includes a biometric authentication part, an encryption part, a document sharing part, a translation part, and an emergency notification part. The biometric authentication unit performs biometric authentication. The encryption unit encrypts communication data. The document sharing unit securely shares a document. The translation unit translates different languages in real time. The emergency reporting unit reports an emergency situation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Blind area pedestrian acousto-optic prompter convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road blind zone pedestrian warning, and discloses a blind zone pedestrian acousto-optic prompter convenient to adjust, which comprises a bottom plate, the top fixedly connected with stand of bottom plate, the inner chamber of stand is provided with adjusting part, and the surface and the right side of stand all are provided with audible and visual suggestion subassembly. According to the utility model, the adjusting assembly is arranged, so that the display screen and the camera can be driven to adjust the height, vehicles and pedestrians with different distances can be shot, the shooting angle can be enlarged, the arrangement of the acousto-optic prompting assembly can be used for shooting vehicles and pedestrians at two sides of a curve and displaying the vehicles and the pedestrians in the display screen, so that the vehicles and the pedestrians passing through the display screen can observe the conditions of opposite roads conveniently, the buzzer is arranged, an alarm can be driven when the vehicles and the pedestrians are found, the vehicles and the pedestrians are reminded of being safe, and the position of the device can be conveniently moved by a user through the arrangement of the movable wheels, so that the application range is enlarged, and the use convenience is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU BEIDOUXING WEITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to realize quick and accurate information sharing at the time of a disaster, prevent diffusion of erroneous information, and enable multilingual support.SOLUTION: A system includes a reception part, an analysis part, an identification part, a warning part, a translation part, an acquisition part, a grasping part, and a distribution part. The reception unit receives a post from a user. The analysis unit analyzes and summarizes the posting received by the reception unit. The identification unit identifies the posted content analyzed by the analysis unit. The warning unit warns of the error information identified by the identification unit. The translation unit translates the posts in different languages. The acquisition unit acquires position information. The grasping unit grasps the safety information for each area based on the position information acquired by the acquisition unit. The distribution unit distributes the support needs based on the information grasped by the grasping unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for receiving an emergency alert mail; means for obtaining location information; means for searching for shelter information; means for summarizing and translating information using generative artificial intelligence; and means for interacting with a user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Real-time fracture characteristic parameter estimation method based on active fault data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time fracture characteristic parameter estimation method based on active fault data, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake early warning. The method comprises the steps of real-time receiving processing of strong vibration data, identification and binarization processing of a near field area of fracture of an observed earthquake dynamic field, construction of a general fault fracture template library, real-time dynamic generation of a specific fault fracture template library, introduction of a virtual station in a sparse area and an edge area of a station network, complement of an observation blind area through weighting fusion of an actual observation value and a GMPE prediction value, correlation matching of the real-time strong vibration observation data and a fault fracture template, searching of an optimal template, and outputting of current fault fracture characteristic parameters based on the optimal matching template. The invention adopts the existing active fault database to dynamically generate the fracture template to process the known fault fracture caused by the active fault, and utilizes the general template to process the unknown and hidden fault fracture, thereby remarkably improving the accuracy of real-time estimation of the earthquake dynamic field in the process of large earthquake fracture.

title_en: Safety protection system based on automatic transformation of air compressor and noble liquid pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine intelligent equipment, in particular to a safety protection system based on automatic reconstruction of an air compressor and a precious liquid pump, which comprises an upper computer, a display screen, a PLC (programmable logic controller) and an alarm mechanism, the alarm mechanism comprises an alarm unit I matched with the air compressor and an alarm unit II matched with the noble liquid pump, and the alarm unit I and the alarm unit II are respectively and electrically connected with the PLC controller. The utility model discloses can realize the safety protection to the core equipment air compressor machine and the noble liquid pump of mine enterprise, when realizing remote monitoring and remote control, the data acquisition of accessible sensor, further carry out early warning, fast processing and traceing back to the risk such as the axle damage, overheated, start and the human factor of air compressor room conflagration, the overheat, human factor and the noble liquid pump that probably take place to the mine enterprise to the level of safety control of mine enterprise has been improved.

title_en: Rock burst monitoring and early warning system for deep mining of underground mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock burst monitoring and early warning system for deep mining of an underground mine, which relates to the technical field of mining and comprises a sensing module, wherein the output end of the sensing module is communicated with the input end of a wireless network module, the output end of the wireless network module is communicated with the input end of a data acquisition module, the output end of the data acquisition module is communicated with the input end of an Ethernet module, and the output end of the Ethernet module is respectively communicated with the input ends of a terminal display module, a communication module and an early warning decision module. According to the invention, through the sensing module, the data acquisition module and the early warning decision module, the real-time acquisition, the adaptive coverage monitoring and the interference signal filtering of the multidimensional parameters of the rock mass are realized, the rock burst precursor characteristics are accurately identified, the problems of more monitoring blind areas, large data interference and low identification precision of the traditional fixed sensor network are effectively solved, and the real-time performance and the accuracy of the deep mining rock burst early warning are obviously improved.
assignees: SINOSTEEL SHANDONG MINING CO LTD;SINOSTEEL MINING CO LTD

title_en: Safety early warning pendant and alarm method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alarm which is suitable for safety precaution pendants of blind persons. The safety precaution pendant comprises a main board, an alarm control circuit, a microphone, a vibration motor and an LED lamp. The microphone and the alarm control circuit are connected with the main board circuit, and the vibration motor and the LED lamp are connected with the alarm control circuit. The main board can identify the environment sound collected by the microphone, and if the identified sound type is alarm sound, a control signal is sent out to start the alarm control circuit, the alarm control circuit controls the vibration motor and the LED lamp to work and generate vibration and luminous flicker, and alarm sound signals are converted into vibration signals and light signals which can be perceived by a hearing loss person, so that the hearing loss person can timely perceive the alarm sound.

title_en: Energy blasting physical risk coping-public emotion regulation and control cooperative method and platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy blasting physical risk handling-public emotion regulation and control cooperative method and platform, which comprise the steps of preprocessing edge layer real-time data by utilizing a risk analysis and early warning prevention and control unit, establishing a gas blasting risk database, constructing a standardized cloud database by utilizing an online increment learning unit based on multi-source multi-mode data, realizing batch automatic preprocessing, storage and calling of data, achieving the purposes of improving calculation efficiency and reducing human operation amount, crawling related accident news and public opinion by utilizing an emotion learning and analysis unit, combining a digital twin body with an emotion analysis process based on emotion prediction and intervention, and realizing public emotion prediction, staged psychological support and resource scheduling. The method solves the technical problem that the emergency response has a decision blind area due to the fact that physical risk early warning and emotion evolution analysis cannot be dynamically associated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring wearing of safety helmet and safety helmet validity period indication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the wearing of a safety helmet and a system for indicating the validity period of the safety helmet, which comprises a sensor unit for collecting the motion data of the safety helmet, and transmitting the motion data to a control unit, and analyzing the motion data by the control unit to judge whether the safety helmet is in a wearing state. The safety helmet wearing state is accurately judged and early-warned in real time through cooperation of the sensor and the control unit, the supervision blind area is eliminated, the safety distance grading accurate early-warning is realized by means of a positioning and distance algorithm, manual visual inspection is replaced, the operation safety is improved, the effective period is automatically managed by utilizing the timing and storage unit, the false judgment of manual missed detection is avoided, the protection performance is ensured, the multifunctional module performs data interaction and cooperative operation, the function fragmentation is broken, and the integrated safety supervision chain is constructed, so that the whole-flow management requirement is met.

title_en: Mobile voice alarm device for aluminum electrolysis workshop
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of voice alarm devices, and particularly discloses a mobile voice alarm device for an aluminum electrolysis workshop, which comprises a shell, a power supply module and an integrated electronic unit, wherein the integrated electronic unit and the power supply module are positioned in the shell, the integrated electronic unit comprises a main control chip, a wireless communication module, a voice broadcasting chip, a voice output module and a power supply module, the wireless communication module is electrically connected with the main control chip, the main control chip is electrically connected with the voice broadcasting chip, the voice broadcasting chip is electrically connected with the voice output module, and the main control chip, the wireless communication module, the voice broadcasting chip and the voice output module are electrically connected with the power supply module, and the wireless communication module comprises a wireless network card and WiFi. The alarm device aims at solving the problem that the prior alarm device can not accurately and timely receive alarm information in the use process. The utility model effectively solves the problem of the workshop voice coverage blind area, and ensures that patrol workers can receive voice alarm information of the electrolytic tank at each corner of the workshop.

title_en: Active safety intelligent prevention and control system for ship end sailing and berthing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship end navigation berthing initiative safety intelligent prevention and control system which comprises a ship visual perception module, navigation equipment, a video storage module, a visual calculation server, a terminal host, a network switch, a serial port server and a wireless module, wherein the ship visual perception module comprises a berthing visual perception module and a navigation visual perception module which are used for collecting berthing environment video data and navigation video data of a ship, the wireless module is used for transmitting the berthing environment video data and the navigation video data to a management platform in real time, the system can provide situation perception, navigation collision prevention and bridge collision prevention early warning functions in the navigation process, provide a ship side image, berthing collision prevention data and early warning information for a driver in the ship berthing process, reduce berthing blind areas of the driver, provide berthing safety guarantee, and furthest reduce collision risks of the ship during berthing and berthing.

title_en: Intelligent safety distance discriminating and warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent safety distance discrimination warning, in particular to an intelligent safety distance discrimination warning device which comprises a model construction module, a space calibration module, a signal receiving module, a distance calculation module and an alarm judgment module, wherein the model construction module is used for constructing a three-dimensional virtual model consistent with a physical space through analyzing a two-dimensional engineering drawing and marking a dangerous area boundary, the space calibration module is used for establishing a virtual-real space coordinate mapping relation, the signal receiving module is used for obtaining the real-time position of personnel equipment through an ultra-wideband positioning technology, the distance calculation module is used for dynamically calculating the shortest distance between the current position and the dangerous boundary, the alarm judgment module is used for generating an early warning or alarm command according to a multi-stage safety threshold, and the signal sending module is used for transmitting the command to an audible and visual alarm device. According to the invention, through automatic space modeling, accurate positioning and real-time distance discrimination, the problems of visual blind areas and subjective errors existing in manual judgment are effectively solved, and the operation safety in a high-pressure environment is remarkably improved.
assignees: ULTRAHIGH PRESSURE BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and distinguishing backward propagation thunderstorm based on wind cloud satellite No. four
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical fields of meteorological information technology and disaster weather monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring and distinguishing backward propagation thunderstorm based on a wind cloud satellite No. four. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing ground precipitation, satellite bright temperature and numerical mode environment field data, generating a spatially aligned multi-source grid data set, estimating cloud advection displacement vectors based on a 850hPa wind field of a numerical mode, carrying out translation correction on the satellite bright temperature field, identifying and communicating a cold cloud area based on the corrected bright temperature field, carrying out target tracking, obtaining cloud mass center tracks and area change sequences, judging consistency of a cloud rear side enhancement feature and a motion direction and the environment wind field by combining short-time strong precipitation events, screening a backward propagation thunderstorm positive sample, and taking a trigger station as a center to extract multidimensional features to construct a standardized multi-source feature sample data set. The application realizes the accurate identification and monitoring of backward propagation thunderstorm, and effectively improves the early warning accuracy and timeliness.
assignees: LIAONING METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY;Liaoning Meteorological Disaster Monitoring and Warning Center

title_en: Investigation system for house earthquake disaster risk hidden danger treatment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of house hidden danger treatment and discloses a house seismic disaster risk potential treatment investigation system which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a big data storage module, an AI risk analysis module, a dynamic early warning generation module, a multi-channel early warning module, an emergency response linkage module, a user feedback module and a visual management and decision support module. The intelligent monitoring system based on the multi-source data acquisition module is used for accurately capturing hidden risks, realizing omnibearing and real-time monitoring of house structure safety and environmental parameters, eliminating monitoring blind areas of a traditional single sensor, dynamically adapting to complex scenes such as building aging, environmental change and the like through AI risk analysis, improving early warning accuracy, solving the problems of high false alarm rate and the like of a traditional threshold method, realizing risk visualization and dynamic simulation through an intelligent platform integrating monitoring-analysis-early warning-decision full flow, and providing scientific basis for emergency command.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION SEISMOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Sign language translation and real-time communication system for special hearing-impaired people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sign language translation and real-time communication system for special hearing impaired people, and particularly relates to the technical field of communication equipment for assisting hearing impaired people. Functionally, the sign language translation mode captures hand and limb actions through a binocular camera, key points are extracted through YOLOv positioning and MEDIAPIPE, xLSTM time sequence modeling is used for identifying dynamic gestures, spoken voice/words are output through a transducer recombinant language sequence, the lip language identification mode adopts ChLipNet models to convert lip images to texts in a layered mode and fuse voice signals to improve noise immunity, and the scene linkage module triggers intelligent warning such as medical calling and traffic danger avoidance based on environmental sound classification and GPS positioning. The system realizes high-precision motion capture by non-contact hardware, solves the problems of sign language-spoken language sequence difference and environmental interference, and achieves bidirectional barrier-free real-time communication.

title_en: Hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the side end of the unmanned aerial vehicle is fixedly connected with a protective fence, the lower side of the protective fence is fixedly connected with a supporting column, the hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device further comprises a lifting mechanism and an auxiliary detection mechanism, the lifting mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the auxiliary detection mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the lifting mechanism, a hyperspectral-based forest disease early warning device stretches a hyperspectral camera into a branch through a balancing weight, a lifting shell, the balancing weight and a disc, information in the branch can be acquired at a short distance, accuracy and timeliness of insect disaster early warning are improved, and the hyperspectral camera is driven to rotate by the aid of an electric turntable, so that shooting and detection can be carried out on the inside the branch from multiple angles, blind areas detected at a single angle are avoided, data are comprehensively collected, and detection results are more comprehensive.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION FORESTRY RESEARCH INST

title_en: Combustible gas monitoring terminal
abstract_en: The underground pipe network environment is complex, risks are hidden, and due to factors such as pressure damage, corrosion and aging, imperfect overhaul system and the like of the pipeline buried deeply for a long time, gas is easy to leak, the blind area of pipe network patrol is difficult to solve by means of civil air defense, the gas patrol quality is difficult to guarantee, and the effective supervision of real-time discovery, real-time early warning and real-time response cannot be achieved on the potential safety hazard of the gas pipe network. Once leakage occurs, the leakage permeates into adjacent underground spaces of medium-high risk gas pipe networks such as underdrains, rain sewage pipelines and the like with other coupling hidden dangers, accidents are interlocked and the results are superposed, and serious casualties and economic losses are often caused. How to sense abnormality in real time, ensure that risks are found out in time and are disposed in the first time, and become urgent demands for safe operation of underground pipe networks.

title_en: Railway factory positioning safety helmet based on ultra-wideband technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway factory positioning safety helmet based on an ultra-wideband technology, which relates to the technical field of railway safety equipment and comprises a safety helmet main body and a positioning label assembly, wherein the positioning label assembly is arranged outside the safety helmet main body and used for acquiring position information of equipment wearers in real time, the positioning label assembly comprises a shell, a man-machine interaction button and a distress alarm indicator lamp are arranged on the front surface of the shell, a UWB chip and a microprocessor are arranged inside the shell, the UWB chip is in communication connection with the microprocessor, and a battery module, an alarm module and a communication module are arranged inside the shell. The utility model can solve the problems of poor indoor precision, easy slow manual fortification, large blind area of operating mechanical equipment, incapability of timely early warning danger and the like of the traditional method, can acquire the position information of a wearer in real time and high precision, has early warning and alarming functions, and improves the safety and management efficiency of railway factory operation.

title_en: Track cab apron
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a track cab apron, which comprises a main body frame, anti-slip panels embedded in the main body frame and fixed bottom corners arranged at four corners of the bottom of the main body frame, wherein the main body frame is a rectangular frame with four sides welded by hollow sectional materials, a supporting beam is arranged in the rectangular frame, clamping grooves are formed in the upper end of each fixed bottom corner, sectional materials at four corners of the main body frame are clamped on each fixed bottom corner, a fixed connecting part is arranged at the outer end of the lower part of each fixed bottom corner, the fixed connecting part is connected with a track steel rail through a fastener, lighting, alarming and protecting units are arranged on the peripheral side walls of the outer part of the main body frame, the track cab apron can solve the problem that sight blind areas are generated during operation of the traditional cab apron, can intuitively observe personnel operation above the cab apron and examine personnel operation conditions at the bottom of a pit, can prevent potential safety hazards from occurring during cross operation, the service cycle is prolonged, the operation safety coefficient is improved, the personnel operation risk is lowered, and the safety function of operation is fundamentally realized.

title_en: Intersection early warning method, vehicle, electronic equipment and program product
abstract_en: The application provides an intersection early warning method, a vehicle, electronic equipment and a program product, relates to the technical field of intelligent driving, and aims to improve the traffic safety of vehicles at a target intersection. The method comprises the steps of determining a target early warning strategy based on traffic rule information of a target intersection in response to the fact that a vehicle is about to arrive at the target intersection, wherein the target intersection comprises a blind area intersection and/or a traffic light-free intersection, and executing the target early warning strategy.

title_en: Method, apparatus and system for providing disaster message translation service
title_ko: 재난문자 번역 서비스 제공 방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양태는 재난문자 번역 서비스 제공 방법, 장치 및 시스템을 개시하고 있다. 상기 방법은, 재난문자에 대한 발송 요청을 수신하는 단계, 상기 재난문자를 적어도 하나의 외국어로 번역하는 단계, 상기 재난문자의 발송 대상 지역 내 위치하는 복수 개의 단말들 중 부가 서비스에 가입된 단말을 확인하는 단계, 상기 부가 서비스에 가입된 단말의 위치에 대한 측위를 수행하는 단계 및 상기 측위를 수행한 결과를 기반으로 상기 번역된 재난문자를 상기 단말로 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent wireless gas automatic fire extinguishing alarm host
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent wireless gas automatic fire extinguishing alarm host, which comprises a sheet metal shell, wherein an air circuit breaker, a power filter and a data concentrator are arranged in the sheet metal shell through a track bar, a liquid crystal touch screen is arranged at the outer end of the sheet metal shell, an alarm indicator lamp is arranged at the bottom of the sheet metal shell, an annular ring is arranged at the inner bottom of the sheet metal shell, and an air pressure control structure for controlling the expansion state of an adhesive ring is arranged in the sheet metal shell. According to the utility model, the communication address of the equipment can be independently modified at will, a batch debugging tool is not needed, the communication quality of the host 485 can be improved, the problem of 485 communication abnormality is solved, and secondly, after a line is led out outwards through the hole ring, the expansion of the glue ring is controlled through the air pressure control structure, so that the expanded glue ring seals the gap between the line and the hole ring, dust, foreign matters, moisture and moisture can be effectively prevented from entering the equipment through the wiring hole by the design, and the protective performance of the equipment is improved.
assignees: YUEQING INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH INST OF WENZHOU UNIVERSITY

title_en: Underground parking lot fire prevention and control treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire prevention and control treatment method and a fire prevention and control treatment system for an underground parking garage, comprising the following steps: collecting fire disaster characteristic parameters of a parking lot based on a fixed detection network; the method comprises the steps of collecting fire characteristic parameters of a parking lot, identifying fire abnormality based on the collected fire characteristic parameters of the parking lot, generating an early warning signal containing an early warning area, dynamically rechecking the early warning area based on the early warning signal to judge the authenticity of fire and confirm the position of the fire, executing fire extinguishing operation based on the position of the fire, and moving a damaged vehicle to a safe area after the fire extinguishing operation is completed. The method realizes the identification of abnormal fire disaster, effectively solves the problem of blind areas in the traditional detection mode, improves the early warning reliability, can quickly reach a fire source in a complex scene and execute fire extinguishing operation, transfers damaged vehicles after fire extinguishment, and effectively prevents the re-ignition risk.
assignees: ANHUI CAS ZHONGHUAN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: GIS switch monitoring and early warning method and system based on blind source separation
abstract_en: The application relates to a GIS switch monitoring and early warning method and system based on blind source separation, which belong to the technical field of power equipment state monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of collecting opening and closing vibration signals through a sensor array arranged on a GIS switch; the method comprises the steps of adopting a blind source separation algorithm to decompose a mixed vibration signal into a plurality of independent source signals which are strongly related to a specific physical action process, carrying out wavelet energy entropy calculation on each independent source signal, extracting characteristic quantities reflecting the states of corresponding mechanical parts, establishing a health state evolution model based on the characteristic quantities, and carrying out multistage early warning by tracking the change trend of the characteristic quantities. The application effectively solves the problems of mutual interference of vibration signals and easy inundation of fault characteristics in the traditional method, remarkably improves the monitoring sensitivity and early warning capability of micro faults, can accurately position fault components, and provides reliable technical support for realizing the predictive maintenance of the GIS switch.
assignees: FUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Cold chain logistics environment intelligent monitoring system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent monitoring system for a cold chain logistics environment based on the Internet of things, which comprises a vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal, a cloud management platform, an environment sensing module, a data preprocessing module, a wireless communication module and a cargo quality evaluation module, wherein the vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal is arranged in a transportation carrier and is used for collecting, processing and uploading cold chain environment and cargo state data in real time, the cloud management platform is connected with the vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal and is used for gathering, processing, storing and displaying the real-time data, so that key influencing factors such as attitude change, gas components and the like in the cargo transportation process can be captured in real time, monitoring blind areas are effectively filled, the real environment state of the cold chain transportation is comprehensively reflected by the monitoring data, in addition, the residual shelf life of the cargo can be predicted in real time, quality early warning can be sent out in advance, and management personnel can take intervention measures in time, and economic losses caused by cargo deterioration are effectively avoided.
assignees: BEIJING DAHEHENG GRAIN AND OIL TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for preventing campus from being overlooked by laser radar imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of campus safety protection, in particular to a method and a system for preventing campus from being overlooked by utilizing a laser radar imaging technology, comprising the following steps of acquiring 3D point cloud data of an environment in a monitoring area in a preset monitoring area in a campus, and simultaneously acquiring sound data in the monitoring area; the method comprises the steps of processing 3D point cloud data to generate a three-dimensional environment image, extracting first behavior features, processing sound data to extract second behavior features, carrying out multi-mode fusion on the first behavior features and the second behavior features to generate unified behavior feature vectors, identifying whether a super-resolution behavior exists in a current scene based on the behavior feature vectors, calculating corresponding behavior risk scores, judging whether a preset alarm threshold is reached, triggering corresponding alarm and early warning operations if the super-resolution behavior reaches the preset alarm threshold, and achieving non-invasive active monitoring of hidden corners of campuses without appearance privacy leakage and overcoming privacy limit and blind area problems of traditional video monitoring.

title_en: Heavy-load all-link collaborative monitoring and controlling system and method for national provincial road bridge
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for cooperatively monitoring and controlling heavy-load full links of national provincial bridges, wherein the system comprises a heavy-load source butt joint and prediction module, a dynamic distribution control module, a multi-source data fusion and damage assessment module and a cooperative management closed loop module which are sequentially connected, wherein the system accurately monitors by butt joint enterprise transportation data and predicting a time window of a vehicle reaching a bridge, and accordingly actively schedules sensing equipment, calculates damage degree caused by overload based on highway bridge engineering specification logic quantization by fusing vehicle load and bridge structure response data, carries out targeted risk assessment on special bridges such as single piers and low ratings, and finally automatically generates a grading early warning and repairing scheme according to an assessment result, and forms a treatment closed loop in parallel with multiple departments such as traffic, maintenance, emergency and the like. The invention realizes the full-link coordination from the source to the management, solves the problems of monitoring blind areas, damage attribution and response dislocation, and remarkably improves the heavy load safety prevention and control capability of the bridge.
assignees: INST OF HIGHWAY SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF YUNNAN PROVINCE

title_en: Autonomous patrol and intelligent navigation robot system for side inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous patrol and intelligent navigation robot system for side inspection, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots. The intelligent charging system comprises a hardware layer, a software layer and a cloud layer, wherein the hardware layer comprises a robot body, a charging pile and a peripheral module, the software layer is developed based on a native iBenRobotOS and integrates an autonomous patrol module, an intelligent navigation module, a multilingual interaction module, a real-time monitoring and position uploading module, an emergency response module and a system self-checking module, and the cloud layer comprises a service cloud platform and a management background. The autonomous patrol module supports 'fixed-point cruising', 'multi-point continuous cruising', a high-precision side inspection map is generated by combining with an SLAM mapping technology, real-time obstacle avoidance is realized by a laser radar and an ultrasonic sensor, patrol interruption rate is reduced to below 5% in a people-stream dense environment, uninterrupted coverage is realized for 24 hours, and patrol coverage rate is improved from 70% to 100% of manual work. When abnormality such as passenger gathering, self-service equipment failure and the like is detected in patrol, the camera automatically captures images and uploads cloud trigger alarms.

title_en: SOS intelligent medical monitoring crutch
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SOS intelligent medical monitoring crutch which comprises a crutch body, a biological filter, a microfluidic chip, an obstacle avoidance sensing module, a main controller and a state monitoring and emergency response module. The biological filter is arranged in the crutch body, sebum and metabolic waste in sweat are filtered, the treated sweat enters a color development area of the microfluidic chip to react with fluorescent dye, fluorescent signals are converted into electric signals through the photoelectric conversion component and are transmitted to the main controller, the obstacle avoidance sensing module detects the front obstacle and transmits the signals, and the main controller respectively compares the concentration threshold value of the biomarker and the safety distance threshold value to judge health abnormality or collision risk. The state monitoring and emergency response module receives the instruction to trigger an alarm and synchronously transmits the position and abnormal information to external software. The intelligent monitoring system and the intelligent monitoring method realize integrated intelligent service of health monitoring and auxiliary traveling, not only provide reliable data for health evaluation, but also make up vision blind areas to ensure traveling safety, and comprehensively meet the requirements of people with inconvenient actions.

title_en: Multi-mode barrier-free interaction system for safety medication management of visually impaired patients
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and discloses a multi-mode barrier-free interaction system for safety medication management of visually impaired patients. In the process of medication management, the central control and decision module is used for dispatching multi-mode interaction of touch sense, hearing sense and voice to realize guiding user operation, the safety rule engine is used for carrying out dose check and incompatibility judgment, the state feedback and fusion module is used for encoding the system state into a cross-mode signal to provide consistent feedback, the safety and emergency module is used for monitoring abnormal operation, the fusion mechanism is started for locking an interface and giving out a warning, and the whole system follows the closed-loop principle of guiding-operation-confirmation-feedback and replaces visual functions through multi-mode cooperation. The invention improves the accuracy and the operation reliability of medication management and enhances the safety of the whole process.
assignees: SHENZHEN LONGGANG DISTR NO 8 PEOPLES HOSPITAL

title_en: Rail line vision and radar imaging monitoring method for train control and automatic risk avoidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for train control and automatic risk avoidance by rail line vision and radar imaging monitoring, which comprises the steps of arranging a sensing unit along a rail, covering the rail line by the sensing unit to acquire a rail state, a line power supply equipment state and a surrounding environment, constructing images of a certain distance in front of train operation, constructing images around the train and behind the train operation, providing train visual images for ground remote control personnel, monitoring personnel or drivers, sensing farther distances and disaster danger in advance, calculating and identifying object distances and sizes by comparing with a reference image, parallax and stereo matching, and identifying foreign matter invasion, the rail and the line power supply equipment state and the surrounding environment, and automatically identifying rail danger and prompting an alarm or controlling the train to enter a safe state.

title_en: Atmospheric pollutant concentration monitoring and early warning method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an atmospheric pollutant concentration monitoring and early warning method and a system thereof, belonging to the technical field of environmental protection informatization and environmental pollution prevention and control, comprising a multi-element data acquisition module, an analysis early warning module, a linkage control module and a remote monitoring platform, the multi-element data acquisition module comprises an infrared spectrum absorption type gas sensor, an electrochemical gas sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor and a wind speed and wind direction sensor, and is distributed in a monitoring area and used for acquiring pollutant concentration and environmental data. According to the invention, comprehensive and accurate monitoring can be realized, the limitation of a single sensor is overcome through cooperation of the multi-principle sensor and fusion of dynamic weights, accurate and reliable monitoring of various pollutants in a full concentration range is realized, monitoring blind areas are remarkably reduced, advanced early warning and efficient closed-loop management and control can be realized, and the speed and accurate management and control capability of environmental pollution emergency response are greatly improved.
assignees: BEIJING JINGYI ATMOSPHERIC ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ship self-defined signal processing alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ship self-defined signal processing alarm system which comprises a relay control module, a 24V power input interface module, a silencing/confirming button interface module, an alarm signal output interface module, a test button interface module, an alarm signal input interface module and an M4 screw mounting hole, wherein the 24V power input interface module is electrically connected with the relay control module, the silencing/confirming button interface module is electrically connected with the relay control module, the alarm signal output interface module is electrically connected with the relay control module, and the test button interface module is electrically connected with the alarm signal output interface module. The device can be applied to the alarm function of equipment such as a ballast water treatment system, a desulfurization system, an energy-saving control system and the like, which is displayed at the position where the ship is on duty, so as to replace the problems that an AMS ship monitoring alarm system is old or can not have an interface, and a foreign service provider can not be found in time.

title_en: Safety anti-collision device of flat car and transfer car
