abstract_en: The utility model relates to a safety anti-collision device of a flat car and a transfer car, which comprises a car body, a driving assembly and a detection assembly, wherein buffer mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the car body in the moving direction, rollers are arranged at the bottom of the car body, the driving assembly comprises a driving source and a speed reducer, the driving source is arranged at the bottom of the car body, the output end of the driving source is connected with the speed reducer, the speed reducer drives the rollers to rotate, the detection assembly comprises a pair of laser range finders and a control module, the pair of laser range finders are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the car body in the moving direction, the control module is electrically connected with the laser range finders and the driving source, and audible and visual alarms are further arranged on two sides of the car body in the moving direction and are electrically connected with the control module. According to the utility model, the distance between the vehicle and the front or rear obstacle is monitored in real time by the laser range finders at the two ends of the vehicle body, and the warning signal is sent out by the audible and visual alarm, so that the collision accident caused by misoperation or blind areas of vision is effectively reduced, and the potential safety hazard is reduced.

title_en: Cable channel intrusion alarm driving-away device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable channel intrusion alarm and separation device which comprises a functional module, wherein the functional module comprises an intrusion monitoring module, an on-site separation module and a man-machine interaction module, the intrusion monitoring module is respectively connected with the on-site separation module and the man-machine interaction module, the on-site separation module is connected with the man-machine interaction module, the intrusion monitoring module adopts an ultrasonic ranging assembly and a pyroelectric infrared sensing assembly and is used for performing sensing monitoring on the moving distance and infrared rays of animals in a cable channel and forming intrusion signals, the on-site separation module is used for performing sound and strong light driving on the animals after receiving the intrusion signals and combining the sound and the strong light into alarm signals, and the man-machine interaction module is used for receiving the intrusion signals sent by the intrusion monitoring module and the alarm signals sent by the on-site separation module. The utility model can realize the full coverage of blind areas in the station, the full reception of information and the full driving-off of invasion.

title_en: Video security monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security monitoring, in particular to a video security monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of firstly identifying the face shielding state of a target through a face key point detection and object detection model, marking the shielding target as the target to be tracked, then extracting the skeleton, gait and other steady-state physical characteristics of the target, constructing a three-dimensional space-time consistency identity fingerprint model, screening candidate targets by combining space-time accessibility constraints among monitoring nodes in a cross-node tracking process, comparing transient apparent characteristics to calculate a characteristic offset vector, judging that the target is suspected to be avoided if the vector exceeds a threshold value, automatically intercepting key frame images before and after mutation, marking an attribute change area by utilizing a thermodynamic diagram, finally generating a structured space-time track record, and executing hierarchical acousto-optic reminding. The invention effectively solves the problem of avoiding monitoring by shielding the face or changing the device halfway, and realizes automatic evidence chain locking and accurate early warning of suspected targets.
assignees: LONGYAN TIANBO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile Application for Real-Time Legal Guidance, Interaction Documentation, and Emergency Response during Law Enforcement Encounters
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a mobile application system designed to provide real-time legal guidance, secure documentation, and emergency response during encounters with law enforcement. The system incorporates artificial intelligence-based speech-to-text transcription, contextual legal analysis, and actionable advice tailored to user interactions and applicable laws. A recording module captures audio in real-time, while a context analysis module generates situationally appropriate “Do's” and “Don'ts” linked to relevant legal frameworks. The application features an emergency response module for immediate communication with predefined contacts, location sharing, and alert generation. Encrypted storage ensures secure handling of recordings and interaction logs for legal admissibility. Additionally, the application provides jurisdiction-specific legal insights, scenario-based guidance, and curated updates on user rights, empowering individuals to navigate interactions with confidence while fostering transparency and accountability.

title_en: Plastic extruding machine material shortage alarm device based on photoelectric induction
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of plastic extrusion equipment and provides an extruding machine material shortage alarm device based on photoelectric induction, which comprises a photoelectric induction module, a material shortage alarm device and a material shortage alarm device, wherein the photoelectric induction module comprises an infrared emitter and a receiver which are arranged on two sides of a feed inlet of a hopper of an extruding machine, the receiver is used for detecting the light intensity change sent by the infrared emitter and converting the light intensity change into an electric signal, and at least one of the infrared emitter and the receiver is obliquely arranged. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the non-contact photoelectric detection technology is adopted to avoid the traditional mechanical abrasion problem, the gravity is conveniently used for guiding the material to naturally fall through the inclination installation, the shielding blind area is reduced, the high-temperature-resistant transparent protective cover is arranged in a matched manner, the surface of the protective cover is plated with the anti-sticking coating, the plastic melt is prevented from adhering to influence the light transmittance, and the stability, the environmental adaptability and the flexibility of the installation structure of the device are improved under the complementary actions of the two structures.
assignees: NINGBO QRUNNING KUKUN CABLE MFG CO LTD

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method, system, equipment and medium for mountain fire disaster prevention planning based on Beidou CORS cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire disaster prevention planning auxiliary decision-making method, system, equipment and medium based on Beidou CORS clusters, belongs to the technical field of mountain fire disaster prevention of power transmission lines, and aims to realize accurate dynamic evaluation of mountain fire risks and intelligent auxiliary decision-making of power transmission line planning by fusing high-precision positioning and global sensing capabilities of Beidou CORS clusters, multi-source environment data and intelligent algorithms, effectively overcome the defects of the traditional mountain fire prevention technology in aspects of large monitoring blind areas, early warning lag, passive prevention and control and the like, remarkably improve the identification precision of mountain fire hidden danger, updating timeliness of risk grades and scientificity of line avoidance and pole height design, thereby enhancing the capability of the power transmission lines in resisting the mountain fire disasters, reducing tripping and equipment damage risks and guaranteeing safe and stable operation of a power grid.
